notes.title: 2025.09.24 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Ballers!

We're excited to bring you our most recent updates today. Please check the
details below.

[b][color=orange][System][/color][/b]

[b][color=gold]1. Athenix Team: Vale & Stella step onto the court![/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/949b24f21e3b1852dcdcb7a2ebf19d63fd4d0cd4.png[/img]
Athenix welcomes two new stars to the court—Vale and Stella! 
Vale and Stella embody the true spirit of Athenix. Vale showcases sharp
instincts and calculated precision, while Stella brings fearless creativity
and boundless energy to every moment.
Together, they represent the future of Athenix, ready to make their mark
on FreeStyle 2!
Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/514096230384533668?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view[/url]

[b][color=orange][Event][/color][/b]

[b][color=gold]1. Athenix PICK UP Event[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b824f1899c7f75b5792ccaa1bab739478c7bb629.png[/img]
A new chapter unfolds on the court! The Athenix Team welcomes
Vale and Stella, two forces destined to shift the balance of the game!
And now’s your chance to bring their brilliance to your roster!
Check out the Pick Up Summon Event and recruit Vale and Stella to your
team today!
Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/514096230384533666?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/[/url]

[b][color=gold]2. Athenix Startup Dash[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/975dc9cd872b61b76ee9a3b2b9bbab3a2d6f0dae.png[/img]
The stage is set for Athenix’s brightest stars—Vale and Stella have joined the game! 
Celebrate their arrival with the Athenix Start Up Dash event!
Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/514096230384533664?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/[/url]

[b][color=gold]3. Athenix Item Collection[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/675e1eef4fbf7c2189d341fb2913b90d47cdb3fd.png[/img]
Take your Freestyle 2 experience to the next level with this limited-time
opportunity!
Collect rare Stella Limited-Time symbols and unlock a premium
High-end Vale and Stella Character Coupon.
Stand out on the court and showcase your elite style with this must-have
reward! Don’t miss your chance to shine and leave everyone in awe!
Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/514096230384533662?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/[/url]

[b][color=gold]4. Arcana Package Discount Event[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5754b8eb7bf9dfcc697aee3198a0606a661e0b1e.png[/img]
The Athenix Team brings a dazzling twist—Vale and Stella have arrived, and so has the Sparkling Arcana Shop!
Enjoy shining discounts to level up your squad!
Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/514096230384533660?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/[/url]

[b][color=gold]5. Returning User Special Event![/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2e852dcdfcc9086ae498dc2feda185c0317f8632.png[/img]
Been away from the court for a while? It’s the perfect time to make your
comeback—because we’ve got a stack of rewards just for you! 
Log in, stamp your attendance, and claim rewards every day! 
The more you show up, the bigger the bonuses you’ll score!
Link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/514096230384533674?l=english]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/[/url]

[b][color=gold]6. The Infinite Machine[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/94df14262351b95620f1da89ebe7c05c0099b4d2.png[/img]
Step into the future with The Infinite Machine event!
This is your chance to upgrade your gear and push its limits like never before!
Enhance any of the available items and make them yours to keep!

[b][color=gold]7. Event Pass: Common Pass[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bea77a33bf2bab0fafde2dd4fb834528cea504b5.png[/img]
Play hard, chill harder. The rewards are melting hot!
Play intensely, unwind completely, and dive into rewards that are blazing hot and designed to make every effort count.

[b][color=gold]8. Yuna’s 24-Hour Convenience Store[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d9acc9644b8e705feb95d777e2027c131d5ec728.png[/img]

The doors never close, the shelves are stacked with treasures, and Yuna’s

From exclusive deals to must-have goodies, this isn’t your ordinary

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!
The more you contribute, the bigger the benefits—so dive in, participate,
and stack up those rewards!
Don’t miss this chance—gear up, aim high, and seize the ultimate rewards!

[b][color=gold]10. The Genesis of Cosmos: Light Fragments[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ca00c8fc06327394d0a200f7f9cf0cb9300d886d.png[/img]
The stars align once more, bringing you the Genesis of Cosmos: Light! 
An event that will immerse you in the mesmerizing world of the
Cosmos, where each draw reveals a piece of the galaxy waiting to be claimed!
Will you get your hands on the most coveted fragments? It's all about strategy, probability, and the thrill of the unknown!

[b][color=gold]11. Lumi's Bonus Shop[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/91dc9973cbd032d78b017202d498a84e3da15e8d.png[/img]
Missed grabbing that must-have item? No worries! Lumi’s Bonus Shop has
you covered!
Trade your event items for the rewards you really want at the Event Exchange Shop!
Packed with exclusive picks from Yuna’s 24-Hour Convenience Store,

including the Limited-time symbols for the new characters, Vale and Stella.

Thank you everyone, and we look forward to giving you all a much better game

notes.title: The Genesis of Cosmos: Light Fragments
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9d78ef3ca577b6b6d9729558f0a7dfad8c3fd227.png[/img]

The stars align once more, bringing you the Genesis of Cosmos: Light! 
 
An event that will immerse you in the mesmerizing world of the
Cosmos, where each draw reveals a piece of the galaxy waiting to be claimed!
 
Will you get your hands on the most coveted fragments? It's all about strategy,
probability, and the thrill of the unknown!
 
Event Period:
2025/09/24 ~ 09/30 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26423521eaed17ce19698ca68950b6f3c3d041cd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c55e5d4cad4d1f30c662d4e8e4a8d7f17d2995ff.png[/img]

Event Guide
 
[1] Select your desired 1st item by clicking the [+] button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0f1721bce8781c90d77f103c08d2784b2bbe51db.gif[/img]

[2] You can acquire one item per draw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/98a061443a826e0f6075fbe8bd8eba421d941db0.gif[/img]

[3] Acquired items are excluded, and their probabilities are evenly
redistributed among the remaining items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/caa5979cc32b85bb675ef7d5a4784849cae85add.gif[/img]

Even Distribution of Acquired Item Probabilities
> Acquired item probabilities are excluded.
> The excluded probabilities are evenly redistributed among the
remaining items.
> Items fully acquired up to the set bundle quantity cannot be obtained again.
> Except for the first draw, item probabilities are evenly redistributed, altering
their appearance rates.
 
Number of Wishing Tickets Consumed Per Draw
> Draws 1-4: 1 ticket consumed
> Draws 5-9: 2 tickets consumed
> Draws 10-14: 3 tickets consumed
> Draws 15-17: 4 tickets consumed
> Draw 18: 5 tickets consumed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07bf13f11734f2a52c7c2678386d1dc82a2e1264.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/39e67bede712deb7e1b8bcbaf7aa53bf06983248.png[/img]

 
Bundle Quantity
> The bundled quantity is the set quantity for the item.
> Probabilities are set per bundle item.
→ If Item A has a 5% probability and there are 2 bundles, the probability
is set to 10%.

> The bundle quantity is displayed on the item icon.
→ x00' = number of items obtained per draw
→ [00] = set quantity of 'x00 items'
→ Example: '[02] Sub Atts x10' means 10 Sub Atts must be acquired
twice to be removed.
 
If You Have Acquired the 1st Item
> If you have obtained the 1st item, you can no longer acquire the
remaining items. 
> You must reselect the desired 1st item to continue the gacha.

Additional Notes
> Wishing Tickets can be purchased by clicking the [+] button in the
top-right corner. 
> Character-restricted items are sent to the locker, and others are sent
to the Gift box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d97fa52f1bf4f0b8f2dcddafd1764f60294ca786.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0c11df5dc7d888906bd66e379f3f6713fd4a98b1.gif[/img]


Rainbow Unicorn Outfit Preview (M/F)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6ba81ef3f1cbbf3ca3f4ca156654b051aff715aa.gif[/img]


=================================================

The cosmos awaits, and the fragments are yours for the taking. Don’t miss
out on the chance to complete your collection of light and claim the universe’s
hidden treasures!

Thank you for your continued support.

- FreeStyle2 Team

notes.title: Fill & Benefit [F&B] Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02f6b576f88898550a894aa97f4e20055102b23.png[/img]

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!

The more you contribute, the bigger the benefits—so dive in, participate,
and stack up those rewards!

Don’t miss this chance—gear up, aim high, and seize the ultimate rewards!

Event Period:
2025/09/24 00:00 ~ 10/07 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0f2359205c94c33a97bac1e9bf182a3c45e6234b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ba413ed3f76ba1f96abd1072a3f1913b0ba6730.png[/img]

How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products
before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c4975adad2a80efe721ed10546ecde40a306cebb.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.


[3] These products have already been discounted once.
You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/959645bfeff9e60ffb5fb5c8da7f54001051bbd0.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus
discount rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the
existing discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a
package containing the products of your choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your Gift Box.

*TIP
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
(If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the
product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
*For more information, check the Benefits tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

What Are Benefits?
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by
purchasing products with bonus discounts!
Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/dce5e4dd4012ada16200f24068252681af16847b.png[/img]

What Is a Set Product?
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards
multiple times until you reach the specified limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ac7e2495260849bf88786eb9923f5e2126158222.gif[/img]

What Is a Bonus Discount Product?
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products
along with other products to receive bonus discounts.
Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/49a55981ebb8c1b7b5e0bad5f21a2faaeb55a105.gif[/img]

[Buff Setup and Usage Guide]

Step 1: Buff Registration
→ Register buffs in 4 slots using the [Buff Settings] tab
→ Drag or click the buffs from the buff list to register them in a slot
(Previously registered buffs cannot be duplicated)
→ Right-click on a registered slot to remove the buff
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2811182a675a91fd3505a14ef484b349818282cf.png[/img]

Step 2: Buff Cooldown Check
→ Once a buff is registered in a slot, its cooldown will automatically
display below the slot
→ The fewer the empty slots you have, the shorter the buff's cooldown
→ Each slot can have Auto-Use toggled "ON/OFF' individually. When ON, you
can specify if the buff should activate Always / Offense Turn / Defense Turn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/192b9e5535566a4bddcc17d01998116f5ed1897e.png[/img]

Step 3: Buff Usage
→ Press {SpaceBar} during a match to activate the buff slots.
→ While active, press 1/2/3/4 to use the corresponding buff.
→ Press {SpaceBar} again to deactivate the buff slots.

notes.title: September System Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/20f990563f19b1cd240c0d56e7ff61b9e76bc0be.png[/img]

Hello Ballers! 
 
First of all, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to each and every
one of you who continues to enjoy and support FreeStyle 2. Your passion for
the game and your dedication on the court are what keep us going!
 
This September, we’re excited to share some updates designed to improve your
gameplay experience and bring a fresh spark to the community.
From matchmaking improvements to new Ceremony update, we’ve been
working hard to create an environment where both new and seasoned
players can thrive.

Let’s take a closer look at what’s waiting for you this month:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e96aeb4a56ba880d7422e191b0a2c1b6cef3d647.png[/img]

We know that the quality of matchmaking and fair competition has always
been a key topic among our players. We have continuously reviewed these
issues through surveys, community feedback, and internal data analysis.
Your feedback has always been a valuable reference for us.

As a result, we have decided to separate the Pro and Amateur channels
once again:

> Amateur Channel
→ Maintains Solo Queue auto-matchmaking for beginner and casual players.
→ Provides a fast and accessible gameplay environment without added
burden.

> Pro Channel
→ Enables room creation and team-based matchmaking for experienced
players.
→ Offers higher-quality matches and greater strategic depth.

Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a380b85cfc7a786fea00c54e1716c4845425536d.gif[/img]

This adjustment is the outcome of our past year of experience,
careful data review, and your valuable insights. Our goal is to provide a
smoother, fairer, and more enjoyable gameplay environment for everyone,
whether you’re just starting out or competing at the highest level.

Changes to Matchmaking and Channel Operation Notice
Link: https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/19369
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6f204e047d23a62052bdf295d4aa3c962ad80f19.png[/img]

Another exciting addition this September is the New Ceremony Update.
We know that expressing yourself on the court is just as important as your
performance, and this update gives you fresh ways to celebrate your big plays.

[Dance Party Machine Free Action Ceremony] - Male Character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f5dbbf1f680d10df54dcc858178092251cecc8ed.gif[/img]

[Dance Party Machine Free Action Ceremony] - Female Character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7c90a558f02ded60a2b23dcfa95a30e5f180ca34.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f595bbf40171ec28bf6cb538bf396140aa16b0be.png[/img]

To ensure smoother gameplay balance and fairer matches, a balance
hotfix patch will be implemented through the update on 9/3 (Wed).

Link: https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/19384

=================================================
We’re looking forward to seeing how these changes and additions will enhance
your FreeStyle 2 experience.

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- FreeStyle 2 Team

Event Guide
 
[1] Select your desired 1st item by clicking the [+] button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/62581fa745ca27d07cd0f50b3ad2dcca3f4b2555.gif[/img]

[2] You can acquire one item per draw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/94c4789d0b1da88d62128cdc524a3741585d0bc3.gif[/img]

[3] Acquired items are excluded, and their probabilities are evenly
redistributed among the remaining items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/caa5979cc32b85bb675ef7d5a4784849cae85add.gif[/img]

Even Distribution of Acquired Item Probabilities
> Acquired item probabilities are excluded.
> The excluded probabilities are evenly redistributed among the
remaining items.
> Items fully acquired up to the set bundle quantity cannot be obtained again.
> Except for the first draw, item probabilities are evenly redistributed, altering
their appearance rates.
 
Number of Wishing Tickets Consumed Per Draw
> Draws 1-4: 1 ticket consumed
> Draws 5-9: 2 tickets consumed
> Draws 10-14: 3 tickets consumed
> Draws 15-17: 4 tickets consumed
> Draw 18: 5 tickets consumed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07bf13f11734f2a52c7c2678386d1dc82a2e1264.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/39e67bede712deb7e1b8bcbaf7aa53bf06983248.png[/img]
 
Bundle Quantity
> The bundled quantity is the set quantity for the item.
> Probabilities are set per bundle item.
→ If Item A has a 5% probability and there are 2 bundles, the probability
is set to 10%.

> The bundle quantity is displayed on the item icon.
→ x00' = number of items obtained per draw
→ [00] = set quantity of 'x00 items'
→ Example: '[02] Sub Atts x10' means 10 Sub Atts must be acquired
twice to be removed.
 
If You Have Acquired the 1st Item
> If you have obtained the 1st item, you can no longer acquire the
remaining items. 
> You must reselect the desired 1st item to continue the gacha.

Additional Notes
> Wishing Tickets can be purchased by clicking the [+] button in the
top-right corner. 
> Character-restricted items are sent to the locker, and others are sent
to the Gift box.

The Devil’s Tower has risen—are you bold enough to conquer its heights?

claim victory!

Event Period:
2025/09/03 00:00 ~ 09/16 23:59 (PDT)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f11b3d4205ccd24266ca70cde75783318a6c35ce.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18b46068dacdb1325fe31d7eb7db975eb0eec7d7.png[/img]

[1] Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d5d9f0f2505f9ea7a37a2b482225aebcff5ae277.gif[/img]

[2] Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
[3] Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
→ You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
→ Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.
[4] Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
[5] Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
[6] Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the
remaining rewards.
[7] If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
[8] From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability.
→ Same items may be obtained again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4745abbd209da9ebdd5007c054dce68baf21828f.png[/img]
 
[1] Devil's Tower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
[2] You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
[3] If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change
settings so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the
event.
[4] Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b6c6feb3461352279e9e16b21230865a68f4520.png[/img]

Step 1: Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower. 
Step 2: Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from
each level.
Step 3: You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
Step 4: Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2be04e5cbfd08daee25cabdd223b86ff0c186ce6.png[/img]
 
→ Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
→ Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
→ Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/867adec713c0252e9fca90fa6aa8bf919c44f56b.png[/img]

→ You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

notes.title: Mega Pass Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc5b379b63a04a1f3bcc3393b447493750ccf005.png[/img]

Get ready for the excitement—the Mega Pass is back!

Dive into the action, conquer every level, and unlock exclusive cosmetic items
along with a trove of rewards!

Event Period:
2025/08/27 00:00 ~ 09/30 23:59 (PDT)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c1c8bd62e337a2bbd91e7150973f280432e4a6fd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e6b328c8f3741b861c58c984e9ef796817e613ee.png[/img]

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for 1480 GKash,
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

Note: You cannot use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/efbf6f1b1986874208d50b5eb3954e07da509c4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/56de2cc867e40bb65d131861bf4ebb9140a20bee.png[/img]

 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

Note: Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass. 
(This period is designated for players to claim their rewards before
the event concludes.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0df9a2aa17d6ae0c9ebf840c160ae348f15bb332.png[/img]


The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the 'regular' and
'Premium Mega Pass'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/09f9da6d45125dd394cd216cb6510d3011455ad9.png[/img]

You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!

How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products
before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8b9be59b43eee2b7b32b5a9a833fb0dd8588a016.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.


[3] These products have already been discounted once.
You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/959645bfeff9e60ffb5fb5c8da7f54001051bbd0.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus
discount rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the
existing discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a
package containing the products of your choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0a29bcda24498e30d008f8e4b356bd9085395777.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your Gift Box.

*TIP
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
(If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the
product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in!

> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards
multiple times until you reach the specified limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ef4bc7f530ea787d68a2dcf8b73703b87b06ec56.gif[/img]

What Is a Bonus Discount Product?
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products
along with other products to receive bonus discounts.
Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate

notes.title: August Balance Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c449138984370679ec5b8d7465bd185da3eeacb4.png[/img]

Hello!

This is the Freestyle 2 Development Team.

A balance hotfix will be applied to address issues identified after the [b]August 13th patch.[/b]

Since the August 6th balance patch, we have been closely monitoring various play patterns and stat efficiency changes.

During this process, we identified parts where the efficiency was excessively higher or lower than intended and will be making adjustments accordingly.

The Freestyle 2 Development Team will continue to monitor the game to provide a more enjoyable and pleasant environment, and we will apply necessary improvements quickly.

Please check the detailed changes below and feel free to share your feedback on the balance patch.

[i]~ After the balance patch, the “Defensive Power Forward” trait skill for PF
positions will be reset. Please check your trait skills before playing.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ea4e78f18d64e07bb18e761206ef02457e600cc.png[/img]

[b]1. Skill Balance Adjustments[/b]
→ [Fast Drift Shot] The base speed of the Fast Drift Shot skill will be slightly reduced.

[b]2. Play Coefficient Adjustments[/b]
A. Physical Contact Stat Adjustments
→ In driving situations, the collision range based on the physical contact stat will be reduced.
→ The general collision range for positions other than big men (C, PF, CT) will be reduced.

B. Steal Coefficient Adjustments
→ Steal efficiency will be slightly reduced compared to the August 6th patch.

[b]3. Trait Skill Adjustments[/b]
A. Rebound & Block Center (C)
→ Added a stat that reduces the motion of the Box-Out Swim Move.

B. 3-Point Specialist Shooting Guard (SG)
→ When equipping the “Jab Step Timing Fake Enhancement” skill in the [Main] stage, 
it will now be possible to chain Side Step Back with X and C inputs.

C. Defensive Power Forward (PF)
→ The “Power Alley-oop” skill will be moved from the [Legend] stage to the [All-Star] stage.
→ The “Power Rebound” skill’s “Power Rebound Range Increase” stat will be adjusted. (+36 → +24)

[b]4. Other Balance Adjustments[/b]
→ [Shot Arc Probability Adjustments] When big men (C, PF, CT) are in close-range contests near the basket,
the probability of a high-point arc trajectory will increase.

=================================================

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

[i][b]- FreeStyle 2 Team  [/b][/i]

notes.title: August System Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2b9fb154f3585a5e3b71ee14c540f2fb44e74756.png[/img]

Greetings, Ballers!

Thank you to all our dedicated Freestyle 2 players for your continuous
passion and feedback!

This August, we’re rolling out key system updates including the
2025 Summer Balance Patch, a revamped Record Search system,
and enhanced MVP calculations to bring a more detailed and
competitive experience.

We’ve also added new features like the Freestyle & Ceremony Preview to
help you enjoy the game even more!

Check out the latest updates coming your way and gear up for all the
thrills waiting in FreeStyle 2!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/00bf2459ce61009c6733664ca57667ef84a152da.png[/img]

→ The 2025 Summer Season Balance Patch will be implemented with the
update on 8/6 (Wed).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/57629ae0f08d7d0e366c1be1117615e809bb0cbd.png[/img]
 
→ The record search system, which allows you to check various records of
in-game characters, has been updated.
 
→ The existing [Ranking] menu has been updated to the
[Ranking & Record] menu.
 
→ Starting Wednesday, August 6th, you can only view your character's
last 20 matches in the ranking search. (Opening later)
 
(a) Full Record Search System
→ You can enter through [Record Search] in the [Ranking & Record]
menu.
 
→ When you enter [Record Search], your character's information is
displayed by default.
 
~ Play Graph
→ You can check each play graph of [Ranked Match] and [All-Star League].
 
→ Records are displayed on a 'daily basis' and will not be recorded if the
play display graph criteria are not met.
(Only recorded if the character has a 'regular match' play record.)
 
> [Ranking Match] If the placement test is in progress, it will not be
recorded.
> [Ranked Match] Characters who give up on the season will not be
recorded.
> [All-Star League] Characters that do not meet the play conditions will not
be recorded.

~ Season Career High
→ Displays the best season-related records for Ranked Play and All-Star
League. 
 
→ Ranked Match : Displays the records of pro channels played during the
season (1 month).
 
→ All-Star : Displays the record of the pro channels played during the
season (1st quarter: 3 months).
 
> Ranked matches are calculated based on the records from one month.
> All-Star League records are combined over a three-month period.
 
~ Find user information
→ You can check the character's information by entering the character name.
 
→ However, if there is no character matching the entered character name,
search is not possible.
 
~ Recent record
→ Displays the wins, losses, and win rate for the character's last 20
matches.
 
→ If there are less than 20 matches in progress, the record is displayed
based on the number of matches.
 
> Draw matches are not shown in the record.
> In case of winning percentage, it is rounded up to the first decimal place.
 
~ Match record information
→ Up to 20 matches are displayed, and if there are more than 20 matches,
the oldest matches will not be displayed.
 
> Draw matches are not shown in the records.
> The ranked match rank and characteristics of the playable character are
displayed based on the match progress time.
 
~  Current Ranked Match Information
→ Displays the character's ranking data.
 
> If you do not participate in the season, give up on the season, or
take the placement test, your ranked match score will not be displayed.
 
~ Current All-Star League Information
→ Displays the character's All-Star League data.
 
> If the season All-Star score is 0, the All-Star League score will not
be displayed.
 
~ Ranked League Record Comparison 
→ Compares and displays my ranked match data with the current season's
ranked match data.
 
~ Data (ALL) : Data of all position-specific characters who participated in the
current season's ranking battles
~ Data (TOP) : Data of the TOP 100 characters by position who participated
in the current season's ranking match
~ Data (MY) : Data of my character who entered the current season page 
 
> For ALL and TOP data, it is displayed based on users who participated in the
ranking match placement test. 
> For MY data, data including 10 placement test matches will be displayed
upon completion of the placement test.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c804acff84c1c6a5269b092f1783056a8d59f0b3.png[/img]
 
(a) Match results screen 
 
~ Added Face-up record
→ During match play, check the record of collision situations with opposing
characters.
 
→ The record of the collider who is the subject of the collision increases.
> Collisions between characters not holding the ball are not included in the
'Face Up Record'.
 
~ MVP Formula improvement
→ The MVP formula includes effective resistance, face-ups, and jump ball
records.
 
(b) Ranking screen
 
~ Add New records
→ You can check the 'Average Jump Ball', 'Average Collision',
'Average Effective Resistance', and 'Winning Efficiency' records in the
Ranked Match Detail Records.
 
→ The ‘Receive Rank Reward’ button in the [Record Ranking] tab will be
removed, and the record ranking reward will be removed.
 
(c) Team Battle Record Screen
 
~ Add New records 
→ 'Jump Ball', 'Effective Resistance', and 'Face Up' records have been added
to the records that can be checked through the [Team Match Record] menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/799c16a07b49e3b4c0441b527554deea7ce4b75d.png[/img]

→ Freestyle preview feature added.
→ Added ceremony preview feature.
 
> However, the entrance ceremony will be improved in the future.

=================================================
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: 2025 Summer Season Balance Patch Developer's Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b56435479e7bcd3187f6de5a341fa49c196c6ec3.png[/img]

Hello, this is the Freestyle2 Development Team.

How is everyone doing during this especially hot summer?

Thanks to your continued support and enthusiasm, we've been working
hard—so much so that we barely notice the heat ourselves! To help you beat the
summer heat even in-game, we've prepared a set of refreshing updates.

We’d like to walk you through the key components of the 2025 Summer Balance
Patch, including:

- Trait System Overhaul
- New Skill
- Match Record's Search System
- Core Play Logic Updates

We always listen carefully to your opinions and analyze gameplay data to make
Freestyle2 more fun and balanced for everyone.

Now, let’s dive into the 2025 Summer Developer’s Note!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a629031ca25c07bf8ebe51de378b9402b32c05b3.png[/img]

With the upcoming update on Wednesday, July 30, the Trait system will shift
to a seasonal format, meaning trait skills will only be available for use during a
specific period.

During each season, different trait skills will be offered for each position with
unique concepts—giving players new ways to attack, defend, and strategize
on the court.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c2f2d1ef45d8f27d62ed586d0314632dfa1e9a5d.jpg[/img]

*The image shown is from a development build and may change upon
release.

In addition, skills that were previously exclusive to certain positions will now be
available across multiple positions depending on the season, enabling broader
and more unique playstyles.

The goal of this seasonal trait system is to introduce more dynamic matchups
and interactive gameplay through newly added skills each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/13a907f242be30131a043e479971a4f7cc687d10.png[/img]

Next, we’d like to introduce the new skills being added in this Summer Season.
Please note that all gameplay previews shown are from an in-development build
and may change upon official release.

¦ Fast Fadeaway

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0ca5489c6d483b12ca5ee0da3eb7a571711ae8b8.gif[/img]
The Fast Fadeaway skill!

Compared to the standard Fadeaway, this version has less backward movement,
but allows for a much quicker shot release.

Use both the regular Fadeaway and Fast Fadeaway depending on the situation to
increase your chances of scoring!

¦ Fast Drift Shot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/051286562c424a9318acee4b708e4e3203cbb302.gif[/img]
The Fast Drift Shot skill!

Compared to the original Drift Shot, this version has less lateral movement, but
also allows for a faster release.

It’s especially effective when dealing with help defense.

Use it in combination with the regular Drift Shot to create better scoring
chances!


¦ Power Alley-oop
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4cc0418d74b7a215a754dec7f238638a609268d8.gif[/img]
The Power Alley-oop skill (tentative name).

This skill allows you to execute an alley-oop from farther away than the
standard version.

It helps limit the range of help defense and opens up new strong inside tactics,
especially when combined with skills like the Floater.


¦ Rocker Step
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/daaecc0808d79c6b4632f16b70ad204f39c263f3.gif[/img]
The Rocker Step skill!

This allows the player to quickly break through in a desired direction using three
directional inputs (left/right).

The move is designed to simplify fake break-through inputs that beginners may
find difficult.

By buffering inputs in advance, the skill allows smoother execution.

Because the skill skips the wind-up animation, even experienced players can
enjoy quicker and more aggressive drive maneuvers depending on the situation.




¦ Skill Combo Examples
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/346b1a9050476263b05d64921377870aed322216.gif[/img]

We hope to see you pull off amazing plays using these new skills!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6019e10cf237c5155901e13994fa35f973f8e62f.png[/img]

Next, we’re introducing the Match History Search System, designed to help you
easily review all records related to your Freestyle2 gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7600579a27a4a70d63a70fb1af0b199b7f6457ca.jpg[/img]

*The screenshot shown is from a development build and may be
subject to change upon release.

This system provides a wide range of information, including:

Your character’s recent match history

Performance metric changes over time

Comparisons with seasonal averages

The ability to view other users’ character stats

As you know — information is the most powerful weapon.

Track your character’s progress through this system,
and gain insights from top-tier players to level up your gameplay even further!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3c89895b37906c44b88d3fbd9f45aa344d5d1db4.png[/img]

Lastly, to ensure even more dynamic and thrilling gameplay alongside the
above balance patch, we’re updating several aspects of the core play logic.

Key changes include:

New Shot Trajectories

Adjusted Success Rate for Shot Fakes

Tuning of Finger Block and Dunk Resistance
 
With these updates, we aim to deliver a clear and refreshing gameplay
experience for all players in the 2025 Summer Season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/03732447fb7ab88561c8c53df9e0da6be8ca4d1e.png[/img]

=================================================

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!


~ FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: Summer Season Balance Patch Rescheduled
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d323c2079970e288be50e992e24c2e1fd6ee1b7b.png[/img]
Hello, this is the FreeStyle 2 Team.

The [b]Summer Season 1st Balance Patch[/b], originally scheduled for [b]Wednesday, July 30[/b], has been [b]rescheduled to Wednesday, August 6.[/b]

This adjustment has been made to allow for the development of additional features, ensure a more stable service environment, and improve overall patch quality.
We sincerely apologize for the sudden change in schedule and thank all players who have been patiently waiting.
We will do our best to deliver higher-quality content in return.

Please make sure to take note of the updated schedule, and we look forward to presenting the summer season patch well-prepared.

Additionally, the following improvements are planned to be included in the [color=orange][b]August 6 patch[/b][/color]:

[list]
[*] Improved effectiveness of the Steal stat
[*] Improved effectiveness of the Body Contact stat
[*] Fix for lag issues with the Baseball Pass
[*] Unification of play logic for Pro and Amateur channels, and additional entry conditions for the Amateur channel (based on position-specific MMR requirements).
[/list]

Once again, we kindly ask for your understanding regarding the delay of the balance patch, and we sincerely thank all players for their continued support and love for FreeStyle 2.

– FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: Want You! Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/04e994180ec1542d8205c7dd7d601a27e0a43439.png[/img]

The Festival Returns for Freestyle 2's Want U Festival!

Join us for the grand reopening of the Want U Festival! It's time to dive back
into the excitement and rewards waiting for you.

Upgrade Buildings, Claim Rewards! Participate in the festivities by upgrading
your buildings and unlocking amazing rewards!

Event Period:
2025/07/16 00:00 ~ 2025/08/05 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6c43bd755b58e0e8237a4c7095589aee7ecbf156.png[/img]

What kind of event is the 'Want U Festival'?

The Want U Festival is an event where you acquire various coins and progress
by upgrading buildings and producing items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6eeb758088aeed82c57bf9b35563f8250f6d68b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b29f043d51509d5a8da6105374cd2aa5143bc07b.png[/img]

Here's a preview of the updated window of the Want U Festival Event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8ce4102241f1b0f71143b15c363993eb055bde7a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c263274e2fa68d822204f72233f461cb10f5cb21.png[/img]

Guide:

1. If you don't click on the accumulated coins to collect them, they will no
longer accumulate.
 
2. The collected coins are used to upgrade all buildings or to produce items in
designated buildings.
(Upgrading buildings that can produce coins or items increases efficiency, such
as production speed, amount, etc.)
 
3. If you upgrade the Main Stage and level up, you earn a special reward for
certain levels.
(Check the rewards list on the right for details.)
 
4. If building upgrade or item production time is too long, you can use
Instant Completion Tickets to finish instantly.
 
5. If all your buildings reach a specific level, the level restrictions will be lifted,
allowing you to upgrade them to higher levels via "Festival Expansion."
(Expanding Festival at least once will allow you to gift your owned coins
to new/returning accounts without limit.)
 
6. All items except coins are moved to Gift Box upon acquisition, and coins
are applied directly to the event.
 
Reminder:
Upgrades and item production cannot be cancelled once they start.
When the event ends, all coins held will be deleted.

notes.title: 2025 Summer Season Update Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/57e54f416edddc8ca991893dfb5e0939b330ccb2.png[/img]


Hello, this is the Freestyle2 Operations Team.

As we pass the halfway mark of 2025, the summer season filled
with passion hotter than the sun has officially begun.

We sincerely thank all of our players for your continuous love and support.

This summer, Freestyle2 is preparing exciting content such as:
[b][color=orange]System improvements
Various seasonal events
Competitive league updates[/color][/b]

Now, let us reveal the Summer Roadmap for July and August.
Let’s check it out together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/251bb366e7e9f003bf0653e8e05041a3c25f36a9.png[/img]
[h1][b][color=cyan blue]2025.07[/color][/b][/h1]
 - Premium Express
 - All-Star League
 - Balance Patch Part 1

[h1][b][color=cyan blue]2025.08[/color][/b][/h1]
 - New Record System
 - Balance Patch Part 2
 - Special Summer Events

[h1][b][color=pink]July[/color][/b][/h1] - A rich lineup of events including Premium Express and All-Star League,
along with the first balance patch to heat up the summer season.

[h1][b][color=orange]August[/color][/b][/h1] - Introduction of the new Record System to wrap up summer and
prepare for the fall season transition.

The development team is working hard to deliver everything as planned, and
we’ll continue to do our best to provide the best experience possible.

Stay tuned for more details in our monthly updates!
=================================================

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/25498a7d835757db53748ce6707f89e2260b4f48.jpg[/img]
First, let's talk about July.

As the beginning of the summer season, we’ve prepared a lot of content for July.
This roadmap will only cover the major updates, and more detailed information
will be shared through future update notes.

[h1][b][color=violet]Premium Express[/color][/b][/h1]
With the update on Wednesday, July 2nd, Selina and Ludrin have newly joined
the Premium Express lineup. Just by logging in, you can receive premium
characters along with the items needed for growth all for free!

Moving forward, we plan to add more characters that haven’t previously appeared
in Premium Express events.

[h1][b][color=violet]All-Star League[/color][/b][/h1]
We’re introducing a new competitive element for top-ranking players.
Players who achieve Platinum 3 or higher in Ranked Matches can compete
quarterly using All-Star League Points.

The key to the All-Star League is maintaining a certain tier each month while
also keeping a high win rate and a high number of matches.
You can aim to become the best while reducing stress from the Ranked system
through the clear point increase/decrease system unique to the All-Star League.

With the addition of the All-Star League, the Ranked Match page will also
undergo significant changes we ask for your anticipation and interest!

[h1][b][color=violet]Balance Patch – Phase 1[/color][/b][/h1]
This summer’s balance patch will roll out in phases across July and August.
Key items for July include:

- Adjustment of the ranked match calculation formula and tier ranges (7/2)
- Launch of All-Star League for top-ranked players (7/16)
- Start of the Seasonal Trait System (7/30)
- Addition of new skills (7/30)
- Rebalancing and motion point updates for certain Rare or lower-tier characters
and outdated Legendary characters (7/30)

[b][color=orange]The Trait System is being prepared with the following concept:[/color][/b]
Skills will be shared across positions based on the season, allowing for a wide
variety of combinations to create new offensive and defensive playstyles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1f98f78f730d377910c3bb2e75fa9693d062d83e.jpg[/img]
Lastly, let’s take a look at what’s coming in August

In August, we plan to wrap up the summer season with the introduction of new
systems and special events.

A new Record Tracking System will be added to make your gameplay more
meaningful, and we’ll also be running cool and rewarding summer events!

There are still unrevealed details, which will be announced separately once
they’re ready.

[h1][b][color=yellow]Match Record Search System[/color][/b][/h1]
A new system that allows you to easily access all of your Freestyle match
records will be introduced.

Since information is power, you’ll be able to search and access a wide range of
data from basic match info to advanced metrics to enhance your gameplay
experience.

[h1][b][color=yellow]New Performance Metrics[/color][/b][/h1]
New stat indicators tailored to Freestyle2’s gameplay will be added.

[b][color=green]Victory Efficiency:[/color][/b] A stat that reflects both win rate and total matches played
[b][color=green]Face-Up:[/color][/b] A stat that highlights tight, high-pressure defense
Additionally, stats that were previously not included in MVP scoring — such as
Jump Ball Wins, Effective Resistance, and the newly added Face-Up — will now
be reflected in MVP evaluations.

Experience how defense is becoming more critical than ever in determining
match outcomes.

[h1][b][color=yellow]Balance Patch – Phase 2[/color][/b][/h1]
- Match Record Search Page Added (8/6)
- MVP Scoring System Updated with New Stats (8/6)

[h1][b][color=yellow]Special Summer Event[/color][/b][/h1]
We’ve prepared a cool event to help you beat the summer heat!
You’ll be able to claim a variety of “so cool” rewards, so don’t forget to join in!

=================================================

Everything we’ve introduced so far is part of our plan to make the
2025 SUMMER SEASON more enjoyable for all of our players.

This update goes beyond just adding new content it’s a major turning point
that aims to enhance the overall fun and completeness of the game. 
We are building this with your voices in mind and listening to every piece
of feedback you share.

We will continue doing our best to deliver experiences that exceed
expectations through ongoing communication and improvements.

Thank you as always for your continued support of Freestyle2.

- Freestyle2 Operations Team

The stars align once more, bringing you the Genesis of Cosmos: Light! 
 
An event that will immerse you in the mesmerizing world of the
Cosmos, where each draw reveals a piece of the galaxy waiting to be claimed!
 
Will you get your hands on the most coveted fragments? It's all about strategy,
probability, and the thrill of the unknown!
 
Event Period:

Event Guide
 
[1] Select your desired 1st item by clicking the [+] button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/424d31d9cbaa8eaf08062d667c33b7d3be134dd9.gif[/img]

[2] You can acquire one item per draw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d835517e32a1c03ef1cf6aff422560689716b5eb.gif[/img]

[3] Acquired items are excluded, and their probabilities are evenly
redistributed among the remaining items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/caa5979cc32b85bb675ef7d5a4784849cae85add.gif[/img]

Even Distribution of Acquired Item Probabilities
> Acquired item probabilities are excluded.
> The excluded probabilities are evenly redistributed among the
remaining items.
> Items fully acquired up to the set bundle quantity cannot be obtained again.
> Except for the first draw, item probabilities are evenly redistributed, altering
their appearance rates.
 
Number of Wishing Tickets Consumed Per Draw
> Draws 1-4: 1 ticket consumed
> Draws 5-9: 2 tickets consumed
> Draws 10-14: 3 tickets consumed
> Draws 15-17: 4 tickets consumed
> Draw 18: 5 tickets consumed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07bf13f11734f2a52c7c2678386d1dc82a2e1264.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/39e67bede712deb7e1b8bcbaf7aa53bf06983248.png[/img]
 
Bundle Quantity
> The bundled quantity is the set quantity for the item.
> Probabilities are set per bundle item.
→ If Item A has a 5% probability and there are 2 bundles, the probability
is set to 10%.

> The bundle quantity is displayed on the item icon.
→ x00' = number of items obtained per draw
→ [00] = set quantity of 'x00 items'
→ Example: '[02] Sub Atts x10' means 10 Sub Atts must be acquired
twice to be removed.
 
If You Have Acquired the 1st Item
> If you have obtained the 1st item, you can no longer acquire the
remaining items. 
> You must reselect the desired 1st item to continue the gacha.

Additional Notes
> Wishing Tickets can be purchased by clicking the [+] button in the
top-right corner. 
> Character-restricted items are sent to the locker, and others are sent
to the Gift box.

notes.title: Miracle Mine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00a929567ca47e5149dfa32321326222a12258f6.png[/img]

Embark on a Journey to Unearth Hidden Treasures!

The beloved Miracle Mine event returns to FreeStyle 2! Are you ready to
channel your inner miner and dig your way to fortune? 

This exciting event invites you to explore a treasure-filled mine and collect
Gold Bars and Ancient Keys, which can unlock incredible rewards!

Event Period:
2025/06/18 00:00 ~ 2025/07/01 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9ec2c18ee68dcbd1b618196a6b8249f42289100b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d4cc6dc11045babccbfc80ea0a54d24adc38bd5.png[/img]

Step into the shoes of a seasoned miner and follow these simple steps to
uncover the riches that lie within:

1. Navigate to the Miracle Mine page through the event banner located in the
lobby.
2. Set up your miners in the miner's quarters and start extracting ore.
3. Delve deep into the mine and collect various ores to obtain Gold bars and
Ancient keys. 
4. As you mine through each stage, advance to the next level of challenges. 
Note: You can clear up to 9 stages in 1 season.
5. Visit the Miracle Shop and use your Gold bars to exchange them for a
wide array of items. 
6. Use the ancient keys you've acquired to unlock ancient boxes filled with
mysterious treasures.

Note:
- When mining is in progress, the time remaining until mining is completed
is displayed.
(Mining only takes place when connected to the game. When offline, mining
is stopped.)
- When the remaining mining time reaches “0”, the object to be mined is
deleted and the reward item is dropped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a28ae5aab534d630653d071746cb3020cc2504a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/359a9d534b4ccc697d95f95e99622c1b346a41a2.jpg[/img]
 
The season runs from Wednesday to Wednesday for 7 days.
1 Season consists of 9 stages.
 
[p][table colwidth=""]
	[tr]
		[td][p][b]ㅤSeasonㅤ[/b][/p][/td]	[td][p]ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤEvent Durationㅤ[/p][/td][/tr][tr]
		[td][p][b]ㅤㅤ1ㅤ[/b][/p][/td]	[td][p]ㅤ2025/06/18 00:00 ~ 2025/06/24 23:59 (PDT)ㅤ[/p][/td]	[/tr]	[tr]
[td][p][b]ㅤㅤ2ㅤ[/b][/p][/td]		[td][p]ㅤ2025/06/25 00:00 ~ 2025/07/01 23:59 (PDT)ㅤ[/p][/td]	[/tr]	[tr]
	[/tr][/table][/p]

Seasonal adjustments
-  Miner's Lodge Level reset
-  Delete miners active in the mine
-  Reset stage clear count

When the event ends, gold bars, pouches of gold bars, and keys will be removed.

Season End Notice preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0f9c1b8ca92b7ff0de85a42c613d1e62be91d527.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1e07288a9c756b7bf4dd377d1f4194dd53760970.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e6fcd003ef33f8aa226a7edce15d8e0b1e995696.jpg[/img]

Miners are produced over time in the miner's lodge and are stored there.
- Production works only while connected to the game.
Note: Mining stops when offline
Production and storage of miners will only work up to the maximum storage
capacity.
Miners can be placed in the mine by pressing the "Place" button.
When deployed, the miner's lodge gains experience and levels up.
Note: As it levels up, the level of the deployed miners also increases.

Preview:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/df2e993d95397fa58fc3080498dc74fa5097800d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/325d76c60cea8ea743e3d2934beb7d563b891e73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/477f331e3c2d41898cd1d08b55bfe5ad591f747d.jpg[/img]

Each mine has a maximum number of miners that can be operated, and the
number of miners cannot exceed that.

Miners can perform actions such as:
- Mining objects: Gold ore, Key ore, Treasure chests, etc.
- Leveling up: combining two of the same miners to level up
Note: Combining reduces mining time.

Preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b89391a8d66b14ed48c9355823fc350e3b46e839.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a1a8b0cb12aeb53c8de43eb8b56dbffc1a9d7332.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/afd4926c67e750e365c513c9e7b6a049cab53cfd.jpg[/img]
 
When miners are placed near an objective, they automatically start mining.
- If there are more than two objectives nearby, the mining direction can be
changed through drag & drop.
When mining, the time remaining to complete the action is displayed in
real-time.
- Mining can only be done while connected to the game
Note: mining stops when offline

When the remaining mining time reaches "0", the target objective is removed,
and reward items are dropped.
Dropped items are obtained by placing a miner at the item's location or clicking
on it.
Note: High-Level Key ore can disappear after a certain period of time.
Your in-game data may not save properly if you close the game abruptly.

Preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2736f0f86dca38cf17676892407168fc73040827.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8e91419b6d841518ac90649e1ff9103c3654ecd8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fb7aaecef5cb12b6ce00b60b392f83b1e3d86f57.jpg[/img]

Various mining objectives can yield Event currency.
- Ore: Gold bars
- Key ore: Ancient Keys

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e7911ae76f264ab2bf3929ec757d76c8e540eb3.gif[/img]
 
The acquired items can be used for various purposes.

are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- The Gold bars you acquire can be used at the Miracle Shop.

the Gold bar Pouch.

Key Ore:

keys are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- High-level key ores will be deleted if they are not mined within the time limit.
- The acquired Ancient key can be used to open the Ancient chest. 

Treasure Chest:

- Rewards are sent on the Gift box.

notes.content:

Get ready for the excitement—the Mega Pass is back!

Dive into the action, conquer every level, and unlock exclusive cosmetic items
along with a trove of rewards!

2025/06/18 00:00 ~ 07/22 23:59 (PDT)

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for 1480 GKash,
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

Note: You cannot use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/efbf6f1b1986874208d50b5eb3954e07da509c4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/56de2cc867e40bb65d131861bf4ebb9140a20bee.png[/img]

 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

Note: Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass. 
(This period is designated for players to claim their rewards before
the event concludes.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0df9a2aa17d6ae0c9ebf840c160ae348f15bb332.png[/img]

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the 'regular' and
'Premium Mega Pass'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/09f9da6d45125dd394cd216cb6510d3011455ad9.png[/img]

You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars
as soon as you finish your quests!

notes.content:

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!

The more you contribute, the bigger the benefits—so dive in, participate,
and stack up those rewards!

Don’t miss this chance—gear up, aim high, and seize the ultimate rewards!

2025/06/18 00:00 ~ 07/01 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ba413ed3f76ba1f96abd1072a3f1913b0ba6730.png[/img]

How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products
before making the purchase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a9a8a57645eee3f22abead048d68c902b8946a6.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.


[3] These products have already been discounted once.
You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/959645bfeff9e60ffb5fb5c8da7f54001051bbd0.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus
discount rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the
existing discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a
package containing the products of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your Gift Box.

*TIP
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
(If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the
product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
*For more information, check the Benefits tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

What Are Benefits?
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by
purchasing products with bonus discounts!
Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/de27ee08dc94e8f1befff2d5c6c084cf0a8b4366.png[/img]

What Is a Set Product?
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards
multiple times until you reach the specified limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1d6e5b30985cd2010107f7ee5bc71f6aea6bca84.gif[/img]

What Is a Bonus Discount Product?
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products
along with other products to receive bonus discounts.
Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!

The more you contribute, the bigger the benefits—so dive in, participate, and stack up those rewards!

[color=darkorange][b]How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?[/b][/color]

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f83430731294c8c87ec32f9d8ba4b163d989ab56.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d9c43bde37e2a0568de5e6023a72a7b5f0aa0eb6.gif[/img]

[3] These products have already been discounted once. You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/959645bfeff9e60ffb5fb5c8da7f54001051bbd0.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus discount rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the existing discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a package containing the products of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your [color=gold][b]Gift Box[/b][/color].

[color=red][b]*TIP[/b][/color]
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
[color=gold][i](If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)[/i][/color]

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
[color=gold][i]*For more information, check the Benefits tab.[/i][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Are Benefits?[/b][/color]
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by purchasing products with bonus discounts!

[color=gold][i]Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail![/i][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e8ffab8ff7045f91305771c562fd2ffce88fe6af.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Is a Set Product?[/b][/color]
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards multiple times until you reach the specified limit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8c0a27298280d54f75e21dfdcc332dc0913d62c1.gif[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Is a Bonus Discount Product?[/b][/color]
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products along with other products to receive bonus discounts. Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
[color=gold][i]*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.[/i][/color]

[2] You can acquire one item per draw.

[3] Acquired items are excluded, and their probabilities are evenly redistributed among the remaining items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/caa5979cc32b85bb675ef7d5a4784849cae85add.gif[/img]

[color=cyan][b]Even Distribution of Acquired Item Probabilities[/b][/color]
> Acquired item probabilities are excluded.
> The excluded probabilities are evenly redistributed among the remaining items.
> Items fully acquired up to the set bundle quantity cannot be obtained again.
> Except for the first draw, item probabilities are evenly redistributed, altering their appearance rates.
 
[color=cyan][b]Number of Wishing Tickets Consumed Per Draw[/b][/color]
> Draws 1-4: 1 ticket consumed
> Draws 5-9: 2 tickets consumed
> Draws 10-14: 3 tickets consumed
> Draws 15-17: 4 tickets consumed
> Draw 18: 5 tickets consumed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07bf13f11734f2a52c7c2678386d1dc82a2e1264.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/77f39baceaf8a110de0d6f1a3f2fef7da221a93d.gif[/img]
[color=cyan][b]Bundle Quantity[/b][/color]
> The bundled quantity is the set quantity for the item.
> Probabilities are set per bundle item.
→ If Item A has a 5% probability and there are 2 bundles, the probability is set to 10%.

> The bundle quantity is displayed on the item icon.
→ x00' = number of items obtained per draw
→ [00] = set quantity of 'x00 items'
→ Example: '[02] Sub Atts x10' means 10 Sub Atts must be acquired twice to be removed.
 
[color=cyan][b]If You Have Acquired the 1st Item[/b][/color]
> If you have obtained the 1st item, you can no longer acquire the remaining items. 
> You must reselect the desired 1st item to continue the gacha.

[color=cyan][b]Additional Notes[/b][/color]
> Wishing Tickets can be purchased by clicking the [+] button in the top-right corner. 
> Character-restricted items are sent to the locker, and others are sent to the [color=gold][b]Gift box[/b][/color].

> Mileage earned from the Mega Pass will carry over even after the season ends, and can be used in the shop for the next season as well.

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for [b][color=yellow]2800 GKash[/color][/b], granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[b][color=red]Note:[/color][/b] [i]You cannot use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c1a3836d56e09dab77390513ea76a353cd399928.jpg[/img]

Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 [i](Able to proceed to the next step)[/i]
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

[b][color=red]Note:[/color][/b] Users will not be able to earn additional stars [b]during the last week of the Mega Pass.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bf41ecbb2e754bf3830ef41bfaef68f4f1c0ed5c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8685bc44493d21dc2ab5c7e4660cdad3bc6b85a5.jpg[/img]

You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

notes.title: Temptation of the Snake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/031c4628fb7e75c196a2de156ca1d6947ec61674.gif[/img]

Are you ready to embark on a thrilling adventure with the allure of the Snake's Temptation? 

Roll the dice, overcome obstacles, and climb to victory for your shot at amazing rewards. Each roll could lead you forward… or send you tumbling back! 

Take the journey and prove your luck and skill in this exclusive event!
 
[h2][b]Event Period:[/b][/h2]
2025/05/07 00:00 ~ 2025/05/20 23:59 (PDT) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ff8f303e5dcedf2520cb02c70b7491b7dd271d12.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7e72f503cf2481bab1dc5c5c20c888d81d81c874.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4b9833aba4529c122406e5e0960ff5f8e3ba9e6f.png[/img]

[1] 1 dice per match/game played, with a maximum of 3 dice per day. 
[2] Dice can be held during the event period, but will be deleted at the end
of the event, so use them all!
[3] You can use the dice you have by clicking the Roll Dice button.
 
[b][color=green]Board Preview[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee5b87ad9ec801158ae15460f29a19a8853559ec.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7863f83b2731db72e414d55fc1f9c669ca99d5ad.png[/img]

[1] Roll the dice to move forward according to the number on the dice.
[2] When the player moves the green frog with the dice, the NPC pink frog
will follow and roll its dice to move.
[3] You can acquire rewards by landing on a reward space; rewards on the
spaces are not removed.
[4] If you land on a space with a ladder, Green Snake Hole or Red Snake Hole.
[5] Upon reaching the FINISH space, all rewards and positions of ladders,
Green Snake Holes, and Red Snake Holes will be reset, and you will start again
from the beginning.
[6] Don't worry if the NPC pink frog reaches the last space before you!
It will wait until you reach it.
→ If the animation feels too slow, press the "Speed Up Animation" button
to roll the dice and progress faster!
 
[b][color=green]Draw Preview[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2d80eed3f20160389fc2a8ac64f747a1a539ccb0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a3ebc81518f19fe4137cd4f96432a3a74278b0d5.png[/img]
 
[1] Complete various missions during the event to earn rewards.
[2] Missions are divided into "Core Missions" and "Repeatable Missions"
[3] Core Missions can only be completed once, after which they cannot be
repeated. 
[4] Repeatable Missions can be completed multiple times until the event ends,
allowing for multiple rewards!
[5] Once a mission is completed, click the Claim Reward Button to receive the
reward in the Gift Box.
[6] All missions will be inaccessible after the event ends, so participate actively
during the event period!
 
[b][color=green]Core Mission[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5de8dfb4eeb69bae47a5b4b715ac227a41075e6a.png[/img]

[b][color=green]Repeatable Mission[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/32eb70849b3ac17fb17ab4393d4e53fee969661c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0130f67ec70fddc7ca1c86bb1d52b4f90439d95d.png[/img]

[1] Various special features may appear on spaces in the Snake's Temptation
event!
[2] Each of the 3 features changes its location with each round.
→ Ladder feature, moving you to a conne 
→ Green Snake Hole, moving you forward by a set distance.
→ Red Snake Hole, moving you backward by a set distance.
[i][color=gold]*Check the "Special Features" tab for detailed information.[/color][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a2e3147e364f818ed033ee50c2af23c3389de129.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fa8871195871b2404e60a6672b1f9b02f95cf10d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fb23d66368ac34fa60c54885c0dd13c71cc8120f.gif[/img]

Gather your dice, take each roll with anticipation, and see if you can conquer the board!

notes.title: May Tournament Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec6dcfa8ddefddf02cc57057955635940f0e7d97.jpg[/img]

Get ready to turn up the heat this month! The May Tournament update just dropped!

It’s a week-long war bringing fierce matchups, rising tension, and non-stop
action in the court!
 
Do you have what it takes to climb the ranks and leave your mark on the court?

Check out the details below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6ce2b018dcce5103be935c48e56ac5907eca0ff0.png[/img]

→ [b]Duration: [/b]The tournament will be open once a month with different
Server Focus Time per Server Region.
→ [b]Format: [/b]The tournament consists of a 16 rounds, and a total of 48 players
can take part.
→ [b]Quick Start: [/b]What is a Quick Start Match? A match that starts as soon as
the minimum number of required teams is gathered.
(Quick Match will begin if there are 8 teams or more)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2e04c2cdc1f0326aef04e5cfa102d83fdc1fa111.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/759381362274a17fc135b97f57cc2bc0b5647299.jpg[/img]

[color=orange][b]1. Coin Rewards:[/b][/color]
→ The tournament will be open to ALL Server Regions and can earn Coin Rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a20504ae9d85e44014e3a0a89ae40c25bf66f85d.png[/img]

[color=orange][b][u]Note:[/u][/b][/color]
1. Coins will be obtained by characters.
2. Displayed reward for playing and winning is the amount granted per match.
3. Amount of coins will be deducted accordingly in case of winning by default.
4. Obtained coins can be used to purchase various items at the Tournament Shop. 
 
[color=orange][b]2. Special Rewards:[/b][/color]
→ Players who are participating in the Tournament during the FOCUS TIME of each server are eligible to be rewarded with Special Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/17344254c22afdd993d53dd85609313dbf4147c9.gif[/img]

[color=red][i]*The personalized uniform reward for the winner will be distributed individually.

[color=orange][b]Conqueror's Gown[/b][/color]
