[color=orange][b]Winner’s Personalized Uniform[/b][/color]
[i](Lettering functions can be applied in this uniform.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/36acf1082362b96001bf8d0c716c3b595edd47f5.png[/img]

[color=orange][b]Exclusive Tournament Outfit[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a8e6378941575590c07f4de82681802fe05d9313.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b981509d360f7b415dc889a42577b297a1d287a6.png[/img]

[color=orange][b]Lettering Outfit Preview (M/F)[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/301ccd131edb462fd43074acdd5f526cd0a70e57.gif[/img]

[color=orange][b]Additional Details about the Lettering Outfit[/b][/color]

> You can obtain lettering outfits from the Tournament Shop.
> You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
> When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free. Afterward, lettering items will be required to make changes.
> Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
> Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfit.

[color=orange]a) Top: Jersey[/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2e4e34a99be88e20206cefe0b2912dff9722a6f.jpg[/img]

[color=orange]b) Bottom: Leggings Shorts, Regular Shorts[/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/526169e6b027078b3eefe194f7ff30a1cda1686f.jpg[/img]

[i]* Before using the lettering function, the basic settings are as follows: Text: FS2,
  Color: White, Stroke: Black
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on the lettering function on unequippable outfits.[/i]

[color=orange]Lettering Items:[/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3ebdbf1e8b188769c0234068572fec8f8f09632b.jpg[/img]

> Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
> Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 999,999,999.

[color=orange]How to Apply Lettering:[/color]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
[i]* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.[/i]

[color=orange]1. Lettering Settings[/color]
> You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for lettering.
> Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
[i]* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.[/i]
 
[color=orange]2. Color Settings[/color]
> You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[color=orange]3. Lettering Trial[/color]
> Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
> Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/318c4d4c8ca1973dfa90226d76cd902447ce745f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bdecf17146c1dcc80e76697cb5962299a266ccdf.png[/img]

→ Rewards will be distributed after the event ends. The schedule will be provided separately.

→ Duplicate participation will not be considered for multiple rewards. If a player participates multiple times in the tournament, the player will be rewarded with only the highest rewards they achieved during the tournament.

→ [i][color=red]Special rewards will be given only once per account.[/color][/i]
 
→ Character selection coupons will be sent after the winning team is determined, and participants can specify their desired characters through separate 1:1 inquiries.
 
→ Choose 1 reward (Premium Sub Att x100 or Character Coupon x1) and contact our support team at [color=orange][i]steam_support@gamekiss.com[/i][/color].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/78ee72c1ca3e2922af9987ce6ecddd8ee67e4a1c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/434a6c5cacb30c6411e34fa32dc26aee4babe2ba.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fdf5a86255d499f6eb52f1d494ff82f2e8ba80b2.gif[/img]

[color=orange][u][b]Participation Conditions:[/b][/u][/color]
→ Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
→ 3 players enter from the waiting room.

[color=yellow](Conditions may be added or changed depending on the nature of each tournament)[/color]
 
→ Meet the "Conditions for Participation" of each tournament.
→ One team can only participate in one tournament.
→ When there is no waiting time for participation due to "giving up match."
→ Only the host can apply for participation.

[color=orange][b][u]Rules:[/u][/b][/color]
 
[color=orange]→Abandoning a Match[/color]
→ If you are participating in the tournament and force-quit a match, the match will be considered abandoned.

→ Penalties will be applied to the player who gives up a match as well as the team members.
 
[color=orange]→Penalties[/color]
a. No match reward for abandoned matches. 
b. Winning Team will not eligible to receive rewards if the opposite team
surrender or leave the match.
c. Cooldown of 1 hour applies until next tournament match.
[i]*Other Rules follow the Regular Channel Match Rules[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bdecf17146c1dcc80e76697cb5962299a266ccdf.png[/img]

→ In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues, it will be considered as a loss.

→ Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes or updates will be communicated through notices.

===============================================================================
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!

[b][i]~ Freestyle 2 Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: Title System Update
notes.content:
The [color=darkorange][b]Title System[/b][/color] Update is Here!

 
We’ve overhauled the [color=darkorange][b]Title System[/b][/color] to give you more customization and flexibility in how you showcase your achievements.

With a new interface, improved title grades, and the introduction of a brand-new system, it's time to level up your title game in FreeStyle 2!
 
Check out the details below!
 
Title System Update
→ The title system has been updated.
→ You can check the screen via Lobby > Profile > Title Settings (Gear icon),
or Locker Room > Title tab.
→ A new title system [Combination Title] has been added, and existing titles are now classified as [color=yellow][Complete Titles][/color].

[color=gold][b]Title[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6dd1a69954aff3c1af2f2cb7c3bb110b1d38c0c9.png[/img]
~ Complete Titles and Combination Titles cannot be equipped at the same time.

[color=orange][b](I) Complete Titles[/b][/color]
→ These are titles obtained before the April 23 (Wed) update, and are
owned at the account level.
→ You can equip up to 1 title.

[color=orange][b](II) Combination Titles[/b][/color]
→ These are divided into 3 parts, and up to 3 can be combined and
equipped.
→ Account-wide titles can be used by all characters once used from the
Locker Room, while character-specific titles can only be used by the character
that uses the item in the Locker Room.

[color=gold][b]Title Grades[/b][/color]
→ The title grade system has been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/25e13a24b5f8c89386973e29454d6ce5bbe7c766.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]Item Acquisition Feature[/b][/color]
→ After equipping a title, you can obtain one item upon completing the
assigned mission.
→ The acquired item can be used for one day, from 00:00 to 23:59.
→ Missions reset at 00:00.
→ If you equip three combination titles with the item acquisition feature,
each title’s feature is applied individually.

[color=darkorange][b]Title Duration[/b][/color]
→ Titles are categorized as either time-limited or permanent.
→ When using multiple time-limited titles, the duration stacks.
→ Once a time-limited title expires, the related item will be deleted.

[color=gold][b]New Combination Titles[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/74f8c31e2fac6209c574be6a3ed5dffe1a0c22c3.png[/img]

[b][color=red][i]~ New combination titles can be obtained through the “Master Sushi King” and “The Genesis of Cosmos: Light” events.
~ The titles [Of] and [And] are character-restricted items.[/i][/color][/b]

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for your continued support. 

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
[i][b]~ Freestyle 2 Team  [/b][/i]

notes.title: The Genesis of Cosmos: Light Fragments
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9d78ef3ca577b6b6d9729558f0a7dfad8c3fd227.png[/img]

The stars align once more, bringing you the [color=cyan][b]Genesis of Cosmos: Light[/b][/color]! 
 
An event that will immerse you in the mesmerizing world of the Cosmos, where each draw reveals a piece of the galaxy waiting to be claimed!
 
Will you get your hands on the most coveted fragments? It's all about strategy, probability, and the thrill of the unknown!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
2025/04/23 ~ 05/06 23:59 (PDT)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/641d714d91440c43942b5819c6daad4cff7d8149.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c55e5d4cad4d1f30c662d4e8e4a8d7f17d2995ff.png[/img]
[color=cyan][b]Event Guide[/b][/color]
 
[1] Select your desired 1st item by clicking the [+] button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/80244c8b1b1d2528bb708f1ad61cdf1b12e7e52b.gif[/img]
[2] You can acquire one item per draw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b8b4466adf02d8ae216e518665101d52cb0e9ef9.gif[/img]
[3] Acquired items are excluded, and their probabilities are evenly redistributed among the remaining items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/caa5979cc32b85bb675ef7d5a4784849cae85add.gif[/img]

[color=cyan][b]Even Distribution of Acquired Item Probabilities[/b][/color]
> Acquired item probabilities are excluded.
> The excluded probabilities are evenly redistributed among the remaining items.
> Items fully acquired up to the set bundle quantity cannot be obtained again.
> Except for the first draw, item probabilities are evenly redistributed, altering their appearance rates.
 
[color=cyan][b]Number of Wishing Tickets Consumed Per Draw[/b][/color]
> Draws 1-4: 1 ticket consumed
> Draws 5-9: 2 tickets consumed
> Draws 10-14: 3 tickets consumed
> Draws 15-17: 4 tickets consumed
> Draw 18: 5 tickets consumed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07bf13f11734f2a52c7c2678386d1dc82a2e1264.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/77f39baceaf8a110de0d6f1a3f2fef7da221a93d.gif[/img]
[color=cyan][b]Bundle Quantity[/b][/color]
> The bundled quantity is the set quantity for the item.
> Probabilities are set per bundle item.
→ If Item A has a 5% probability and there are 2 bundles, the probability is set to 10%.

> The bundle quantity is displayed on the item icon.
→ x00' = number of items obtained per draw
→ [00] = set quantity of 'x00 items'
→ Example: '[02] Sub Atts x10' means 10 Sub Atts must be acquired twice to be removed.
 
[color=cyan][b]If You Have Acquired the 1st Item[/b][/color]
> If you have obtained the 1st item, you can no longer acquire the remaining items. 
> You must reselect the desired 1st item to continue the gacha.

[color=cyan][b]Additional Notes[/b][/color]
> Wishing Tickets can be purchased by clicking the [+] button in the top-right corner. 
> Character-restricted items are sent to the locker, and others are sent to the [color=gold][b]Gift box[/b][/color].

notes.title: Fill & Benefit [F&B] Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02f6b576f88898550a894aa97f4e20055102b23.png[/img]

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!

The more you contribute, the bigger the benefits—so dive in, participate, and stack up those rewards!

Don’t miss this chance—gear up, aim high, and seize the ultimate rewards!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2025/04/16 00:00 ~ 04/29 23:59 (PDT)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8e0860fda68ce254f6743e18ae18b09db10ea11a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ba413ed3f76ba1f96abd1072a3f1913b0ba6730.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?[/b][/color]

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/dec808b1ae7b069009fb24d3e0b09f9171537219.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d9c43bde37e2a0568de5e6023a72a7b5f0aa0eb6.gif[/img]

[3] These products have already been discounted once. You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/959645bfeff9e60ffb5fb5c8da7f54001051bbd0.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus discount rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the existing discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a package containing the products of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your [color=gold][b]Gift Box[/b][/color].

[color=red][b]*TIP[/b][/color]
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
[color=gold][i](If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)[/i][/color]

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
[color=gold][i]*For more information, check the Benefits tab.[/i][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Are Benefits?[/b][/color]
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by purchasing products with bonus discounts!

[color=gold][i]Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail![/i][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/447738afeb941ebe906ac060e158b513b49985e5.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Is a Set Product?[/b][/color]
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards multiple times until you reach the specified limit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0c1dae9834eddae39de3fac48cb787f9ea81549a.gif[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Is a Bonus Discount Product?[/b][/color]
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products along with other products to receive bonus discounts. Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
[color=gold][i]*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.[/i][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bbd26209216628ea2ce26b25f6570b15666eb2c0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/690f0dfe0618c742fa1b22a6146534809f516baa.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]I. Friends Preview[/b][/color]

[color=darkorange][b]1) Hip-Hop Neo Friends[/b][/color]
→ Don't miss out our new  friend, ‘Hip Hop Neo' in this event!

[color=orange]1. Match Balance[/color]
> Layup and dunk's max success rate will be reduced by 10%.
> Score buff will be removed.
> Resistance from defenders against all shots will increase by 14%.

> Away Screen Move's Movement Speed will be reduced by 5%.

> Match time: 4 mins to 3 mins.

2. If even one member does not wish to proceed with the classic court, it will not proceed.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d194a2ec018d47a9882d541ff6759aa1e93c3051.png[/img]

Hello, this is the FreeStyle2 Operations team.

The first quarter of 2025 has already ended, and April marks the beginning of the second quarter.

We are always grateful to our users who continue to support FreeStyle2.

To communicate more closely with all our players who care about our game and share their valuable feedback, we are launching the [color=gold]FS2 GM Magazine[/color] to exchange stories and updates together.

The GM Magazine will be released twice a month, sharing ongoing improvements, future update plans, and our thoughts on the feedback and voices from the community.

Now, let’s begin the very first issue of the FS2 GM Magazine for April 2025. 

First, we’d like to share the improvements that have been completed in the first quarter of 2025.

[color=darkorange][b]List of Completed Improvements[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d876b3b8d3b37a84cd8168cbdc30ca526a68fcb6.png[/img]

In the first quarter, we focused on improving the overall game environment to provide a better experience.

Additional improvements are underway to enhance system stability and reduce in-game lag, so we ask for your continued interest and support.

We will also do our best to quickly respond to any other issues that may arise or have been identified.

Next, we’d like to share the list reviewed by the development team based on the feedback we received from our players.

[color=orange][b]Phase 1 – April 2 (Wed) Release[/b][/color]

> List of Planned Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9af2a5f28f3da47622a463360e1af8c604c6ab7b.png[/img]

[color=orange][b]Phase 2 – Released April 16 (Wed)[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7673e9e8165a730a9f489ade9c15d1b58db163f8.png[/img]

[color=gold][b]1. Balance Patch[/b][/color]
 - The balance patch will be based on an analysis of player data and will aim to bring new excitement to the summer season.
 - Details regarding the direction of the balance patch will be shared at a later date.

[color=gold][b]2. User Convenience Improvements[/b][/color]
 - We are currently reviewing the addition of an outfit preset feature for user convenience, along with account-wide integration for certain items.
 - While we cannot promise a specific schedule due to internal priorities and circumstances, we are actively reviewing these improvements.

[color=gold][b]3. Ranked Match Improvements[/b][/color]
 - Ranked match improvements will be carried out in two phases, with the first phase scheduled to begin soon.
 - The development team is currently reviewing feedback and suggestions from players regarding the ranked match scoring system and is working to implement a more refined system moving forward.

Please refer to the above list for other planned improvements.

We will do our best to implement the listed items as scheduled.  However, please understand that the schedule may change depending on internal circumstances.

[color=greenyellow][b]That concludes the content of the first GM Magazine for April.[/b][/color]

We will compile and share a list of completed items. Any new items not included above will be shared in the next issue of the GM Magazine.

We always listen to every single player’s voice and strive to create a better game environment. We appreciate your continued interest and participation.

Your feedback is the most valuable compass for us.

Please feel free to send us your thoughts and suggestions regarding game improvements.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

 
[i][b]- Freestyle 2 Operations Team [/b][/i]

Get ready for the excitement—the Mega Pass is back!

Dive into the action, conquer every level, and unlock exclusive cosmetic items along with a trove of rewards!

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for [color=yellow][b]490 GKash[/b][/color], granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[color=red][b]Note:[/b][/color] You cannot use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/449b82aa1977af962225dc0a7831752171e465c4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4356bc559ffe48c9c7e0a477c63404aa512eadb4.jpg[/img]
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

[color=red][b]Note:[/b][/color] Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass. 
[i](This period is designated for players to claim their rewards before the event concludes.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/acc3c66a1378659f7d121a09dd62383e5aedf824.png[/img]
The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the 'regular' and 'Premium Mega Pass'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1627e8635ab4ae899dd46c5b0dafccd1425effbb.jpg[/img]
You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

Get ready to stack, strategize, and climb to the top in our exciting event: [b]SumSum Fruits![/b]

Show off your talent, outwit the competition, and take over the leaderboards with your strategy and skill!

3. Combine two fruits of the same kind to level them up.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/28e74d9cd8464ac98064a51eb889361eddab45ff.png[/img]

Mysterious Glass Beads—what secrets do they hold?

It’s said that those who possess them can unlock rare and dazzling treasures. Are you ready to claim yours?

Join the Mysterious Glass Beads Event and use their magic to get the outfit you’ve been waiting for!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2025/03/19 00:00 ~ 04/01 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f33aef14fe11bd0615215e567d76d50748fa8062.gif[/img]

** If you use [b]340 "Mystery Scrolls"[/b] you can obtain a FREE [b]Premium Reward[/b]! 
[i](Free reward will be sent to Gift Box)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5a9b9532578ba3aad44ca2db1e4b5d7a29a989ba.png[/img]
- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items [i](except those obtained through the draw)[/i] will be sent to the gift box.
 
[b]** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse will be moved to the gift box automatically.[/b]

[color=orange][b]* Step 1[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d764e7adc6c229b3f48d7b63f78a6cc034c68f79.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6ff4ae96b08719395064fe8cceb4562c5ef9112b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/80433ffa54a55be5a86d1e538c1a3c705c4f2aab.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the 'Purchase' button and draw 1 or 5 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/415b2c2b73c4dfc93730ad2328af31428b4188ed.gif[/img]

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7322ccf335866591179146011e4307e25843ce6a.png[/img]

- Obtain a FREE [color=orange][b]Premium Reward[/b][/color] for every [color=red][b]340 draws[/b][/color]!

[color=orange][b]*Step 2[/b][/color]
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f7c7d7e8f81ab9d244388b0d9b4c5be0e5a20aff.gif[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
(***[color=red]Note:[/color] [b]Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.[/b])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/43c431f1cc2fcdce1511a30a6bc997b77ddae57c.png[/img]

- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[color=orange][b]*Step 1[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1061c27a5ae1aa6e9cb18e818871ca03e13de797.gif[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials. The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bb8e3d5edc2bdbc9e0d6a97b2ae707508f3fb93a.jpg[/img]

[color=orange][b]*Step 2[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/822e007a463b07f058cc861470fd87c4ff959dfe.gif[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once. You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order, with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused or there aren't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/384a419fce19fae0dada5a7527551b338294254e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a7819f78f3ca5d87bf1a9300453d52cf1701ca4.png[/img]

notes.title: Team-Up System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9d29b635f4bc599801ff74fef443c93be1c6cffd.png[/img]

Hey Ballers! A brand-new [b]Team-Up System[/b] is here to shake up the court!

This update is designed to help new and casual players gain an edge
when teaming up under specific conditions. 

Check out the details on how to activate Team-Up Effects and maximize
your game!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00dc26461d83ad8ebc651a1e5fbd7b61701f58d9.png[/img]
 → The Team-Up System is designed to provide additional stat benefits to
beginner and casual players when they play in specific team compositions at
the start of a match.
→ Core players who are already familiar with the gameplay or those utilizing
specific tactics will not receive these benefits.
→ The Team-Up System accumulates balance data and may be adjusted
or improved through balance patches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/96bfa6db4bbe18d482c05069dc7a0149be2c6f33.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/29d446e203bd4850fb430b33e928278e34d90d8f.png[/img]

[b]How to Check and Set Team-Up Effects[/b]
 
[b][1] GSP applies only to the Amateur version[/b]
→ GSP exists only in the Auto-matching [Amateur] version of the Regular
match channel.
→ Click the Check Team Up’ button located below the [Match Start]
button to check the status.
 
[b] [2] Setting Method[/b]
→ Team-Up effects are automatically applied when the conditions are met.
 
[b]Team-Up Effect Benefits[/b]
 
1. The conditions required to receive Team-Up effects must be met.
2. When playing with a designated team composition, Team-Up stat boosts
are automatically applied.
3. Once the match starts, the stat boosts will take effect.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/164ccea0e48a7e5ffbc74ba2cdc55d6c6121c338.gif[/img]
 
[i]Eligible team compositions that receive Team-Up effects can be checked in-game.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6bc048c2186409bd07b96dc87a5dd8c7eb1f9d20.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e729b0f6439c2cc20dd56a931777ed238ec7a6e4.gif[/img]

[b]Important Notes:[/b]

→ The Team-Up System applies to the Pro Channel, Amateur Channel
auto-matching, and private team matchmaking with 1-2 players.
[i](It does not apply to Tournament Channels, Tournaments, or
Domination Mode.)[/i]
→ In the Amateur Channel, the system checks Team-Up conditions only after
a match is found; before that, it will be displayed as inactive.
→ The system will not apply if matched with AI in the Amateur Channel.
→ In the Pro Channel, Team-Up effects are determined based on the average
MMR of the three characters in the room. Teams with a high average MMR
will not receive benefits.
→ The system evaluates skill levels based on the highest MMR character
within a user’s account, relative to the current character’s position in the
waiting court.
→ If there is a large gap between low MMR and high MMR users,
benefits will not be applied.
→ If the skill gap among team members is too large, the Team-Up System
will not activate.
→ Detailed Team-Up conditions can be checked via the Team-Up pop-up.
→ If a team is eligible for the Team-Up System, the Team-Up effect will
be displayed after the entrance scene.
→ Eligible team compositions for Team-Up effects are pre-defined
and may be adjusted through balance patches.
 
===============================================================================

With the Team-Up System, beginner and casual players can enjoy a smoother
and more competitive experience. Now, hit the court, team up, and show off
your skills! 

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!


[i][b]- FreeStyle 2 Team[/b][/i]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5e8fd62c3e28fb5dd6f234bbe8fd9126f98552d1.png[/img]

We’re back with another exciting update for FreeStyle 2!

A huge shoutout to all our dedicated players—your passion and support keep the game alive! This update brings fresh content, improvements, and more to elevate your streetball experience.

More awesome updates are on the way! Let’s keep the game strong!

notes.title: Fill & Benefit [F&B] Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02f6b576f88898550a894aa97f4e20055102b23.png[/img]

The Fill & Benefit Event is back, rewarding your efforts with incredible prizes!

The more you contribute, the bigger the benefits—so dive in, participate, and stack up those rewards!

Don’t miss this chance—gear up, aim high, and seize the ultimate rewards!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2025/03/05 00:00 ~ 03/18 23:59 (PDT)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2d0be826d5d57119c4d3183b252afbdfd20905d7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ba413ed3f76ba1f96abd1072a3f1913b0ba6730.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?[/b][/color]

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products
before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/899ef20e2309b2224687d1dce9c89c55ea932f05.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/de0913dad41f7d6a1bf5170ad41cf00cc6005cd1.gif[/img]

[3] These products have already been discounted once. You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/959645bfeff9e60ffb5fb5c8da7f54001051bbd0.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus discount rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the existing discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a package containing the products of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your [color=gold][b]Gift Box[/b][/color].

[color=red][b]*TIP[/b][/color]
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
[color=gold][i](If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)[/i][/color]

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
[color=gold][i]*For more information, check the Benefits tab.[/i][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Are Benefits?[/b][/color]
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by purchasing products with bonus discounts!

[color=gold][i]Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail![/i][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/61ee43f698d1059ff9dab943c5840bcb74af0694.png[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Is a Set Product?[/b][/color]
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards multiple times until you reach the specified limit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2e7e9dd5d87c08a672fb59de88130c89f4f3370e.gif[/img]

[color=darkorange][b]What Is a Bonus Discount Product?[/b][/color]
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products along with other products to receive bonus discounts. Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
[color=gold][i]*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.[/i][/color]

notes.title: Free2Land: Private Restaurant
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b0bd598501fbed737c9a0775bb1cfed9d92dac59.png[/img]

Greetings! Welcome to Your very own Private Restaurant! 

We’ve got a tasty full-course meal waiting for you! Just click on each item to grab FS2 coins and awesome prizes!

[color=darkorange][b]Quick tip[/b][/color]: Make sure to tap the "receive" button to collect your coins after finishing the mission! All you have to do is log in and play a few matches, and you’ll automatically join the event! 

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2025/03/05 00:00 ~ 04/01 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1d31fed0fad8560aae41dbc62f556407f7763fb.png[/img]

Accumulated number of matches played & Login time Event has corresponding coin rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9f64699b82bceac02603760be2980ab9c26348d8.png[/img]

[color=gold][b]Guess the last Digit Mission[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2b544049eece9e534d1626dff1613cc1f8586b95.gif[/img]

Guess your opponent's last score digit by clicking a specific number on  the selection provided. For non-VIP players, you can only choose 1 number and 3 for VIP members. Don't forget to hit "Save".

> Coin rewards for prediction: 10 Coins for successful prediction and 1 Coin for failed prediction.
> Maximum coins that a player can acquire per day is 100.
> Predictions will remain the same throughout the event unless you decided to change it.
> You can exchange coins for various consumables! Just visit the Event Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5edf4ec53a27c9fcb697bfa4318801befd64c6fb.gif[/img]

[color=yellow][b]Ferris Wheel Event[/b][/color] is back! Login and Play to get stamps to claim the reward for the day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d3af6120e14865d5879b85c0864358383324dcdc.gif[/img]

[color=yellow][b]Unlock Event: [/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8dd2a8fc6f602817a0c4c58c9f22074bb0141034.gif[/img]

For every team/individual match you finish or every hour you stay logged in, you will earn Box Keys.

10 Keys for every match.
20 Keys for every half an hour logged in.

- Box Keys can be used to Open or Upgrade the Box
- Each Box has corresponding rewards and you can get one of the items listed randomly.

** Once you have chosen a specific box, the box level will reset to the lowest Box Grade.

** You won't be able to claim any rewards after the event period so make sure to spend Box Keys on time!

Wait, there's more! If you have collected a huge amount of FS2 Coins, you may also use it to redeem S+ Rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/36cc434cf2e299a985e99b7ed948e57796b09098.gif[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6783d778712207a60b9715cd629c93d39737f0f3.png[/img]

Get ready for the ultimate challenge in the Conquest War!
Compete in the league, conquer the Sunshine Beach and Sunset Part,
and earn amazing rewards!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2025/02/19 ~ 03/04 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/890c815bbba35d3dab642333ac46dea4300a8ef4.gif[/img]

[b][color=darkorange]How to Join the Basketball League?[/color][/b]
 
1. Win one (1) regular match to qualify for the Basketball League!  
2. Your team’s areas to conquer will be automatically selected based on
your team’s average ELO score.  
(ELO Points are determined by the MAX ELO of your characters in
the same position!)
3. As the Team Leader, check the activated areas and hit the 'Challenge' button
to start conquering!  
4. Conquer areas by succeeding in challenges!  
5. If your challenge fails, your team will be moved back to the lobby.
6. Start Playing the Basketball League at 00:00 each day to
earn amazing rewards!

[b][color=darkorange]Rewards Breakdown:[/color][/b]
- Victory: Earn 4 badges  
- Defeat: Earn 3 badges  
- Every 2 wins: Get an extra 3 badges!

[b][color=darkorange]Court Ranking:[/color][/b]

[color=gold]Additional Details about the Lettering Outfit[/color]

- [color=yellow]You can obtain lettering outfits from the Conquest Badges.[/color]
- You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
- When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free.
   Afterward, lettering items will be required to make changes.
- Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
- Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfit.

[i][color=red]* Before using the lettering function, the basic settings are as follows: Text: FS2,
  Color: White, Stroke: Black

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f90fca31d3faded60e85424e13825bfaf8999243.jpg[/img]

have up to 999,999,999.

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
[i][color=red]* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.

   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
[i][color=red]* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.[/color][/i]
 
[i][color=gold]2. Color Settings[/color][/i]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[i][color=gold]3. Lettering Trial[/color][/i]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for [color=yellow][b]2800 GKash[/b][/color], granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[color=red][b]Note: [/b][/color]You cannot use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/670f3f316041d19b0d75f2c269fbcca8f6b251d5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c1a3836d56e09dab77390513ea76a353cd399928.jpg[/img]

Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 ([i]Able to proceed to the next step[/i])
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

[color=red][b]Note:[/b][/color] Users will not be able to earn additional stars [b]during the last week of the Mega Pass[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7588152821b4573bd586a59d903ba6af7032040b.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the regular and Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8685bc44493d21dc2ab5c7e4660cdad3bc6b85a5.jpg[/img]

You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4064c82d5d63a13cb3274ab6381708aec6870d41.gif[/img]

[color=red][b]Note:[/b][/color] During the last week of the event, no additional levels will be introduced. This period is designated for players to claim their rewards before the event concludes.

notes.title: Mysterious Glass Bead
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eac61fde8d6a422844123e958e8c8b593a1b3884.png[/img]

Ever wondered about the mystery surrounding the glass beads?

Rumor has it that these enchanted beads hold the key to unlocking untold treasures... and now, they’re yours to discover!

In the Mysterious Glass Beads Event, you can use these magical items to score the outfit you’ve been dreaming of! 

Event Period:
2025/01/22 00:00 ~ 02/04 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/75b5cf7e341f5be5019c068251a914ff78cbdb55.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5f577147025785fd30f33b90715cdced3c7631cf.png[/img]

[b][color=orangered][Mysterious Glass Bead][/color][/b]
** If you use 340 "Mystery Scrolls" you can obtain a FREE Premium Reward! 
[i](Free reward will be sent to Gift Box)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f24e67efc4d8f111d2ecfcc9225c70ac57681bbd.png[/img]

- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items (except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.
 
[b]** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse will be moved to the gift box automatically.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/adbc616ffcffba9cc4ac0f80abf4fae473c7ccd2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b08f8f27d7049c03d30920ea2c2ab8cebb659bb3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a84dc42f7100ce5e04016541f62296407fac9ebc.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the 'Purchase' button and draw 1 or 5 time/s.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2d853bd00675b6a047c7f5986087e34d328c1f7b.png[/img]

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]

- Obtain a [color=yellow][b]FREE Premium Reward[/b][/color] for every [color=red][b]340 draws![/b][/color]

[color=orangered][b]*Step 2[/b][/color]
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1fdece622aefeb3c9404a1761e04d7437727480a.png[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
[b]([color=red]***Note:[/color] Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e49eaa7aad76350c5cd9b627c1edd9ad0cb83cf4.png[/img]

- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[color=orangered][b]*Step 1[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3fc4304fc7b58d869fbeea0813d8f3fc9a1b954f.png[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials. The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6bb4de5fecfcd0ff89427bfde30147d3dcef7d6e.jpg[/img]

[color=orangered][b]*Step 2[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a5b5d1039bc5c2df55b24820c5623147d1846312.png[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once. You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order, with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused or there isn't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa66b2259e4964878a7d2033499774d18e75bf6e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e40c1167a953e158c6853c376616a12c9d693ad2.png[/img]

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars

notes.title: Miracle Mine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00a929567ca47e5149dfa32321326222a12258f6.png[/img]

Embark on a Journey to Unearth Hidden Treasures!

The beloved Miracle Mine event returns to FreeStyle 2! Are you ready to
channel your inner miner and dig your way to fortune? 

This exciting event invites you to explore a treasure-filled mine and collect
Gold Bars and Ancient Keys, which can unlock incredible rewards!

Event Period:
2025/01/08 00:00 ~ 2025/02/04 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5b105d56000faf3b0e9378ac7d49f513d0507798.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d4cc6dc11045babccbfc80ea0a54d24adc38bd5.png[/img]

Step into the shoes of a seasoned miner and follow these simple steps to
uncover the riches that lie within:

1. Navigate to the Miracle Mine page through the event banner located in the
lobby.
2. Set up your miners in the miner's quarters and start extracting ore.
3. Delve deep into the mine and collect various ores to obtain Gold bars and
Ancient keys. 
4. As you mine through each stage, advance to the next level of challenges. 
Note: You can clear up to 9 stages in 1 season.
5. Visit the Miracle Shop and use your Gold bars to exchange them for a
wide array of items. 
6. Use the ancient keys you've acquired to unlock ancient boxes filled with
mysterious treasures.

Note:
 
- When mining is in progress, the time remaining until mining is completed
is displayed.
 
(Mining only takes place when connected to the game. When offline, mining
is stopped.)
- When the remaining mining time reaches “0”, the object to be mined is
deleted and the reward item is dropped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a28ae5aab534d630653d071746cb3020cc2504a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/359a9d534b4ccc697d95f95e99622c1b346a41a2.jpg[/img]
 
The season runs from Wednesday to Wednesday for 7 days.
1 Season consists of 9 stages.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ae21588d81ccaeae098843c90d643045ee1aedc8.jpg[/img]
 
Seasonal adjustments
-  Miner's Lodge Level reset
-  Delete miners active in the mine
-  Reset stage clear count

Note: When the event ends, gold bars, pouches of gold bars, and keys will be removed.

Season End Notice preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0f9c1b8ca92b7ff0de85a42c613d1e62be91d527.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1e07288a9c756b7bf4dd377d1f4194dd53760970.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ed376d443f72c1837fc65bb1e764bb9f025644ae.png[/img]

Miners are produced over time in the miner's lodge and are stored there.
- Production works only while connected to the game.
Note: Mining stops when offline
Production and storage of miners will only work up to the maximum storage
capacity.
Miners can be placed in the mine by pressing the "Place" button.
When deployed, the miner's lodge gains experience and levels up.
Note: As it levels up, the level of the deployed miners also increases.

Preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/df2e993d95397fa58fc3080498dc74fa5097800d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/325d76c60cea8ea743e3d2934beb7d563b891e73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b1cca1056f13510fb9a0f6c7e075c1c58b50d07.jpg[/img]

Each mine has a maximum number of miners that can be operated, and the
number of miners cannot exceed that.

Miners can perform actions such as:
- Mining objects: Gold ore, Key ore, Treasure chests, etc.
- Leveling up: combining two of the same miners to level up
Note: Combining reduces mining time.

Preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b89391a8d66b14ed48c9355823fc350e3b46e839.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a1a8b0cb12aeb53c8de43eb8b56dbffc1a9d7332.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/32e1f550047ee3e4bcf8804ba3e3be61797715ad.jpg[/img]
 
When miners are placed near an objective, they automatically start mining.
- If there are more than two objectives nearby, the mining direction can be
changed through drag & drop.
When mining, the time remaining to complete the action is displayed in
real-time.
- Mining can only be done while connected to the game
Note: mining stops when offline

When the remaining mining time reaches "0", the target objective is removed,
and reward items are dropped.
Dropped items are obtained by placing a miner at the item's location or clicking
on it.
Note: High-Level Key ore can disappear after a certain period of time.
Your in-game data may not save properly if you close the game abruptly.

Preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2736f0f86dca38cf17676892407168fc73040827.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8e91419b6d841518ac90649e1ff9103c3654ecd8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cd136202e5ba4acb755fd190c617a0f0cdd98ea9.jpg[/img]

Various mining objectives can yield Event currency.
- Ore: Gold bars
- Key ore: Ancient Keys

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e7911ae76f264ab2bf3929ec757d76c8e540eb3.gif[/img]
 
 
The acquired items can be used for various purposes.
- Gold bars: Exchanged for various products in the Miracle store
- Ancient keys: Used to unlock ancient chests and obtain them

Ore:
- You can obtain Gold bars when mining Ore, and the Gold bars you acquire
are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- The Gold bars you acquire can be used at the Miracle Shop.
 
Special Ore: 
- When mining Special Ores, you can obtain a large amount of Gold bars from
the Gold bar Pouch.
- Gold bars obtained through the Gold Bar bag can be used at the Miracle Shop.
- Rewards are sent on the Gift box.
 
Key Ore:
- You can obtain Ancient keys when mining Key ore, and the acquired Ancient
keys are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- High-level key ores will be deleted if they are not mined within the time limit.
- The acquired Ancient key can be used to open the Ancient chest. 

Treasure Chest:
- You can obtain various items when mining Treasure Chests.
- Rewards are sent on the Gift box.

Form a team and be the best by defeating many of the great teams on each server!

Starting [b]May 2024[/b], the Freestyle 2 Tournament will pause Super and Crew Tournaments to improve the experience, while Normal Tournaments will have more intense matches starting from [b]Semi-Finals[/b].

[[b]Link to Changes to Freestyle 2 Tournament Notice][/b]
[url=https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/18602]Changes to Freestyle 2 Tournament[/url]

3. Amount of coins will be deducted accordingly in case of winning by default.
4. Obtained coins can be used to purchase various items at the Tournament Shop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d49f3b0bc7872902a3f2f0d46f3e1ee43ef7b0bf.gif[/img]

[u][b]Participation Conditions:[/b][/u]
→ Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
→ 3 players enter from the waiting room.

(Conditions may be added or changed depending on the nature of each
tournament)
[i]→ Meet the "Conditions for Participation" of each tournament.
→ One team can only participate in one tournament.
→ When there is no waiting time for participation due to "giving up match."
→ Only the host can apply for participation.[/i]

[u][b]Rules:[/b][/u]
 
[b]→Abandoning a Match[/b]
→ If you are participating in the tournament and force-quit a match, the match will be considered abandoned.

→ Penalties will be applied to the player who gives up a match as well as the team members.
 
[b] →Penalties[/b]
a. No match reward for abandoned matches. 
b. Winning Team will not eligible to receive rewards if the opposite team surrender or leave the match.
c. Cooldown of 1 hour applies until next tournament match.
 
*Other Rules follows the Regular Channel Match Rules
 
[b]Important Notes:[/b]

→ In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues, it will be considered as a loss.

→ Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes or updates will be communicated through notices.

notes.title: Stray Rebels: Lukas and Aurora PICK UP Summon Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fd0969a1a103ca5aa563ec50a926394f20e5a942.png[/img]

The Stray Rebels: Lukas and Aurora Draw Event is here!

Don't miss out on the opportunity to add our newest characters, Lukas
and Aurora, to your roster! These dynamic characters bring a fresh
perspective and unique skills to the game!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/12/18 00:00 ~ 01/07 23:59 (PST)

[1] Purchase 'Summon Tickets' by clicking the [+] or "Summon" buttons.
[2] Stray Rebels: Lukas and Aurora can be obtained at certain probabilities using
the purchased tickets.
[3] You can earn 1 Mileage Point per summon.
[4] Obtained Mileage Points can be exhanged for various items in the
"Exchange Shop".
[5] If you haven't obtained the character in 100 summons, you can obtain her via
the "Exchange Shop" button.

[b]Rewards:[/b]
[1] You can view the Event reward by clicking the "Rewards" button in the top
right cornet of the "PICK UP" event page.
[2] Summoned items will be sent to Gift Box.
[3] Certain rewards, such as Crafting materials, are applied to the account
immediately. .

your buildings and unlocking amazing rewards!

notes.title: Direction of Freestyle 2 in 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a0fd78e676140d387e5a81df385e49444bca9257.jpg[/img]

Hello, this is the Freestyle 2 Development Team.

First, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all users
who love Freestyle 2.

In 2025, we aim to bring better services and a more enjoyable gaming
environment by making changes to the overall operational policies of the game.

[color=red]The key goals are as follows:[/color]

[b][color=orange]1. Restructuring the Payment Structure[/color][/b]
We aim to enhance fairness and accessibility in the payment services
for our users.

In July, we implemented the "Game Changer" patch to mitigate disparities
based on character grades.

From 2025, we aim to create an environment that allows for a greater focus
on gameplay with the following changes

- Cards with frequently used attributes will be easier to obtain.
- Difficult-to-acquire items like att items, freestyles, and premium characters
will be more accessible not only through payments but also through gameplay.
- Barriers to items affecting game balance will mitigate,
while many of the appearance elements (such as costumes, banners,
ceremonies, etc.) will be released to bring out more and bigger value.

[b][color=orange]2. Restructuring Promotional Events[/color][/b]
We will bring greater satisfaction to participating users with the following
improvements

- The probability of obtaining S-grade items in promotional events will
significantly increase.
- Event Gkash will be available for use in most gacha events, making desired
items easier to obtain.

[b][color=orange]3. January 2025 Update Plan[/color][/b]

[color=gold]1) Simplification of Card Content[/color]
- All cards (Normal, Magic, Rare, Legendary, Allstar Pro Cards), except
Allstar World Cards, will be removed.
- Normal, Magic, Rare, and Legendary cards in your possession will covert
to card fragments upon deletion, and Allstar Pro Cards will be replaced
with Allstar World Cards.
- Card creation, card fusion, and card upgrade spray contents will be removed.
- Except for Allstar World Card Mover item, all card Movers will be removed.

[color=gold]2) Store Update[/color]
- A significant number of new outfits and package items will be introduced,
and the composition and pricing of existing outfits will be adjusted.
- Items obtainable in the ceremony shop will now be accessible through
item ball or promotional events.

[color=gold]3) Gacha Ball Update[/color]
- New gacha ball items will be introduced, consisting of in-game currency
items, ceremonies, banners, rare outfits, and premium outfits.
- The existing gacha ball items will be removed, so we recommend using
all your gacha ball items before the update on January 8, 2025.

Any unused resources will be handled through a separate announcement.
(Items to be removed: Point Ball, Card Ball, Item Ball)

[color=gold]4) Workbench Update[/color]
- A significant number of new crafting outfits will be added.
- Crafting materials will be obtainable through promotional events,
mission shops, etc.

[color=gold]5) Mission System Update[/color]
- All configurations and prices in the mission shop will be updated.
(Premium characters and aesthetic elements will be added.)
- Daily, weekly, and monthly missions and rewards will be updated.

[color=red]* Please note that the above content is subject to change based on the
update schedule.[/color]

==============================================

In 2025, Freestyle 2 aims to provide an environment where everyone can
enjoy the game easily and joyfully.

We encourage you to share your opinions on the
official Freestyle 2 Discord channel.

We will carefully review and reflect on each suggestion.

Thank you for your continued love and support.


- Freestyle 2 Development Team -

1. From the "PICK! PICK!" on the right, pick your rewards.
2. Once you have selected the rewards you want, you can begin the gacha.
3. If you are having a hard time deciding what you want, click "Auto Select".
4. The selected rewards can be canceled and re-selected at any time.
5. The obtained items will be sent to your gift box.
 
-You cannot use the purchased currency when the event period ends.
 
** Reminder:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc5b987b4944ad38839ba4c34561e69f546d9049.png[/img]

You won't be able to choose or unselect the Freestyle Ticket reward as it is
meant to be included as a default prize (pinned in rewards).
 
The odds or chances of receiving a reward are individually set, and a portion
of the selected probability is allocated as a Freestyle Ticket reward.
 
(The total chances for the selected rewards do not add up to 100%, and the
remaining probability of 100% is allocated to the Freestyle Ticket.)

Here's a guide on how to navigate to this event:
 
First, pick your desired items from the right. These are your choices, and
please note that each ball type has a limited number of items. It's best to think
carefully before placing these items.

notes.content:

The Fill & Benefit Event has arrived, giving you the perfect opportunity to turn
your efforts into amazing rewards!

The more you fill up, the greater the benefits—so get ready, jump in, and
watch your rewards soar!

Don’t miss your chance to score big and take your game to new heights!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/11/27 00:00 ~ 12/03 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d465c97572a771d1f6c4870cea0ad9e565246332.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4ba413ed3f76ba1f96abd1072a3f1913b0ba6730.png[/img]

[b][color=orange]How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?[/color][/b]

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products
before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2fc23b59538fa3969f14d91c9af90415447decf3.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/421ad909f6667d4057f65464918c5d556420f728.gif[/img]

[3] These products have already been discounted once.
You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/acac5ecf5fae70dda64efec122fa49e687617680.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus discount
rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the existing
discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a
package containing the products of your choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your [b][color=gold]Gift Box.[/color][/b]

[color=red]*TIP[/color]
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
[i][color=gold](If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the
product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)[/color][/i]

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
[i][color=gold]*For more information, check the Benefits tab.[/color][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

[b][color=orange]What Are Benefits?[/color][/b]
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by
purchasing products with bonus discounts!
[i][color=gold]Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail![/color][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/faf7fe7769ba37b89122b3183f0566e78786f9ce.gif[/img]

[b][color=orange]What Is a Set Product?[/color][/b]
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards
multiple times until you reach the specified limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e0da5d41a67717c6edddd21455948b09c6d7e243.gif[/img]

[color=orange]What Is a Bonus Discount Product?[/color]
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products
along with other products to receive bonus discounts.
Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
[i][color=gold]*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.[/color][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/84075eb502aba5c6a03cb51fb547a5b180bf0839.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tournament Issue
notes.content:
Dear Ballers,

We would like to notify you that we have detected certain abnormalities during the previous tournament.

We understand that these issues may have affected your gameplay experience, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

As an effect of this, the EU and Asia Tourney may not be able to proceed following this issue. However, the NA server tourney will still proceed normally.

Please rest assured that our team is actively investigating the situation to identify
the cause and resolve the issue as quickly as possible before the start of the next tourney.

Your patience and understanding are greatly appreciated during this time.
We will provide updates as soon as more information becomes available.

Thank you for your continued support and dedication to the game.

- Freestyle 2 Team

before making the purchase.

package containing the products of your choice.

product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)[/color][/i]

purchasing products with bonus discounts!

> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!

> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products
along with other products to receive bonus discounts.

notes.title: Devil's Tower
notes.content:

Get ready to test your limits in the Devil's Tower Event!

Scale new heights, collect rewards along the way, and face the coolest perk
at the peak. Will you reach the summit?

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/11/06 00:00 ~ 12/03 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c6c8cd04ee2f7afe74c4e5d5e58479fb93bfbc7d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18b46068dacdb1325fe31d7eb7db975eb0eec7d7.png[/img]

[1] Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/42ae7cb8daccae6554d6d1b07d6820820fe6e596.gif[/img]

[2] Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
[3] Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
→ [i]You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.[/i]
→ [i]Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.[/i]
[4] Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probability.
[5] Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
[6] Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the
remaining rewards.
[7] If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
[8] From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability.
→ [i]Same items may be obtained again.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4745abbd209da9ebdd5007c054dce68baf21828f.png[/img]
[1] Devil's Tower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
[2] You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
[3] If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change settings so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the event.
[4] Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b6c6feb3461352279e9e16b21230865a68f4520.png[/img]
[b]Step 1:[/b] Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower. 
[b]Step 2:[/b] Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from each level.
[b]Step 3:[/b] You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
[b]Step 4:[/b] Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2be04e5cbfd08daee25cabdd223b86ff0c186ce6.png[/img]
→ Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
→ Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
→ Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/867adec713c0252e9fca90fa6aa8bf919c44f56b.png[/img]
→ Obtained rewards can be sent to the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack) or [b]Gift Box[/b] directly.
→ You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

[b][Devil’s Tower Event Reward Distribution Settings Screen][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/51cc003010f46244495cb947fdae6f6878aeaadf.gif[/img]

[b]Obtaining through Backpack[/b]

→ Up to 8 obtained items will be displayed in the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack).
→ You can select a character and “send items to inventory”.	
→ If the rewards are left unclaimed until the event ends, the items will be sent
to the Gift box.

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Storing in Backpack][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4d625a4eb010be23cf80f25fb6d7edfa20a3a38a.gif[/img]

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Item Distribution Screen][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/125d57e2e42cc13cb4dcba84853b8d60e9d91444.gif[/img]

[b]Distribution to Gift Box[/b]

→ Obtain items will be sent to the gift box immediately.	
→ You can view up to 8 items obtained through the Adventurer’s Inventory.	

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Sending to Gift Box][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5253b48bc9e1a7b5fb853d88f636b869f5b4816d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ad7295b8513d5d702a0dc9c6ec338886d1d1c518.png[/img]
→ Up to 5 rewards are placed on each level, and you can randomly
obtain one of them.	
→ After you receive the reward on the final level, you will go back to the first
level and play again.	
→ After you have claimed all 5 rewards on the final level, “level 0” will be
unlocked where you can randomly obtain one of the rewards placed there.	
→ The Card Option Changer item obtainable through the Devil’s Tower event
allows you to change the sub attributes of the Allstar Cards (offense/defense).	

> When you reach the final level, you will return to level 1 and play again.	
> Rewards you obtain on the final level cannot be obtained again. 	
> Once you have obtained all rewards on the final level, you will randomly
obtain one of the rewards from level 0.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/076fe59ddf5f4631ef97d9508b5e9794e66f0192.png[/img]

Click the link below for more information about Card Option Changer:

Check out the exclusive and exciting rewards when you reach 300 Floors!

notes.title: October Update and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cfb6038988bcce24f32c4c4027a42b14c4cc0d29.png[/img]

Get ready to elevate your game with the October Update!

Our team has been hard at work refining the gameplay experience based on
your feedback. These updates focus on optimizing performance, balancing
contents, and enhancing overall playability.

Check out the list of improvements below to see what's been fine-tuned for
smoother, more enjoyable matches and to enhance your gameplay experience.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b881b80a4c3648b66ea373f6183051ddafc79df8.gif[/img]
[b][color=cyan]1. AI Skill Usage Probability Setting[/color][/b]
→ The AI is designed to set the probability of using specific skills in certain
situations based on difficulty levels, making its playstyle as similar to human
players as possible

[b][color=cyan]2. Situation Setting[/color][/b]

[b][color=orange]A. Offensive Situations:[/color][/b]
→ When the AI is in possession of the ball and in a shooting scenario, it is set to
use specific types of shots based on the situation
a Close-range dunk
b. Long-range dunk
c. Mid-range shot
d. 3-point shot
e. Specific skill
f. If unable to attempt a shot, the AI will pass to a teammate.

[b][color=orange]B. Passing Situation:[/color][/b]
→ Set to use a specific type of pass when passing to a teammate.
a Regular pass
b. Specific skill
c. If the specific skill cannot be used, the AI will perform a regular pass

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8aeae09e94ef11b0188d6a92fdbb8c16d73488bc.gif[/img]
[b][color=cyan]1. Match Record[/color][/b]
→ Adjusted so that the most recent match record is always displayed when

Prepare to immerse yourself in an exciting event where you control your own fate!

Join in and choose the prizes you’ll take home!

Event Period:
2024/10/10 00:00 ~ 10/22 23:59 (PDT)

2. Once you have selected the rewards you want, you can begin the gacha.
3. If you are having a hard time deciding what you want, click "Auto Select".
4. The selected rewards can be canceled and re-selected at any time.
5. The obtained items will be sent to your gift box.
 
-You cannot use the purchased currency when the event period ends.

The odds or chances of receiving a reward are individually set, and a portion of the selected probability is allocated as a Card Sub-Attribute Changer reward.
 
(The total chances for the selected rewards do not add up to 100%, and the remaining probability of 100% is allocated to the Card Sub-Attribute Changer.)

[b][color=Darkorange]Here's a guide on how to navigate to this event:[/color][/b]
 
First, pick your desired items from the right. These are your choices, and please note that each ball type has a limited number of items. It's best to think carefully before placing these items.

[u][b]Participation Conditions:[/b][/u]
→ Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
→ 3 players enter from the waiting room.

(Conditions may be added or changed depending on the nature of each
tournament)
[i]→ Meet the "Conditions for Participation" of each tournament.
→ One team can only participate in one tournament.
→ When there is no waiting time for participation due to "giving up match."
→ Only the host can apply for participation.[/i]

[b]→Abandoning a Match[/b]

[b] →Penalties[/b]
a. No match reward for abandoned matches. 
b. Winning Team will not eligible to receive rewards if the opposite team surrender or leave the match.
c. Cooldown of 1 hour applies until next tournament match.
 
*Other Rules follows the Regular Channel Match Rules
 
[b]Important Notes:[/b]

→ In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues, it will be considered as a loss.

→ Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes or updates will be communicated through notices.

notes.title: Mysterious Glass Beads
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6f4568c38ca4c78c95d8af1fdb06d79590f51d5d.gif[/img]

Have you heard of the secret behind the glass beads?

Legends say that these mystical beads hold the power to unlock hidden treasures... and now, they're in your hands! 

With the Mysterious Glass Beads event, you can use these enchanted items to snag the gear you've always dreamed of. This is your chance to claim the outfit you've been eyeing! 

Event Period:
[b]2024/09/25 00:00 ~ 10/08 23:59 (PDT)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4342bfe45b74378609defd75b18f82b416734d3b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5f577147025785fd30f33b90715cdced3c7631cf.png[/img]

[color=orange][b][Mysterious Glass Bead][/b][/color]
** If you use 200 "Mystery Scrolls" you can obtain a [b]FREE Premium Reward[/b]! 
(Free reward will be sent to Gift Box)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f24e67efc4d8f111d2ecfcc9225c70ac57681bbd.png[/img]

- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items (except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.
 
[b]** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse will be moved to the gift box automatically.[/b]

[b][color=red orange]* Step 1[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3122a66a9997ed285ce4d33dee58440916e820a6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b08f8f27d7049c03d30920ea2c2ab8cebb659bb3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a84dc42f7100ce5e04016541f62296407fac9ebc.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the 'Purchase' button and draw 1 or 5 time(s).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ad5b62aec525fbe76bb9645b58b1591564a5aed6.gif[/img]

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]

- Obtain a FREE [color=yellow]Premium Reward[/color] for every [color=red]200 draws[/color]!

[b][color=red orange]* Step 2[/color][/b]
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b50dde7c025f93bf33c883b845e52ea3871e463e.gif[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
([color=red]***Note[/color]: Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e49eaa7aad76350c5cd9b627c1edd9ad0cb83cf4.png[/img]
- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[b][color=red orange]* Step 1[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9c236197ed727d4abc4bf77970a5318bfc944688.gif[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials.
The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6bb4de5fecfcd0ff89427bfde30147d3dcef7d6e.jpg[/img]

[b][color=red orange]* Step 2[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64fdab712d149def3c923a2c86752b37c1b412a6.gif[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once. You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order, with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused or there isn't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa66b2259e4964878a7d2033499774d18e75bf6e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e40c1167a953e158c6853c376616a12c9d693ad2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7bccaccb3fb6ab694c1623b25c5e07d82fc6969.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a865aa5363361a418e010f988f03e4d46056f44.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cace9ba99fdd10632432768d2404ce40a0a2a2a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/109da095a781507e82c0c2c6b2769173b8ef6aaa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ecf6bfe1415852eff6a42f4da6f3be8a5fd5b92a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e0366d66c6068c80ed66f65f18d9b023d1b2b167.png[/img]

[color=red][AllStar] Dragon's Breath Outfit Selection Box (M/F)[/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/65f356d39cc81b9a7d8d26fc51b5a007680a8fff.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/703e23044fdadeef4275698a5b86b69744fba51c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cbe8419e5fe2274310f614c5d8c78f421c0d45de.png[/img]

So, are you ready to elevate your style game to extraordinary heights? Get your
hands-on the Mysterious Glass Bead today and unleash the magic within!
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!


[i][b]~ [color=yellow]Freestyle 2 Team[/color][/b][/i]
