notes.title: September Update and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fa90f2f8d347e26ebfcc4d7c37c615ae45d39ceb.png[/img]

We're thrilled to bring you the September update for FreeStyle 2!

Our team has been working hard to enhance your gaming experience, and
these updates come packed with exciting new features, events, and
improvements!

We can’t wait for you to dive in and check out everything we’ve prepared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eab5f81d9653b5a416b39a35b6cd80b121b9f787.png[/img]

1) AI Functionality Improvements
→ When a match includes AI, the difficulty of the AI will be adjusted according
to the user's ELO.

[Fixed]
→ An issue where the AI traits appear blank on the loading page has been
resolved.

2) In-game UI Improvements (Returning User Settlement System)
→ The 'Price Break Package' UI for returning users will be visible only to users
who possess the package coupon.

3) DT Shop / Joycity Generous Card Improvements
 - Previously, the following card decks obtained in the wish boxes listed below,
are set to Main Attributes +12 and Sub-Attributes +10. After the update, they
will increase by +1 each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/484174e1114961837401a03e7e332e1991987386.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9e64b2d06e83adaf1dc90ff714d112819d149d6f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d88de00770d0b16bb90ab1b29a492280a4bcd92b.png[/img]

We're introducing an exciting new addition to the Collection System—
Limited-Time Event Character Symbols!

This exclusive update is your chance to collect and unlock amazing Rewards
and Stats that will enhance your gameplay!
 
1) Key Points
→ The Time-limited collection can be obtained through play events or purchase
events.
→ The collection has a set event period, and if you complete the symbols within
that period, you can obtain items.
→ Once the period ends, item acquisition will no longer be possible.

Here's How it works:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/975534d66f95bbee440a161504496a76003b8a53.png[/img]

> Collect Event Symbols:
You can acquire event collection symbols through various play events and
purchase events. Each symbol is a step closer to unlocking powerful rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a7f38ffd58fb4fb3b33a4c5a001e1dbcb8b33f9c.gif[/img]

> Register Your Symbols: 
Once you've obtained Event Character symbols, head over to the event collection
page to register them. This registration will allow you to obtain special items
or attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0e68eabc81442994c245cfdfd298bfd018aa66ed.png[/img]

> Unlock Items:
Complete the registration of all designated symbols in the item collection
to immediately receive the corresponding item/rewards.
*Obtained rewards will be moved to your Locker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/75d6f04816a3e2f23bf6867d110c5202c2a081f4.gif[/img]

> Unlock Attributes:
Similarly, completing the registration of all designated symbols in the attribute
collection will grant you the corresponding attributes, giving you that
competitive edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/77f412ba41a5feb98fa43340204fa8cd8e6a426f.gif[/img]

Obtained Stats

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d883cfd23bf82de4c760e3415d467b4c8e9c3381.gif[/img]

> Limited-Time Period:
Each event collection comes with a set event period. Make sure to complete your
collection within this time frame, as the symbols and benefits will disappear once
the period ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e5e89e28b31bf19dd9923c74590c02839c25c758.png[/img]

> Note on Symbol Usage:
Keep in mind that event collection symbols and system collection symbols
cannot be used together.

2) Symbols

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/131353aaaa0fec1e5005e4b1fa1a40ed4802ff32.png[/img]

3) Rewards
→ Please check the rewards for the time-limited collection under
"Collection - Event Collection."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ba42fb7bbddb9a99f8873f1fdea253d7d59b6822.gif[/img]

> Updated Achievement Rate screen
You can track your progress and see how many Limited-Time Event Character
Symbols you've gathered in the Achievement Rate tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a334d5b921e808992ea352e9ee6aee65b2b9d691.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/16a27d8afd67989d9f93afb8e138ff55aae34b86.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0dc121cfd11d4d0231b98594da6db957d76acf14.png[/img]

Prepare to join forces with your adorable festive friend: Fire Festival Rohan!

Sporting a fresh look and dazzling effects, you and your companion will take
on the FS2 Court, outclassing rivals and dominating the game.

The Fill & Benefit Event is here, and it's time to turn your efforts into incredible
gains!

The more you fill up, the bigger your benefits—so gear up, dive in,
and watch your rer brds skyrocket as you hit your milestones!
This is your chance to score big and elevate your game like never before!

2024/09/11 00:00 ~ 09/24 23:59 (PDT)

[b]How to Fill & Benefit (F&B) Event?[/b]

[1] Select the product you want from the many. You can select up to 5 products
before making the purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2263f8a4cfecae694fd363bafa9bf85d5fead158.gif[/img]

[2] The selected products will be registered to the slot on the right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0c8fe2be841f00a3cf2721c5a82a09d66b1d9380.gif[/img]

[3] These products have already been discounted once.
You can check the price and individual discount rate for each product.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/acac5ecf5fae70dda64efec122fa49e687617680.gif[/img]

[4] If you have selected products with bonus discounts, the highest bonus discount
rate from the bunch will be applied to all the products on top of the existing
discount.

[5] You can check the discounted price and click the Buy button to purchase a
package containing the products of your choice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/436bb4cbfa3eb4992691e6553138f78eb151fb48.gif[/img]

[6] You are free to make your purchases as there are no purchase limits.

[7] Purchased items will be sent to your [b]Gift Box[/b].

[b]*TIP[/b]
[1] Check the discount rates and prices set for each product before choosing one!
What happens if you choose a Bonus Discount Product and buy it? Discounts are
added on top of the existing discounts!
[i](If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate of the
product with the highest discount rate will be applied.)[/i]

[2] It's not just about buying individual products!
Click the Detail button and check out the Set Products!
Buy all the products in a set to get a bonus!
Rewards will come pouring in! 
[i]*For more information, check the Benefits tab.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/826ee91e722229c1e96407136a30b549201e254e.png[/img]

[b]What Are Benefits?[/b]
> Purchase all the Set Products for a bonus reward!
Make purchases for even more stuff! Further increase the discount rate by
purchasing products with bonus discounts!
Click the Detail button to read about the two types of Benefits in detail!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a93924a1c3893748072d3a38b32124e14745d95e.gif[/img]

[b]What Is a Set Product?[/b]
> If you purchase all the products in a set, you will get a bonus reward!
Set Products do not need to be purchased all at once. You can obtain the rewards
multiple times until you reach the specified limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/042bb9290dd67a1a220da37ce0290f5d69ea265d.gif[/img]

[b]What Is a Bonus Discount Product?[/b]
> Get discounts on top of discounts! Purchase Bonus Discount Products
along with other products to receive bonus discounts.
Purchase Bonus Discount Products to receive even bigger discounts!
*If you select multiple Bonus Discount Products, only the discount rate
of the product with the highest discount rate will be applied.

notes.title: Mega Pass Season 38
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/dd476440f08ac1d9968d3a320f0b2fd1141dcb19.png[/img]

Get ready for the thrill as the Mega Pass renews for its 38th Season!

Immerse yourself in the action and complete all levels to unlock exclusive
cosmetic items and a wealth of other rewards!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/09/11 00:00 ~ 2024/10/15 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9b7d7590f3b035b1322bcfc217cb76a33081a074.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for 1980 GKash,
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[i]Note:[/i] You cannot use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/630f4750eecce1f44c24af3c8e6f97eef42583be.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0b51e222d16e2612968c9c1d423104c0632a0db3.jpg[/img]
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

[i]Note:[/i] Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0d5fc2a3c150a9b090de715ff5aa0b1d2c79e686.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the regular and
Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c1ec58d5f2d08191afb50ce95c36933ae45d3345.jpg[/img]
 
You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars
as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3b60ef60bd144e8454c0ee91a49d8c7f4e9bc78c.gif[/img]

[i]Note:[/i] Please note that during the last week of the event,
no additional levels will be introduced. This period is designated for
players to claim their rewards before the event concludes. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7d695c5eb80c4e0d10fe31db94533d957deb7822.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/25c0b1900e5fa5991266fac705b590d95d9dce73.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Infinite Machine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/69ccd631cbede26a2670351962903804c67a2c3f.png[/img]

The Infinite Enhancement Machine is back!

Much like gears in a machine that constantly twists and turns, this event comes with an exciting new challenge!

Do you have the skills to take on the Infinite Enhancement Machine?

Show what you're made of in this thrilling event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a6bf86590da7eef3a1447f606a91cfda2922be8.gif[/img]

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/09/11 ~ 2024/09/24

[b]Event Mechanics:
[/b]Enhance any of the available items to claim them! By enhancing at specific levels, you’ll not only boost the item's stats but also extend its duration for up to 90 days!

Enhancement Fuel is required to enhance items. It can be purchased by selecting the "Buy Enhancement Fuel" button on the event page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6677e7ab92bc52fef55fea39be7a0adae6d7c529.gif[/img]

After obtaining Enhancement Fuel, you can move forward with the enhancement process.

- Items can be enhanced by pressing the 'Enhance' button on your preferred item. Enhancing an item will use Enhancement Fuel(s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2bb26931ad6cfa19c103c4b8c1e82278306b81ec.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] The amount of Enhancement Fuel required to enhance the item increases with
the item's level.

- After a successful enhancement, the duration of use or attributes will increase based on the grade.
 
- After successfully enhancing an item and receiving it, specific attributes can be selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/28293ce1299316aa69f96fc3d6ee1ef1a8066e61.gif[/img]

- A 'big failure' or enhancement failure may also occur, where the item will not be enhanced, and its enhancement may either reset or degrade. So, keep this in mind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c6f94312e7f18eedbf53c60478b0f4fe824e211c.gif[/img]

- A compensation reward will be granted for a failed enhancement, depending on the grade.

You can find more information about the enhancement by pressing the 
'Detailed Enhancement Info' button.

================================================================================

Thank you for your continued support!

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!

[i][b]~ Freestyle 2 Team[/b][/i]

[b]What is an Outfit Set?[/b]
1.  Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
[b]Outfit Set Feature Description:[/b]
 
[b]Transformation Set Outfit Function:[/b]
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.
4. If they have Back Acc, the Back Acc Ceremony will be unusable.
 
[b]Attribute Set Outfit Function:[/b]
1. When outfitted, the ability value always increases.
2. This is applied to the "Switching char" wearing the outfit set.

notes.title: Equipment System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4accc20bb6c6cc5ea597895385dcb3c4c666dc10.png[/img]

Get ready for a major upgrade in our Equipment System!

We’re excited to introduce the new Attribute Gems, bringing a fresh way to enhance your character’s attributes. 

Here’s everything you need to know:

Starting August 14 update, the Equipment will be renamed 'Attribute Gems'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/625e18da55d573389c0192bab1da3289552f60ca.png[/img]

You may also refer to the table below containing information about the new [i]Attribute Gem[/i] system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6baaa616931aa697dc02217ede146374a643ab6d.png[/img]

[b]Note:[/b]
- Season 1 End Date: December 31, 2024
- When a season changes, all items related to Attribute Gems in possession will be reset.
- The balance of attributes may be adjusted when the season changes.
Example 1: Slot types and the types of Attribute Gems that can be equipped.
Example 2: Activation conditions of Attribute Gems and attribute values.

[u][h3][b]-- What Are Attribute Gems? --[/b][/h3][/u]
[b]1. Seasonal Enhancements:[/b]
Attribute Gems are seasonal items designed to enhance your character’s attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7a2bf4d22eabd1871ce812385bcfe51d0d5f01bd.gif[/img]

[u][h3][b]-- How to Obtain Attribute Gem Coins? --[/b][/h3][/u]
- Disassemble Attribute Gems: You can obtain Attribute Gem Coins by disassembling Attribute Gems. These coins can be exchanged for desired items at the Attribute Gem Shop, accessible from the Attribute Gem menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/34d4ee50fc00c9b8743a4663507118476987933a.gif[/img]

- Mission System and Freeticket Shop: Attribute Gem Coins can also be obtained through the 
Mission System and the Freeticket Shop.

[u][h3][b]-- How to gear up your new Attribute Gems? --[/b][/h3][/u]
- Navigate to your Attribute GemTab/Screen, choose the item, and then click the check button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/44b6a9628e0339a58351efd63f1e9fcaff7b08ff.gif[/img]
[u][h3][b]-- How to upgrade your Attribute Gems? --[/b][/h3][/u]
- Navigate to your Attribute Gem Tab/Screen, access 'Manage Attribute Gems,' choose the item you wish to upgrade, and then click on the upgrade button. [i](Ensure that you unequip the unlocked Attribute Gem before upgrading it)[/i]
- All Attribute Gems can be upgraded and disassembled, and successful upgrades increase attributes.
- The success rate and the required materials for upgrade vary according to the grade and upgrade level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4d882bfc88c95f3e6f61a614cd9fff732e797e16.gif[/img]

- When the upgrade fails, it remains on the same level status.
- Upon upgrade failure, a certain amount of upgrade materials may be returned to you.
- From certain grades and levels, you can use sub-upgrade materials, which increases the success rate
- The maximum number of sub-upgrade materials that can be applied varies by upgrade level, and these items can be obtained through events, etc.
- Materials used for upgrade and sub-upgrade materials are consumed regardless of whether the upgrade succeeds or fails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/56317790ef9340ef540d5d61a1cbfb5e5c10fdc9.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]2. Types and Slots:[/b][/h3]
There are three types of Attribute Gems, each of which can be equipped in one
of three slots: Hair, Top, or Bottom.

[h3][b]I. Attribute Gems: Hair[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2581dc99cbb82a1def7389ef11c374ac931ddc98.png[/img]

[h3][b]II. Attribute Gems: Top[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c7e52ec47882eafcc9db747c6d8329fc79e5fdf4.png[/img]

[h3][b]III. Attribute Gems: Bottom[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/93cdf0dfeefc130a5c26a3ca5011eebff861c83a.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]3. Activation Conditions:[/b][/h3]
Each Attribute Gem has unique activation conditions. When these conditions are met during gameplay, the gem’s attributes are granted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5dd4c4bc7d8657422ac5a0adf2a5bcc2d4e55b12.png[/img]

[b]NOTE: You cannot equip multiple gems with the same activation conditions.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]4. Duration:[/b][/h3]
The attributes granted by the gems last for a specified period, which depends on the gem's grade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4b4936cc8f4d9c498aad2797f09d7dc805662a23.png[/img]

We have prepared a sample preview of each attribute gem with unique activation conditions. Please check the preview below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c0db12153b56307a5978c8babf703e5c456915b.gif[/img]

[b]Note: Only One (1) attribute is applied for every match.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]5. Enhancement and Disassembly:[/b][/h3]
Enhance your Attribute Gems to increase their attributes. Disassemble them to receive "Attribute Gem Coins," which can be exchanged for various items at the "Attribute Gem Shop".

For existing items depending on the enhancement level, will be exchanged for Attribute Gem Coins. Please refer to the table below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee752b240500935dc00da1805cf1bb5734b0105f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Used / Possession Item[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/beef5104ae41fedcc2bcbe1d05db74d61cf604a6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Enhancement Level[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Character Generation System Improvement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a3f802a49b120c336c0694f64936c80e5082da5b.png[/img]

Dear, FreeStyle 2 Players!

We’re excited to announce a new update that enhances the Character
Generation process!

We’re bringing you a fresh way to create the characters you love.

Say hello to instant character generation with our new system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5532c146650068f316ad89984e7a9746428da4ea.png[/img]

>  You can now create Character coupons using new items,
without needing to separate character-generating pieces.

> Existing character generation-related items will be consolidated
into a new item called a "Torn Contract".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c7ed20b5e5c8e1e1925a1c5bc4560d9bcbb6320e.gif[/img]

> If you have any of the above existing items, they will be replaced with a
new item, the "Torn Contract". The existing items will be deleted following
the replacement.

> The existing items will be exchanged based on the following ratio,
depending on the number of items you hold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/74ed21e91c056cf87afaef84d6282fbd61cef2eb.gif[/img]

Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/53ef2d9a6ab552f06eb5b3a0c9f4804ce8f8f8ac.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/37a27605e029d556c28fc3b340f8858a25407064.png[/img]

Below are the complete list of characters that you can generate using the
Torn Contract.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/51ece143db1798e238dcf203ebf348622f746e1f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2d879064c484b3ac3c9061bf2163d9c4bea2ca45.gif[/img]

1. Select the Character Coupon Tab:
Start by selecting the tab specifically for character coupons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/23e5b1a55d155dbb78ddf4e9f633c32957e9966b.gif[/img]

2. Choose Your Character:
Pick the character you wish to create and review the character details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/50ac9b9678eaf80db3624cd687ad9fdde4a1a3d4.gif[/img]

3. Check 'Torn Contract' Requirements:
Review the number of 'Torn Contract' items needed and press the create
button to finalize your selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8353593d510798bc5c86ca351528ab3d581d0942.gif[/img]

4. Locker Room Storage:
The newly created character coupon will be moved to your Locker Room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/782654dfe38599607eea926dbedc187594511e43.gif[/img]

5. Quick Search Feature:
Easily find the character by searching their name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4a0c866c1102a3fa450540cd31e45c436bd90e13.gif[/img]

6. Grade Selection:
When choosing character grades, you can view the character list
and team list corresponding to each grade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/32b2b4ac62c2d0648f63249566529d11b0b10473.gif[/img]

7. Position Selection:
Check out the recommended character list for each position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8ae61c93346dd6e8c338e0be48cf0243d8514fe6.gif[/img]

Note: You can create characters for positions other than those
recommended, but some characters may be restricted to their recommended
positions only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d8d5eb9fc0a4d971929adadfa5ec6add68bcc97e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cbe834e888d7fab2cca4ccec997379c1bf2bbbcd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ea8a28abc41f1f8cf8100df83fc42c839d7d47e4.png[/img]

For more details on the Character Generation Changes,
please visit our Pre-Notice Update:
https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/18799

Important Notes:
> Character coupons and symbol prices may be subject to adjustments
through future patches.

=================================================

Stay ahead of the competition, and don’t miss out on these new feature!

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!
 

- Freestyle 2 Team

Hermit's Super Quest!

FREE Premium Reward! 
(Free reward will be sent to Gift Box)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f24e67efc4d8f111d2ecfcc9225c70ac57681bbd.png[/img]
- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits
you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items
(except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.
 
** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse
will be moved to the gift box automatically.

* Step 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e7724ae3a0d929c98d7d8b537391b576d33a3ffd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/41f1fab00cab84158edb2128a9065f137f317e49.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d58ff5bd53c24492055aee72a5bf845b4b63d1fd.gif[/img]
 
2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]


- Obtain a FREE Premium Reward for every 200 draws!

*Step 2
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1cad335750a5ca98b7da171c4513e5cb74026b86.png[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
(***Note: Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/658ceda91b50cff62e13eef8ee048671f33c0649.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e49eaa7aad76350c5cd9b627c1edd9ad0cb83cf4.png[/img]
- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use
as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the
material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability
of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is
fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the
fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the
number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are
automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d2d141ba1928a5a60d4672a09fe3834737767b73.gif[/img]

*Step 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7c6bd4fda4f15f548150149a7da5b8bd86cfb5ba.png[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one
item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials.
The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.
 
*Step 2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2c11cd72ec1e2790de5d255018c7f879a502dad3.png[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once.
You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order,
with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused
or there aren't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be
excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your
Locker room.

notes.title: Advanced Announcement: Updates to the Character Generation and Equipment Systems
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b4274aa96b4d3f2c57f6ff7deb5a5ac9985c425.png[/img]

Greetings, This is Freestyle2 Dev!

Just a quick update— as highlighted in our Summer Season Roadmap, we’re
planning some cool improvements to the equipment and generation system.
Can’t wait to show you what’s coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/75033de7468164765a237359960a007f0190dc60.png[/img]

The second part of the GAME CHANGER update on 8/14 (Wednesday)
will be implemented as planned.

This update will include changes to the Character Generation System and
equipment system, which we’d like to inform ballers about in advance.

As these changes are important, we encourage you to review the details
ahead of time to ensure a smooth experience with the game. Please see
below for more information.

[b]1. Patch Date:[/b]
 - 2024/08/14 (Wed)

[b]2. Early Announcement:[/b]
 - Character Generation System Improvements
 - Equipment system Improvments

[b][ Character Generation System and Improvements ][/b]

1. Key Points of Changes to the Generating Piece
- You can now generate the latest character coupons and character symbols
using new items, without needing to separate character generating pieces.
- Existing character generation-related items will be consolidated into a new
item called a [b]"Torn Contract"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3591fa26d1307720bd9a8b4f6d85aa8d478272a8.png[/img]
 
2. Information on compensation for existing items in your inventory
- If you have any of the above existing items, they will be replaced with a
new item, the "Torn Contract", after the maintenance on
August 14 (Wednesday). The existing items will be deleted following
the replacement.
- The existing items will be exchanged based on the following ratio,
depending on the number of items you hold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/93c21bb300712f437af65947adb58dbba3bc06c9.png[/img]
* Please note that the conversion rate has been adjusted and applied differently
from the original item value, taking into account the reorganization of the
generation method, the introduction of new goods, and the addition of
new characters that can be created.

3. Information Regarding the Improvements
- If you possess any of the existing items, they will be replaced with a new item,
the "Torn Contract", after the maintenance on August 14 (Wednesday).
- Following the August 14 (Wednesday) update, character generating piece
will no longer be obtainable from combined device packs instead, only
character enhancement piece will be available.

[b][ Equipment System Improvements ][/b]

1. Key Points of Changes to the Equipment system Improvements
- The equipment system will switch to a seasonal model after
the August 14 (Wednesday) maintenance.
- Existing equipment will be removed and replaced with new gear.
- The main changes are as follows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8bca9cfcb6012f57d951a89bdab3feab66770eb7.png[/img]
 
2. Information on compensation for existing items in your inventory
- Compensation for existing items will be based on data from before
the August 14 (Wednesday) maintenance.
- Due to the removal of equipment from the previous system,
the new season’s equipment will be replaced with equipment upgrade
material items and distributed accordingly.

[b]A. Equipment Disassembly Piece[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/33bf2f74e8fdeebc52879463e8268d3baecbacb2.png[/img]
 
[b]B. Equipment and Equipment Boxes in Possession[/b]
- Equipment disassembly pieces will be provided based on the grade of the
equipment and equipment boxes that are installed or in possession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c74ae6a735530187d8dd30aa7833070423fb3ffe.png[/img]
 
[b]C. Materials Used for Strengthening Existing Equipment[/b]
Upgraded and sealed crystals used for strengthening existing equipment
will be converted into equipment disassembly pieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11202c22ba71d3ed7da1d000036dc20bda4a4b6c.png[/img]

[b]D. Quality Change Equipment[/b]
The items used for quality changes and those currently in possession will be
converted into equipment disassembly pieces, based on the quantity held.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c1356eb073cec482dbc8f57b7fa2fcc4e0a55b24.png[/img]

[b]E.  Sealed Crystals[/b]
- The probability of successful strengthening will be increased
from 1% to 2% for rare and legendary items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a2dc16f6fc10df9b8093507f48a09b59a74a4128.png[/img]

=============================================================================

Create your own style, Freestyle!
 
[i][b]~ Freestyle 2 Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: 2024.07.24th July Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/87f2f045edd680a344de7439282b1b3170bede45.png[/img]

Hello, Ballers!
 
This is the FreeStyle2 Development Team.
 
A Balance Hotfix patch will be implemented to address issues identified after
the 7/10 patch. We are currently reviewing various aspects, including player
trends, unintended gameplay mechanics, and balance data following the
July balance patch.

Please check the details of the changes below and feel free to leave your
feedback regarding the balance patch.
 
*After the balance patch, the 'Drift Shot SF' Mastery skill for the SF position
will be reset. Please check your Mastery skills before playing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec7b9df7e751d858c4a61c47a8a5b32fc48d8a33.png[/img]
[b]1) Gameplay Balance Changes[/b]
 
[b]A. Cross Hop Step (SF)[/b]
→ A coefficient has been added to make the Cross Hop Step basic skill affected
by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
→ The coefficient for the Cross Hop Step enhanced Mastery skill has been
modified to be more influenced by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
[b]B. Straight-line Drive (SF)[/b]
→ The coefficient for the Straight-line Drive Mastery skill has been modified
to be more influenced by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
→ The coefficient for the Straight-line Drive enhanced Mastery skill has been
modified to be more influenced by the Drive Speed attribute.
 
[b]C. Ball Handler Team Formation Adjustments[/b]
1) If there are 2 or more ball handlers on the HOME team, the attributes
of the ball handler positions will be decreased.

Ball Handlers:
Defensive Dual Guard, Block Point Guard, Steal Point Guard,
PG, and DG positions without specialties equipped.
 
2) Decreased Attributes
   - Move Speed -20%
   - 3pt Shot Success Rate -20%
 
[b]D. Diving Off[/b]
→ The skill hotkey will be changed.
 
  - Before: [W] key when loose ball is available.
  - After: [R] key when loose ball is available.

[b]2) Balance Changes & Error Fixes[/b]
 
[b]A. Changes to Results Display[/b]
→ An issue where match results were not displaying correctly has been fixed.
- Jump Ball & Effective Resistance Records.
 
[b]B. Back Roll Turn Pull-up Jumper (Mastery Skill)[/b]
1) An issue where the skill would activate even when the Enhanced Pull-up
Jumper Mastery isn’t equipped has been fixed.
 
2) An issue where the Enhanced Pull-up Jumper would activate when
using the Back Roll Turn Pull-up Jumper has been fixed. 
 
[b]C. Last Resistance Upgrade (Mastery Skill)[/b]
→ The probability condition in the activation requirements for the enhanced
Last Resistance Upgrade skill has been changed.
 
  a. Before
  - Big Man (C, PF, CT) will be affected by the Last Resistance skill if they
    possess the ball for more than 0.8 seconds.
      → Last Resistance Activation Success Rate
      - 0.8s: 40% Chance
      - 1s: 50% Chance
      - 2s: 100% Chance
 
  b. After
  - Big Man (C, PF, CT) will be affected by the Last Resistance skill if they
    possess the ball for more than 0.8 seconds.
    → Last Resistance Activation Success Rate
      - 0.8s: 53% Chance
      - 1s: 67% Chance
      - 1.5s: 100% Chance
 
[b]D. Paint Zone Middle Shot Adjustment[/b]
→ Fixed an issue where shot resistance was applied significantly lower
when taking middle shots from the paint zone.
 
[b]E. Status Indicator Icon Update
[/b]→ A status icon will be displayed under characters during gameplay.
  - Last Resistance Upgrade Activation Availability Status
    (Only the time condition will be displayed.)
  - Interrupt Skill Activation Availability Status.
 
[b]F. Growth Guide[/b]
→ A Balance tab has been added to the Growth Guide.
→ We will continue to update and provide more detailed
explanations regarding balance changes in the future.

=================================================

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- Freestyle2 Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5f46e993f2db6b9c5d05bf2dfccd948ac1f3c664.png[/img]

Dear, Ballers!

We would like to announce the details of our latest bug fixes.

Our team has been working diligently to address various issues to ensure you
have the best possible gaming experience.

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we appreciate your patience and
support as we strive to make continuous improvements to the game. 

Here are the specifics of the issues addressed during today's
maintenance:

[b]1. Card Bug[/b]
→ We are fixing all issues affecting specific Defense and Offense Cards.
Please note that the affected attribute options will undergo a reset and
reassignment process.
   
[i]i. Legend Grade Card: [/i]
Users affected by this bug will receive 5 Premium sub-attributes and 5
Card Attribute locks.

[i]ii. All-Star Grade Card: [/i]
Users affected can change the attribute to their preferred option by
contacting the Support Team. However, sub-attributes cannot be
changed to the same options.
**Users cannot select the same 3 sub-attributes. 

To address this issue promptly, please submit a support ticket to
steam_support@gamekiss.com

[b]2. Green User Skill Slot[/b]
→ Fixed the issue related to the Green User Skill Slot.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Matching Mechanism
notes.content:

Greetings, Ballers!
 
We are reaching out to inform you about important updates to our matching mechanism effective from today's maintenance.
 
Key Changes:
- Licensed Users: Licensed users will now meet more real users. However, if there are very few people on the server, they may still encounter AI opponents.
- Non-Licensed Users: Non-licensed users will continue to keep the same mechanism, so they can encounter AI opponents.
 
We understand that changes to the matchmaking system can affect your experience, and we want to ensure that these adjustments lead to an improved and more engaging environment. Your feedback is crucial to us, and we encourage you to share your thoughts and insights through a support ticket.
 
We will closely monitor the system and consider all feedback as we strive to provide the best possible experience for our users.
 
Thank you for your continued support and understanding.
 
 
[i]~ FreeStyle2 Team[/i]

notes.title: Mission System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aacba43aab2969c6ae7d6e3e5cecd6723efd44e1.png[/img]

We're excited to announce a major update to the Mission System in Freestyle 2!

Get ready to dive into the action and earn amazing new rewards.

Here’s what’s new:

Complete the Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Missions to earn fantastic
rewards and improve your gameplay experience.

By completing missions, you'll now receive Mission Clear Coins.
These special coins can be used in the Mission System Shop to exchange for
exclusive items.

Don’t miss out on the chance to enhance your game with these incredible
updates. 


I. Daily Mission

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/83751da39ff0f053b2d8ab6baacdf6fbdcbb7852.gif[/img]

- You can play Daily Missions in each slot for up to 3 times and obtain rewards.
- There's also a mission tracker located on the upper right corner of the screen
when you're currently in the lobby. Here's how it looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3a654cf7db8f7640b81f263860fe072530e3c55b.gif[/img]

- A daily mission can be changed each hour. The cooldown for changing a
mission will be shared across all slots. Check the preview below as reference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/155a966352cd95fbefe69457d4699f8bcebd6690.gif[/img]

- Missions will be reset at 00:00 daily.
- Rewards will be sent to your Gift Box.

List of Daily Missions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7a1792b350aa8e3ba44a184e1fbe2aab6542a664.png[/img]

II. Weekly Mission

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b8f4a6b023de8c95e6baf8a7aa588c94727fbe1d.gif[/img]

List of Weekly Missions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e9c248233f04f99d74f512ff599bf53c85f5d05c.png[/img]

- Weekly Missions will be reset at 00:00 on Mondays.
- Players need to complete weekly missions. Once you've finished the first
stage, you may claim the rewards and then proceed with the remaining stages.
- Rewards will be sent to your Gift Box.

Stage Rewards:
a. Stage 1: Mission Clear Ticket x600 and Freeticket x100
b. Stage 2: Mission Clear Ticket x800 and Freeticket x200
c. Stage 3: Mission Clear Ticket x1000 and Freeticket x300

Weekly Stage Missions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8294e68b21c2321e17662caca38a6a83028501fa.png[/img]

III. Monthly Mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/220afdf42eac653534edd5dcdb1fd3378ef44b51.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c81ad5d9a6e0163ca7b88f8f66c60dc9fd4f4d27.png[/img]

- Monthly Missions will be reset at 00:00 on the first day of every month.
- The monthly mission has 4 stages. Players must complete missions until they
get their 1st stage rewards. You may proceed with the following stages if you
wish to obtain different set of rewards.
- Rewards will be sent to your gift box.

Stage Rewards:
a. Stage 1: Mission Clear Ticket x1200 and Freeticket x100
b. Stage 2: Mission Clear Ticket x1400 and Freeticket x200
c. Stage 3: Mission Clear Ticket x1600 and Freeticket x300
d. Stage 4: Mission Clear Ticket x1800 and Freeticket x400

Monthly Stage Missions

Maximum attribute will be preserved. Motions will remain as they were
previously. If the attribute from Growth mode is lower than the character's
default attribute, the default will be applied, and only the excess will be
retained. 

→ C/PF/CT: Power type 
→ SF/SW/SG/DG/PG: Shrewd type, considered standard.

2. Draft Event
The Draft System will end in July. Instead, we will introduce a new
feature allowing you to create Parts Characters directly when making a
character.

3. BZ Channel
Starting with our July 10 update, the Buzzerbeater (BZ) Channel will be
removed and merged with the Regular Channel, creating a single,
unified channel for our players.

4. Newbie Mission
We are announcing a new event exclusively for new users of Freestyle 2.
This updated Newbie Mission is designed to provide a more structured and
engaging experience for our latest players, offering various opportunities
and rewards.

5. Character Growth Package
The Character Growth Package will be discountinued.

For more details regarding the discontinued and updated events,
please refer to the "July 10th Event Conclusion and Adjustment Notice"
Link: https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/18731

and Black Lightning.
- The original parts previously used by these advanced characters (Team Slam,
Naughty Kitty, & Black Lightning) are removed.

magic characters)

character Manager Liu can.

are +1 higher.

> Deleted Parts Item

magic characters (Team Slam, Naughty Kitty, Black Lightning) are deleted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/777f8786c0f09a379da9ca6003602b494bfc8d7a.png[/img]

11. Character Attribute Changers

- Character Attribute Changers added on users info system
(This feature is available for all characters, but some characters may
have restrictions)
Following the character attribute  changer update on 7/10 (Wednesday), the
existing character growth mode will be removed.
The character growth mode button in the 'Training' menu will be deleted, and
the related content will be disabled.

 
==================================================================================

Prepare for an enhanced gaming experience with these
exciting July Improvements!

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!

~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Character Performance Upgrade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6f176f0464e9fd3158ba38fdd2d029fb8c094192.png[/img]

Introducing the Character Performance Upgrade, designed to elevate
the abilities of your beloved Normal, Magic, and Rare Characters to elite levels
in Freestyle 2.

We would like to share that this system has been added to upgrade the
performance of Normal, Magic and Rare characters.

Accordingly, we have created a system that allows users to significantly
upgrade the unique characters they love to premium character level.
 
We plan to support upgrades even if you play hard, and you will be able
to create a unique character with the motions and abilities you want. 
 
Here's what this exciting update entails:

Key Features:

1. Enhanced Character Abilities:
   - Upgrade your characters' performance significantly, allowing them to
rival premium characters.
   - Customize Motions and Abilities to suit your playstyle through the
new Motion Change and Attribute Equip features.

2. Mission Shop Feature:
   - Complete Daily, Weekly, and Monthly missions to earn Mission Clear Tickets.
   - Use Mission Clear Tickets in the Mission Shop to acquire Motion Skills and
Attribute parts.
   - Access the Character Attribute Changer to modify and enhance your
character's stats.

3. Motion Change Tab:
   - Users can check their acquired motions in the Skill - Motion Change tab. 

Check out the details below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/472d673414f2d2acf5379690731f92f0478d1398.png[/img]

Boost your characters' performance substantially, enabling them to compete with
premium characters.

There are two ways for users to enhance their characters:
 
1. Through the Mission Shop
2. Using the Skill > Motion Change tab

What is a Mission Shop?
[1] It is a dedicated shop where you can purchase items using Mission Clear
Tickets, which are obtained by completing missions.
[2] Mission Clear Tickets can be earned through daily, weekly, and
monthly mission stage rewards.
[3] Various items such as Attribute Parts, Titles, Cards, and Outfits can be
purchased.
[4] Purchased items will be sent to the Gift Box.
*The types of items, price, and purchase limits may be susceptible to
changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9cdfb867ea287534b7c3f13efb7274edb42b1b60.gif[/img]

Clear Mission Tickets
→ Users can obtain Mission Clear Tickets through Daily, Weekly, and Monthly
Missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d8cdf68278ede09168f76e073fc05756a6507fb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/75354c6cafe88aa0e139feea45949366e7d495e2.png[/img]

→ Visit the Mission System Shop to explore available upgrades and purchases.

→ Using Mission Clear Tickets, Event Cash, or Free Tickets, users can
acquire Motion skills, Attributes, and Character Attribute Changers.

→ Please be informed that only the Mission Clear Tickets can be used at the
Mission Shop.

→ In the Skill - Motion Change tab, users can use Event cash and
Freetickets.
 
Mission Shop Guide Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4df350c529aa189b72bcb44e00924bf048fbc4c1.jpg[/img]

[1] You can see the acquired Mission Clear Tickets on this Tab.
[2] Click Mission Shop
[3] Check Out the list of categories that you can use your Mission Clear Tickets
[4] To know more about the Mission Shop, kindly hover your mouse here.
[5] This is the Product List where you can obtain Motion skills and other items. 

--------
Note:
→ If you clear Daily, Weekly, and Monthly missions in the Mission system, you
can obtain Clear Mission Tickets that you can use to purchase a Motion skill.

→ You can also get stat Parts and increased stats through the 
Character Attribute Changer.

→ You can only wear one motion skill at a time, but you can equip
multiple skills and choose the motion you want to use and buy it.

→ You can get attribute parts from the mission shop, and they can be
equipped by all characters. However, the skill motion is only available
for Normal to Rare items.

→ Parts that can be obtained through Parts collection events will be removed,
and new stat parts will be provided.

Character Attribute Changers: 
→ Adjusts the Attributes of certain characters. The Attribute Changer
can be used in the 'Character Changer Performance Enhancement'
tab under 'User Information'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/05d5736ef9feaa4380dc68fd623f32d96cd0804b.png[/img]

Preview
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/15ae13cd43dbc39dfad3e6baf2a3f472f08665c4.gif[/img]

Character Performance Reset Ticket:
→ Resets the attributes modified by Performance Changers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aba5aea77763aee2cc41a0e460afdc5c9a462099.png[/img]

Preview
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/55fa5d0f1fc443cef4157e064209fdff509c6b56.gif[/img]

Note:
[1] The purchased motion skills can be held by each character, with some
being permanent and others time-limited.
[2] Each character can only have one permanent skill. For fixed-term skills,
the duration of use can be extended with additional purchases.
[3] Only one motion skill of each type
(Jump shot, Long-range Dunk, Long-range Layup, Block, Rebound)
can be equipped at a time.
(Example: Different skill motions of the same jump shot type cannot be
equipped simultaneously; only the first motion can be equipped.)
[4] Acquired Motion skills are non-transferable and cannot be sold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2711264e408ff66bf78f2414426e3d44f9db40b3.png[/img]

→ Users can check their acquired motions in the Skill - Motion Change tab.
 
→ The Motion Change system allows you to exchange character motions or
adjust insufficient attribute values according to your preference.

→ In the motion change tab, users can obtain motions based on the character's
grade:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9557c8698d3c353f86eba0fe1918b0c8827aae05.png[/img]

**Legend characters don't receive points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e43277d3bf220c602d69f08c0fee454304f3d2a5.gif[/img]

Motion Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e300e5df96857059f79ab0ab95c33c4e46c9318e.gif[/img]

How to Purchase a Motion:
- You can use Clear Mission Tickets, Gkash, Freetickets and Mileage
Points to purchase a Motion Skill.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8007791/776d92d2b41ab1a2687681eda9d9317ef2b62845.gif[/img]

How to Unequip a Motion:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8007791/a07d9de6729286db8a45eaf676110117f5d2f589.gif[/img]

Attribute Preview:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8007791/2bebee4cd7ffd4152bac97badc0be0ab1b46723a.gif[/img]

Motion Change Guide Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fe0f3cb20b406ff0c1446f73f828d2d489cba960.jpg[/img]

[1] Click 'Motion Change' from the Skill tab
[2] Navigate to the Character Motion List tab
[3] View the List of Motion Categories
[4] Explore the List of Motion Skills per category
[5] Identify the Character Name
[6] Note the Character Rarity
[7] Check the Available Motion Points.
[8] After selecting Motion Skills, click 'Save'
[9] Preview the Motion Preview here
[10] View the Displayed Equipped Motion Skills

Kindly check the Help tab for more information regarding the Motion skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9f63138c3ffec4551e534ead64eeeaccb02b9445.gif[/img]

--------
Important Points:

[1] Normal, Magic, and Rare characters can obtain Motion skills,
Attributes, and Character Attribute Changers through the Mission System. 
[2] Previously, users could equip only one (1) motion skill, but now multiple
motion skills can be equipped.
[3] Users can now choose the skills they want instead of obtaining them
randomly.
[4] This new system replaces the previous growth mode.

=================================================

We hope you enjoy the enhanced gameplay with these exciting new features!

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!


- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: All Star Outfit Mover
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a9deef9c0fe27b8811e817abd1423aa80a2205e5.png[/img]

All Star Outfit Item Mover is now added to the game!
 
We're excited to announce a fantastic new feature in Freestyle 2: the All Star
Outfit Item Mover!

This new addition allows players to transfer All Star clothing items between
characters within the same account, making it easier than ever to customize
your roster.

What is an All Star Outfit Item Mover?
→This item lets you move All Star clothing items to other characters within the
same account, enhancing your ability to personalize your team's look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0749ca4951e04986b5f9586f9f092dd9833efcb2.png[/img]

Here's how you can move the clothing items:

1. Click Locker and select "Costume Move" Tab
→ Access your locker and navigate to the "Costume Move" tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/719dceb11b684c2767103390307c5f748ca2f7df.png[/img]

2. Select the Outfit that you wish to move
→ Choose the specific item you want to transfer to another character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b3cfade31bf086f0b3e33ccc48dec50df12be359.gif[/img]

3. Click "Select Character"
→ After selecting the item, click "Select Character." A window will appear listing
all the characters in your account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/dee19714993a5aa3ce650f10d3a04d8bd0809fb6.gif[/img]

Note:
→ After moving/transferring the item(s) to another character, the attributes
added to the clothes are equally applied. 

=================================================
We hope you enjoy the new All Star Outfit Item Mover feature and find it
useful for customizing your characters in Freestyle 2!
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!
 
- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: BZ+Regular Channel Merge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ce37b82dde326b1d2477ea891eb178fdd338b353.png[/img]

Attention FS2 Ballers!

We’re thrilled to announce an exciting update that’s set to elevate your gaming
experience!

Starting with our July 10 update, the Buzzerbeater (BZ) Channel and the
Regular Channel will be merged into one powerhouse channel! 

This merge promises to bring you:

More Competitive Matches: With a larger pool of players,
get ready to face diverse opponents and sharpen your skills like
never before.

Unified Community: Connect with more players, make new friends, and
form stronger teams!

Enhanced Gameplay: Enjoy a seamless transition and improved matchmaking
as we combine the best elements of both channels.

Before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2f9d22196ba7c5247c81a49589195197d09b2b00.png[/img]

After: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/968d912c0d55486307d71761a248d45b739624fc.png[/img]

How to Play a Match:
1. Create a Private Room: Set up your own exclusive team.
You can adjust the maximum room capacity using the player count dropdown box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a83b93606b2a8e63bba87c6cf21e80a45db835df.gif[/img]

- If the matchmaking player count is 1 or 2, The role groups for teammates are
automatically set based on your character's position.
 
2. Activate Auto Matchmaking: Get into action by clicking the Match Start
button. Let our advanced system pair you
with compatible teammates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/08d7cbf41049523e2648623dca6b6dccfaf8ccad.gif[/img]

Auto Matchmaking Features:
- Smart Team Assignment: Automatically matches you with teammates based
on your role group, ensuring balanced and strategic gameplay.
 
- Convenience at your Fingertips: Access lobby features while waiting for the
perfect squad to assemble.
 
- Flexible Player Slots: Customize your waiting room by opening
or closing character slots, seamlessly integrating Auto Matchmaking to fill
remaining positions.

Matchmaking Match Booster

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/350230c3c4a75500b9bd0765e6cfa3c441f6648c.gif[/img]

After 5 seconds of auto matching, the 'Match Booster' button becomes available.
 
Activating the 'Match Booster' expands the matchmaking search range,
allowing for faster matching, but it may result in teaming up or matching with
higher-ranked users.
 
Note: the booster feature CANNOT BE USED when proceeding with
matchmaking through the waiting room."

Feel free to check the information below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e5fc68095ffdb51b68839d7311bddfed17bb2058.png[/img]

Important Note: 
→ If a user doesn't have a license, they will only be matched with other
users who also don't have a license.

→ Similarly, users who have a license will be matched with others
who have a license.

→However, once they create a private room, users with a license
and those without a license can play together.

=================================================

We can’t wait to see you all in the game, competing, collaborating,
and having a blast in this newly unified channel. 
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Miracle Mine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00a929567ca47e5149dfa32321326222a12258f6.png[/img]

Dive into the depths of adventure with Freestyle 2's latest event: Miracle Mine! 

Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey filled with mystery and excitement
as you unearth hidden treasures waiting to be discovered!

Event Period:
2024/03/20 00:00 ~ 2024/04/16 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/265f3dd3ffe74d60533d444693c61fb6d7c682a1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d4cc6dc11045babccbfc80ea0a54d24adc38bd5.png[/img]

Step into the shoes of a seasoned miner and follow these simple steps to
uncover the riches that lie within:

1. Navigate to the Miracle Mine page through the event banner located in the
lobby.
2. Set up your miners in the miner's quarters and start extracting ore.
3. Delve deep into the mine and collect various ores to obtain Gold bars and
Ancient keys. 
4. As you mine through each stage, advance to the next level of challenges. 
Note: You can clear up to 9 stages in 1 season.
5. Visit the Miracle Shop and use your Gold bars to exchange them for a
wide array of items. 
6. Use the ancient keys you've acquired to unlock ancient boxes filled with
mysterious treasures.

Note:
- When mining is in progress, the time remaining until mining is completed
is displayed.
(Mining only takes place when connected to the game. When offline, mining
is stopped.)
- When the remaining mining time reaches “0”, the object to be mined is
deleted and the reward item is dropped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1fbf66c242f844b61e98db1e00d01bee0dbffeb8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/13048db661241ae5262afc69bf5eec06e02405d5.jpg[/img]

The season runs from Wednesday to Wednesday for 7 days.
1 Season consists of 9 stages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/adb8fa405e9e93c9d95cb4ac4504b32ea8c1543a.gif[/img]

[b]Seasonal adjustments[/b]
-  Miner's Lodge Level reset
-  Delete miners active in the mine
-  Reset stage clear count

[b]Season End Notice preview:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eb952dcdbb2037ddab55af81db9b2d30bd423e07.jpg[/img]

Miners are produced over time in the miner's lodge and are stored there.
- Production works only while connected to the game.
Note: Mining stops when offline
Production and storage of miners will only work up to the maximum storage
capacity.
Miners can be placed in the mine by pressing the "Place" button.
When deployed, the miner's lodge gains experience and levels up.
Note: As it levels up, the level of the deployed miners also increases.

[b]Miner Information:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c9809a5fa47b3c76af9dcd50e6159f255fab381a.png[/img]

[b]Preview:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b1cca1056f13510fb9a0f6c7e075c1c58b50d07.jpg[/img]

Each mine has a maximum number of miners that can be operated, and the
number of miners cannot exceed that.

Miners can perform actions such as:
- Mining objects: Gold ore, Key ore, Treasure chests, etc.
- Leveling up: combining two of the same miners to level up
Note: Combining reduces mining time.

[b]Preview:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e38df7eae8b5bc5099aaa37a59f87b84e8a825c5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a1a8b0cb12aeb53c8de43eb8b56dbffc1a9d7332.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/32e1f550047ee3e4bcf8804ba3e3be61797715ad.jpg[/img]

When miners are placed near an objective, they automatically start mining.
- If there are more than two objectives nearby, the mining direction can be
changed through drag & drop.
When mining, the time remaining to complete the action is displayed in
real-time.
- Mining can only be done while connected to the game
Note: mining stops when offline

When the remaining mining time reaches "0", the target objective is removed,
and reward items are dropped.
Dropped items are obtained by placing a miner at the item's location or clicking
on it.
Note: High-Level Key ore can disappear after a certain period of time.
Your in-game data may not save properly if you close the game abruptly.

[b]Preview:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2736f0f86dca38cf17676892407168fc73040827.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8e91419b6d841518ac90649e1ff9103c3654ecd8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cd136202e5ba4acb755fd190c617a0f0cdd98ea9.jpg[/img]

[b]Various mining objectives can yield Event currency.[/b]
- Ore: Gold bars
- Key ore: Ancient Keys

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e7911ae76f264ab2bf3929ec757d76c8e540eb3.gif[/img]

[b]The acquired items can be used for various purposes.[/b]
- Gold bars: Exchanged for various products in the Miracle store
- Ancient keys: Used to unlock ancient chests and obtain them

[b]Ore:[/b]
- You can obtain Gold bars when mining Ore, and the Gold bars you acquire
are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- The Gold bars you acquire can be used at the Miracle Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d5b2d486d11f2f4d3f1dda6d1e0a7aaab84b9243.png[/img]

[b]Special Ore: [/b]
- When mining Special Ores, you can obtain a large amount of Gold bars from
the Gold bar Pouch.
- Gold bars obtained through the Gold Bar bag can be used at the Miracle Shop.
- Rewards are sent on the Gift box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ecbdcad7ab77da41787988c15815c7879486a8ad.png[/img]

- You can obtain Ancient keys when mining Key ore, and the acquired Ancient
keys are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- High-level key ores will be deleted if they are not mined within the time limit.
- The acquired Ancient key can be used to open the Ancient chest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/77dc947173c5b8d1cfc77650bb3dbc5c7b26d38a.png[/img]

1.  Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
Outfit Set Feature Description:
 
**Transformation Set Outfit Function:
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.
4. If they have Back Acc, the Back Acc Ceremony will be unusable.
 
**Attribute Set Outfit Function:
1. When outfitted, the ability value always increases.
 
2. This is applied to the "Switching char" wearing the outfit set.

notes.title: 2024.07.10th Summer Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d65d2ad8fe1685bf736d40cdd849c8e6fed3b01.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

This is the FreeStyle2 Development Team.

There will be a balance patch with the July 10th (UTC) summer season update.
We will continue to check for issues after the patch and if needed, apply hotfixes.
Please check the information below for details. And once again, we ask you
for your feedback and opinions regarding the balance changes.

*The Mastery Skills for all positions will be reset.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec7b9df7e751d858c4a61c47a8a5b32fc48d8a33.png[/img]

1) New Skills
A. Fast Back Dribble
SW Position – Crossover Swingman Mastery Skill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e64fab91a68b0bcaaac431b4abfbb937b3f5dcf.gif[/img]

Quickly move backward during drive-through dribble to create distance from the
defense. Dribble state is maintained during this action.
Fast Back Dribble Speed increases based on the Drive Speed ↑ Attribute.
[i](Note: You can use the skill without equipping Fast Back Dribble.)[/i]

B. Normal / Enhanced Pull-up Jumper
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3cc227e5166d1eac6ede8b4b2161184111f648ab.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0d2cac5315271ae13ee3fba5af6a26577f10febd.gif[/img]

SW Position – Crossover Swingman Mastery Skill
Allows you to perform an extremely quick jump shot while drive dribbling.
In offensive situations, if the HOME team's C or PF position is not in the
post-push area, the regular Pull-up Jumper skill will be activated.
[i](You can use the skill only when you have the Pull-up Jumper skill equipped.)[/i]

C. Back Roll Turn Pull-up Jumper
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d39e6ff3a585f21a1b65761e910340073d619194.gif[/img]

SG Position – Crossover Shooting Guard Mastery Skill
Quickly perform a Fade Away shot during a back roll turn.
[i](Note: When using the 'Back Back Roll Turn 1' skill, you can only use the
'Backroll Pull-Up Jumper' skill if you have the 'Pull-Up Jumper' skill equipped.)[/i]

2) Mastery Changes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a1fbf7731b8d183a1c52fded62cf5bd09c4f1b33.png[/img]

3) Skill Changes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fbf4558b0d2250a4ad6604a5559796060a0b298c.png[/img]

4) Play Logic Balance Changes
A. Timing Fake Conditions Adjustment (Play Logic)
1) In offensive situations, if the HOME team's C or PF position is not in the
post-push area, Timing Fake is not applied.
 - Timing Fake is applied to the SF position’s ‘Technical Shot Master’ regardless
of HOME team’s location.
2) If there is an ‘Away Screen Move Shooting Guard’ in HOME team, Timing Fake
is not applied to ‘Quick Jumper’ in the Mid-Range Shot area.

B. Screen Body Check (Normal Skill)
1) If ‘Away Screen Move’ can be activated (MOVE tag shown), Stamina is greatly
decreased when using Screen Body Check.

C. Diving Throw (Mastery Skill)
1) The shortcut to use is change to [W].
2) The range and release point will be greatly increased compared
to ‘Diving Catch’.

D. Screen: Collision Range↑ (Attribute)
1) The range increased for each Screen: Collision Range↑ Attribute is reduced.
2) Screen: Collision Range’s effectiveness is decreased
when Screen Body Checking.

E. Side Hop Step (Normal/Mastery Skill)
1) Side Hop Step Speed increases based on Drive Speed ↑ Attribute.

F. Character Attribute (Attribute)
1) The difference in Attributes between ‘Power Type’ and
‘Balance Type’ / ‘Shrewd Type’ and ‘Balance Type’ will be decreased.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8007791/32b97238ee4c2f284b1016e3ff4eac0cb495911a.png[/img] 

[i]*The example attribute above represents the basic attribute value for the
Center position, without the unique effect of each character applied.[/i]

G. Last Resistance  (Normal Skill)
C, PF, and CT position are not checked under the last resistance
subbone conditions.
(When there are positions other than C, PF, and CT, the use of the
last resistance skill changes.)

H. Move Speed Increase during Defense	
1) The existing 'Move Speed Increase during Defense' Mastery is the
same as the 'Move Speed Increase during Defense' stat +19.		
2) If the Move Speed Increase during Defense is less than +19,
it is less than the speed of the existing Mastery

5. Bug Fixes
A. Long Range Shot Success Rate Revised
1) Commonly identified as a bug, the issue of relatively long range shots in certain areas has been resolved.
 
6) Balance Improvements
A. Alley-oop Pass
 - If you are pressing [V], Alley-oop Pass will not activate.

B. Training System
 - The following characters will be added to the Training System.
→ Lukas
→ Aurora
→ Unlimit Jake

C. New Records Added
 - The Season OP and Season DP after a match will be removed and
new records will be added.
→ Jump Ball: The number of Jump Balls obtained, starting from
the beginning of the game. (Excluding overtime)
→ Effective Resistance: An indicator that increases when
effective block resistance is applied to shots from the opponent.
(When multiple players have resisted, the player who have the
highest resistance will be recorded.)
 * Records such as player info, ranking, match stats, and more will be added.

D. Normal/Magic Character Attributes Enhancement
1) All parts that could be obtained through the Parts Collection Event
will be removed.
 - Normal Character Parts
 - Naughty Kitty Parts (Ginger, Nicki, Liu)
 - Black Lightning Parts (Lyn, Nick, James Kim)
 - Team Slam Parts (Gorilla, Michelle, Simon)

2) Unique Effect skills will be added for normal characters.
 - Game Changer Regular Attributes
 - All Stats +3 (All Training Stats +3)

3) Unique Effect skills will be added for magic characters.
 1> Game Changer Regular Attributes
 - All Stats +1 (All Training Stats +1)

 2> Game Changer Extra Attributes
 - Mid.Shot: success%↑ +1
 - 3pt Shot Success Rate ↑ +1
 - Drive Speed ↑ +1
 - Stamina max↑ +1
 - Stamina: recovery↑ +1
 - Move: speed↑ +1
 - Manual Block Range +1
 - Steal Speed ↑ +1

4) Parts of normal/magic characters are deleted and replaced with
unique effect skills. The added attributes may be reduced compared to
before.

- The motion change system in the character performance upgrade allows
you to exchange character motions or adjust insufficient attribute values
according to your preference.
(For more details, please refer to the 'Character Performance Upgrade' update.)
 
5) The unique effects of normal/magic characters can be adjusted for
some attributes and effects through balance patches.
 
6) Balance planning:
- The use of new skills in the training system will be updated later.

notes.title: Mega Pass Season 37
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/78c9fb4964e036f8c2f43be77193cedce656f860.png[/img]

Get ready for the excitement as the Mega Pass returns for its 37th Season! 

Dive into the action and conquer all the levels to unlock exclusive cosmetic items
and a treasure trove of other goodies!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/07/03 00:00 ~ 2024/08/27 23:59 (PDT)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5797a9d078c5c5e2420c0bb0681891e6f8aba809.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9eb11f3807897e99012fb1ccf0f3254d815c5460.png[/img]
The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash,
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[b]Note: [/b]You can use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64a436e83efccc7dcff1eb7ba28ead6c06900b37.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5122908698a37c5dfb8232f40d5250e72c7b6d67.png [/img]
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)
- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

[b]Note:[/b] Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ab19320a6b5eb9200df3db76e7c99ba08684537a.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the regular and
Premium Mega Pass.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d84f9dd0dd16099ebf1a44ee336e5259dc230cce.png[/img]
 
You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars
as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3eb82415b631823b18bea96d8b84c3a8715744eb.gif[/img]

[b]Note: [/b]Please note that during the last week of the event,
no additional levels will be introduced. This period is designated for
players to claim their rewards before the event concludes. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cb001291a9c64e588c5b01f359b804b865cd31b0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7317866f5a6f6f8b28060b14341e0bd92acc172a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/dcb39e1535ad19f8366c5a6baf3bf802104c40e3.gif[/img]

notes.title: 2024 Summer Season Update Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ce93ddb0f643a94fc15b15856d365c574fda6509.png[/img]

Hello from the Freestyle 2 Dev Team!

Summer 2024 is here, and we’re excited to bring you new content to
enjoy this season. We’re working hard to prepare a variety of new features
to make your summer even more fun.

We truly appreciate your love and support for Freestyle 2.

Since our update on June 5th (PDT), we’re thrilled to share
our Summer 2024 Roadmap with you.

[b]Here are the main points of our Summer 2024 Roadmap:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d34cf4a6b3c62df1f5b0066ebc71a77e0800ea78.png[/img]
 
[b]June [/b]- Unlimit Jake / Establishing a foundation to reduce the power gap
between players through Parts Character Draft

[b]July [/b]- Add parts characters to basic characters, Upgrade character performance,
Game Changer Big Update with Special Express Event

[b]August [/b]- Summer Season 2 Big Update with Character Craft System and
Various Improvements

The Development Team will do its utmost to deliver the above content
in its best possible form.

Next, we will share the details of the Update with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/63714403eafbe451804fb8181a3720682dee5a43.png[/img]

We will begin with the June Update.

- [b]Draft System: Parts Characters[/b]
The Draft System was revamped in June. 
You could now receive the complete Parts Character instead of a Draft Character. 
From Saru to Helena, a total of 11 Parts Characters were made available.

[Link] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/4166472403255651202?l=english]Draft Season 12[/url]

- [b]Unlimit Jake[/b]
The Wild Rookies’ Jake has returned to FS2 with major upgrades.

 
Unlimit Jake is distributed to players through an Event. We hope you
look forward to meeting him!

[Link] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/4163095337680829908?]Unlimit Jake Update[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d761a407bfa421ece5522601a37c230f75e6e761.png[/img]
 
Next is the July Update.

In July, many new features will be introduced under
the title "Patch Name: Game Changer."

- [b]Character Performance Upgrade[/b]
A new system that allows you to upgrade Normal, Magic, and Rare Characters
will be added. 

Over the extended period that FS2 has been in service, many original characters
have become less practical due to changes in the meta. 

To address this issue, we have developed a system that enables you to
enhance your favorite characters.

We plan to make these upgrades easily accessible, so they will be available
simply by playing the game.

However, this system will replace the Growth Mode. Following the July Update,
Growth Mode will be removed from the game. 

The existing motions acquired through Growth Mode can still be used
without any changes. Additionally, we are improving the system to make
obtaining motions easier and more enjoyable.

Stay with us! you’re in for a treat!

- [b]Game Changer - Express Event[/b]
July 10th! Game Changer Special Main Event will be held.
We promise you a thrilling gift that you have never experienced before.
Please look forward to it!

- [b]Summer Balance Patch[/b]
A new balance patch will arrive for the Summer Season.
New skills will be added to the game, and balance adjustments will be made
to various positions and strategies.

We will continue to bring exciting changes to the meta with consistent
balance adjustments, starting from the Summer Season and extending
through the Winter Season.

- [b]User Benefit Revamp[/b]
We are planning to revamp some fundamental aspects of FS2. 

We’re excited to share that you can now get SP Running, SP Stamina, and
other premium skills just by playing, with no payment needed!

The Green User Benefit will finally be updated, and new products
will be added to the Shop.

Additionally, a UI update in July will make the menu easier to navigate. 

We will provide further details regarding these adjustments in
an announcement after the July Patch.

- [b]BZ+Regular Channel Merge[/b]
We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear. 

To improve our matchmaking system, the first step we will take is to merge
the BZ and Regular channels. 

After the merge, it will operate as a Regular Channel. Various options will be
implemented to enhance the matchmaking experience. 

We hope this merge will allow our players to enjoy more quality games.

- [b]Parts Character Distribution[/b] 
The “Game Changer” Update will allow you to create Parts Characters when
creating a character. 

We hope this update will enhance your gaming experience and deepen
your love for the game. 

However, this system will replace the Draft System. 

Following the July Update, the Draft System will be removed from the game,
and Parts Characters will also be removed from the Crystal Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8147fc4331f647389fb961caf9bce9c7e9bed639.png[/img]

Lastly, let’s talk about August.

The second big update of the summer season is scheduled for August,
focusing on introducing new systems and events.

- [b]Character Craft System[/b]
The existing character creation and enhancement systems will be completely
reorganized to make it easier to create and strengthen characters.

- [b]Equipment System[/b]
The existing equipment system will be changed to a seasonal system. 
Equipment will reset and be rebalanced every season, making the process of
acquiring equipment more meaningful and rewarding.

- [b]Summer Season Event[/b]
We are preparing a new event to wrap up the summer season.
The event will feature various rewards and plenty of enjoyment,
so we hope you look forward to it.

- [b]2nd New Item Update[/b]

=============================================================================

Our 2024 SUMMER SEASON Roadmap ends here.

Our Developer Team is currently doing its best to incorporate your feedback and
brainstorm ideas to further enhance your gaming experience.

We are also very happy to share with you their plans for the summer.

We will do our utmost to ensure the promised content is added to the game in
due time.

Thank you!

Sincerely,

[i][b]~ Freestyle 2 Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: How to fix 'Failure to Download the Launcher Data Error'
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d323c2079970e288be50e992e24c2e1fd6ee1b7b.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

We understand that some of our players have been experiencing the
"Failure to Download the Launcher Data" error when trying to launch the game.

This issue can be quite frustrating, and we're here to help you resolve it swiftly
so you can get back to enjoying the game. Below, you'll find a comprehensive guide
to fixing this error.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9b911dec6e749476bf453d4096c2c1a31b4ec8fe.png[/img]

1. Completely delete the folder where FS2 is installed:

→ Navigate to: This PC → Local Disk (C:) → FS2 Folder
→ Delete the FS2 folder by pressing Shift + Delete
*Alternatively, go to the folder where the game was installed and Delete it.

2. Re-download the web launcher after completely deleting the original
game folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a240913f67ef7e73d00dff27633cd497aa7be1a5.png[/img]


3. After installing the launcher, check the version of Launcher.exe in the
installation folder:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18862244e5a566545b70cf2bfa9d00bee96b939b.png[/img]

→ Locate the Launcher.exe from the game folder→ Right-click on Launcher.exe
→ Click Properties (R) → Details → Check the file version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4cf2d3786c54131f3400b3b3756c236f45df1ba1.png[/img]

*If the file version number is 0.10.139.13, you can run the game as normal.

4. Start the Game!
 
Note:
**If the problem continues to occur even after following the above steps,
please submit your inquiry for 1:1 customer support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa73eb357b88087770db8651f478f4f7238b1ab8.png[/img]

1. Follow the path below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/305047e42eb7d7de98cce3b6ba1eb78dbe47df77.png[/img]
 
2. After completing the process above, check the game version at
LauncherSteam.exe in the installation folder:
→Right-click on LauncherSteam.exe → Properties (R) → Details →
Check the file version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/12dc0a995da8e3706bfa082afb616f3fdd4a1222.png[/img]

*If the file version number is 0.10.127.3, you can run the game as normal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7fab84179ef964c65e33c0ce5b69c5815a9f4880.png[/img]

3. Start the Game!
 
Note:
**If the problem continues to occur even after following the above steps,
please submit an inquiry for 1:1 customer support.

=================================================
We hope these steps help you fix the "Failure to Download the Launcher Data"
error.

If you continue to experience issues, please contact our support team for
further assistance.

Thank you for your continued support.
 
Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
- Freestyle 2 Team
