character. But you can still do the quests (Daily, Weekly, and Seasonal) and
gain Draft Exp.

* If rewards are not obtained during the draft period, you cannot
obtain result rewards.
 
* Characters participating in character growth mode are also eligible.
 
* Characters participating in the draft cannot be deleted.
 
* STEP level rewards cannot be obtained when participating in the draft
with existing characters.
 
* Daily, weekly, seasonal, and STEP rewards through the draft system
can only be received by characters participating in the draft and will be
provided to the locker room.
(Final result rewards can be obtained by all characters in the account.)
 
* Rewards for STEP level-up are automatically given, and a
reward notification popup window will appear.
 
* Selected rewards cannot be redistributed or exchanged.
 
* Experience points available depending on quest difficulty vary.
 
* Daily quests reset every day at 00:00.
 
* Weekly quests reset every Monday at 00:00.
 
* Draft quests can be undertaken with all characters held in the account.
 
* With the purchase of a draft pass, you can undertake seasonal quests.
(The draft pass takes effect immediately upon purchase.)
 
* When using a STEP level-up item, you can increase STEP level by 1.
(Experience points are reset to 0 when using the STEP level-up item.)

(except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.

will be moved to the gift box automatically.

* Step 1

1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1cad335750a5ca98b7da171c4513e5cb74026b86.png[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
(***Note: Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1a00cc593fcea685f3f85cd9b5fe74b86a26d80d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e49eaa7aad76350c5cd9b627c1edd9ad0cb83cf4.png[/img]
- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use
as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the
material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability
of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is
fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the
fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the
number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are
automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e842b72991c99c53795dbcb7905002f363bb49a6.gif[/img]

*Step 1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7c6bd4fda4f15f548150149a7da5b8bd86cfb5ba.png[/img]
1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one
item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials.
The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.
 
*Step 2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2c11cd72ec1e2790de5d255018c7f879a502dad3.png[/img]
1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once.
You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order,
with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused
or there aren't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be
excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your
Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2527dbe428d29902d26510314636827fc306064f.png[/img]

[b]What is an Outfit Set?[/b]
1.  Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
[b]Outfit Set Feature Description:[/b]
 
**Transformation Set Outfit Function:
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.
4. If they have Back Acc, the Back Acc Ceremony will be unusable.
 
**Attribute Set Outfit Function:
1. When outfitted, the ability value always increases.
 
2. This is applied to the "Switching char" wearing the outfit set.

notes.title: Devil's Tower
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24f16ef4874a0be57e888270e4775678475dccf7.png[/img]

Are you ready to ascend to new heights?

Join us as we challenge you to climb the ominous Devil's Tower and bask in the
glory of your rewards! 

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/05/16 00:00 ~ 05/29 00:00 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a9448984fc27473c70e636d189a3cd2c617c44fa.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18b46068dacdb1325fe31d7eb7db975eb0eec7d7.png[/img]
[1] Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/42ae7cb8daccae6554d6d1b07d6820820fe6e596.gif[/img]

[2] Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
[3] Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
[i]→ You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
→ Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.[/i]
[4] Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
[5] Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
[6] Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the
remaining rewards.
[7] If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
[8] From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability.
[i]→ Same items may be obtained again.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4745abbd209da9ebdd5007c054dce68baf21828f.png[/img]
 
[1] Devil's Tower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
[2] You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
[3] If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change
settings so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the
event.
[4] Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b6c6feb3461352279e9e16b21230865a68f4520.png[/img]
[b]Step 1:[/b] Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower. 
[b]Step 2:[/b] Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from
each level.
[b]Step 3:[/b] You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
[b]Step 4:[/b] Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2be04e5cbfd08daee25cabdd223b86ff0c186ce6.png[/img]
→ Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
→ Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
→ Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/867adec713c0252e9fca90fa6aa8bf919c44f56b.png[/img]

→ Obtained rewards can be sent to the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack)
or [b]Gift Box[/b] directly.
→ You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

[b][Devil’s Tower Event Reward Distribution Settings Screen][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/51cc003010f46244495cb947fdae6f6878aeaadf.gif[/img]

[b]Obtaining through Backpack[/b]
	
→ Up to 8 obtained items will be displayed in the Adventurer’s Inventory
(backpack).	
→ You can select a character and “send items to inventory”.	
→ If the rewards are left unclaimed until the event ends, the items will be sent
to the Gift box.	
	
[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Storing in Backpack][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e9d4e2d0201ee6a6b9bf78f8c0c1498807561464.gif[/img]

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Item Distribution Screen][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0f37c2301a0ec641709a8c4434c532735461034.gif[/img]
	
[b]Distribution to Gift Box[/b]

→ Obtain items will be sent to the gift box immediately.	
→ You can view up to 8 items obtained through the Adventurer’s Inventory.	

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Sending to Gift Box][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9d6a43df6608f2527746f46781965415345144c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ad7295b8513d5d702a0dc9c6ec338886d1d1c518.png[/img]
→ Up to 5 rewards are placed on each level, and you can randomly
obtain one of them.	
→ After you receive the reward on the final level, you will go back to the first
level and play again.	
→ After you have claimed all 5 rewards on the final level, “level 0” will be
unlocked where you can randomly obtain one of the rewards placed there.	
→ The Card Option Changer item obtainable through the Devil’s Tower event
allows you to change the sub attributes of the Allstar Cards (offense/defense).	
	
 
> When you reach the final level, you will return to level 1 and play again.	
> Rewards you obtain on the final level cannot be obtained again. 	
> Once you have obtained all rewards on the final level, you will randomly
obtain one of the rewards from level 0.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/076fe59ddf5f4631ef97d9508b5e9794e66f0192.png[/img]

[b]** Note: [/b]
Click the link below for more information about Card Option Changer:
[url=https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/16800]https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/16800[/url]

Check out the exclusive and exciting rewards when you reach 300 Floors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fea1c74d3146efec498636478e3e2e7266a164c9.png[/img]

Yellow Viper Outfit Package (M/F)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e72961ea103890aacb631c90960efd151a14c30d.gif[/img]

=================================================
Are you ready to rise to the challenge? See you at the top!

Thank you for your continued support.
 
Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3e3b23060c773a892a322fa3de462f6961f71e04.png[/img]

The Festival Returns for Freestyle 2's [b]10th Anniversary Celebration![/b]

Join us for the grand reopening of the Want U Festival! It's time to dive back
into the excitement and rewards waiting for you.

Upgrade Buildings, Claim Rewards! Participate in the festivities by upgrading
your buildings and unlocking amazing rewards!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/05/08 00:00 ~ 06/04 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c36ecebbf25f7c1d8f21ffcfb5cc1b1d7e3e32f6.png[/img]

[b]Event Details:[/b]

Here's a preview of the updated window of the Want U Festival Event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/569b4419f80ac8682b05ca45d295e3fbdeda4bf5.gif[/img]

[b]Material and Quantities required for Building Upgrades[/b]

[b]Guide:[/b]

1. If you don't click on the accumulated coins to collect them, they will no
longer accumulate.
 
2. The collected coins are used to upgrade all buildings or to produce items in
designated buildings.
([i]Upgrading buildings that can produce coins or items increases efficiency, such
as production speed, amount, etc.[/i])
 
3. If you upgrade the Main Stage and level up, you earn a special reward for
certain levels.
([i]Check the rewards list on the right for details.[/i])
 
4. If building upgrade or item production time is too long, you can use
[b]Instant Completion Tickets[/b] to finish instantly.
 
5. If all your buildings reach a specific level, the level restrictions will be lifted,
allowing you to upgrade them to higher levels via "Festival Expansion."
([i]Expanding Festival at least once will allow you to gift your owned coins
to new/returning accounts without limit.[/i])
 
6. All items except coins are moved to Gift Box upon acquisition, and coins
are applied directly to the event.
 
[b]Reminder:[/b]
Upgrades and item production cannot be cancelled once they start.
When the event ends, all coins held will be deleted.

notes.title: Mega Pass Season 36
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f6a4915dba1dc486838c1511e3938138cc62e154.png[/img]

Get ready for the excitement as the Mega Pass returns for its 36th Season! 

Dive into the action and conquer all the levels to unlock exclusive cosmetic items
and a treasure trove of other goodies!

Event Period:
2024/05/08 00:00 ~ 2024/07/02 23:59 (PDT)
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a2c8a0e05a5d52ba6cd360091b8fc28df2aa1ffd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9eb11f3807897e99012fb1ccf0f3254d815c5460.png[/img]
The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash,
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

Note: You can use Event Gkash in purchasing Premium Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64a436e83efccc7dcff1eb7ba28ead6c06900b37.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5122908698a37c5dfb8232f40d5250e72c7b6d67.png[/img]
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)

- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.

- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.
 
 
Note: Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ab19320a6b5eb9200df3db76e7c99ba08684537a.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the regular and
Premium Mega Pass.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d84f9dd0dd16099ebf1a44ee336e5259dc230cce.png[/img]
 
You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars
as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9d7f67263d2c93fb775247aded763c5ad2dda4f3.gif[/img]

Note: Please note that during the last week of the event,
no additional levels will be introduced. This period is designated for
players to claim their rewards before the event concludes. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cb001291a9c64e588c5b01f359b804b865cd31b0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/dbf0327f1bad57d54aba735569fad49f46faa852.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/708a2121d6ec95a7bdf840b893765889f88c57c1.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle!

- Freestyle 2 Team

Welcome to our Freestyle 2 May 2024 Tournament Update!

Form a team and be the best by defeating many of the great teams
on each server!

Starting [b]May 2024,[/b] the Freestyle 2 Tournament will pause Super and Crew
Tournaments to improve the experience, while Normal Tournaments
will have more intense matches startng from Semi-Finals.

[[b]Link to Changes to Freestyle 2 Tournament Notice][/b]

[b]

[b]Note:[/b]
1. Coins will be obtained by characters.
2. Displayed reward for playing and winning is the amount
granted per match.
3. Amount of coins will be deducted accordingly in case of
winning by default.
4. Obtained coins can be used to purchase various items at
the Tournament Shop. 

**REMINDERS**[/b]

[u][b]Participation Conditions:[/b][/u]
→ Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
→ 3 players enter from the waiting room.

(Conditions may be added or changed depending on the nature of each
tournament)
[i]→ Meet the "Conditions for Participation" of each tournament.
→ One team can only participate in one tournament.
→ When there is no waiting time for participation due to "giving up match."
→ Only the host can apply for participation.[/i]

[u][b]Rules:[/b][/u]
 
[b]→Abandoning a Match[/b]
→ If you are participating in the tournament and force-quit a match, the match
will be considered abandoned.

→ Penalties will be applied to the player who gives up a match as well as the
team members.
 
[b] →Penalties[/b]
a. No match reward for abandoned matches. 
b. Winning Team will not eligible to receive rewards if the opposite team
surrender or leave the match.
c. Cooldown of 1 hour applies until next tournament match.
 
*Other Rules follows the Regular Channel Match Rules
 
[b]Important Notes:[/b]

→ In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues,
it will be considered as a loss.

→ Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes
or updates will be communicated through notices.

Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
[b]
~ Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

of team-wide buffs at random.

2. Stray Rebels characters can choose one of three types of buffs,
and if the randomly selected buff during a match matches the chosen type,
the buff is enhanced to gain a Special  effect.

3 Buffs apply to all team members.

4. If the unselected buff type is activated, only obtain +1 attribute.
 
5. The buffs are divided into three types: 'Special  Buff Type,' which
utilizes Special  abilities, ‘Attribute Type,' which increases attributes,
and 'Buff & Attribute Type,' which combines aspects of both types.

6. Depending on the chosen buff type, you can earn buff motion points,
which can be used to select and change exclusive buff motions.

* The transformation/buff duration increase buffs of the Special Buff Type
do not apply to the awakened state or Selina characters.

notes.title: Infinite Enhancement Machine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/69ccd631cbede26a2670351962903804c67a2c3f.png[/img]

The Infinite Enhancement Machine returns!

Similar to a machine with gears that twist and turn,
this event also introduces a new twist!

Think you have what it takes to face the Infinite Enhancement Machine?

Put your skills to the test in this event!

[b]Event period:[/b]
2024/04/24 ~ 2024/05/21

[b]Event mechanics:[/b]
Enhance any of the available items to acquire them! Enhancing at
certain levels will not only add stats to the items but also
extend their duration up to 90 days!

Additionally, you can also obtain other items using the mileage obtained
from enhancing the item!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/694082edaa0fc8b45da0742d88af74dea6a9e53d.gif[/img]

Enhancement Fuel is required to enhance items. It can be purchased by
selecting the "Buy Enhancement Fuel" button on the event page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c4802336077a61cda33c59b77ab3d6f7c0b65d50.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Event Gkash can be used to purchase Enhancement Fuel.

After acquiring Enhancement Fuels, you may proceed with the
enhancement process.

[b]Enhancement process:[/b]
To enhance the item, simply click or press the 'Enhance' button and use the fuel.
You can enhance the item in two modes: 'Auto' and 'Normal'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f838018b390f18d9ee61e87d2e1664ee0fd0443b.gif[/img]

For "Auto" enhancement, the item can be enhanced based on the selected
grade level from the dropdown menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c6993218a7684161f4791f1e9a0723ea008834e4.gif[/img]

For "Normal" enhancement, the item can be enhanced by one level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2794b3dbff5cd300395b038ba5affae015607fc.gif[/img]

- A 'big failure' or enhancement failure may also occur, in which the item
will not be enhanced, or the item's enhancement may reset.
So, keep this in mind!

- After a successful enhancement, the duration of use or attributes
will increase based on the grade.

- After successfully enhancing an item and receiving it,
specific attributes can be selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c6993218a7684161f4791f1e9a0723ea008834e4.gif[/img]

- After its period of use expires, the item will be deleted.

You can see detailed information about the enhancement by
clicking or pressing the 'Detailed Enhancement Info.' button.

[b]Mileage usage:[/b]
When enhancing items, Mileage can be earned.
This Mileage can be used to acquire the selected item with a
guaranteed +10 upgrade lasting 90 days for 5000 Mileage,
guaranteed upgrade it to +9 for 2000 Mileage,
and can also be used to obtain a Card Sub-Attribute Changer for 4 Mileage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2794b3dbff5cd300395b038ba5affae015607fc.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b]
- Each mileage count is separated per item.
- When obtaining the Card Sub-Attribute Changer using Mileages,
it will consume all available Mileage.

*If there isn't enough Enhancement Fuel during auto enhancement,
the enhancement process will stop.

*If the current mileage meets the required threshold for the set grade,
the enhancement will be temporarily suspended.

*If the current mileage is full, the enhancement will be temporarily suspended.

(Required enhancement item acquisition,
firm enhancement compensation required. Only once per mileage arrival,
and a notification will be displayed again upon reconnection without
receiving mileage compensation.)

Thank you for your continued support!

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!

[b]- Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.content:

Get ready for the Devil's Tower!

While there are certain event requirements, no need to fret.

Simply follow the guide and instructions provided below to join.

The key is to earn rewards at every level, and you might even reach
the pinnacle! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ca78fa53095943d5f76614956d03dfdf1d8df732.gif[/img]

2024/04/24 00:00 ~ 05/07 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d298d43d2790d467132d6f3512ebebbe4b30f710.gif[/img]

[1] Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/42ae7cb8daccae6554d6d1b07d6820820fe6e596.gif[/img]

[2] Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
[3] Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
→ You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
→ Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.
[4] Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
[5] Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
[6] Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the
remaining rewards.
[7] If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
[8] From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability. (Same items may be obtained again).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b335c2cd31987cb604931a13e5412ba4e0af9960.gif[/img]
 
[1] Devil's Tower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
[2] You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
[3] If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change
settings so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the
event.
[4] Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

each level.
Step 3: You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
Step 4: Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

notes.title: Training Mode Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eef4a0727d4e38aa1cbb0b6e6b751b3729f03a7a.png[/img]

How much do you know about the newly added Training System?

The Training System is a system that allows you to play and practice certain
scenarios that take place during regular matches.

Through the Training System, we hope that many players share their personal
tips and tricks and other unique strategy with others.

The GMs have prepared a special event to kick things off with the new Training
System.

Check the information below for details regarding the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/efa9cf879a41c6acc01f099e1f5b9f21fe928199.png[/img]

[b]→ Event Schedule[/b]
[b]- Event Period:[/b]
04/05 00:00 to 04/21 00:00 (PDT)

[b]- Winner Announcement & Reward Distribution:[/b]
During the Maintenance of 04/24.

[b]→ Event Participation Requirements[/b]
- The event will take place through the Training Bulletin Board.

- Only the players who meet the following conditions for making posts on the
Training Board can participate in the event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/71b4273455f4525002e4cb7409175226392e737d.png[/img]

- We have prepared a total of four types of event rewards, and you can find out
how to participate in the events and collect their rewards from the information
below.
[b]  
→ How to Participate[/b]
A. Create your very own Training File containing your unique tips and tricks
B. Check if you meet the requirements to post or comment on the Training
Board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a6a3d4062edf91258192f4a0a137441512edebbd.png[/img]

C. Please refer to the screenshot above when participating.
The below information must be included.
 
- Select the appropriate position for the use in training
- The title of the training post must include the phrase: Event - topic
Example:
- Event - topic
 
[b]- Please enter the following within each category of the post.
1. Training Method
2. Notes for Training
3. Producer’s Comments[/b]

[b]**Note: [/b]Users who registered training before the event need to re-register
according to the form in order to participate in the event. 

We ask for your understanding as this is to inform many users of the training
information that contains know-how.	

[b][Precautions for Event][/b]
- You cannot upload another player’s Training File. The system will
automatically detect and block such attempts.
 
- You must follow the layout detailed in the [1. How to Participate] before
making your post in the Training Board for your participation to count.	

[b]→ Rewards	[/b]	
- There are a total of 4 rewards, and the contents of the rewards are as
follows.

- Reward distribution is based on IDs. Aside from the Participation Reward,
a single ID cannot receive multiple rewards.	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d47306a5a95a84ee8d2f8c2cd840bb8ef98c3653.png[/img]

[i]**Participation rewards are distributed by counting participation up to 20 times
per ID.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/444386b68b83e75a2e1ba186e7299f646815d210.png[/img]

[b]→ Winner Selection[/b]

[b]A. How to Be Selected as the GOD of Training[/b]
- The GOD of Training is selected based on the following criteria.
1. Number of Likes Received from Other Players: 30%
2. Reflecting on the Opinion of the Developers: 70%
 
- The development team will verify each and every participating post and
conduct the event as fairly as possible.
 
- Issues that violate the Terms of Services, such as exploiting, will be dealt
with accordingly, and the severity of the punishment will vary depending
on the circumstance.

**Posts with the same content will be excluded from the selection.
 
[b]B. Lucky draw[/b]
- 5 random players who participated in the GOD of Training event will
be drawn.
 
- In the case of Lucky Draw, the rewards will not overlap with the God of
Training rewards.
 
[b]C. Participation Reward[/b]
- During the event, you will receive up to 20 rewards for the number of
times you participated in the event.
 
- Posts that do not comply with the method of participation detailed in
the guide will be excluded from participation.
 
- Insincere posts, posts that contain profanity, or posts that contain content
that violates the game’s Terms of Services will be excluded from participation.
 
[b]D. Comment Reward[/b]
- Ten players who played and experienced another player’s registered Training
File, and leave a sincere comment based on their experience will be selected
for the Comment Reward.
 
- Abusive or profanely written comments will be excluded from the event.

[b][Precautions][/b]
→ Violating the game’s Terms of Services or not following the event rules,
may result in your removal from event participation.
 
→ Winner announcement and reward distribution schedule are subject to
change. Updates to the schedule will be listed in this notice.
 
→ Deleting the post you used to participate in the event during the
selection period may result in your forfeit from the event.
 
→ If you have any questions about the event, please contact Customer
Support.
 
We ask for your interest and participation in the new training event.
 
We look forward to seeing you enjoy FreeStyle2 to its fullest with this
brand new event!
 
=================================================
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 
[b]
~ Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9d1765a9deb5750fd5bdafa3a62826b058eeafd.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of an electrifying update to your wardrobe!

Get ready to level up your style game with our latest additions:
the All-Star Outfit and the New Outfit Set Effect!

Event Period:
2024/04/03 00:00 ~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee028e9c9a09004a3dc90572cf7907fc14d4b51b.png[/img]
Introducing the All Star Grade to the existing outfit grades, including 

Normal Magic, Rare, and Legend. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/10436e264f23e94377835ec0098aaf592a10e741.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/93a774367f1a13e8c5284195dab61d7e7b060c68.png[/img]
Capability Set Costume Features
1. Installing all the capability sets will raise the set capability values.
2. Capability values are always applied before and after the game.
3. Switching characters are only applied to switching characters
in set costumes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a749fa6e65d118e4a30ef27112fa572881b0febf.png[/img]

What is an Outfit Set?
1. Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
Outfit Set Feature Description:
 
**Transformation Set Outfit Function:
 
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.
4. If they have Back Acc, the Back Acc Ceremony will be unusable.
 
**Attribute Set Outfit Function:
 
1. When outfitted, the ability value always increases.
2. This is applied to the "Switching char" wearing the outfit set. 

=================================================
Get ready to revolutionize your gameplay and showcase your unique style
like never before!
 
Thank you for your continued support.

Be free to create your own style, Freestyle!
 

~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.content:

Unlock Your Style with the Mysterious Glass Bead!

Harness the mystical power of the Glass Bead and watch as your wardrobe
transforms before your very eyes. Gone are the days of settling for ordinary

[b]
Event Period:[/b]
2024/04/03 00:00 ~ 04/24 00:00 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5d330e3dcd3ef6e68f60de9d11e9400403131589.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5f577147025785fd30f33b90715cdced3c7631cf.png[/img]

[Mysterious Glass Bead]
** If you use 180 "Mystery Scrolls" you can obtain a
FREE Premium Reward! 
(Free reward will be sent to Gift Box)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f24e67efc4d8f111d2ecfcc9225c70ac57681bbd.png[/img]

- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits
you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items
(except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.

** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse
will be moved to the gift box automatically.
 
[b]* Step 1[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e7724ae3a0d929c98d7d8b537391b576d33a3ffd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee86406747c66c7fcdfaac6d9a2c3053c10ec42d.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the 'Purchase' button and draw 1 or 5 time(s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6bf1723ad4502ec2d83ccfd43c79fb895994334b.gif[/img]

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]

-  Obtain a FREE Premium Reward for every 500 draws!
[b]
*Step 2[/b]
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1cad335750a5ca98b7da171c4513e5cb74026b86.png[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
(***Note: Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1a00cc593fcea685f3f85cd9b5fe74b86a26d80d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e49eaa7aad76350c5cd9b627c1edd9ad0cb83cf4.png[/img]

- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use
as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the
material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability
of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is
fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the
fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the
number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are
automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e842b72991c99c53795dbcb7905002f363bb49a6.gif[/img]

[b]*Step 1[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7c6bd4fda4f15f548150149a7da5b8bd86cfb5ba.png[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one
item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials.
The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.

*Step 2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2c11cd72ec1e2790de5d255018c7f879a502dad3.png[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once.
You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order,
with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused
or there aren't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be
excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your
Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d27864abdfbdf4c06a617c5598982e5e350e198c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e40c1167a953e158c6853c376616a12c9d693ad2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d167a954b444e29d286a95b96209a6d681f89da5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ad56e9ebccc2a9249993e564718815619a139269.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/278fbf2b442838c5d0b219225ee054be9e5dca4e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eede8e31845570fc91e5d91aac8ba41f22a33465.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a785537683e124cbbfaa1062b7c922da56538750.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2527dbe428d29902d26510314636827fc306064f.png[/img]

[b]Accessory Set Preview:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a749fa6e65d118e4a30ef27112fa572881b0febf.png[/img]
 
[b]What is an Outfit Set?[/b]
1.  Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
Outfit Set Feature Description:
 
**Transformation Set Outfit Function:
 
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.

notes.title: Training System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/31c7ebe3ce6c215e5ec0af15769c37d7f9ad36d4.png[/img]

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level? Get ready for the
Training Mode, where learning meets innovation like never before! 

[b]Training System Guide:[/b]
1. Training Bulletin Board: A place where users can share training materials
they have created.
2. Training Production: The section where users can develop and create their
own training content.
3. Training Play: Here, you can play the training you've either created yourself
or downloaded from the bulletin board.
 
[b]Training System Details:[/b]
1. The training system provides a platform for creating scenarios and engaging
in practice sessions.
2. Settings can be shared with fellow players by posting them on the
Bulletin Board.
3. Players have the opportunity to practice training sets created by others
through the Bulletin Board postings..
4. Guidance on creating training scenarios can be accessed via the
'Training Production' screen to assist players in getting started.
5. It's important to note that if there's a balance patch affecting stats,
skills, etc., certain training scenarios may become inaccessible.
 
[b]How to proceed to the Training Mode:[/b]

- Click on the Pactice tab located on the main lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ddefd4918e05c5180c7e6a2d0e9d464439336035.png[/img]

- Then choose the Training Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d343ee0745ab8b6caf29ace9ed4b59b7d6c69051.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ba71a2dd60c947db37213df1e14e907b1b71cae6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cda3f9258c33cf852489de98017dbf330ef4fa50.png[/img]
Dive into the Training Bulletin Board, your go-to hub for sharing and
discovering user-created training materials.

[b]Posting Conditions for the Training Bulletin Board[/b]
 
[b]Posting Requirements[/b]
 - Only accounts meeting the following criteria are eligible to make a post.
  → Accounts that have won over 100 games in the Regular channel
  → Accounts that have played more than 3 games in the last 90 days
  → Accounts that have written no more than two posts in a single day
(deleted posts are counted as written.)

[b]Commenting Requirements[/b]
 - Only accounts meeting the following criteria are eligible to write a comment.
  → Accounts that have played more than 10 games
(BZ channel, Regular channel)
  → Accounts that have played more than 30 games in the last 90 days
  → Accounts that have written no more than three comments in a single day
(deleted comments are counted as written.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9df2a0e1e1807813cd090731cd382601bd2b51db.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7f8252807c7cf96cf29da4164de4cc1ca6c00199.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d67dc1764974c135f6d326a172e7bc3416e7ba65.png[/img]
Unleash your creativity in Training Production, where you can craft your
own custom training content.

Basic Training Production Method: Basic Recording Method
1. Create an NPC character for the scenario.
 - To create an NPC character for the scenario, click the [+] button in the
'AWAY Team Member 1' section.
 - After selecting 'create', proceed to adjust the character's detailed settings.
 a. Customize the character's attributes such as position, height, and
available motions (if applicable).
 b. Load a character preset of your choice.
 c. Confirm the character creation by pressing the designated button.
 d. The character will be successfully created and integrated into the scenario.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00a6941764a9855f0917558adc9d41b47af9002b.gif[/img]
 
2. Determine the character to be controlled by either clicking the
'Control Character (MY)' or 'AWAY Team Member 1' section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/61d2991a0aa885e99d0fa7901bb288de90691d65.gif[/img]

3. Record the practice scenario using the NPC character.
- Establish a situation where the NPC character obtains the ball
(either by picking it up or the F8 button).
- Start the recording process by activating it via the [1] shortcut key or
by clicking the designated [Start Recording] button.
- Direct the movements of the NPC character during the recording
phase to simulate the desired actions and scenario dynamics.
- Once the intended sequence is recorded, conclude the process by
clicking the [2] shortcut key or selecting the [End Recording] button to finalize the recording.
(Once recording starts, the [2] [End Recording] button appears.)
- You can play the recorded NPC character by clicking the [3] shortcutkey
or the [Play Recording] button.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c37918e8fa7a0a02c9150a05a0c661085abaf1f1.gif[/img]
 
4. 'Control Character (MY)' creates the character the player
will operate.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e8fc05d78269c976ee5fd374373980c162a32753.gif[/img]

5. You can practice the predetermined scenario through playback
while controlling the set character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/95f15f8b8d83aa642be86383780cb259f5143527.gif[/img]

[b]Advanced Training Production Method: Preset Recording Method[/b]
1. Utilize the basic recording method to capture the desired scenario and save it.
2. Switch to preset 2 through the [5] shortcut key or selecting
the [Record Preset] button.
 - The first recording preset is automatically set to 1.
3. Repeat the recording process as per the basic method and save it
to preset 2.
 - You can set up to three recording presets.
4. Explore diverse scenarios by accessing the presets through
the [7], [8], and [9] buttons.

[b]Button Function Information[/b]
All functions can be accessed by either clicking the corresponding
button or using the designated shortcut key.
[1] Shortcut key: Initiates recording.
[2] Shortcut key: Ends recording; applicable when recording.
[3] Shortcut key: Plays the action recorded from start to finish.
[4] Shortcut key: Halts the playback of the action.
[5] Shortcut key: Assigns a preset number for recording, with up to
three presets available.
[6] Shortcut key: Randomly plays one of the recorded actions within the preset.
[7] Shortcut key: Repeatedly plays the recorded action within the current preset.
[8] Shortcut key: Sequentially and repeatedly plays all recorded actions
within the preset.
[9] Shortcut key: Randomly and repeatedly plays all recorded actions
within the preset.
[0] Shortcut key: Deletes the recording stored in the preset.
[F8] Shortcut key: Makes the currently selected character hold the ball.
[F9] Shortcut key: If not in recording state, resets the action, stamina,
and ball position.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0be85cc377038118a8a8f1626b95b9a4a0b5b7d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f1ac43b72ff75a79a049dbef8adf6581d59a2753.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ab14f2b91fe631e3a45e1a520b26962f128d3aa2.png[/img]

This is where your saved recordings are located, which you can then be initiated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee77b906f798638962184907d77437e66ef4ba96.gif[/img]

[b]Upcoming Updates to the Training System[/b]
1. The existing training system is currently in its BETA version, undergoing
refinement and enhancement.
2. Presently, the system exclusively supports 1:1 gameplay.
3. Future updates will introduce support for expanded gameplay options,
including up to 3:3 matches.
4. Ongoing updates are scheduled to improve the overall user experience,
streamlining both the creation and execution of training sessions.

[b]Reminder:[/b]
- You can only upload the files you created.
- The use of forbidden words in all posts and comments on
the training system is prohibited
- Sanctions may apply if any violation of the operating policy is found
while using the training system.
- Please use polite and respectful language when using the training system.
- Posts that are abusive, contain small talk, or do not adhere
to guidelines may be deleted from the training system.
- Sanctions may be carried out based on operational policies.
Please use the system carefully.
- For other inquiries, please use the Customer Center 1:1 inquiry.

=================================================

Join us in the Training System Update and unlock your full potential on the court!
Train smarter, play better. See you in the game!

~ Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Miracle Mine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00a929567ca47e5149dfa32321326222a12258f6.png[/img]

Dive into the depths of adventure with Freestyle 2's latest event: Miracle Mine! 

Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey filled with mystery and excitement
as you unearth hidden treasures waiting to be discovered!

Event Period:
2024/03/20 00:00 ~ 2024/04/16 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/265f3dd3ffe74d60533d444693c61fb6d7c682a1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d4cc6dc11045babccbfc80ea0a54d24adc38bd5.png[/img]

Step into the shoes of a seasoned miner and follow these simple steps to
uncover the riches that lie within:

1. Navigate to the Miracle Mine page through the event banner located in the
lobby.
2. Set up your miners in the miner's quarters and start extracting ore.
3. Delve deep into the mine and collect various ores to obtain Gold bars and
Ancient keys. 
4. As you mine through each stage, advance to the next level of challenges. 
Note: You can clear up to 9 stages in 1 season.
5. Visit the Miracle Shop and use your Gold bars to exchange them for a
wide array of items. 
6. Use the ancient keys you've acquired to unlock ancient boxes filled with
mysterious treasures.

Note:
- When mining is in progress, the time remaining until mining is completed
is displayed.
(Mining only takes place when connected to the game. When offline, mining
is stopped.)
- When the remaining mining time reaches “0”, the object to be mined is
deleted and the reward item is dropped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1fbf66c242f844b61e98db1e00d01bee0dbffeb8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/13048db661241ae5262afc69bf5eec06e02405d5.jpg[/img]

The season runs from Wednesday to Wednesday for 7 days.
1 Season consists of 9 stages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4221b392d5f28e3a29a2f0823f0b93eb41097b7e.png[/img]

[b]Seasonal adjustments[/b]
-  Miner's Lodge Level reset
-  Delete miners active in the mine
-  Reset stage clear count

[b]Season End Notice preview:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0f9c1b8ca92b7ff0de85a42c613d1e62be91d527.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ae9c19c6f02a785582044eb8300b04c6f70e5375.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eb952dcdbb2037ddab55af81db9b2d30bd423e07.jpg[/img]

Miners are produced over time in the miner's lodge and are stored there.
- Production works only while connected to the game.
Note: Mining stops when offline
Production and storage of miners will only work up to the maximum storage
capacity.
Miners can be placed in the mine by pressing the "Place" button.
When deployed, the miner's lodge gains experience and levels up.
Note: As it levels up, the level of the deployed miners also increases.

[b]Miner Information:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c9809a5fa47b3c76af9dcd50e6159f255fab381a.png[/img]

[b]Preview:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/df2e993d95397fa58fc3080498dc74fa5097800d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b1cca1056f13510fb9a0f6c7e075c1c58b50d07.jpg[/img]

Each mine has a maximum number of miners that can be operated, and the
number of miners cannot exceed that.

Miners can perform actions such as:
- Mining objects: Gold ore, Key ore, Treasure chests, etc.
- Leveling up: combining two of the same miners to level up
Note: Combining reduces mining time.

[b]Preview:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e38df7eae8b5bc5099aaa37a59f87b84e8a825c5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a1a8b0cb12aeb53c8de43eb8b56dbffc1a9d7332.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/32e1f550047ee3e4bcf8804ba3e3be61797715ad.jpg[/img]

When miners are placed near an objective, they automatically start mining.
- If there are more than two objectives nearby, the mining direction can be
changed through drag & drop.
When mining, the time remaining to complete the action is displayed in
real-time.
- Mining can only be done while connected to the game
Note: mining stops when offline

When the remaining mining time reaches "0", the target objective is removed,
and reward items are dropped.
Dropped items are obtained by placing a miner at the item's location or clicking
on it.
Note: High-Level Key ore can disappear after a certain period of time.
Your in-game data may not save properly if you close the game abruptly.

[b]Preview:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2736f0f86dca38cf17676892407168fc73040827.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8e91419b6d841518ac90649e1ff9103c3654ecd8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cd136202e5ba4acb755fd190c617a0f0cdd98ea9.jpg[/img]

[b]Various mining objectives can yield Event currency.[/b]
- Ore: Gold bars
- Key ore: Ancient Keys

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e7911ae76f264ab2bf3929ec757d76c8e540eb3.gif[/img]

[b]The acquired items can be used for various purposes.[/b]
- Gold bars: Exchanged for various products in the Miracle store
- Ancient keys: Used to unlock ancient chests and obtain them

[b]Ore:[/b]
- You can obtain Gold bars when mining Ore, and the Gold bars you acquire
are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- The Gold bars you acquire can be used at the Miracle Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d5b2d486d11f2f4d3f1dda6d1e0a7aaab84b9243.png[/img]

[b]Special Ore: [/b]
- When mining Special Ores, you can obtain a large amount of Gold bars from
the Gold bar Pouch.
- Gold bars obtained through the Gold Bar bag can be used at the Miracle Shop.
- Rewards are sent on the Gift box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ecbdcad7ab77da41787988c15815c7879486a8ad.png[/img]

[b]Key Ore:[/b]
- You can obtain Ancient keys when mining Key ore, and the acquired Ancient
keys are applied to your Acquired quantity.
- High-level key ores will be deleted if they are not mined within the time limit.
- The acquired Ancient key can be used to open the Ancient chest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/77dc947173c5b8d1cfc77650bb3dbc5c7b26d38a.png[/img]

[b]Treasure Chest:[/b]
- You can obtain various items when mining Treasure Chests.
- Rewards are sent on the Gift box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4910ec308f36b8db91c5f0282e696b4d6d753c1c.png[/img]

[b]List of Items that you can obtain from Treasure Chest: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64c86d864fe4962e7c9cfbe263a17d6162aa14ef.png[/img]

[b]List of Items that you can exchange from Mystery Ore:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fce296314f26bf87bd190db9ed62931aca9e77cd.png[/img]

[b]Mystery Ore Selection Preview:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a03449fce6c3bc0644101835ea8107be9941b836.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f41fb9b72a1bb51d71727eb9ad3b9a4ae01d5894.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ed73d29883c81ac0f03440db4645176993122e72.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0e970bfb7774890f2d06bc21ebe6551850ec4619.png[/img]

Place miners at the Key ore to obtain keys.
 
[b]Note: [/b]Obtained rewards will be sent to the Gift Box.
- You must obtain the previous chest to get the next one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2c7a7641eb91eb826d85b4c468554345d59f747.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b1b648f11b3f03c646360a8b16a80ab1c4c2fa5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8c392518ba406a1e718705274cda5b449ba73881.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4d689eb4d0bd502316de231ec67e7f1abd4671aa.png[/img]

You can use the Gold bars you have to exchange items at the Miracle Shop.
- Exchanged items will be sent in the Gift box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ebbbe5dc1b57e269cc8dd93675d4de35f09d4b8b.png[/img]

[b]Note:[/b]
- New users [accounts created after the maintenance on 3/20 (Wed)]
will receive 250 gold bars when they log in everyday.

notes.title: 2024.03.20 Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4aacd4c73cb1ac82d2155058c7efad788a951c20.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

This is the Freestyle 2 Development Team.

The March 20th (UTC) update will be accompanied by a Balance patch.

The March balance patch will serve as a conceptual framework for preparing in
advance for the extensive balance patch scheduled for July.

Any issues that arise from this patch will be hotfixed promptly.

Please check the information below for details. And once again, we ask you for
your feedback and opinions regarding the balance changes.

- After the maintenance, [b]100,000 points[/b] were paid to all accounts and the
majesty of point guard (PG) and dual guard (DG) positions were initialized.
- Please check if the item is received and the majesty is applied before the
game is played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/60fdbb731c843ae9099e058b773d8497868edec4.png[/img]
[b]Our Goal[/b]

The continual objective of Freestyle 2's development team is to increase and
enhance the opportunities for players to excel in their designated roles.

By alleviating the pressure on the scorer position and promoting effective
defensive plays for ball handlers, as well as creating diverse rebounding
situations for big men, we wish to encourage everyone to perform their roles to
the best of their abilities and foster the occurrence of various scenarios.

To achieve this objective, our plan involves fine-tuning the game's balance
during the Classic Court Event and subsequently validating these adjustments
through extensive in-game testing.

Ahead of the extensive patch scheduled for July, we are preparing by
pre-adjusting the efficiency of each attribute and resistance values in
March to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any dissonance with the
planned large-scale balance patch. 

Moving forward, we will continue to strive to provide a more enjoyable
gameplay experience by diligently preparing through various balance
adjustments facilitated by the Classic Court.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec7b9df7e751d858c4a61c47a8a5b32fc48d8a33.png[/img]
[b]1. Regular Match Adjustments[/b]
- Resistance from defenders against all shots will increase by 6%.
- Shot Trajectory probability will be adjusted.
- Big Man’s shot success rate reduction based on distance will be slightly
increased.
- The criteria for receiving score buffs when experiencing consecutive losses
will be removed.

[b]2. Attribute Adjustments[/b]
- Block and Rebound attributes’ effect will be slightly reduced.
- A new feature will be added to the Tussle attribute.
- When resisting against Big Man, get up to 6% (approximately) resistance
based on the difference in Tussle attribute.
[i](1 Block Resistance difference: 0.11% increase)[/i]
 - For the other targets (Scorer, Ball Handler), get up to 5% (approximately)
resistance based on the difference in Tussle Attribute.
[i](1 Block Resistance difference: 0.025% increase)[/i]
 - Positions aside from Big Man (C, PF, CT) will not have their Move Speed
attribute affect their Box Out Speed.
 - Big Man (C, PF, CT)’s Tussle attribute will increase their Box Out Speed.

[b]3. Addressing the Issue: Blocking Player Movement[/b]
- You will fall over when making contact with an opposing character while
using the Pick and Move skill.
- Using dash to push away an opponent will reduce your stamina by 70%.
- You cannot use dash to push away an opponent if you have less than 70%
stamina.
(The dev team will monitor the game to check if this change can be abused
by attackers)

[b]4. Skill Adjustments[/b]
- The Perfect Pass skill for the PG position will be removed.
- Your stamina will not recover for 2 seconds after using the Away Screen
Move skill.

[b]5. Specialty Skill Adjustments[/b]
- Fake Shot Steal’s success rate increase specialty skill will be slightly buffed. 
- Upon using the Hook Hook Defense specialty skill, Ankle Break will not
apply for Fake Shot Drive.
- Hook Shot & Skyhook Shot Range Increase specialty skill’s maximum distance
will be reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c634f25e3e9e06e91bbc10514a077412f3be734f.png[/img]
- ‘Mid.Shot:  Motion Speed ’ stat will be added to some defensive specialties for
Big Man (C, PF, CT).
- ‘Jab Step and Shoot Delay’ +1 will be added to SG Position’s majesty skill.

notes.content:

Get ready for the excitement as the Mega Pass returns for its 35th Season! 

Dive into the action and conquer all the levels to unlock exclusive cosmetic items
and a treasure trove of other goodies!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
2024/03/13 00:00 ~ 2024/05/07 23:59 (PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b77ef472ed2695a07e0241bf773cb3e270dbd703.png[/img]

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for [b]590 GKash[/b] (Real GKash or Event GKash),
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c1062b10cc99dbb096aa24527267e784d728a01a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/88981afadd53507ef69820e3d5d58877735944af.png[/img]
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)

- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.

- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.
 
[b]Note:[/b] Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1ee20160714e229f335d70f1e26ab007928960d.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the regular and
Premium Mega Pass.

Note: You can use[b] Real GKash[/b] or [b]Event GKash[/b] to purchase Megapass Tierup!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f52f816580efa6cde91ee58cb53403122b95cbd5.png[/img]
 
You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars
as soon as you finish your quests!

[b]Note: [/b]Please note that during the last week of the event,
no additional levels will be introduced. This period is designated for
players to claim their rewards before the event concludes.

Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.

it will be considered as a loss.

at a later time.
 
- Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes
or updates will be communicated through notices.

[b]--Crew Tournament Mechanics--[/b]

- Participation is limited to 3 individuals from the same crew.
- A maximum of 2 teams can enter one Crew Tournament.
- There is only one tournament open, consisting of 16 rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a7c889c25a9b9516b9f2b0f9803caf2f84316112.gif[/img]

1. The Button for [Crew Tournament Open] will be visible on the main screen of the Crew.
2. Upon opening the tournament, a room is generated automatically.
- Throughout the event, a single round takes place in a room.
3. Recruit fellow players and assemble a team.
- In the waiting area, all three members from the same crew team must be present, 
and only the room leader has the authority to apply for participation.
4. If all team members, except the room leader, consent to participating within 10 seconds,  participation is confirmed in the order it was received.
5. All teams participating will compete simultaneously.
6. The games persist until the Crew Tournament concludes, iterating through game progress, game completion, and round completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b5dbe1ef85cf11f76878f1694e53e488df6b8b1.gif[/img]

- Leaving the crew, deleting a character, or dissolving a crew does not erase ranking record data.
- Within the Ranking page, a Crew tab has been introduced in the Tournament section.
- In the Crew Ranking page, a Tournament Ranking tab is now available.
(Rankings are determined by aggregating the TP Points earned by each crew.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2c1a2cbea1322324de15bcbab1a4071f2385eb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/79d53ea0f95d67cab275a6df4f24f1c22ff35388.gif[/img]

On the lobby screen, you can view the details of the winning team from
the Crew Tournament.

[b]a) Requirement:[/b]
After the conclusion of the Crew Tournament, the ranking is updated,
and the insignia of the first-place crew is showcased.
(In typical tournaments, the Crew Tournament airships are exhibited at random.)

Channel: FS Channel
Details: The crew emblem and name are visible for viewing.

[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/72b87702fee1e59de37f4847054e42fec36dda44.png[/img]

You can use the lettering feature to specify text and color.
When setting lettering for the first time, it's free, but for subsequent lettering changes, you'll need to consume lettering items.
Lettering outfits have unique marks for identification.
You cannot set duplicate lettering for different lettering outfits (case-insensitive for alphabets).
Magic Pens can be obtained from the Tournament Shop.

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02378adaa40e26131033dd70c782f869ccd3a21.png[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can
have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]
Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bf18b206dc674f90e06237d31c3a9fa0a28a4f17.gif[/img]


[b]- Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.content:

Unlock the outfit of your dreams with the enchanting power of glass beads in Freestyle 2!

[b]

2024/03/06 00:00 ~ 03/19 23:59 (PST)

[Mysterious Glass Bead]
** If you use 500 "Mystery Scrolls" you can obtain a
FREE Premium Reward! 
(Free reward will be sent to Gift Box)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f24e67efc4d8f111d2ecfcc9225c70ac57681bbd.png[/img]

- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits
you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items
(except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.

** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse
will be moved to the gift box automatically.
 
[b]* Step 1[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e7724ae3a0d929c98d7d8b537391b576d33a3ffd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a84dc42f7100ce5e04016541f62296407fac9ebc.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the 'Purchase' button and draw 1 or 5 time(s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6bf1723ad4502ec2d83ccfd43c79fb895994334b.gif[/img]

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]

-  Obtain a FREE Premium Reward for every 500 draws!
[b]
*Step 2[/b]
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1cad335750a5ca98b7da171c4513e5cb74026b86.png[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
(***Note: Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bb0cc74853789e13c77027a444f691512e966e68.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e49eaa7aad76350c5cd9b627c1edd9ad0cb83cf4.png[/img]

- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use
as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the
material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability
of winning a higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is
fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the
fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the
number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are
automatically excluded, and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5305dd9ab375bfb4a157a6f09f51f8201cf42af1.gif[/img]

[b]*Step 1[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7c6bd4fda4f15f548150149a7da5b8bd86cfb5ba.png[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one
item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials.
The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.

*Step 2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2c11cd72ec1e2790de5d255018c7f879a502dad3.png[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once.
You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order,
with the highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused
or there aren't enough to be used as material, it will automatically be
excluded from fusion. 
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your
Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a17183ea49ee1823123a793df95f52426cb01433.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e40c1167a953e158c6853c376616a12c9d693ad2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a785537683e124cbbfaa1062b7c922da56538750.png[/img]

Fallen Angel's Outfit Preview (M/F)[/b]

notes.title: Freestyle 2 Classic Court
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/35e57eb6a2b117bd4dd4a8c93a4ce99dd043df54.png[/img]

Hello Ballers,

This is the Freestyle2 Development Team.

The Classic Court event will begin at the end of February.

The previous Classic Court resulted in the removal of shooting feedback and
the improvement of turn-based confirmed shots.

We wish to continue the Classic Court Event to better test the game’s balance
and allow the players to experience any future updates ahead of time.
We ask you again for your opinion regarding the balance in this iteration of
the Classic Court.

Thank you.

~ Freestyle2 Development Team.

==============================================================

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5a1ed880f69f94d5cb5437488ebc4cc0301f3585.gif[/img]

[b]February Classic Court Balance[/b]
1. Regular Match Balance
- Layup and dunk’s maximum success rate will be reduced by 10%.
- Score buff will be removed.
- All positions will have the 'Last Stand Enhancement' specialty skill applied.
- Resistance from defenders against all shots will increase by 12%.
- The movement speed of all characters will be reduced by 8%.
- The Perfect Pass skill will not be applied.
- Hook Hook Defense skill’s ‘Fake Shot Drive’ from failed ‘Drive Defense’ is
excluded. 

[b]2. Attribute Changes[/b]
- Block and Rebound attributes’ effect will be slightly reduced.
- A new feature will be added to the Tussle attribute.
  - Defense Resistance is increased based on the difference of the ‘Tussle’ stat
between the attacker and defender. (Big Man (C, PF, CT) resistance increase
& slight resistance increase for other positions)
  - Positions aside from Big Man (C, PF, CT) will not have their Move Speed
attribute affect their Box Out Speed.
  - Big Man (C, PF, CT)’s Tussle attribute will increase their Box Out Speed.

[b]3. Steal Improvements[/b]
- Fake Shot Steal’s success rate increase specialty skill will be slightly buffed. 

[b]4. SG Position Skill Adjustment[/b]
- Away Screen Move’s Movement Speed will be reduced by 9%.
(Adjusted from 12% to 9%)
- Using Away Screen Move will prevent stamina recovery for 3 seconds.
- Crossover Shooting Guard Specialty will gain Jab Step Shot Delay +1.

[b]5. Big Man (C, PF, CT) Offense Adjustment
[/b]- ‘Hook Shot Maximum Distance’ specialty’s distance will be reduced.
- Big Man’s shot success rate reduction based on distance will be slightly
reduced.

[b]6. Addressing the Issue: Blocking Player Movement[/b]
- You will fall over when making contact with an opposing character while
using the Pick and Move skill.
- Using dash to push away an opponent will reduce your stamina by 70%.
- You cannot use dash to push away an opponent if you have less
than 70% stamina.
(The dev team will monitor the game to check if this change can be abused
by attackers)
 
[b]Play Classic Court (On/Off)[/b]
1. If there is a user among the 6 match participants who wants to play
on Classic Court, there is a probability that it will be selected.
2. If all team members on one side do not want to play Classic Court,
the chances of it being selected are 0%.
3. You can check the chances of Classic Court being selected by
clicking the [Probability] button
4. While the users are in waiting room, they can turn on and
play the Classic Court.
Just hit the [Event] button from the upper left side of the screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/624636dd0e8c2f7c8d8f01d60a4429a6efaddbed.png[/img]

There are also indicators that the team members turned ON/OFF their Classic Court.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0f78911044659ebbcc6bd3c7e3abb4ac917cccbb.png[/img]
