notes.title: February Tournament Schedule
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6485d78d0434abb98de596080b4071d3038d6a7c.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our Freestyle 2 [b]February 2024[/b] Tournament Update!

Form a team and be the best by defeating many of the great teams
on each server!

[b]Tournament Information[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/52471ccdb08160f2962bc36c12f0b6dbf7d105b9.png[/img]

- Quarterfinals or Round of 8 Format

- Participants can enter the tournament multiple times during the Normal Tournament Schedule and not limited to one entry.

- 2 normal tournaments will be open and running at the same time.

[b]Normal Tournament Schedule (Part 1):[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d3b3394b7f14bde14b078a2c4b4fcb64438c6baf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d3f2e00cd9067d1aa2b3bbd686797f13d6727547.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bd1c6808e90554af613448bd75c8b4c3719b183c.jpg[/img]

[b]Normal Tournament Schedule (Part 2):[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/527b9e5ec08abaf172b9f1c05ff5804170bbcfaa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b75afa906038e7a4549675b6e37b5844c29da454.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7f5244cc144136a2e4929c5bfbf31e1d5bec24b0.jpg[/img]

[b]Normal Tournament Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fecc9ddd6d63cec1c30f576421299f5e4223332b.png[/img]

[b]Rules:[/b]
1. Coins will be obtained by characters.
2. The amount of the coins granted will be increased for bigger tournaments.
3. The displayed reward for playing and winning is the amount granted per match.
4. Amount of coins will be deducted accordingly in case of winning by default.
5. Obtained coins can be used to purchase various items at the Tournament Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/50765ab49249413655b9c431420e35a9d5b8d5a5.png[/img]

Both the Super Tournament and Crew Tournament will be held three (3) times on February 24th (PST).

Check out the schedule below.

[b]--Tournament Schedule--[/b]

[i][u]Asia Super Tournament Schedule[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/699f1d5f93ff6351f524dc94a61c84c00314f885.jpg[/img]

[u][i]Asia Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f38be5b7e69995eaceafe44758a6f67d8740af97.jpg[/img]

[u][i]EU Super Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9e7da041f02ab60f57e07338c00eac0d925af294.jpg[/img]

[u][i]EU Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ae040d291758f2b2c02b46e231689f984415bcba.jpg[/img]

[u][i]NA Super Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/00db1ad54753d2ef3b5ee52467681fb53ee7fd4f.jpg[/img]

[u][i]NA Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9d886b27b09b9bef67b86256ec1c85dd385a1a9.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Super Tournament Mechanics[/b][/u]
- Players can participate in other servers (Asia, EU, NA) regardless of the server focus time.

[b]Example:[/b]
[u][b]During Asia Server Focus Time Tournament[/b][/u]
- Players in the Asia Server that are participating in the event may earn the Special Rewards.
- Players playing on the other servers (NA or EU) will not be able to earn the Special Rewards.
- Coin Rewards will still be distributed regardless of server and tournament focus time.
- The player's location or country does not matter, only where the player is currently logged in the server.

[u][b]Participation Conditions[/b][/u]
 - Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
 - The tournament consists of 16 rounds, and a total of 48 players can take part.
 
[u][b]--Super Tournament Rewards--[/b][/u] 

[b]1. Coin Rewards[/b]

The tournament will be open to ALL Server Regions and can
earn Coin Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11a553b81db3385ae106faa150fbdbf02c5aeb0e.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Special Rewards[/b]

Players who are participating in the Tournament during the FOCUS TIME of each server are eligible to be rewarded with Special Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1c9a58bbe9a281690efe7165945824eace1a0541.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/14f891ffc86cbb70099c245e69a2d94a73a72b92.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/15ba805b8357467b3a246748499e28717c760723.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f2faac798582a46c6503b874f6fc5abad7bebeeb.gif[/img]

[i]*The personalized uniform reward for the winner will be distributed individually.
*The character name will be engraved on the back of the uniform.[/i]
 
[i][b]Outfit Preview:[/b][/i]

[b]Conqueror's Gown[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/452192bd7df423fbd44bfdedd9bca227a509b4b6.gif[/img]

[b]Super Conqueror Frame[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8ccf1c330e7b1270837ffb75d58e7e8a35979825.gif[/img]

Winner’s Personalized Uniform
[i](Lettering functions can be applied in this uniform.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f5cc01f146f9463e344ce5f6a1fa4b7c00feafe9.gif[/img]

[b]Exclusive Tournament Outfit[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7ec6aea26e7f42dbb72a840dcf9e45f45d4059a.gif[/img]

[b][i]*Lettering Outfit and Magic Pen added to Super League Tournament Rewards*[/i]

Lettering Outfit Preview (M/F)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/70d1a461739a292b2ebeadc45a5be26630751288.gif[/img]

[b]Additional Details about the Lettering Outfit[/b]

- You can obtain lettering outfits from the Tournament Shop
- You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
- When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free.
   Afterward, lettering items will be required to make changes.
- Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
- Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfits.

[b]a) Top: Jersey[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fae6e65be57848388f1e3a8dd4a7e1dcbb9a00e3.gif[/img]

[b]b) Bottom: Leggings Shorts, Regular Shorts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5d110ef344784ab942e864b865d537adffff3dba.gif[/img]

[i]* Before using the lettering function, the basic settings are as follows: Text: FS2,
  Color: White, Stroke: Black
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on the lettering function on unequippable outfits.[/i]

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ea377329d49ecfbd72f8f4fd8e5441538afb8acc.gif[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
[i]* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.[/i]

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
[i]* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.[/i]
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fef6c962994bc9f8def5546e19f4a1f5325a19c9.gif[/img]

[b]Important Notes:[/b]
- Rewards will be distributed after the event ends.
The schedule will be provided separately.

- Duplicate participation will be not be considered for multiple rewards.
If a player participates multiple times in the tournament, the player will be
rewarded with only the highest rewards they achieved during the tournament.
 
- Character selection coupons will be sent after the winning team is
determined, and participants can specify their desired characters through
separate 1:1 inquiries.
 
- Choose 1 reward (Premium Sub Att x100 or Character Coupon x1) and contact
our support team at steam_support@gamekiss.com

[b]Premium Character Reward List:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0338d5b0c16778f09d3e4432d9242a75b261590b.gif[/img]

- In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues,
it will be considered as a loss.
 
- If a system error occurs during the finals, the match may be held again
at a later time.
 
- Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes
or updates will be communicated through notices.

[b]--Crew Tournament Mechanics--[/b]

- Participation is limited to 3 individuals from the same crew.
- A maximum of 2 teams can enter one Crew Tournament.
- There is only one tournament open, consisting of 16 rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a7c889c25a9b9516b9f2b0f9803caf2f84316112.gif[/img]

1. The Button for [Crew Tournament Open] will be visible on the main screen of the Crew.
2. Upon opening the tournament, a room is generated automatically.
- Throughout the event, a single round takes place in a room.
3. Recruit fellow players and assemble a team.
- In the waiting area, all three members from the same crew team must be present, 
and only the room leader has the authority to apply for participation.
4. If all team members, except the room leader, consent to participating within 10 seconds,  participation is confirmed in the order it was received.
5. All teams participating will compete simultaneously.
6. The games persist until the Crew Tournament concludes, iterating through game progress, game completion, and round completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b5dbe1ef85cf11f76878f1694e53e488df6b8b1.gif[/img]

- Leaving the crew, deleting a character, or dissolving a crew does not erase ranking record data.
- Within the Ranking page, a Crew tab has been introduced in the Tournament section.
- In the Crew Ranking page, a Tournament Ranking tab is now available.
(Rankings are determined by aggregating the TP Points earned by each crew.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2c1a2cbea1322324de15bcbab1a4071f2385eb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/79d53ea0f95d67cab275a6df4f24f1c22ff35388.gif[/img]

On the lobby screen, you can view the details of the winning team from
the Crew Tournament.

[b]a) Requirement:[/b]
After the conclusion of the Crew Tournament, the ranking is updated,
and the insignia of the first-place crew is showcased.
(In typical tournaments, the Crew Tournament airships are exhibited at random.)

Channel: FS Channel
Details: The crew emblem and name are visible for viewing.

[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/72b87702fee1e59de37f4847054e42fec36dda44.png[/img]

You can use the lettering feature to specify text and color.
When setting lettering for the first time, it's free, but for subsequent lettering changes, you'll need to consume lettering items.
Lettering outfits have unique marks for identification.
You cannot set duplicate lettering for different lettering outfits (case-insensitive for alphabets).
Magic Pens can be obtained from the Tournament Shop.

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02378adaa40e26131033dd70c782f869ccd3a21.png[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can
have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]
Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[b]- Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/577a0fc5c39b9a4ab30e2d904d54c5ac5294314e.png[/img]

In the bustling realm of Freestyle 2, a new character emerges.

Meet Tristia, a unique character in Freestyle 2, born from the rare mix of angels and demons. 
 
Tristia carries an extraordinary legacy, showcasing a blend of heavenly purity and demonic allure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cbaf3ffea1dc8b4fcd7c65b09815fb5465eedfd2.gif[/img]

birthed a storm that shattered her world.

profound isolation. In her despair, dormant celestial powers awoke—a gift from
her mysterious lineage. But strength couldn't heal her emotional scars.
 
Corrupted by the past, her awakened state saw tragedy in her existence.
Affection became her adversary, and she withdrew into loneliness.

notes.title: February Update and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d809fa8379460348881a6fc18599f2a50d0c0a9c.png[/img]

We're excited to unveil the latest February update, packed with exciting 
improvements and features to enhance your gaming experience like never 
before!

This February update is our way of showing our commitment to continuously 
improving Freestyle 2 and delivering the best possible gaming experience to our 
dedicated community.

What's Included in the February Update:

1. Set Accessories

Equip all set items of accessories, and unlock a whole new level of power!
Experience the thrill of gaining additional attributes when you complete your
accessory sets. 

Accessory Preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/726b7ba55ab5f6a595f429483918ea7590ffca1b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/01a077fcf56785911492c8926c74e523e5734f1c.png[/img]

[b]Hidden Outfit Effect Details:[/b]
 
What is an Outfit Set?
1.  Outfit Sets are divided into "Transformation Sets" and "Attribute Sets".
2. You get an effect by equipping all pieces of the set.
- Transformation Outfit Set: When the match starts, the outfit changes according
to the time.
- Attribute Outfit Set: Permanently gain the Attribute bonuses given by the set.
 
[b]Outfit Set Feature Description:[/b]
 
- Transformation Set Outfit Function:
 
1. Outfit change every 30 seconds after the match starts.
2. Outfit changes occur every time turns change between OFF/DEF.
3. Transformation characters change after their transformation is over and outfit
changes are applied only to the main character for switching characters.
4. If they have Back Acc, the Back Acc Ceremony will be unusable.
 
[b]- Attribute Set Outfit Function:[/b]
 
1. When outfitted, the ability value always increases.
2. This is applied to the "Switching char" wearing the outfit set.

[b]2. Character Note[/b]

We are introducing a brand-new Character Note function that adds a personal
touch to your gaming journey. 
 
Located in the character lobby, this feature allows you to see the details about
your Characters Attributes, Card, Action, and Records information.

[i][u][b]It's important to note that only the user can view their own
attributes.[/b][/u][/i]

[b]Records:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7d3c28f9f9fcab203a224ed72b5dc1ef66aabd52.gif[/img]

We're grateful for your ongoing support, and we hope these updates add an

notes.title: Crew Invitation Channel Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/df1034f1717051e82a8a0ed345fc4ed97db46d75.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce a significant update that enhances the
Crew Invitational Channel function! 
 
These enhancements are aimed at providing you with more flexibility
and control over your Crew's tournament participation. Dive into the action,
coordinate with your Crew, and make the most of these improvements to
elevate your Freestyle 2 gaming experience!
 
Check the improvement details below:

[b]1. Crew Invitational Channel function improvements[/b]
 
- For unofficial tournaments or non-official tournaments, players can
purchase and use Crew Invitational Channel Tickets.
 
(1) Crew Invitational (Tournament) Channel Ticket
- Can be purchased using Crew Points or Freetickets.
 
[i](Only users with the [Crew Master] role can purchase with Crew Point.)[/i]
- Matching can only be done by accounts holding the ticket.
- Usage available time will be deducted immediately upon purchase.

[b]2) How To Use the Crew Invitational Channel[/b]
 
[b]Step 1:[/b] Purchase a Tournament Channel Ticket.
- You may use [b]50,000 Crew Points or 5,000 Free Tickets[/b] for
purchasing Tournament Pass.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/16c26d7dcb2c0b4f01cc497f0ba57aa0d6fe8184.png[/img]
 
[b]Step 2:[/b] Create a room using an account that holds the
Tournament Channel Ticket.
- You may just click the Special Channel -> Crew Invitational Main Game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/08d345346df795ee5bfe263575b14a68fef73f07.png[/img]
 
[b]Step 3:[/b] Invite a team member to the created room to participate in the tournament.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9bb832497932c39914fcfb083a82f8cf29afb312.gif[/img]
 
[b]Step 4:[/b] The invited team member invites the remaining team members to
form the team.

[b]Step 5:[/b] The account holding the Tournament Channel Ticket leaves the
room and creates a new room for the opposing team.

[b]Step 6:[/b] Similarly, invite one member of the opposing team, and the invited
team member invites the rest of their team.

[b]Step 7[/b]: Once everyone is invited to the rooms, click the
[Proceed with Tournament Matching] button to set up the tournament.

[b]Step 8:[/b] Enter the room number for matching the HOME team/AWAY team
and click the "Confirm" button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/67609984f9cb07450e344063e8205a5ceee1b113.gif[/img]
 
[b]Step 9:[/b] Click the [Start Matching] button to check matching progress.

[b]Step 10:[/b] When both the HOME team and AWAY team have completed
the matching check, the match will proceed.

[b]Step 11:[/b] You can watch the ongoing game through the Broadcast Car.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a5e01fbbfb6e3eab41310d1bf70c50bc731b583a.gif[/img]

Screen Before and After purchasing Tournament Pass
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3cecda833bd200444baecb4c50d80de1018d076a.gif[/img]
 
- Freestyle 2 Team

Here comes the opening of Want U Festival! Join us for a month of exciting events,
amazing rewards, and exciting building of booths that capture the essence of this
Beautiful season. Let's get together this month and make some wonderful
memories!

Guide:

1. Every hour, various coins are automatically produced in the designated
buildings and can be collected by clicking on them. Coins can be stored
for up to 10 hours. (If you don't click on the accumulated coins to collect
them, they will no longer accumulate.)
 
2. The collected coins are used to upgrade all buildings or to produce items in
designated buildings. (Upgrading buildings that can produce coins or items
increases efficiency, such as production speed, amount, etc.)
 
3. If you upgrade the Main Stage and level up, you earn a special reward for
certain levels. (Check the rewards list on the right for details.)
 
4. If building upgrade or item production time is too long, you can use Instant
Completion Tickets to finish instantly.
 
5. If all your buildings reach a specific level, the level restrictions will be lifted,
allowing you to upgrade them to higher levels via "Festival Expansion."
Expanding Festival at least once will allow you to gift your owned coins
to new/returning accounts without limit.
 
6. All items except coins are moved to Gift Box upon acquisition, and coins
are applied directly to the event.
 
Reminder:
Upgrades and item production cannot be cancelled once they start. When
the event ends, all coins held will be deleted.

fused.

number of materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are

excluded from fusion.

notes.title: January's 2nd Balance Patch and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5084be6dc493de921e4c14be7ff4a2c1ededb867.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

The Freestyle 2 Development Team is reaching out to provide early notice, allowing you to review and prepare for the upcoming 2nd Winter balance patch and improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e03935b2a433d324b8016634916462b412364ed2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/516338c294292567e69717d2c313ebfd7e743d58.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bb0c2d44f4afa1511b9308bfd46b47f95282f572.gif[/img]

[b]1. Shot Trajectory Improvements[/b]
- New rebound shot trajectory is added for middle shots, 3-pointers.

[b]2. Turn-based fixed shot Improvements[/b]
-Improvements have been made in the areas where we previously inferred
certain situations based on the shooting results.

[b]3. Shot Feedback removed[/b]
- During the match, the shot result UI, which used to be displayed at the top
center of the screen, will no longer be shown	

[b]4. Adjustments to the Equipment System Balance[/b]
   A. The attributes of all equipment, ranging from normal to legendary, have
been scaled down.
   B. All durations for the acquired capabilities of the normal to legendary
equipment have been reduced.	
   C. The probability of triggering the conditional ability value has been changed.
   D. Details ([url=https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/event/18392]https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/event/18392[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccf1970f52b6eb7c5df514c53ceb13199714557b.gif[/img]

1. Street Block removed
- The in-game Workbench → Street Block menu has been deleted.
- Block points that could be acquired after matches will no longer be available
after the update.

2. Changes to Broadcast Car creation conditions
- The conditions for mid-level skill games, indicated by yellow Broadcast Cars, have been expanded.

3. End of Street Block Celebration and Mission System Rewards
   A. Rewards for the end of Street Block
- In commemoration of the end of Street Block, all users who meet the conditions will receive rewards in their Gift Box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1f32209d2f0391a6391cb7e148a237f70510b652.png[/img]

[b]~ Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.content:

The Mega Pass is back for its 34th season! Complete all the levels and
acquire this season's exclusive cosmetic items, along with other goodies!
 
Event Period:
2024/01/17 00:00 ~ 2024/03/12 23:59 (PST)
 
Event Details:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/84fa1cc0deb25b00b6ff07eb4d7a093a204a75a7.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass genuinely rewards players who can fully level it up!

Play games and complete challenges to collect stars and
level up your Mega Pass.

Upon reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward players
for their hard work.

Players can purchase the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash,
granting them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/080cbec5e6a481eb70fe4672badf5c20a186fe84.gif[/img]

Revamped Mega Pass:
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon reaching the next step
of the Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next step)

- Purchase Premium to be eligible for Premium Rewards.

- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9378f63f780b4be2743235dd6c155635fdfa348e.gif[/img] 
Note: Users will not be able to earn additional stars
during the last week of the Mega Pass.

The Mega Pass consists of tiers for different levels.
 
In each tier, there will be rewards for both the regular and
Premium Mega Pass.
 
How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?
 
You can advance through the Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars.

Stars are obtained by completing daily and weekly quests, as well as
by fulfilling the Pass Grade Missions.

Once you have completed a quest, click on it, and a 'receive' button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you click this button, and the quests will
reset daily and weekly. Therefore, be sure to collect your stars
as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8f8250806939af8953082a2fae347459f7d1d38c.gif[/img]

no additional levels will be introduced. This period is designated for
players to claim their rewards before the event concludes.

notes.title: January 1st Balance Patch and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/780d763c3ce12b57096fe7e294076baf58bc1d27.png[/img]

We are delighted to bring you an array of awesome updates and improvements
to elevate your Freestyle 2 experience! 

Our development team has been hard at work crafting features, refining
gameplay, and incorporating your valuable feedback to ensure that
Freestyle 2 continues to be the ultimate destination for our Ballers!

We are excited to share these latest advancements with you, promising
more excitement, smoother gameplay, and a host of new features to
explore!

1. 1/10 (wed) Balance Contents Update
We aim to enhance the game's content and introduce diverse features
for a more immersive user experience

2. 1/17 (Wed) Play Balance Update
We have planned several key updates, including adjustments to play
balance, equipment content, and the removal of the street block.

In 2024, we acknowledge the importance of play balance and are
committed to enhancing the gaming experience by replacing the
long-standing 'street block' system with new, regularly updated
equipment content. This change will be aligned with the evolving
play meta, and we will consider both external and achievement factors.

Our goal is to significantly improve player satisfaction.

For more details, please refer to the information provided below.
We highly encourage you to share your feedback on the balance patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3ce8e18af6931eae688e1e7ec50753c0a2124006.gif[/img]

1. Loading Page Improvements

- During the matching process, we improved the area where the
'loading' indicator obscured the position and Mastery
- Pre-season Ranking grade display changed from Master grade
or higher to Platinum Tier 3 grade or higher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24be958deecd7fa4d2885e39c25b2a0b9b215284.png[/img]

2 Crew Entrance Scene Added

- the entrance scene and map will change for Crew matches.

3 Win Streak Display Changes

- When a character is on a win streak, the color of the displayed
nickname will change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6b31c58ee69b95bc0fde100f4311bbae53b9b61a.png[/img]

4. MVP Scene Changes

- Additional types of MVP scenes have been added and will be
played based on probability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1ad6de5004e0bdc398f636c26d58dbc4882f0bd6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4fcab2315cca43413515763567d26668a3b40ea.gif[/img]

5. Match Result Page Changes

- the match results page displays new match records and season
records.
- the MVP user display is enhanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4694b3b1e05f3904c5ba0ea4e593029d7ad9a59.gif[/img]

6.  Removal of match waiting rewards

- The reward paid in the gift box while waiting for matching
has been removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ffcfc94bd5d87eced0134f0bb929071cb27c847a.gif[/img]

1.  Ranking Page Improvements

(1) Ranked Game Improvements
- In 2024, the beta season will end and a new season will begin.
- The ranked game image has been changed.

(2) LOS Ranked Game Store Outfit Added
- The “White Ribbon Outfit Set” will be added to the LOS Ranked Game Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9207908d2a01bacf9245f58cf92b5662d61f75d.gif[/img]

Oufit Preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0cbacb37cd2d10963bd6f5c94bf9ccff34d016b.gif[/img]

(3) Change the pre-rank calculation formula
- The reset score before the ranking was adjusted to alleviate the problem of
reaching a high grade with a small number of matches.

2. Ranking

(a) Ranked Game Tab
- The “Top League” tab will change to the “TOP 300” tab, and “Master,”
“Diamond,” and “Platinum” tabs will be added.
- the “Promising Star” tab will be removed.
- a “Detailed Record Help” button will be added.

(b) Rating Ranking Tab
- the rating Ranking tab will be removed.

(c) Crew Ranking Tab
- Crew Ranking calculation method will be changed.
-Crew ranking points are allocated based on the ranks of the characters in
each crew.
-The ranking is determined by the crew that accumulates the highest score

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b9324555001cecea9e28f930318faf9f88e8c3de.png[/img]

(d) Changed Ranked game Page
- Changes to the Ranked Matches page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8014b9cb328f41059bc1033f6dc1d9251905281b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8f001a8b13c3cd54bae2035f9365adb456466172.gif[/img]

(1) Broadcast Car UI Improvements
- the position of the Broadcast Car camera UI button in the Lobby screen will
be changed, a broadcasting preview area will be added, and the current number
of ongoing broadcasts will be displayed.
- Different colors will indicate Different types of Broadcast Cars.

→ Mid-level competition: Yellow
→ Top performance competition: Red
→ Crew: Purple
→ Competition: Green

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d6be6e6b860a47bcbaba68c9e247b5c5222785d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e38192e29fead98733d50b70703609e57b7ce2ef.gif[/img]

- Street Block item will be removed from New User and Returnee
Exclusive Event, Point Ball and Newbie Mission.

notes.title: Equipment System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f9058ea988b5dcd8a18e81e29da4269c8c759836.png[/img]

Hey there, ballers! We're thrilled to introduce our brand-new equipment system
to the game. Now, you can gear up with the latest hoops gear to boost your
skills on the court. From high-tech equipments to specialized basketballs,
explore how these new items can enhance up your game and help you
shoot for victory.

Get ready to elevate your basketball experience with our exciting new equipment
lineup!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/21009bbcb7fded1a184f71865e21d40c7eb79cf0.gif[/img]
1. Character Equipment consists of equippable items that do not change
appearance.
2. There is Equipment for 4 parts, and each part can have a max of 4 items
equipped.
3. Each Equipment has unique activation conditions, and if you meet these
conditions while in the match, you will gain Attributes. 
(However, Equipment with the same conditions cannot be simultaneously
equipped or stack)
4. Obtain Attributes have a certain duration, which is determined by the
Equipment grade and quality.
5. All Equipment can be upgraded and disassembled, and successful upgrades
will increase attributes.
6. Disassemlbing Equipment will grant "Equipment Disassembly Pieces", which
can be collected and exchange for higher-grade Equipment and other items. 

Where can you find the Equipment System?
- You can access the new Equipment System by navigating to the Locker tab
at the bottom of your screen and toggling the cursor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7066bfa592823f306b3407154c78facf7e72cffb.png[/img]
How to gear up your new equipment items?
- Navigate to your Equipment Tab/Screen, choose the item, and then click the
check button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1bd84b275e0bcee1ea5cd9f9e09ece2c528067a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc9ae02d382cd38b3cd09ca584c065ab9c2bae01.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/af3dbf369103ff1c09f0591658ad626ea70f12d1.gif[/img]
How to upgrade your equipment items?
- Navigate to your Equipment Tab/Screen, access 'Manage Equipment,'
choose the item you wish to upgrade, and then click on the upgrade button.
(Ensure that you unequip the unlocked equipment item before upgrading it)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1bd84b275e0bcee1ea5cd9f9e09ece2c528067a.gif[/img]
1. All Equipment can be upgraded and disassembled, and successful upgrades
will increase Attributes.
 
2. When upgrading, the success rate and required upgrade materials
vary depending on the grade and upgrade level.
 
3. Upgrade failures can result in a “big failure,” and in such cases upgrade
level will decrease by 1.
 
4. In the event of upgrade failure, you will receive a certain amount of
upgrade materials back.
 
5. Starting from a certain grade and level, you can use Sub Upgrade Material
and doing so will increase upgrade probability.
 
6. Max applicable quantity of Sub Upgrade Material varies depending on
upgrade grade, and they can be obtained from events and other such means.
 
7. Upgrade Materials and Sub Upgrade Materials used to upgrade are
consumed regardless of whether the upgrade succeeds or fails.
 
Example of Attributes by Equipment Upgrade Level
- 3-Pointer Success Rate Increased
 
What Are Equipment Conditions?
1. Each Equipment has unique activation conditions.
2. Each part has 12 activation conditions.
3. If you meet these conditions for equipped Equipment during a game,
you will gain Attributes.
4. If there are 2 or more identical conditions when equipping Equipment,
they cannot be equipped.
 
Equipment Activation Conditions

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a7364aa102b15f249084ed38cd3273565401f38.png[/img]
About Equipment Attributes
"1. Each Equipment has different available Attributes depending on the part.
2. Upon obtaining Equipment, random Attributes will be obtained.
3. Equipment Attributes vary depending on the Equipment Grade and upgrade level.
Note: Applied Attributes are rounded to the nearest whole number.
(Example: +1.6 → +1)"

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b08b029c520e7913b7bebc49051a936961d9a271.gif[/img]
About Quality
1. There are 5 grades of Quality for Equipment.
(Lowest/Low/Intermediate/High/Highest)
2. Random quality grades are assigned when obtaining Equipment.
3. The duration of the Equipment condition activation varies depending on quality.
4. Different durations can be obtained even for equipment of the same quality.
 (Detailed obtainable ranges can be checked in the table below.)
5. Quality can be changed using “Equipment Quality Changers.”
6. “Equipment Quality Changers” can be obtained from events
and the Equipment Shop."
 
Condition Duration
Note: Duration based on quality is randomly obtained when obtaining Equipment.
1-1.1 second(s)
 
- When your team scores
- When opponent team scores
- Every even score of your team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ba65b29c2bb39a4f23a6add095ea36604c878f0d.gif[/img]
1. You can change equipment quality using Equipment Quality Changers.
2. The quality will be randomly changed among 5 grades: Highest, High,
Intermediate, Low, and Lowest.
3. Quality Changers can be obtained through the "Equipment Shop" or events.
4. 1 Resource will be consumed when changing quality, and
quality changes cannot be canceled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/66c3ca77e8de990faf60e5cc3734c2e035404a4b.gif[/img]
- The disassemble feature will provide you disassembly piece. Disassembly piece
can be used as currency to purchase items from the Material Shop. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c81fed560d461c55126284d25f076460ebba3808.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/41541e4db97c0e9e60890a87d7f6f1932ddeb04f.gif[/img]
- You can purchase various items from the Material Shop to purchase
equipment items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b0a5ace7356b39c8fad2e3e7d8aa38458c524afc.gif[/img]
 
Note:
Exchanged items are sent to the Gift Box.

What are you waiting for? Claim your free Equipment Items now!
 
- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: January Tournament Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6485d78d0434abb98de596080b4071d3038d6a7c.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our Freestyle 2 January 2024 Tournament Update!

Form a team and be the best by defeating many of the great teams
on each server!

[b]Tournament Information[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/52471ccdb08160f2962bc36c12f0b6dbf7d105b9.png[/img]

- Quarterfinals or Round of 8 Format

- Participants can enter the tournament multiple times during the Normal Tournament Schedule and not limited to one entry.

- 2 normal tournaments will be open and running at the same time.

[b]Normal Tournament Schedule (Part 1):[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/39462ffc4290aa2825a1415a7df1361af4c351fe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/686c3120c29a6ad54340a9805b60a317bb4c6f1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/453cc562f9171007086c931b6d833bd2e8b5ca17.jpg[/img]

[b]Normal Tournament Schedule (Part 2):[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e6010ac2756656af5198bd7e777b78ba430fbeeb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6ec42d20066e07f5d47df1cb0298d3e775eb7bc9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ecf130c2146a2ff08d79ee5804a6438ef174b9cc.jpg[/img]

[b]Normal Tournament Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fecc9ddd6d63cec1c30f576421299f5e4223332b.png[/img]

[b]Rules:[/b]
1. Coins will be obtained by characters.
2. The amount of the coins granted will be increased for bigger tournaments.
3. The displayed reward for playing and winning is the amount granted per match.
4. Amount of coins will be deducted accordingly in case of winning by default.
5. Obtained coins can be used to purchase various items at the Tournament Shop.

[b]Tournament Schedule[/b]

[i][u]Asia Super Tournament Schedule[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e23d7486da127b5564c792b48a6aa368ee71fb68.jpg[/img]

[u][i]Asia Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4e801e59439c21f9c1faa8eefdb1ff294abda0db.jpg[/img]

[u][i]EU Super Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/79b28adf09c1925ff270c315dc3b45a8dfc5c4a3.jpg[/img]

[u][i]EU Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/852e37a1c25b0680b0a642a80a7b16d1334eb041.jpg[/img]

[u][i]NA Super Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/40b0a5646f044e0c488343ccf243d84664d53919.jpg[/img]

[u][i]NA Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9b7f597ddc75d6f128424c363746b990595929d8.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Super Tournament Mechanics[/b][/u]
- Players can participate in other servers (Asia, EU, NA) regardless of the server focus time.

[b]Example:[/b]
[u][b]During Asia Server Focus Time Tournament[/b][/u]
- Players in the Asia Server that are participating in the event may earn the Special Rewards.
- Players playing on the other servers (NA or EU) will not be able to earn the Special Rewards.
- Coin Rewards will still be distributed regardless of server and tournament focus time.
- The player's location or country does not matter, only where the player is currently logged in the server.

[u][b]Participation Conditions[/b][/u]
 - Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
 - The tournament consists of 16 rounds, and a total of 48 players can take part.
 
[u][b]--Super Tournament Rewards--[/b][/u] 

[b]1. Coin Rewards[/b]

The tournament will be open to ALL Server Regions and can
earn Coin Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11a553b81db3385ae106faa150fbdbf02c5aeb0e.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Special Rewards[/b]

Players who are participating in the Tournament during the FOCUS TIME of each server are eligible to be rewarded with Special Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1c9a58bbe9a281690efe7165945824eace1a0541.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/14f891ffc86cbb70099c245e69a2d94a73a72b92.gif[/img]

[i]*The personalized uniform reward for the winner will be distributed individually.
*The character name will be engraved on the back of the uniform.[/i]
 
[i][b]Outfit Preview:[/b][/i]

[b]Conqueror's Gown[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/452192bd7df423fbd44bfdedd9bca227a509b4b6.gif[/img]

[b]Super Conqueror Frame[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8ccf1c330e7b1270837ffb75d58e7e8a35979825.gif[/img]

Winner’s Personalized Uniform
[i](Lettering functions can be applied in this uniform.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f5cc01f146f9463e344ce5f6a1fa4b7c00feafe9.gif[/img]

[b]Exclusive Tournament Outfit[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7ec6aea26e7f42dbb72a840dcf9e45f45d4059a.gif[/img]

[b][i]*Lettering Outfit and Magic Pen added to Super League Tournament Rewards*[/i]

Lettering Outfit Preview (M/F)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/70d1a461739a292b2ebeadc45a5be26630751288.gif[/img]

[b]Additional Details about the Lettering Outfit[/b]

- You can obtain lettering outfits from the Tournament Shop
- You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
- When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free.
   Afterward, lettering items will be required to make changes.
- Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
- Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfits.

[b]a) Top: Jersey[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fae6e65be57848388f1e3a8dd4a7e1dcbb9a00e3.gif[/img]

[b]b) Bottom: Leggings Shorts, Regular Shorts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5d110ef344784ab942e864b865d537adffff3dba.gif[/img]

[i]* Before using the lettering function, the basic settings are as follows: Text: FS2,
  Color: White, Stroke: Black
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on the lettering function on unequippable outfits.[/i]

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ea377329d49ecfbd72f8f4fd8e5441538afb8acc.gif[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
[i]* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.[/i]

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
[i]* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.[/i]
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fef6c962994bc9f8def5546e19f4a1f5325a19c9.gif[/img]

[b]Important Notes:[/b]
- Rewards will be distributed after the event ends.
The schedule will be provided separately.

- Duplicate participation will be not be considered for multiple rewards.
If a player participates multiple times in the tournament, the player will be
rewarded with only the highest rewards they achieved during the tournament.
 
- Character selection coupons will be sent after the winning team is
determined, and participants can specify their desired characters through
separate 1:1 inquiries.
 
- Choose 1 reward (Premium Sub Att x100 or Character Coupon x1) and contact
our support team at steam_support@gamekiss.com

[b]Premium Character Reward List:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0338d5b0c16778f09d3e4432d9242a75b261590b.gif[/img]

- In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues,
it will be considered as a loss.
 
- If a system error occurs during the finals, the match may be held again
at a later time.
 
- Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes
or updates will be communicated through notices.

[b]--Crew Tournament Mechanics--[/b]

- Participation is limited to 3 individuals from the same crew.
- A maximum of 2 teams can enter one Crew Tournament.
- There is only one tournament open, consisting of 16 rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a7c889c25a9b9516b9f2b0f9803caf2f84316112.gif[/img]

1. The Button for [Crew Tournament Open] will be visible on the main screen of the Crew.
2. Upon opening the tournament, a room is generated automatically.
- Throughout the event, a single round takes place in a room.
3. Recruit fellow players and assemble a team.
- In the waiting area, all three members from the same crew team must be present, 
and only the room leader has the authority to apply for participation.
4. If all team members, except the room leader, consent to participating within 10 seconds,  participation is confirmed in the order it was received.
5. All teams participating will compete simultaneously.
6. The games persist until the Crew Tournament concludes, iterating through game progress, game completion, and round completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b5dbe1ef85cf11f76878f1694e53e488df6b8b1.gif[/img]

- Leaving the crew, deleting a character, or dissolving a crew does not erase ranking record data.
- Within the Ranking page, a Crew tab has been introduced in the Tournament section.
- In the Crew Ranking page, a Tournament Ranking tab is now available.
(Rankings are determined by aggregating the TP Points earned by each crew.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2c1a2cbea1322324de15bcbab1a4071f2385eb7.png[/img]

the Crew Tournament.

and the insignia of the first-place crew is showcased.

Channel: FS Channel

We are thrilled to introduce a fantastic opportunity for you to create your
very own Custom Package, tailored to your preferences and desires!

This exclusive event will allow you to handpick five items from a curated
selection and unlock amazing discounts!

Event Period: 
2023/12/27 00:00 ~ 2024/01/09 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/858b3beab4e68f6e80be839fa0d8cd99595298c7.gif[/img]

Event Mechanics:

1. Select the 5 items that you want!
You have the power to choose the products that suit your needs and style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/15fd13dc32b2ae7ba2a6d874dd8b9f27f51dcd1b.gif[/img]

2. The selected items will go My Personalized Package slots!
Our catalog boasts a wide range of high-quality items, and the ones you
select will be displayed in your Custom Package.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fa28fcaa8d33d785366708a7990818cebddc068a.gif[/img]

3. Activate the "Jackpot Chance":
Once all 5 items have been added, the "Jackpot Chance" button
will become active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ce298b949dfff90bcf1ca86bf02350090d6e33b4.gif[/img]

4. Try Your Luck with the "Jackpot Chance"!
Click the "Jackpot Chance" button to take your chances.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/133c6bea180ab22a05468ca1d93eb0efb65aa564.gif[/img]

*The minimum and maximum discount range is proportional
to the total price of the selected items.
*The discount rate is determined with equal probability in 1%
increments.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/af1e62e75e28506e3eb7b0920bb28d27068e1539.png[/img]
 
5. Check and Confirm!
Review the item quantity and discount rate. When you're satisfied,
the purchase button will become active, allowing you to buy the package.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2d9ac9b0d43b8076ac2efe541748ac0de284d3df.gif[/img]
 
6. Resource Use for Reset!
If you wish to try your luck again, you can use resources to reset
the item quantity and discount rates for the "Jackpot Chance."

*Shop Mileage is earned from Jackpot Chance.
 
7. Item Removal!
If you decide to remove an item that already has an applied quantity
and discount rate, the item quantity and discount rate will be reset.
 
8. Purchase Limit!
Each account can purchase up to 10 My Personalized Packages.

notes.title: Mysterious Glass Bead
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d54fea494d6299df3ff8ef6b2ab5c3bb54da384.png[/img]

Dive into the enchanting realm of the Mysterious Glass Bead Event,
and uncover the magic within these beads to acquire the outfit of your dreams!

Event Period:
2023/12/27 00:00 (PST) ~ 2024/01/09 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0e6aa27c19a3aea27d53a135316c33319d36d3d.gif[/img]

Event details:
[Mysterious Glass Bead]
 
** If you purchase 500 "Mystery Scrolls", you can obtain one
of the following rewards:
- Mysterious Complete Card Glass Bead x1
- Sensitive Intuition (15D) x1
- Skull Nunchuck x1
 
** It will be sent to the gift box.
 
[Draw Outfit]
- You can obtain Normal Grade to Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits
you’ve obtained!
- Outfits obtained through Outfit Fusion and items
(except those obtained through the draw) will be sent to the gift box.

** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse
will be moved to the gift box automatically.
 
* Step 1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9920789404da8d712d1c094eb453cb347093e2f3.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the 'Purchase' button and draw 1 or 5 time(s).

Mystery Scroll
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/841132313eafc55296b67ce5117f485a0f44a64c.gif[/img]

Event Gkash can be used to purchase.

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]

*Step 2
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed in the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see the outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d60159fcf8b2d7433a59a7058b579367a2ed71f4.gif[/img]

- Send the selected outfits to the Locker.
(***Note: Outfits sent to the Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fd70828de861951f7c5916340f129110e3c2c83c.gif[/img]
 
[Outfit Fusion]
- You can proceed to Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to use as
Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to Premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can vary depending on the Grade of the item used as the material,
and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability of winning a
higher Grade outfit.
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed.
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the outfit is fused.
- 'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the
fuse conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest-grade costumes are fused, and if the number of
materials registered is insufficient, the outfits are automatically excluded,
and the batch Fuse is carried out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d31850805b7cf0060913cf6b5390e74aa80ffaf1.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//8007791/8d434fcf38303cdb2eed29adde5248f18c2ef036.gif[/img]

1. Choose two outfits to be used as fusion materials.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and click the "Fusion!" button to obtain one
item randomly.
3. Easily locate outfits by grade and/or part using the filter at the top.
4. Fusion results will vary based on the grade of the items used as materials.
The higher the grade, the greater the chances of obtaining a higher-grade item.

*Step 2
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//8007791/08778a52aae1efb1eb5a595677810ce45882f9fa.gif[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once.
You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order, with the
highest-grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused or there aren't enough
to be used as material, it will automatically be excluded from fusion.
3. After fusing, you may choose to send all the outfits to your Locker room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc5b987b4944ad38839ba4c34561e69f546d9049.png[/img]

You won't be able to choose or unselect the Freestyle Ticket reward as it is
meant to be included as a default prize (pinned in rewards).
 
The odds or chances of receiving a reward are individually set, and a portion
of the selected probability is allocated as a Freestyle Ticket reward.
 
(The total chances for the selected rewards do not add up to 100%, and the
remaining probability of 100% is allocated to the Freestyle Ticket.)

Here's a guide on how to navigate to this event:
 
First, pick your desired items from the right. These are your choices, and
please note that each ball type has a limited number of items. It's best to think
carefully before placing these items.

Auto Selecting:

Now that you have finished picking your items, whether you chose

It's time to play the Gacha Machine. Good luck, ballers!

Form a team and be the best by defeating many of the great teams on each server!

[b]Tournament Information[/b]

- 2 normal tournaments will be open and running at the same time.

//Note:
Due to the summertime update, please be aware that Tournament schedules may experience delays in some countries.
Link to Notice: https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/18304

[b]Normal Tournament Schedule (Part 1):[/b]

[b]Normal Tournament Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fecc9ddd6d63cec1c30f576421299f5e4223332b.png[/img]

[b]Rules:[/b]
1. Coins will be obtained by characters.
2. The amount of the coins granted will be increased for bigger tournaments.
3. The displayed reward for playing and winning is the amount granted per match.
4. Amount of coins will be deducted accordingly in case of winning by default.
5. Obtained coins can be used to purchase various items at the Tournament Shop.

[b]Tournament Schedule[/b]

[i][u]Asia Super Tournament Schedule[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/797d9deda7b360f25980c8238ba8aedd8d84a8cc.jpg[/img]

[u][i]Asia Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8fae375e0e2a923bacf931e3b64395f8fe7179e2.jpg[/img]

[u][i]EU Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cb76c70e8ead545c3d3d619156dfb8e4f8eb0ec7.jpg[/img]

[u][i]NA Super Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b15f0b06a189cc73916c632503ce27cd55acd24c.jpg[/img]

[u][i]NA Crew Tournament Schedule[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/50e453b10900305863b5e9e02403deae9f614695.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Super Tournament Mechanics[/b][/u]
- Players can participate in other servers (Asia, EU, NA) regardless of the server focus time.

[b]Example:[/b]
[u][b]During Asia Server Focus Time Tournament[/b][/u]
- Players in the Asia Server that are participating in the event may earn the Special Rewards.
- Players playing on the other servers (NA or EU) will not be able to earn the Special Rewards.
- Coin Rewards will still be distributed regardless of server and tournament focus time.
- The player's location or country does not matter, only where the player is currently logged in the server.

[u][b]Participation Conditions[/b][/u]
 - Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
 - The tournament consists of 16 rounds, and a total of 48 players can take part.
 
[u][b]--Super Tournament Rewards--[/b][/u] 

[b]1. Coin Rewards[/b]

The tournament will be open to ALL Server Regions and can
earn Coin Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11a553b81db3385ae106faa150fbdbf02c5aeb0e.jpg[/img]

[b]2. Special Rewards[/b]

Players who are participating in the Tournament during the FOCUS TIME of each server are eligible to be rewarded with Special Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1c9a58bbe9a281690efe7165945824eace1a0541.gif[/img]

[i]*The personalized uniform reward for the winner will be distributed individually.
*The character name will be engraved on the back of the uniform.[/i]
 
[i][b]Outfit Preview:[/b][/i]

[b]Conqueror's Gown[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/452192bd7df423fbd44bfdedd9bca227a509b4b6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8ccf1c330e7b1270837ffb75d58e7e8a35979825.gif[/img]

Winner’s Personalized Uniform
[i](Lettering functions can be applied in this uniform.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f5cc01f146f9463e344ce5f6a1fa4b7c00feafe9.gif[/img]

[b]Exclusive Tournament Outfit[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7ec6aea26e7f42dbb72a840dcf9e45f45d4059a.gif[/img]

[b][i]*Lettering Outfit and Magic Pen added to Super League Tournament Rewards*[/i]

Lettering Outfit Preview (M/F)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/70d1a461739a292b2ebeadc45a5be26630751288.gif[/img]

[b]Additional Details about the Lettering Outfit[/b]

- You can obtain lettering outfits from the Tournament Shop
- You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
- When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free.
   Afterward, lettering items will be required to make changes.
- Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
- Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfits.

[b]a) Top: Jersey[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fae6e65be57848388f1e3a8dd4a7e1dcbb9a00e3.gif[/img]

[b]b) Bottom: Leggings Shorts, Regular Shorts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5d110ef344784ab942e864b865d537adffff3dba.gif[/img]

[i]* Before using the lettering function, the basic settings are as follows: Text: FS2,
  Color: White, Stroke: Black
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on the lettering function on unequippable outfits.[/i]

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ea377329d49ecfbd72f8f4fd8e5441538afb8acc.gif[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
[i]* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.[/i]

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
[i]* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.[/i]
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fef6c962994bc9f8def5546e19f4a1f5325a19c9.gif[/img]

[b]Important Notes:[/b]
- Rewards will be distributed after the event ends.
The schedule will be provided separately.

- Duplicate participation will be not be considered for multiple rewards.
If a player participates multiple times in the tournament, the player will be
rewarded with only the highest rewards they achieved during the tournament.
 
- Character selection coupons will be sent after the winning team is
determined, and participants can specify their desired characters through
separate 1:1 inquiries.
 
- Choose 1 reward (Premium Sub Att x100 or Character Coupon x1) and contact
our support team at steam_support@gamekiss.com

[b]Premium Character Reward List:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0338d5b0c16778f09d3e4432d9242a75b261590b.gif[/img]

- In case of match failure or disconnection due to PC/network issues,
it will be considered as a loss.
 
- If a system error occurs during the finals, the match may be held again
at a later time.
 
- Any other issues that arise will be addressed promptly, and any changes
or updates will be communicated through notices.

[b]--Crew Tournament Mechanics--[/b]

- Participation is limited to 3 individuals from the same crew.
- A maximum of 2 teams can enter one Crew Tournament.
- There is only one tournament open, consisting of 16 rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a7c889c25a9b9516b9f2b0f9803caf2f84316112.gif[/img]

1. The Button for [Crew Tournament Open] will be visible on the main screen of the Crew.
2. Upon opening the tournament, a room is generated automatically.
- Throughout the event, a single round takes place in a room.
3. Recruit fellow players and assemble a team.
- In the waiting area, all three members from the same crew team must be present, 
and only the room leader has the authority to apply for participation.
4. If all team members, except the room leader, consent to participating within 10 seconds,  participation is confirmed in the order it was received.
5. All teams participating will compete simultaneously.
6. The games persist until the Crew Tournament concludes, iterating through game progress, game completion, and round completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b5dbe1ef85cf11f76878f1694e53e488df6b8b1.gif[/img]

- Leaving the crew, deleting a character, or dissolving a crew does not erase ranking record data.
- Within the Ranking page, a Crew tab has been introduced in the Tournament section.
- In the Crew Ranking page, a Tournament Ranking tab is now available.
(Rankings are determined by aggregating the TP Points earned by each crew.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2c1a2cbea1322324de15bcbab1a4071f2385eb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/79d53ea0f95d67cab275a6df4f24f1c22ff35388.gif[/img]

the Crew Tournament.

[b]a) Requirement:[/b]
After the conclusion of the Crew Tournament, the ranking is updated,
and the insignia of the first-place crew is showcased.

Channel: FS Channel

[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/72b87702fee1e59de37f4847054e42fec36dda44.png[/img]

You can use the lettering feature to specify text and color.
When setting lettering for the first time, it's free, but for subsequent lettering changes, you'll need to consume lettering items.
Lettering outfits have unique marks for identification.
You cannot set duplicate lettering for different lettering outfits (case-insensitive for alphabets).
Magic Pens can be obtained from the Tournament Shop.

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02378adaa40e26131033dd70c782f869ccd3a21.png[/img]

- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can
have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]
Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

notes.title: Devil's Tower
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24f16ef4874a0be57e888270e4775678475dccf7.png[/img]

Here comes the Devil's Tower!

There are specific requirements for this event but there's no need to worry.

To participate, make sure to follow the guide and instructions that we'll
be preparing below.

What's important is that you'll be able to obtain rewards from each level,
and there's a chance to reach the highest level as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ca78fa53095943d5f76614956d03dfdf1d8df732.gif[/img]

2023/12/06 00:00 ~ 12/19 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f088d583cca5e78a5bddae11c4f60bbfb629cf57.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d298d43d2790d467132d6f3512ebebbe4b30f710.gif[/img]

1. Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c589812a22365cd4a9acf1465eade2bb8eacee55.gif[/img]

2. Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
3. Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
 - You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
 - Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.
4. Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
5. Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
6. Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the remaining rewards.
7. If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
8. From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability. (Same items may be obtained again).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b335c2cd31987cb604931a13e5412ba4e0af9960.gif[/img]
1. Devil'sTower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
2. You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
3. If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change settings
so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the event.
4. Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8c4af5f30ef2a18ef6bf8888cdcf238fa3aad486.gif[/img]
Step 1: Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower. 
Step 2: Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from
each level.
Step 3: You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
Step 4: Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1a1714076e40da965f610fb49b617a9921ee54e8.gif[/img]
- Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
- Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
- Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b472f8eba0498178be9b2dd6cdf371e7acbc9ad.gif[/img]
- Obtained rewards can be sent to the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack)
or Gift Box directly.
- You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

[Devil’s Tower Event Reward Distribution Settings Screen]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/51cc003010f46244495cb947fdae6f6878aeaadf.gif[/img]

Obtaining through Backpack	
- Up to 8 obtained items will be displayed in the Adventurer’s Inventory
(backpack).	
- You can select a character and “send items to inventory”.	
- If the rewards are left unclaimed until the event ends, the items will be sent
to the gift box.	
	
[Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Storing in Backpack]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e46b47c1f4ecf0f72bc48f4fb3ee0fdd9c7e0d99.gif[/img]

[Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Item Distribution Screen]	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1049d55e3c515f4799c2c3e6fe88f0af70031b87.gif[/img]
	
Distribution to Gift Box	
- Obtain items will be sent to the gift box immediately.	
- You can view up to 8 items obtained through the Adventurer’s Inventory.	

[Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Sending to Gift Box]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/84d08e5d47f32f930d302089c24abbc3c623979d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f3fd93b656aa14dbc8b41c365856d73637295a64.gif[/img]

- Up to 5 rewards are placed on each level, and you can randomly
obtain one of them.	
- After you receive the reward on the final level, you will go back to the first
level and play again.	
- After you have claimed all 5 rewards on the final level, “level 0” will be unlocked
where you can randomly obtain one of the rewards placed there.	
- The Card Option Changer item obtainable through the Devil’s Tower event allows
you to change the sub attributes of the Allstar Cards (offense/defense).	
	
> When you reach the final level, you will return to level 1 and play again.	
> Rewards you obtain on the final level cannot be obtained again. 	
> Once you have obtained all rewards on the final level, you will randomly obtain
one of the rewards from level 0.

notes.title: Freestyle 2nd System Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/94bc09ad85e8e758761d4fb7b074281084ccff93.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

We want to let everyone know that we've made significant changes in the
hopes of making Freestyle2's overall functionality much more accurate,
as well as balancing other game aspects. We also want to share the most
recent information we have about the system improvements that we've
made specifically for the user interface of Freestyle.
 
We hope that these changes will make reading/viewing more convenient
for our beloved ballers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d94753a88e52e1a18a068a129c9eff86c6a5d214.gif[/img]

[b]I. Updated main window of Freestyle[/b]
[i]Before[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11fe0fe89c1777e6e57e81d359e654719151a2bd.png[/img]

[i]New version[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7ba5e0dd0772ad751753eb4b1f9d75692decd31a.png[/img]

We've added an 'UP' tag and it will serve as a reminder to users which Freestyles
are currently upgradable. The UP indicator will only occur when you have
sufficient Freestyles for upgrades.

[b]II. New pop-up reminders for levelling up Freestyles[/b]
[i]Freestyle Level Up[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/83abd9e942b76ffdc67d4282da030dbe4af3c826.png[/img]

[i]Quick Level Up[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7ede5b962871a1e3efd95d223693ff09fdee8852.png[/img]

Those two pop-up messages will occur if you attempted to level up your freestyle
without sufficient resources.

[b]III. Updated Help Window[/b]
[i]Freestyle Level Up Help Section[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bf9b9a9c1d9644c34892f5472a61dd216e187f41.png[/img]

1. Among owned Freestyles, the "Freestyle Level Up" button will be activated for
    those with an "Up" mark.
2. Clicking the FreeStyle Level Up button will open a separate Freestyle Level Up
    pop-up.
3. You can adjust the number of level-ups based on the number of low Freestyles
    you own.
4. The resources needed will change based on the number of level-ups and will be
    displayed in the pop-up.
5. However, if you do not have enough resources, the deficient amount will be
    displayed in red, and you will be unable to proceed with the chosen number
    of level-ups.

[i]Quick Level Up Help Section[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e27d68018b970fe47b316731dc7727b9cc210f92.png[/img]

1. Among unowned Freestyles, you can Quick Level Up those with a border or
    marked with a red dot.
2. Quick Level Up is a system that allows you to obtain unowned Freestyles by
    using low Freestyles.
3. Clicking the Quick Level Up button will open a separate pop-up.
4. The amount of resources needed will be displayed in the pop-up.
5. However, if you do not have enough resources, the deficient amount will be
    displayed in red, and you will be unable to proceed with Quick Level Up.

[i]Change Set Options Section[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ae37a328eea2ff8f90be66915b6a147ce256c646.png[/img]

1. Set Option Change is a feature that allows you to change the existing set
    options on a 5? Freestyle by using Freestyle Training Tickets.
2. Clicking on the Set Change button will open a pop-up related to set option
    changes.
3. You need 10 Freestyle Training Tickets to change set options, and the button
    will not activate if you do not have enough tickets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/60d4feaebc13af65ffc36cb361f19abb3af0f430.gif[/img]

the enigmatic "Forgotten" race, a rare hybrid of angelic and demonic heritage.
As an orphaned girl with extraordinary potential, Eugenie's powers remain dormant,
waiting to be unlocked.

What sets Eugenie apart is her emotional blindness, a unique condition that
renders her unable to express her feelings. Undeterred by this challenge,
she has set her sights on the Freestyle 2 competition, prepared to face any
obstacles that come her way. The question that looms is whether Eugenie will
succeed in awakening her full potential,. The answer, it seems, lies in her journey,
and it's a journey that only she can determine. Her destiny is in her hands, and
the world of Freestyle 2 awaits therevelation of her true power.

notes.content:

Get the outfit you want using the power of glass beads!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
11/22/2023 00:00 ~ 12/05/2023 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0e6aa27c19a3aea27d53a135316c33319d36d3d.gif[/img]

[b]Event Details: [/b]
 
** If you purchase 500 "Mystery Scrolls" you can obtain one of the following rewards below:
- Mysterious Complete Card Glass Bead x 1
- PVC Techwear Package x 1
- Sensitive Intuition (15 Days) x 1
 
** it will send to gift box
 
[b][Draw Outfit][/b]
-  You can obtain Normal Grade ~ Rare Grade outfits through the draw.
- Click the “Check Outfit Warehouse” button to see which outfits you’ve
obtained!
- Outfit through Outfit Fusion and Item (except the outfit obtain through draw)
will sent to gift box
 
** At the end of the event, all outfit items in the Outfit Warehouse will be
moved to the gift box automatically
 
[b]* Step 1[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9920789404da8d712d1c094eb453cb347093e2f3.png[/img]

1. Purchase Mystery Scrolls using the "Purchase" button and draw x1/x5 times(s).

[b]Mystery Scroll[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7fe6a07a6c44a141555ad4e5670edb3cf8f8a441.gif[/img]

2. You can obtain random Normal/Magic Grade outfits through the draw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ccdc325f6ac769ac2a68ce4d213b4f5bfa177321.png[/img]

[b]*Step 2[/b]
 
1. Outfits obtained from the draw can be viewed at the Outfit Warehouse.
2. Click the "Check Outfit Warehouse" button to see which outfits you've obtained!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d60159fcf8b2d7433a59a7058b579367a2ed71f4.gif[/img]

- Send selected outfits in the Locker.
(***Note: Outfits sent to Locker cannot be fused.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fd70828de861951f7c5916340f129110e3c2c83c.gif[/img]

[b][Outfit Fusion][/b]
- You can proceed Fuse by selecting two outfits that you want to
use as Fusion materials.
- You can obtain a Normal to premium Grade outfit through Outfit Fuse.
- The results can be different depend on the Grade of the item used as
the material, and the higher the Grade of the Outfit, the higher the probability
of winning a higher Grade outfit
- During batch Fuse, the expected range of Fuse is not exposed
- Material items used as Fusion materials will be deleted after the
outfit is fusion.
-'Fuse ALL' allows you to fuse up to 100 outfit items that meet the fuse
conditions you have at once.
- During "fuse all", the highest grade costumes are fuse, and if the number of
materials registered is insufficient, the outfit are automatically excluded
and the batch Fuse is
carried out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d31850805b7cf0060913cf6b5390e74aa80ffaf1.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//8007791/8d434fcf38303cdb2eed29adde5248f18c2ef036.gif[/img]

1. Select 2 obtained outfits to use as Fusion material.
2. Use Mysterious Glass Beads and press the "Fusion!" button to obtain one outfit
at a random possibility.
3. You can use the filter at the top to easily locate outfits by grade and/or part.
4. The results of Fusion will vary depending on the grade at the items used as
material. The higher the grade of the item, the higher the chances of drawing a
higher grade outfit.

[b]*Step 2[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//8007791/08778a52aae1efb1eb5a595677810ce45882f9fa.gif[/img]

1. Try using the "Fuse All" button to easily fuse multiple items at once.
You can fuse 100 outfits from the ones you have.
2. Using the "Fuse All" button will fuse outfits in descending order, with the highest
grade outfits fusing first. If an item cannot be fused or there aren't enough to be
used as material, it will automatically be excluded from fusion.
3. After fusing, You may choose to send all the outfits into your Locker room.

notes.title: November Super Tournament and Crew Tournament Schedule
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8007791/171469fdca78ec8908fdc127c7b04d9c4b1839f7.png[/img]

Welcome to our Freestyle 2 November 2023 Tournament Update!

Form a team and be the best by defeating many of the great teams
on each server!

Both the Super Tournament and Crew Tournament will be
held three (3) times on November 25, 2023 (PST).

Check out the schedule below.

[b]--[u]Tournament Schedule[/u]--[/b]

[b]Asia Super Tournament Schedule:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f73c19ff67ca40904cfcd4292386481008840d81.jpg[/img]

[b]Asia Crew Tournament Schedule:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8bfc69347e624d566f8ed114c815b649d84a1e1e.jpg[/img]

[b]EU Super Tournament Schedule:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8c7812e456bf0f588290c6a5df5750959f80c991.jpg[/img]

[b]EU Crew Tournament Schedule:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b6c7dc0d936a1057bc04830107eecfb54acc3034.jpg[/img]

[b]NA Super Tournament Schedule:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0c46baa029b948389a212dc398786594d79c4563.jpg[/img]

[b]NA Crew Tournament Schedule:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f33e95a3433be554c359b280a8d73d7de9aa1e1a.jpg[/img]

[b]--[u]Super Tournament Mechanics[/u]--[/b]

- Players can participate in other servers (Asia, EU, NA) regardless of the 
server focus time.

Example:
During Asia Server Focus Time Tournament
- Players in the Asia Server that are participating in the event may earn the
Special Rewards.
- Players playing on the other servers (NA or EU) will not be able to earn the
Special Rewards.
- Coin Rewards will still be distributed regardless of server and tournament
focus time.
- The player's location or country does not matter, only where the player is 
currently logged in the server.

Participation Conditions
 - Bronze rank or above in the Ranked Game
 - The tournament consists of a 16 rounds, and a total of 48 players can take part.
 
[b]--[u]Super Tournament Rewards[/u]--[/b]
 
1. Coin Rewards
 
The tournament will be open to ALL Server Regions and can
earn Coin Rewards.

notes.title: Sweet Love Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/678b1261b19d6139da332c690167d48f5979443a.png[/img]

While February may have come and gone, the opportunity to express your love
to those who hold a special place in your heart is always open!

What could be a more heartwarming way to convey your affection than
through a timeless and classic love letter? In this event, you have the chance
to present Love Letters to the character of your choice, earning not only rewards
but even more importantly, their affection and love!

Event Period:
2023/11/08 00:00 ~ 11/22 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a645551c5de097254da0a25d9aacdbf1ffd5bd54.gif[/img]

Choose a character to give a Love Letter! Regular Love Letter can
 
be acquired by playing regular matches everyday up to a maximum of 10.

Hot Love Letter is available for purchase using Freestyle tickets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eb7d4370e388c642189e67b37e4dce5650d36388.png[/img]

You can give out 2 different Love Letters! Regular Love Letters and Hot Love
