notes.title: Devil's Tower
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24f16ef4874a0be57e888270e4775678475dccf7.png[/img]

Here comes the Devil's Tower!

There are specific requirements for this event but there's no need to worry.

To participate, make sure to follow the guide and instructions that we'll
be preparing below.

What's important is that you'll be able to obtain rewards from each level,
and there's a chance to reach the highest level as well.

[b]Event Duration:[/b]

2023/11/01 00:00 (PDT) ~ 11/21 22:59 (PST)

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]

[b]Devil's Tower Help[/b]

1. Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/856ff136145f3649e7831acb1c7e79fa1222d167.gif[/img]

2. Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
3. Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
 - You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
 - Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.
4. Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
5. Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
6. Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the remaining rewards.
7. If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
8. From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability. (Same items may be obtained again).

[b]Devil's Tower Inventory Help[/b]
1. Devil'sTower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
2. You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
3. If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change settings
so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the event.
4. Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

[b]How to participate in Devil's Tower:[/b]
Step 1: Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower. 
Step 2: Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from
each level.
Step 3: You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
Step 4: Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

[b]Bonus Steps  [/b]
- Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
- Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
- Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.

[b]Event Reward Distribution Notice [/b]
- Obtained rewards can be sent to the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack)
or Gift Box directly.
- You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

[b][Devil’s Tower Event Reward Distribution Settings Screen][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/51cc003010f46244495cb947fdae6f6878aeaadf.gif[/img]

[b]Obtaining through Backpack[/b]
- Up to 8 obtained items will be displayed in the Adventurer’s Inventory
(backpack).	
- You can select a character and “send items to inventory”.	
- If the rewards are left unclaimed until the event ends, the items will be sent
to the gift box.	
	
[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Storing in Backpack][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26ce430cd98436722b68723b6a9da0e95ee4932b.gif[/img]

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Item Distribution Screen]	[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/177734596ff7a51a445edfe8757464b209aa90ad.gif[/img]
	
[b]Distribution to Gift Box[/b]
- Obtain items will be sent to the gift box immediately.	
- You can view up to 8 items obtained through the Adventurer’s Inventory.	

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Sending to Gift Box][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/20287e490b60d1ba6b6cb3329a0da6b14aba9d42.gif[/img]

[b]Devil’s Tower Reward by Level[/b]
- Up to 5 rewards are placed on each level, and you can randomly
obtain one of them.	
- After you receive the reward on the final level, you will go back to the first
level and play again.	
- After you have claimed all 5 rewards on the final level, “level 0” will be unlocked
where you can randomly obtain one of the rewards placed there.	
- The Card Option Changer item obtainable through the Devil’s Tower event allows
you to change the sub attributes of the Allstar Cards (offense/defense).	
	
> When you reach the final level, you will return to level 1 and play again.	
> Rewards you obtain on the final level cannot be obtained again. 	
> Once you have obtained all rewards on the final level, you will randomly obtain
one of the rewards from level 0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/30a1e9793173404ec773a1993eabdb5f8e653db6.gif[/img]

Click the link below for more information about Card Option Changer:

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/de3261458e5f80ec618c5a1d42e6c52d3665de7d.png[/img]

Crew Tournament mode has been updated with improvements to the crew system.
 
Participate in the tournament with your crew members and enjoy exciting matches!

Note:
- Participation is limited to 3 individuals from the same crew.
- A maximum of 2 teams can enter one Crew Tournament.
- There is only one tournament open, consisting of 16 rounds.

[b]Crew Tournament Schedule:[/b]
10/27/2023 06:00 ~~

To know more about the tournament schedule, please check the link below:

[b][Crew Tournament Schedule Post][/b]
[url=https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/event/18252]https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/event/18252[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a7c889c25a9b9516b9f2b0f9803caf2f84316112.gif[/img]

1. The Button for [Crew Tournament Open] will be visible on the main screen of the Crew.
2. Upon opening the tournament, a room is generated automatically.
- Throughout the event, a single round takes place in a room.
3. Recruit fellow players and assemble a team.
- In the waiting area, all three members from the same crew team must be present, 
and only the room leader has the authority to apply for participation.
4. If all team members, except the room leader, consent to participating within 10 seconds,  participation is confirmed in the order it was received.
5. All teams participating will compete simultaneously.
6. The games persist until the Crew Tournament concludes, iterating through game progress, game completion, and round completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1b5dbe1ef85cf11f76878f1694e53e488df6b8b1.gif[/img]

- Leaving the crew, deleting a character, or dissolving a crew does not erase ranking record data.
- Within the Ranking page, a Crew tab has been introduced in the Tournament section.
- In the Crew Ranking page, a Tournament Ranking tab is now available.
(Rankings are determined by aggregating the TP Points earned by each crew.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b2c1a2cbea1322324de15bcbab1a4071f2385eb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/79d53ea0f95d67cab275a6df4f24f1c22ff35388.gif[/img]

On the lobby screen, you can view the details of the winning team from
the Crew Tournament.

[b]a) Requirement:[/b]
After the conclusion of the Crew Tournament, the ranking is updated,
and the insignia of the first-place crew is showcased.
(In typical tournaments, the Crew Tournament airships are exhibited at random.)

Channel: FS Channel
Details: The crew emblem and name are visible for viewing.

[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/72b87702fee1e59de37f4847054e42fec36dda44.png[/img]

You can use the lettering feature to specify text and color.
When setting lettering for the first time, it's free, but for subsequent lettering changes, you'll need to consume lettering items.
Lettering outfits have unique marks for identification.
You cannot set duplicate lettering for different lettering outfits (case-insensitive for alphabets).
Magic Pens can be obtained from the Tournament Shop.

[b]Lettering Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d02378adaa40e26131033dd70c782f869ccd3a21.png[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can
have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]
Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.

[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bf18b206dc674f90e06237d31c3a9fa0a28a4f17.gif[/img]


[b]- Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.title: October Crew Tournament Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9bb03ac9d263fa6b184d6253ed2ed5513ac1f182.png[/img]

Get ready for an epic showdown on the court!

It's time for our Crew Tournament Basketball, where teams battle it out on
the court for glory. Let's cheer on our talented crews as they shoot for victory
and showcase their skills in this high-energy tournament!

[b]Tournament Date:[/b] October 27, 2023

[b]Mechanics:[/b]
- The tournament will be conducted as a one-time event in a 16-team
knockout format.
- Three members from the same crew can participate together.
- Up to 2 teams from the same crew can participate in a single match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/885480047d161c94c77f7c2049bdafd514cec3f9.png[/img]

[b]Rewards:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f812ec84d98efc00a49ca1699c9137f54eaa4267.png[/img]

You can use the lettering feature to specify text and color.
When setting lettering for the first time, it's free, but for subsequent lettering
changes, you'll need to consume lettering items.
Lettering outfits have unique marks for identification.
You cannot set duplicate lettering for different lettering outfits
(case-insensitive for alphabets).
Magic Pens can be obtained from the Tournament Shop.

[b]Lettering Item[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ea377329d49ecfbd72f8f4fd8e5441538afb8acc.gif[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can
have up to 999,999,999.

How to Apply Lettering
Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.

1. Lettering Settings
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
2. Color Settings
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
3. Lettering Trial
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d5f6d0d309921dab39f8101e15d008f28205ce04.gif[/img]

[b]- Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.title: Team The Forgotten: Eugenie Arrival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6596f4f1f1d8fff13ae661a323aa0dd0d72d3290.png[/img]

A dynamic newcomer has graced the court – none other than Eugenie.
While beauty may be a matter of perspective, Eugenie's captivating presence
is universally acknowledged. With her stylish short hair and eyes that sparkle
with a vibrantspectrum of colors, her charm is truly magnetic.
 
"A striking blue tattoo gracing my chest stands as a testament to the intensity of
my passion, leaving a lasting impression on those who encounter me."
 
- Eugenie

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/60d4feaebc13af65ffc36cb361f19abb3af0f430.gif[/img]

Meet Eugenie, a fascinating character in the world of Freestyle 2, who hails from
the enigmatic "Forgotten" race, a rare hybrid of angelic and demonic heritage.
As an orphaned girl with extraordinary potential, Eugenie's powers remain dormant,
waiting to be unlocked.

What sets Eugenie apart is her emotional blindness, a unique condition that
renders her unable to express her feelings. Undeterred by this challenge,
she has set her sights on the Freestyle 2 competition, prepared to face any
obstacles that come her way. The question that looms is whether Eugenie will
succeed in awakening her full potential,. The answer, it seems, lies in her journey,
and it's a journey that only she can determine. Her destiny is in her hands, and
the world of Freestyle 2 awaits therevelation of her true power.

notes.title: Character Collection System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ba3a48fdd15116437f3138c11a268f23ce9221b8.png[/img]

- Introduction to Collection -

1. A place where you can see obtained characters, outfits, Freestyles, and other collected items within the game.
2. You can obtain item rewards/Attribute enhancement effects by collecting items (characters).
3. There are two types of Collections: Basic and Special.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1980b0b67058f376dee19b6d064cf26685a9c1a4.gif[/img]

- Basic Collection - 

1. Items (characters) will be automatically collected when you obtain them in-game.
2. When you obtain an item (character), all Collection Lists containing that item (character) will be unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f4f882cb13992845ad90589f792d448cd2a156c1.png[/img]

3. You will receive a certain reward if you obtain all the items (characters) on the paricular group list.
4. Obtained rewards will be moved to your Locker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7eb407963720efd6c4115af0c5400b68dc187587.gif[/img]

You can obtain these newly added items as rewards for completing a particular team from the Basic Collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1a0a21e8d7d8da4f5e778be985e9c0ea7fe8d2b0.png[/img]

- Special Collection -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9b3407bf5f0a84d30741b78649de5b96eb5b4282.png[/img]

**Note: Only whole numbers are applied to the actual attribute.

1. This collection is for collecting Character Symbols.
2. You can obtain Character Symbols from the Character Draw, Crystal Shop, and other various events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7457040760de6f4bd90b5d498f15147654dc5b5a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4cfc2185c4627fc571ffc76d8db98d2c507f29f.gif[/img]

4. The "+" button used to add to the Special Collection will appear when you obtain the Character Symbol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c3225d81b1b158bdd9d3763d1ba4e79f5927a3ca.gif[/img]

6. When you add the Symbols for all the characters on the Special Collection list, the Attribute effects for completing that collection will be activated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f62e449258fa23330b15e6552ee784a8aeca38b1.gif[/img]

7. Attribute effects are applied to all characters within the account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f738d0a15db4856cd5d4c9810e0bd59c01248d18.gif[/img]

This is where your Basic and Special Collections are reflected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1df35aa172b3da98dc35f7a041ea398cd8e03f91.gif[/img]

September Improvements:
https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/event/18187

notes.title: Devil's Tower
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24f16ef4874a0be57e888270e4775678475dccf7.png[/img]

Here comes the Devil's Tower!

There are specific requirements for this event but there's no need to worry.

To participate, make sure to follow the guide and instructions that we'll
be preparing below.

What's important is that you'll be able to obtain rewards from each level,
and there's a chance to reach the highest level as well.

[b]Event Duration:[/b]

2023/09/06 00:00 ~ 09/24 23:59 (PDT)

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]

[b]Devil's Tower Help[/b]

1. Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/856ff136145f3649e7831acb1c7e79fa1222d167.gif[/img]

2. Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
3. Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
 - You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
 - Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.
4. Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
5. Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
6. Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the remaining rewards.
7. If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
8. From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability. (Same items may be obtained again).

[b]Devil's Tower Inventory Help[/b]
1. Devil'sTower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
2. You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
3. If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change settings
so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the event.
4. Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

[b]How to participate in Devil's Tower:[/b]
Step 1: Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower. 
Step 2: Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from
each level.
Step 3: You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
Step 4: Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

[b]Bonus Steps  [/b]
- Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
- Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
- Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.

[b]Event Reward Distribution Notice [/b]
- Obtained rewards can be sent to the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack)
or Gift Box directly.
- You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

[b][Devil’s Tower Event Reward Distribution Settings Screen][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/51cc003010f46244495cb947fdae6f6878aeaadf.gif[/img]

[b]Obtaining through Backpack[/b]
- Up to 8 obtained items will be displayed in the Adventurer’s Inventory
(backpack).	
- You can select a character and “send items to inventory”.	
- If the rewards are left unclaimed until the event ends, the items will be sent
to the gift box.	
	
[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Storing in Backpack][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8d6f0283361e72a24dd01132cfdf763b3a297a9d.gif[/img]

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Item Distribution Screen]	[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/029457b37e08df4f6a68a1e170184914c691c32e.gif[/img]
	
[b]Distribution to Gift Box[/b]
- Obtain items will be sent to the gift box immediately.	
- You can view up to 8 items obtained through the Adventurer’s Inventory.	

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Sending to Gift Box][/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9cde748cdf736f480434a1551e86c5ccb204ed5e.gif[/img]

[b]Devil’s Tower Reward by Level[/b]
- Up to 5 rewards are placed on each level, and you can randomly
obtain one of them.	
- After you receive the reward on the final level, you will go back to the first
level and play again.	
- After you have claimed all 5 rewards on the final level, “level 0” will be unlocked
where you can randomly obtain one of the rewards placed there.	
- The Card Option Changer item obtainable through the Devil’s Tower event allows
you to change the sub attributes of the Allstar Cards (offense/defense).	
	
> When you reach the final level, you will return to level 1 and play again.	
> Rewards you obtain on the final level cannot be obtained again. 	
> Once you have obtained all rewards on the final level, you will randomly obtain
one of the rewards from level 0.

notes.title: Hidden Outfit Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18034ca7569bcce5866decf447c115d2596937fa.png[/img]

[Hidden Outfit]
	
1. A Hidden Outfit is a special outfit that activates unique effects when you wear
all the designated outfits as Hidden Outfits.		

2. Wearing all Hidden Outfits and participating in a match will activate a special
effect. The effect will reset at the end of the match.	

3. Outfits that do not match your gender cannot be worn.
You can check them in the locker.		

- This special outfit has an ‘evolution’ effect where the appearance changes
when you wear all Hidden Outfits and participate in a match.	

- After the match starts, the outfit evolves every 30 seconds progressing
through a total of 3 evolution stages.	

- The outfit will no longer change once the 3rd evolution stage is reached
and will change back to the 1st stage outfit when the match ends.	

- The outfit evolution only occurs during a ‘turnover’ where the offense and
defense switch and it progresses automatically without any manual
intervention.			

*** For characters with transformations, the evolution process will begin with the next ‘turnover’
after their transformation has ended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/734c382b47a3c7fd8e1c94a96423205f37f077d5.gif[/img]

[Set Outfit Evolution Activation Condition]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/426a396aebbcfb4f09812133f52d21bd8d2f665b.png[/img]

4) Exceptions
(a) a transformed character
- Time elapses even in transformation.
- The costume evolution will not proceed when the transformation is carried out,
and the costume evolution will proceed when the transformation is released.
 
(b) Switching characters
- When creating a character, only the selected main character can be changed.
 
*** Hidden outfit – cannot equip back accessories ***

- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: FREE2 LAND
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/61948776d08e22b22f0ccd5d8a33b152c232a5dd.png[/img]

Greetings! Welcome to FREE2LAND! 

We have prepared various events in our FREE2LAND!

Complete quests to acquire coins that you can use to exchange for rare items!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
08/09 00:00 ~ 09/05 23:59 PDT 
 
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure to hit the "receive" button to acquire the coins after completing
the mission! Just by logging in and playing several matches, you will
automatically be part of the event! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d59b6b8990b78e840790313bacc8c27feb74da36.gif[/img]

Accumulated number of matches played & Login time Event has a corresponding
coin rewards!

[b]Guess the last Digit mission[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f25e1a43f51cb753f079a61ec431456efc62f984.gif[/img]

Guess your opponent's last score digit by clicking a specific number on the
selection provided. For non-VIP players, you can only choose 1 number and
3 for VIP members. Don't forget to hit "Save".

Coin rewards for prediction: 10 Coins for successful prediction and 1 Coin
for failed prediction.

The maximum number of coins that a player can acquire per day is 100.

Predictions will remain the same throughout the event unless you
decided to change it.

You can exchange coins for various consumables! Just visit the Event Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e5ab4ec3c0a6416d1148d102b9297d54a727f1f5.gif[/img]

[b]Ferris Wheel Event[/b] is back! Login and Play to get stamps to claim
the reward for the day!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a70c65bc24d01e8f78e69f752b5581a57c237952.gif[/img]

[b]Unlock Event: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a5ccd0e0d790e4550d0c06886f1cdf9d4993b2b0.gif[/img]

For every team/individual match you finish or every hour you stay logged in,
you will earn Box Keys.

10 Keys for every match (Maximum 10 Games per day) = 100
20 Keys for every hour logged in (Maximum of 5 hours per day) = 100 

Total of Box Keys that can be acquired per day: 200

- Box Keys can be used to Open or Upgrade the Box
- Each Box has a corresponding reward and you can get one of the
items listed randomly.

** Once you have chosen a specific box, the box level will reset to the
lowest Box Grade.

** You won't be able to claim any rewards after the event period so
make sure to spend Box Keys on time!

Wait, there's more! If you have collected a huge amount of FS2 Coins,
you may also use it to redeem S+ Rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/29f1fd1b2d20ee4bd55c2ff944a6f3a47066e6de.gif[/img]

Don't forget to check your Mission Progress to make sure that you have
received all FS2 Coins for the day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cb5905e6351b05ee7dd68b144bba6c0fe37db4f3.gif[/img]

- FreeStyle 2 Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4485a3664029d1cbf330095f320d13f9734afb8.png[/img]

[b]Lettering Outfit and Magic Pen added to Basketball League[/b]

[b]Lettering Outfit (M/F)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1188398e333b78ced94fdcb811bffcef0c168a81.png[/img]

[b]Additional Details about the Lettering Outfit[/b]

- You can obtain lettering outfits from the Tournament Shop
- You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
- When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free. Afterward, lettering items will be required to make changes.
- Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
- Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfits.

[b]a) Top: Jersey[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1adb06db6ab7165054dbb186d5311a3684b3110b.gif[/img]

[b]b) Bottom: Leggings Shorts, Regular Shorts[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/66ccc9303344654a1f45633ca067487736a73843.gif[/img]

[i]* Before using the lettering function, the basic settings are as follows: Text: FS2,
  Color: White, Stroke: Black
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on the lettering function on unequippable outfits.[/i]
 
[b]Lettering Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8197e35dbfdca95342e76d78bdcab8ddc60c29b8.gif[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 999,999,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
[i]* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.[/i]
 
[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for
   lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
[i]* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.[/i]
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover the mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.

Mega Pass is back for its 31st season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
 
2023/08/02 00:00 ~ 09/26 23:59 (PDT)
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f3d2a06e3da0aa644289e7dc558274d588569c48.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able
to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward
the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c3d2aa3559d72c3b6df8248f102bfd76e7b8d43.gif[/img]

Revamped Mega Pass:
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
 
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
 
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
[b]Note:[/b] Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2fbeff64fe6fdc208da1ed186e5b6934a4e5e174.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
[b]How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?[/b]

Daily, Weekly, Season STEP rewards that can be obtained from the Draft can only
be received by the character that has participated the Draft.

Thrift Shop is now open! New outfits to choose from, check them out now!
 
What is FS2 Thrift Shop?
 
The FS2 Thrift Shop is an all new customizable Capsule. 

You now can choose any two main prizes you wish to win from the Thrift Shop.
When you draw, you will have a chance to win one of the two main and
three sub prizes.
 
There is also a Rank Reward for customers that use the Thrift Shop the most.
The number of draws you have made will be counted and ranked. The ballers
with the most Draws will win another prize according to what Rank they have
reached.
 
** The Ranks will be recorded for one week. Prizes will be sent to the winners
during the weekly maintenance and the Ranks 
will be reset. **
 
** The Rank Reward will be given during the next weeks maintenance which 
is 5/02 and 5/09 **

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bd52c7787f24aa47a51f3bb61cd24400f932a9b3.png[/img]

Here comes the 2023 Summer Camp! Many tasks have been created for this
summer camp. Through training, players will be able to earn useful rewards.
To get the most out of this summer camp, be sure to keep track of your
training progress.

Event Period: 2023/07/12 - 2023/08/08

We also want to inform everyone that we've prepared a table showcasing
the participation rewards for the 2023 Summer Camp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1ca810b1aa3bcd67615011bfde708436430f2ed5.png[/img]

Please also read the important reminders for the 2023 Summer Camp
which we've listed below.

-> You can play once per day. (Resets daily at 00:00)
-> Each training is considered 100% complete after successfully completing
     it 25 times.
-> There is no limit to the number of attempts in the mini-game challenge
     until you succeed.
-> Daily attempts do not carry over to the next day.
-> Rewards will be delivered to your gift box.

Preview of 2023 Summer Camp

training guide for each drill so everyone will be guided accordingly. Please refer
to the following images.

Don't forget to check the training plans section. To get your preferred rewards,
make sure to view all the tabs in this window.

[u][b]IV. FS2 Lucky Instant Lottery[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cc0a0700277b2b98b6ec3493f2535bc23861317e.gif[/img]

Get your desired items by exchanging lottery tickets here. It's also worth noting
that there's a daily reset timer to restock, so check it from time to time.

It's important to be aware of the event mechanics of FS2 Lucky Instant Lottery.
Kindly read the following information so you'll be guided accordingly.

Step 1. The quantity of items that can be obtained per day is limited.
Step 2. Daily lottery tickets will be given upon completing regular matches.
Step 3. If you win a lottery, you can exchange it for prizes at the Exchange Center.
 
-> You can obtain 1 lucky lottery ticket per BZ/Regular channel match.
(Up to 5 tickets per day per account can be obtained.)
 
-> You cannot receive a lottery ticket if you surrender within 10 seconds after
     the match starts.
 
-> No lottery tickets will be given during the product restocking time (23:30-24:00).
 
-> The winning lottery tickets will be provided as exchange ticket, which can be
    exchanged for rewards on the Exchange Page.

Item exchange is only possible until 23:30 on the same day.
 
-> Unclaimed lottery tickets and unredeemed exchange vouchers will expire
     starting at 23:30 on the same day.
 
-> The prize list and exchange count will be reset daily at 00:00.

[b]V. Comprehensive Evaluation[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2a74f55d799bda23f645b150daa6486b17dfe76e.gif[/img]

character. This is also the place where you can receive the training result
reward as seen on the image above.

notes.title: Attribute Transfer System
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1jQXWPd.png[/img]



Power Disk is a consumable item used for transferring attributes from one outfit to another.



Purchase the Power Disk via the Shop - ETC section.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r2T0MNb.png[/img]



[u][b]Power Disk Price:[/b][/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8fjDcln.gif[/img]



[u][b]Attribute Transfer:[/b][/u]



1. On the first slot, select the outfit from which you will transfer attributes from.
2. On the second slot, select the outfit of the same part as the source outfit.

3. Click the "Selection Complete" once you have chosen the outfit.
4. Click the "Attribute Transfer" 

5. You can check outfits with completed attribute transfer(s) at the locker.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/XgYYyUf.gif[/img]


You can also do multiple attributes transfers at the same time by checking the 

"Select Multiple"



[img]https://i.imgur.com/5TRO2DG.gif[/img]



The duration of outfits and the duration of attributes are different
 
For example, if you transfer the attributes of a limited-time outfit to a permanent

outfit, the duration of the outfit remains the same, but the attributes are

replaced with those of the permanent outfit.



Sample

A. Attribute's total duration: 30 days.

B. Duration of the outfit: 7 days.



[u]Based on the sample above, the attribute will be removed after 7 days.

[/u]



[b]- FreeStyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YBWcy5l.png[/img]

Mega Pass is back for its 29th season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
 
2023/06/07 00:00 ~ 08/01 23:59 (PDT)
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3mKbtvB.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able
to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward
the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c3d2aa3559d72c3b6df8248f102bfd76e7b8d43.gif[/img]

Revamped Mega Pass:
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
 
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
 
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
Note: Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2fbeff64fe6fdc208da1ed186e5b6934a4e5e174.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
[b]How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?[/b]
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l03qnFf.gif[/img]

[b]Note[/b]: Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.

1. You can check and change the buff attributes from the
“Player Info > Character Buff Settings” tab.
2. 3 attributes can be selected for offense and defense each.
3. Same offense/defense attributes will not stack when buff effect is applied.

04/26 00:00 ~ 05/16 23:59 (PST)
 
[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]
 
Enhance any of the available items in order to acquire them! Enhancing at certain
levels will add stats to the items as well as making the item duration permanent.

for 15 GKash each.

grade. A "big failure" can also occur, which will reset the enhancement grade.

I don't like wearing the same clothes as others! I want to look different! 
 
Make your own uniform! Lettering outfits have been updated!

[b]Known Issue![/b]
There is a minor issue with Lettering Outfits when equipping and switching
with your other characters. This issue will be fixed as soon as possible.

[b]Lettering Outfits[/b]

- You can obtain lettering outfits from the Tournament Shop
- You can use the lettering function to write your own text and select colors!
- When using the lettering function, You can make the first change for free. Afterward, lettering items
will be required to make changes.
- Lettering outfits are divided into tops and bottoms. 
- Outfits with a "Pencil" icon on the bottom left can be used as lettering outfit.

a) Top: Jersey
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/68fcd020b1e5fac01bc76ad7d2ac916641701c36.jpg[/img]

b) Bottom: Leggings Shorts, Regular Shorts
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e1b1d4f93c21cda44b87fdb97338d6ee468b66a7.jpg[/img]

* An error notice will pop up when clicking on the lettering function on unequippable outfits.
 
Lettering Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f90fca31d3faded60e85424e13825bfaf8999243.jpg[/img]

- Use 1 Lettering Item to apply lettering one time.
- Lettering Items are shared within the account, and you can have up to 9,999.

[b]How to Apply Lettering[/b]

Step 1. Go to Locker and click on the lettering function of the Lettering Item.
Step 2. Select a lettering outfit and change the lettering and color settings.
Step 3. Click the “Apply” button to save settings.
* An error notice will pop up when clicking on unequippable lettering outfits.
* View options can be changed to show only the outfits without the character.
 
[b]1. Lettering Settings[/b]
- You can use English, Korean, and Chinese characters as well as numbers for lettering.
- Special characters and spaces cannot be used.
* You can enter up to 12 characters.
* Banned words or names of the lettering outfits themselves cannot be used.
 
[b]2. Color Settings[/b]
- You can select one of the displayed colors.
 
[b]3. Lettering Trial[/b]
- Hover mouse over a lettering outfit to see the lettering trial button.
- Press the button to try the lettering function.

notes.title: Devil's Tower
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24f16ef4874a0be57e888270e4775678475dccf7.png[/img]

Here comes the Devil's Tower!

There are specific requirements for this event but there's no need to worry.

To participate, make sure to follow the guide and instructions that we'll
be preparing down below.

What's important is that you'll be able to obtain rewards from each level,
and there's a chance to reach the highest level as well.

Event Duration:
4/19 00:00 ~ 5/3 23:59 PDT

Event Mechanics:

Devil's Tower Help
1. Purchase Stamina and climb the tower.
2. Climb the tower to randomly obtain the items allocated to the levels.
3. Climb up more levels at once to obtain more 'bonus steps'.
 - You can climb additional levels depending on the amount of bonus steps.
 - Moving 1 level does not grant bonus steps.
4. Upon reaching the final level, you will randomly obtain one of the rewards set
with the same probabilty.
5. Receive the final level reward to go back to level 1.
6. Upon reaching the final level again, you will randomly obtain one of the remaining rewards.
7. If you obtain all of the level rewards for the first round, the rewards will be
replaced with a fixed list of normal items.
8. From the second round, the list of items will be fixed and set with the same
probability. (Same items may be obtained again).

Devil's Tower Inventory Help
1. Devil'sTower rewards are sent to the inventory by default.
2. You can select a character and send all items collected in the inventory.
3. If you want to send different rewards by character, you need to change settings
so that the items will be 'directly sent to the gift box' before starting the event.
4. Please note that the settings will take effect after they are applied.

How to participate in Devil's Tower:


Step 1: Purchase the event resource “Stamina” to challenge the Devil’s Tower.
 
Step 2: Use the purchased stamina to play the gacha and obtain the reward from
each level.
Step 3: You can draw 1, 10, 30, or 50 times.
Step 4: Obtain rewards from each level and reach the highest level!

Bonus Steps  
- Bonus Steps add a certain amount of stamina.
- Additional chances may be granted based on the number of draws.
- Bonus Steps may be granted when drawing 1, 30, or 50 times.

Event Reward Distribution Notice 
- Obtained rewards can be sent to the Adventurer’s Inventory (backpack)
or gift box directly.
- You can set where to send the rewards to from the event page.

[b][Devil’s Tower Event Reward Distribution Settings Screen][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d739601b2cf84b4cb5448d5a230374bf1ede76fd.gif[/img]

Obtaining through Backpack	
- Up to 8 obtained items will be displayed in the Adventurer’s Inventory
(backpack).	
- You can select a character and “send items to inventory”.	
- If the rewards are left unclaimed until the event ends, the items will be sent
to the gift box.	

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Storing in Backpack][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0a441e63fc5dd77816bf2ea3a6de5c49e13ca21d.gif[/img]

[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Item Distribution Screen][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7a0ee01f2368553e4551e1ae379c6da4d8b473a1.gif[/img]

Distribution to Gift Box	
- Obtain items will be sent to the gift box immediately.	
- You can view up to 8 items obtained through the Adventurer’s Inventory.	
	
[b][Devil’s Tower Adventurer’s Inventory Screen – Sending to Gift Box][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/22ada11fcd758ca1edf762e06de63ecc9a366f25.gif[/img]

Devil’s Tower Reward by Level	
- Up to 5 rewards are placed on each level, and you can randomly
obtain one of them.	
- After you receive the reward on the final level, you will go back to the first
level and play again.	
- After you have claimed all 5 rewards on the final level, “level 0” will be unlocked
where you can randomly obtain one of the rewards placed there.	
- The Card Option Changer item obtainable through the Devil’s Tower event allows
you to change the sub attributes of the Allstar Cards (offense/defense).	
	
> When you reach the final level, you will return to level 1 and play again.	
> Rewards you obtain on the final level cannot be obtained again. 	
> Once you have obtained all rewards on the final level, you will randomly obtain
one of the rewards from level 0.

notes.title: Crew Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3769d9a487183caa33bdf70f5d730c2897d6fc6b.png[/img]

Hello from the developers of Freestyle 2!
 
The renewed Crew system through the March update!
 
Many users showed interest and participated!
 
There might have been some inconveniences with the newly changed Crew
system.
 
We will conduct a hotfix for the Crew renewal on April 12th and share the purpose
of the Crew renewal and the roadmap for future Crew updates.
 
Purpose of Crew Renewal by the Development Team

"The development team aims to create more diverse cooperative and competitive
contents through the Crew renewal compared to before.
 
The first renewal patch was conducted as a groundwork for content production. In the future, we plan to expand the scale of the Crew content through the second and third updates.
 
To enhance the fun of playing together, we aim to add cooperative and competitive elements through the “Crew” content and add various fun elements to the Freestyle 2 gameplay.
 
However, before adding such elements, we plan to improve convenience and
support and create related contents to facilitate the creation of many Crews.
 
4/12 Crew Update Hotfix

1. Crew Points and Quest Adjustments
"After the Crew renewal patch, we have recognized that it is currently difficult to
achieve the quests that were designed in consideration for the gaps between the
number of members in different Crews.

Therefore, we have adjusted the difficulty levels so that Crew Quests can be
easily achieved regardless of the size and increased the amount of Crew Points
that can be obtained from weekly quests while removing them as rewards from
daily quests.

In addition, to eliminate any possibility of unfairness to the Crews who have worked hard before the reset of Crew Points, we plan to reward Crew Points by converting the previous Crew level and accumulated points before the renewal."
 
2. Other Improvements
 
A. Messenger Display
We have increased the font size of the nickname of the currently logged in
character in the Crew tab of the messenger pop-up when the crew member is
online.
 
B. Online Crew Members Display
When a Crew member logs in, their name and self-introduction message will be
displayed.
 
C. Crew Member Note Display
 
When you right-click on a Crew member to check their Notes, you can now check
Notes for both the “main character” and “online character” separately.
 
D. Acquisition History Button Removed

Daily quests no longer grant Crew Points and the Acquisition History button has
been removed.														
 
E. Contribution Ranking Display
The Contribution score will now be displayed even for the accounts that do not
have a score.
 
F. Weekly Quest Contribution Details Popup
Weekly Quest achievement rate is now updated real-time.
 
G. Crew List Tab Added
The Crew List tab has been added so that players who have already joined a Crew
can check the list of Crews.
 
H. “View Online Members” Button Added
A filter function has been added so that only online Crew members can be seen in
the Crew Member List.
 
3. Notice on Content to Support Crew Masters in April
 
Currently, each Crew is being operated under the management of a Crew Master.
 
After the Crew members complete quests, Crew Points can be used to set rewards for the "Monthly Contribution Ranking.”

As for Crews that have less members, it has been difficult to obtain enough Crew
Points needed to set Monthly Contribution Ranking Rewards.
 
In order to make it more convenient, we are planning to give benefits to the
masters for Crews that have more than a certain number of members.
 
From April, a beneficial content for Crew Masters will start in order to facilitate the creation of new Crews.
 
Depending on the size of the Crew, event Gkash will be provided to Crew Masters
on the first day of maintenance every month if the members have been active and
fulfill certain conditions.
 
[Crew Master Benefits]
Target: Crews that have 15 or more members including the master.
 
Benefit Conditions:
*  Small Crews: 15 - 30 members, 10 members play 50 or more matches each in a month
*  Medium Crews: 31 - 60 members, 20 members play 50 or more matches each in a month
*  Large Crews: 61 - 90 members, 30 members play 50 or more matches each in a month
*  Extra-Large Crews: 91 or more members, 50 members play 50 or more matches each in a month
 
Crew Size Check Time: On the first day of every month, with the exception of April where it will be checked on the 12th which is the maintenance day.

will be considered a Large Crew.)"

* The first [Crew Master Benefits] will sent on May

and the crew coin held before the crew system update. 
 
4. Crew System Update Roadmap
We plan to keep adding various Crew-related contents after April.
 
We would like to share a brief roadmap of improvements and additions to the Crew content in line with the purpose of the Crew renewal.
 
Update Period: Update Contents
March: Crew Renewal Update
April: Crew Quest Difficulty Adjustments / Crew Quest Point Adjustments
May: Crew Master Benefits
June: Crew-related Product Update
 
3rd Quarter (July - September): Crew Ranking Aggregation Scheme Change, Crew Tournament Update
4th Quarter (October - December): Crew League System Added (A small number of Crews will be able to form a league and community where they can play together.)

The following updates may be added in the second half of the year.

Crew System.
 
If the contents in the roadmap are actually updated, we will let you know in detail
through another notice.
We look forward to your continued support for FreeStyle 2, and we will carry on
making the game better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a94a0d694565a2f11c05a2ca2cfc02c151a8e7a4.png[/img]

Mega Pass is back for its 29th season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
 
2023/04/12 00:00 ~ 06/06 23:59 (PDT)
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2748c5d359fdffd41f4b762bc4f73c48f3f4cb0e.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able
to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward
the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c3d2aa3559d72c3b6df8248f102bfd76e7b8d43.gif[/img]

Revamped Mega Pass:
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
 
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
 
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
Note: Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2fbeff64fe6fdc208da1ed186e5b6934a4e5e174.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

Note: Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.

notes.title: Crew System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0d336c85208d0b454926731c9a773bb69112f7bf.png[/img]

We are excited to announce the Crew System renewal, improvements, and updates!
For this notice, we will provide you with important notes and information to get you
started!

For more detailed guide of the UI changes and functions, please visit our
Freestyle 2 Guides section for the [url=https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/news/notice/16733][b]FreeStyle 2 Crew System Update[/b][/url]

[u][b]Crew Update[/b][/u]

1. With the Crew Update, the first and main Crew Name will be set as the name
of your "main character."

[b]2. Crew Main Page[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d82ecd83fd0a6d004d5a6947ccca21ad67e9a413.png[/img]

[b]3. Crew Management[/b]

3-1. Crew Manager Settings Page

- Crew positions and titles can be set.

a. Crew Master

- There can only be 1 Crew Master.
- The Crew Master can delegate the crew master position to another member and
appoint a Vice Crew Master and Managers.
- Edit and delete posts from the ‘Crew Notice’ and ‘Crew Sentence Board’.
- Accept crew join requests and send out crew invitations.
- Kick crew members from the crew list.
(You cannot kick a member who is in a higher or same position as you)
  (Position Ranking: Crew Master>Vice Crew Master>Manager> Crew)
- Access Crew Quest and Crew Contribution settings.
- Register recruitment posts and access Crew Mark settings.
- Purchase Crew Buffs.

b. Vice Crew Master

- There can only be 1 Vice Crew Master.
- Vice Crew Master can appoint new Managers.
- Edit and delete posts from the ‘Crew Notice’ and ‘Crew Sentence Board’.
- Accept crew join requests and send out crew invitations.
- Kick crew members from the crew list.
(You cannot kick a member who is in a higher or same position as you)
  (Position Ranking: Crew Master>Vice Crew Master>Manager> Crew)
- Access Crew Quest and Crew Contribution settings.
- Register recruitment posts and access Crew Mark settings.
- Purchase Crew Buffs.
* The Vice Crew Master’s authority over the crew can only be edited by the
Crew Master.
* However, during the Vice Crew Master will play the same role as the
Crew Master during the crew stabilization period (2 months).

c. Manager
 
- There can be up to 3 Managers. 
- Accept crew join requests and send out crew invitations.
- Kick crew members from the crew list.
(You cannot kick a member who is in a higher or same position as you)
  (Position Ranking: Crew Master>Vice Crew Master>Manager> Crew)
- Edit and delete posts from the ‘Crew Sentence Board’.
* The Manager’s authority over the crew can only be edited by the Crew Master
and Vice Crew Master.

3-2. Crew Recruitment Management

a.  List of Crew Applications

- The date of which the application was sent, the character name of the sender,
and his or her message will be displayed.
- You can turn on/off open recruitment for the crew with the [Recruit Crew Member] button.
- You can send a crew invitation message with the [Crew Invite] button.
* When sending a crew invitation message, the crew’s crew master’s main
character name will be shown on the message.

3-3. Crew List & Crew Mark

a. Crew List

- You can sort the list in the order of: crew creation (oldest, newest) and
by crew size.
- You can enter and search for any specific crew.
* The crew name must be entered exactly to search.
 
b. Crew Mark

- The Crew emblem is the symbol of the Crew. It is used in the Crew Page.
- You can select the emblem’s layout, design, and color.
- You can access the Crew Mark settings through [Crew Management] >
[Crew Mark].
* Only the Crew Master has access to the Crew Mark.

3-4. Inactive Crew Master Position Delegation

a. Crew Master Position Auto Delegation

- If the Crew Master does not log in for 30 days, the Vice Crew Master
will automatically become the new Crew Master.
 
* If there is no Vice Crew Master, the Manager with the highest total contribution
will become the new Crew Master.
* If there is no Vice Crew Master or Managers, the crew member with the highest
total contribution will become the new Crew Master.
* If everyone’s contribution is the same, the crew member with the oldest account
will become the new crew master.

[b]4. Crew Shop[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d82ecd83fd0a6d004d5a6947ccca21ad67e9a413.png[/img]

[b]- FreeStyle 2 Team[/b]

notes.title: Matching System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/64621722edb36b413351869eb8dafd7752bceb80.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,
 
We are glad to bring you an update on our Matchmaking System!
 
Through our Satisfaction Survey conducted back in December 2022,
our Freestyle 2 Development Team recognized that one of their top priorities
in development is to provide an improved matchmaking system.
 
In order for our players to enjoy Freestyle 2 in an optimized environment in
2023, we have developed a new matchmaking system designed to match
players with ideal and minimal latency between each other. However, with the
new matchmaking system in place, it may require more queuing time than before
to apply this new condition with minimized latency.
 
After the 2 weeks of Beta Testing Period, we will decide on its final implementation
based on user satisfaction.
 
The Freestyle2 developers are always listening to your feedback. Please feel free
to contact us if you have any suggestions for the game.
 
We look forward to your participation.
		
[b]Beta Testing Period: March 22th, 2023 - April 4th, 2023		

User Satisfaction Survey Period: March 29th, 2023 - April 4th, 2023


- FreeStyle 2 Team[/b]

- Eastern Intersection
- Southern Redevelopment Area

Simply for a team of 3 Users and wait for any available
opponent teams to play with, then select "Challenge"

? If you win once on the regular channel, you will be able to challenge the basketball league.

(Each team member's ELO is calculated as the highest ELO score among the same position characters in the account.)

? Even if your ELO is changed, you can maintain a series of wins in the same area.

Users will receive 4 Badges per win

to level it up completely.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash which will give them access to additional quests and more rewards.

weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions.

notes.title: Position Master Guide Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7f1e24527e354100db2043c5b00485f944074598.png[/img]

Greetings, Ballers!

We've implemented a few improvements for our Position Master feature!

Please refer to the information below for your reference.

[b]Update Implementation:[/b]

2023/02/08 00:00 ~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1fe47facc79d0666c58fb18e5bd0586fae548b2d.gif[/img]

[b]This update includes the following:[/b]

- Newly improved Mission Progress gauge
- Adjusted Login & Match Play requirement

[b]Mechanics:[/b]

As soon as you access the Position Master section you will be
asked to set your Character Acquisition order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e0804b660b3363ba6ecb5ea966ff95558d73be53.gif[/img]

Once done, your Soul Missions menu will appear on the left side of the Event UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6582e2458c3d134b718ffb07f8efb3eab62d726f.png[/img]

Please note, that you have to use the recommended position before
you start completing each Mission.

There are 10 Missions for each Position Type.

[b]Soul Mission Gauge:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/92ad1852367c80ef900fe789555daa40c86e6fa0.png[/img]

The Soul Mission gauge will increase every
time you complete a Position Type mission.

Remember, the gauge point applies separately for each Position Type Mission.

[b]Login & Match Gauge:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b87b29bf9526d9d8d23ae71464e66866e08ef59f.png[/img]

The Login & Match gauge increases every time you log in or play regular matches.

This gauge is bound to a character so don't confuse it with the Soul Mission gauge

- Gain 1 point for Login&Play Gauge by playing 3 matches per day (BZ, FS Channel)
- Gain 1 point for Login&Play Gauge by Checking-in
- Gauge points that can be acquired through regular matches: 30 points

Lastly, we have adjusted the total accumulated
Login & Match Play requirement from 60 to 50!

Soul Part:

Soul Part can be obtained once you've filled
up the corresponding gauge for each Part.

There are 3 Soul Parts in total and when you collect all of them, you can obtain
your selected character! So let's start mastering the positions now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1278f7529e920fb1a4b19e427ec8224bdc03fdd8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/da62b59e99c84211758aa6b9d4d2974f3395f065.gif[/img]

With this update, it will be more easier for those who just started exploring Position Master feature.

Now go finish those missions and get exciting rewards!

[b]- Freestyle 2 Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b90629ecca5497c59f8eff6e288d4717905e914d.jpg[/img]

Win prizes that's decided by none other than you! Participate now in our new
My Pick Event. Get to choose from a variety of prizes and pick those you
truly desire.

[b]Event Period:[/b]
 
2023/02/08 ~ 2023/02/21 23:59 (PST)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1c9e6fe36107d01d58b2af17c220dd3d13a52ebb.gif[/img]

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]
 
1. From the PICK! PICK! are on the right, pick you reward.
2. Once you select the rewards that you want, you can begin the gacha.
3. If you are having a hard time picking what you want, click the "Auto Select"
4. The selected rewards can be canceled and re-selected at anytime
5. The obtained items will be sent to your gift box. You cannot use the
purchased currency when the event period ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/872af990cbc6097c30efd518b7327ea319b8ec76.gif[/img]

Let me guide you on how this thing works. First, pick your desired items
from your right.

These are your choices and take note that every ball type has a limited
number of items.

Better think it carefully before placing those items.
 
Before you can play the Gacha Machine you need buy first the Pick Coin.
See the prices below:

[b]Gkash:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7bd26225fd4535b60202a85ee95335f749cfe672.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aeaacf6dc1ec4518903f07a55de8e1b878165fbd.png[/img]

[b]Manual Selecting[/b]

auto select button again)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26ee1c551146797c3a8fbc7aca0117634ac50e68.gif[/img]

2023/02/08 ~ 2023/02/14 23:59 (PST)

is increased if you complete the missions.

is equal, Mission 1's discount rate is applied. If you reach the final stage, you
can buy the item for free.
 
[b]TIP 3:[/b]

can no longer participate in the Event.

Marathon for tons of discounted price!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1577dc05d75310d65140cbde2b36527f1fcc306a.gif[/img]

- Players need to complete weekly missions. Once you've finished the first stage,
  you may claim the rewards and then proceed with the remaining stages.
- Rewards will be sent to your Gift Box.
- Stage Rewards:
a. Stage 1: Premium Sub Att. x3 & Freeticket x100
b. Stage 2: Joker Card Box (Legend) x1 & Freeticket x200
c. Stage 3: AllStar Pro Wish Box x1 & Freeticket x300

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/c4696d8b126fea172cc4b49ac89e1d385eec97f2.gif[/img]

- The monthly mission has 4 stages. Players must complete missions until they get
  their 1st stage rewards. You may proceed with the following stages if you wish to
  obtain different set of rewards.
- Rewards will be sent to your gift box.
- Stage Rewards:
a. Stage 1: Premium Sub Att. x5 & Freeticket x100
b. Stage 2: Premium Prism Changer x3 & Freeticket x200
c. Stage 3: AllStarW Mover x1 & Freeticket x300
d. Stage 4: AllStar World Wish Box x1 & Freeticket x400

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able

You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

Infinite Enhancement Machine is back!

Do you have what it takes to challenge the Infinite Enhancement Machine?

Test your mettle on this event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7026a57d363db217cb27706f2bec88da2833b73.gif[/img]

[b]Event Period:[/b]

12/14 00:00 ~ 12/27 23:59 (PST)

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]

Enhance any of the available items in order to acquire them! Enhancing at certain
levels will add stats to the items as well as making the item duration permanent.

Enhance Fuel is needed in order to enhance. It can be bought at the Event Page
for 15 GKash each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/33928b204457c8df7ff7c4c19bfbd7f8b0dee3e4.png[/img]

Once you have acquired enhancement fuels, you can then proceed with the
enhancement process.
 
- Item(s) can be enhanced by pressing the Enhance button and using fuel.
- Upon successful enhancement, the user period or attributes will be increased depending on the grade.

notes.title: Mission System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2ac843096a1fe77efd3373fc3fb8664b9815b59d.png[/img]

We would like to present to everyone, the new Mission System! Please be informed that the Daily and Super Quest have been removed. There's no need to worry. This update is composed of three different types of missions.

Note: (Daily Quest) One Selection Box will be given for each remaining point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/181f51a615bb7f6e0926b10a2a854b2509837720.png[/img]

I. Daily Mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/50128bfb732bf5eb1746e9d28519d4cc63f5e0c7.png[/img]

- You can play Daily Missions in each slot for up to 3 times and obtain rewards.
- There's also a mission tracker located on the left side of the screen when
  you're currently in the lobby. Here's how it looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/81d630f341ba574cdb36371fa11a8f8268b29ba3.gif[/img]

- A daily mission can be changed each hour. The cooldown for changing a mission will be shared across all slots. Check the preview below as a reference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/39b4fa151abccd8fafd5f1c012d05380b63a2cdb.gif[/img]

- Missions will be reset at 00:00 daily.
- Rewards will be sent to your Gift Box.

List of Daily Missions:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/98a1f13e08ec1f88dc158ad7eb93e681efd4cc6a.png[/img]

II. Weekly Mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f0d8a43a0d8278b4b40ec733c9f99640d32ce56b.gif[/img]

- Weekly Missions will be reset at 00:00 on Mondays.
- Players need to complete weekly missions. Once you've finished the first stage,
  you may claim the rewards and then proceed with the remaining stages.
- Rewards will be sent to your Gift Box.
- Stage Rewards:
a. Stage 1: Premium Sub Att. x3 & Freeticket x100
b. Stage 2: Joker Card Box (Legend) x1 & Freeticket x200
c. Stage 3: AllStar Pro Wish Box x1 & Freeticket x300

List of Weekly Missions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26adeb2c6bbfcfceda38baff264a726c6063a17d.png[/img]

Weekly Stage Missions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/47fa0c51e34d6c8219955ef6dad65905f4dacf28.png[/img]

III. Monthly Mission
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a83fe59808bd70feac1398090af4d82b4dbbfb59.gif[/img]

- Monthly Missions will be reset at 00:00 on the first day of every month.
- The monthly mission has 4 stages. Players must complete missions until they get
  their 1st stage rewards. You may proceed with the following stages if you wish to
  obtain different set of rewards.
- Rewards will be sent to your gift box.
- Stage Rewards:
a. Stage 1: Premium Sub Att. x5 & Freeticket x100
b. Stage 2: Premium Prism Changer x3 & Freeticket x200
c. Stage 3: AllStarW Mover x1 & Freeticket x300
d. Stage 4: AllStar World Wish Box x1 & Freeticket x400

List of Monthly Missions:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0f4e34fe2f6c805b8545013e532eba87b4f05bc.png[/img]

Monthly Stage Missions

notes.content:

Being a Noble has it perks! Grace and her mega corporation has developed 
what she calls the “Enchanted Wallet”. 

How this wallet works no really knows except her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the 
world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

[b]Event Period:[/b]

10/26 02:00 ~ 11/08 23:59 PDT
 
[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]
 
1.) You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets” to participate in this
event and you can only buy one of the wallets for a limited time only
10/26 ~ 11/08 23:59 PDT. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5894f5d886faabc1b8c3037001f7a4252bcbad5f.png[/img]

Free Points each day and Event Gkash on the 7th and 14th day. 
 
(Log-in for 14days and complete the reward list!)

[b]Note: The time starts to tick on the day and time when you open the wallet.[/b]

To prevent what happened from the previous Grace Wallet Event
here's the reward redemption date for your reference.

When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7afea253924e9df5510e7688fcb1aaf3bbde977a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/483ca076bcd3605bc30ca621611b626780f1b26e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bd930ff71ccea9bd3d4a65274baeade9dbe40031.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ecf7c12adbfd4f56a565bff818a96389a580c5f4.png[/img]

1) Alley-oop Pass

PG and DG’s current Alley-oop Pass Skill will be removed and will be given as a
Mastery Skill

2) Post Up Drive Combo

The Post Up Drive Combo skill is added to the SF position.

3) Intercept level adjustment

I. Intercept Success% adjustment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ce02efa1f15b9706747d648a99edae496743fe1e.png[/img]

II. Acquire Over Pass Intercept & Over Pass Intercept: success% stat added

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/24a1b1facb3ff46c50402c8ad691ded7148da999.png[/img]

*The Overpass Intercept skill is deleted from the previous PG position.

4) Diving Catch

I.       The Diving Catch skill is added to the DG position.

II.      Diving Catch cannot be equipped together with Rolling Diving Catch.

5)     Skill stat adjustment 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3bcee18d6325b72e2718590b14d96728b8f8b860.png[/img]

6) Baseball pass

There has been a slight increase in baseball pass stamina ↓

7) Last Resistance

- Previous:
 
‘Last Resistance’ could be activated no matter the number of players around
the post.
 
- Changed: 
 
‘Last Resistance’ can be activated if no one other than the opponent (offense)
is around the post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7dfc85afd346a421e95655875cf813b4fb2e4a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/def0a72f7729ac06d314b73ffce1473b53e97857.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7edd4cd97d81c8c59ec07e0a466117b8c9f4f59.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/051438ab9861108113e89722888074c8ff72ef4a.png[/img]

1) Rule Changes
I. Offense Rebound time change
 
- When your team is in offense, if you perform a successful rebound that does
not grant the offense to the opponents, the attack timer will be changed.  
→ Previous: [22] second(s)
→ Changes: [14] second(s)
 
 
II. Draw Match Rule Change
 
- Change to time that a match will result in a draw after a player has force-quitted
the game
→ Previous: [60] second(s)
→ Changes: [20] second(s)
 
 
2) Training Attribute Change

I. Default Attributes Change
 
[240] points
 
II. The increase amount of required stats for Training is improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b8e7924ddd0f5259ed2d740adb3cb26234cee05b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1f755624b97e05303489300a8c048d513b84be66.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1f087c89d58ece964cc94a5e48af803c5de83c13.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d71fd98da33b9d14867a40e7ecab1e68eedd068e.png[/img]

*When using Training Points, the amount of required points will now be fixed
instead of being increased with each use.

*Training Points will reset after the implementation of the Balance Patch.
Re-allocate your points under User Info menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/61ab9ea1e0409a72a5eb0abe94507d18752abb4e.png[/img]

1) Astria Character 'Buff Attributes' Change

I. Complete Freestyle condition once buff Improvement 
→ Previous: Freestyle condition of all teammates increased by 1 when using a buff
(no limit to condition increase)
→ Changed: ‘Complete Freestyle Condition Once’ buff is now separated into
team/individual buffs and only one may be selected.
 
[When set as a team buff]
a. Complete Freestyle condition once (team)
- When using buffs, all Freestyle conditions of teammates met + [1] Increased
- Condition goes up to [3] times including buffs used by the team 
(‘Unobtainable’ mark displayed upon exceeding 3 times)
- This buff is does not apply to characters that have the ‘Complete Freestyle
condition once (individual)’ buff.
 
[When set as an individual buff]  
b. Complete Freestyle condition once (individual)
- When using buffs, all Freestyle conditions of your character met + [1] Increased
- Condition goes up to [3] times including buffs used by the team 
(‘Unobtainable’ mark displayed upon exceeding 3 times)
- Complete Freestyle condition once’ buff does not apply to other characters than
yours.

notes.title: Starlight Yua Debut Showcase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1578988ee2c6928636fd57bb8d317666cbd3a964.png[/img]

We would like to present Starlight Yua! Want to know more about her?

Check out Yua's story below. 

Ever since she was a child, Yua dreamed of becoming an idol, so she practiced
dancing and singing without a break, even as a child.


As time passed, Yua became a high school student and she joined an
entertainment company that made her an idol trainee.


Yua felt that reality is quite different from what was broadcasted, she got
exhausted. However, to keep her promise to her mother, Yua practiced hard
and successfully debuted as an idol.

She kept on living the idol life that she always dreamed of. Unfortunately, when
she became popular, many people showed jealousy towards her.

notes.title: Draft System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/574e526da0ef22ade77d8b4278e837e5cfe61679.png[/img]

Here comes a better twist for our Draft System!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/11d96c9275566f9de6d951e118447d1aa78de105.png[/img]

[b]How to Participate[/b]
 
Step.1: Once Draft Season is running, players can participate in the Draft event by
choosing one of the Draft Characters or player's originally owned characters.
 
- At the end of the Draft Season, the new season will be a fresh start after the end period. (View Results)										
- Characters in the character growth mode can also participate.											
- If you participate in the draft with an existing character, you cannot receive STEP level compensation.	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/62de8cc825e9ae3bb705ca7267b9b4639576392f.png[/img]

Step.2:  Increase the STEP level through daily, weekly, and season quests during the season.			
			
Step Level:
		
- You can increase the STEP level with the experience you gain while participating in the draft and completing the quest.			
- At the end of the draft season, the available rewards vary depending on the STEP level.			
			
[b]STEP Level Up Ticket[/b]	


[b]- Not available [/b]using points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b4ea5c0493a1395602dfaad500136404fe141339.png[/img]

[b]Draft Pass Ticket	[/b]



- [b]Available[/b] using points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b4ea5c0493a1395602dfaad500136404fe141339.png[/img]

[b]Result Reward Changer	[/b]



- [b]Available[/b] using points								
- Once user reached Lv.6, User can obtain character randomly, by buying this result reward changer user can draw the character once again		

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/15e05b9d288fb48736362f10d5afc3b476a8c5a8.png[/img]

[b]Details[/b]		

- Quest has different attainable experience values by difficulty level.											
- The same mission cannot be duplicated.											
- Weekly quests are initialized every Monday at 00:00.											
- If you use the draft pass ticket item, you can proceed with the season quest. (Applies immediately when purchasing draft pass ticket items.)											
- Draft result rewards are only available for the end (View Results) period.											
- Draft compensation will be paid to the locker room.											
- Transformation and parts characters will be paid with all of their abilities or items in possession. (However, Draft Golden, Violet, Cabernet, Nari, and Alazak will be paid with only parts without transformation.)											
- All character compensation will be paid with a change ticket, and characters will be randomly changed among characters that can be obtained by step level when using the change ticket.											
- You can raise the STEP level by 1 when using the SETP Level Up Ticket item. (The experience value becomes 0 when using the SETEP Level Up privilege.)											

- FreeStyle2 Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8e09b2641795107e7bf0bb7d1b5e25b3b3f19dc5.png[/img]

Mega Pass is back for its 25th season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
[b]Event Period:[/b]
 
2022/08/31 00:00 ~ 10/25 23:59 (PDT)
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/44c740fed9057ca7d82823e13e9163251e6f327f.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able
to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward
the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c3d2aa3559d72c3b6df8248f102bfd76e7b8d43.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0593644303c63850374e6b5c4d322008270dac7b.gif[/img]

[b]Revamped Mega Pass:[/b]
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
 
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
 
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
[b]Note:[/b] Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2fbeff64fe6fdc208da1ed186e5b6934a4e5e174.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
[b]How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?[/b]
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e8153c1268ac4482af3b5abb5605cad9cccd2581.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.
