notes.title: New Ranking System: Lord of the Street
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6a087fc1c3c7a045868eeac2b75bb525f148b4ce.png[/img]

Introducing our revamped Ranked Mode.
 
This new mode will surely benefit the competitive ones and casual players.
 
Keep scrolling to find out more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/041ef49da12da789b43e5cbc21904a4d99135563.png[/img]

1. Users will automatically be part of this new Ranking System once the season commences.

You may access the LOS Ranked Page via Lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8167c097b93125d8e56c6d6995c7782f527b7b62.png[/img]

2. Each season will be a month-long duration (1st and last day of the month)
 
3. There will be 10 placement matches that participants need to complete in
order to determine their starting rank on the current Season's Ranked ladder.

*Playing with or against AI in BZ Channel will not count in Placement Matches
 
* If a user feels like they're not yet fit to compete against other participants,
they may opt-out of participating through the Ranked Game Rewards & Settings section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c5e8ec32ae66ef2b72d5c47621b4b4e1dec50e7.gif[/img]

[b]* Please note that once you opt-out of participating in the Ranked
Mode, your rank and your placement matches will reset.[/b]

Thus, you have to start over and finish the required number of matches mentioned above.
 
4. This Ranking System applies to both BZ and FS Channel
 
*Single League is specifically for FS Channel (Regular Channel)
*Multiple Leagues are for both BZ and FS Channel (Regular Channel)
 
5. The Maximum attainable Rank in BZ Channel is Gold 1. If you wish to aim
for a much higher Rank, you have to switch to FS Channel
 
*This basically means that if you have reached Gold 1 by playing in
BZ Channel, it is mandatory to switch to FS Channel to gain more points.
 
6. Each Rank Tier has a corresponding Season Score, and users may be
promoted/demoted depending on their current Score.
 
7. Corresponding Coins and Rank Trophy rewards varies depending on your end of Season Rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/58be287a0730eaf71db03f7ca4d81a6f9e0290c5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4f683b9cd76e6bb43f58e00e73d9e5ba6494963b.png[/img]

8. Ranked rewards can be obtained after the current season and users can
use them to exchange via Ranked Shop for various in-game Items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/536748d28b0f298f2f060ab1bd02317ac8853c41.gif[/img]

[b]Contents:[/b]
 
[b]Season Score[/b] -  Score achieved by current Character
 
[b]Season Match[/b] - Number of matches played during the Season (FS Channel + BZ Channel combined)
 
[b]Season Win Rate[/b] - Your average Win rate for the entire Season (Number of FS+BZ Wins / Number of FS+BZ Channel matches)
 
[b]My Ranking[/b] - Ranking to which Tier of the Leaderboard the user is included
 
[b]Top Ranking [/b]- Top Ranking Players
 
[b]Crew Ranking[/b] - Crew Ranking with the Most Top Ranking Members

During this update, the VVIP animation on the loading screen
(Before the match starts) will be removed.

[b]Season Score Table Per Tier:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d266a45cc82257a2419e5d8246db32234ec0067b.png[/img]

[b]Game Rank Icons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0fbcec1f1962db6cb27c898cf1f8da650bf7bf49.png[/img]

In the next update, items that can only be obtained in the ranked game
will be added. We look forward for your participation.

[b]- FreeStyle 2 Team [/b]

notes.title: Megapass Season 24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/290347598f754ef898e034cf3d21980144650275.png[/img]

Mega Pass is back for its 24th season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
Sale Period:
 
2022/07/27 00:00 ~ 08/30 23:59 (PDT)
 
Event Details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3e834ea89f6be95e6970a4f112dd7a354353fbca.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for 590 GKash which will give them access to additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4c3d2aa3559d72c3b6df8248f102bfd76e7b8d43.gif[/img]

Revamped Mega Pass:
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
Note: Users will not be able to gain more stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9ccf111040e4f33df91f2b80f2d10a97565c7147.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this, and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/4aa91ccc00e997fddff704646df08475da408bcb.gif[/img]

Note: Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.

notes.title: FREE2LAND
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3cee3f7bf41ebb771f178d7d9095f0b4fae62fbd.png[/img]

Greetings! Welcome to FREE2LAND! 

We have prepared various events in our FREE2LAND!

Complete quests to acquire coins that you can use to exchange for rare items!

Note: Make sure to hit the "receive" button to acquire the coins after completing
the mission! Just by logging in and playing several matches, you will automatically
be part of the event! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9bc947d8317db845c222895a9e81d5ca6b0f7491.gif[/img]

Accumulated number of matches played & Login time Event has a corresponding
coin rewards!

[b]Guess the last Digit mission[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7f645d0102086d1466f14e624a864575b5d0bec3.gif[/img]

Guess your opponent's last score digit by clicking a specific number on 
the selection provided. For non-VIP players, you can only choose 1 number
and 3 for VIP members. Don't forget to hit "Save".

Coin rewards for prediction: 10 Coins for successful prediction and 1 Coin
for failed prediction.

Maximum coins that a player can acquire per day is 100.

Predictions will remain the same throughout the event unless you
decided to change it.

You can exchange coins for various consumables! Just visit the Event Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ce35c4cd562e1f04c6c9ee56de31626408c23c5f.gif[/img]

[b]Ferris Wheel Event[/b] is back! Login and Play to get stamps to claim
the reward for the day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/798ee37e3b9281d1804c724629c087cb3c46a5ac.gif[/img]

[b]Unlock Event: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/77b2e871d5fb42ade625e99ef234796ef029069e.gif[/img]

For every team/individual match you finish or every hour you stay logged in,
you will earn Box Keys.

10 Keys for every match (Maximum 10 Games per day) = 100
20 Keys for every hour logged in (Maximum of 5 hours per day) = 100 

Total of Box Keys that can be acquired per day: 200

- Box Keys can be used to Open or Upgrade the Box
- Each Box has a corresponding rewards and you can get one of the
items listed randomly.

** Once you have chosen specific box, the box level will reset to the
lowest Box Grade.

** You won't be able to claim any rewards after the event period so
make sure to spend Box Keys on time!

Wait, there's more! If you have collected a huge amount of FS2 Coins,
you may also use it to redeem S+ Rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/54264aa84e7f9a2d7f2342a1ff6e81183a4e54ca.gif[/img]

Don't forget to check your Mission Progress to make sure that you have
received all FS2 Coins for the day!

Mega Pass is back for its 23rd season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
[b]Sale Period:[/b]
 
2022/06/22 00:00 - 2022/07/26 23:59 (PDT)
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/44cb9a1efe961d09f2a967eb6bf68c606ca788a1.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able
to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward
the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for
590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e76d17b376b56529349c4d6539ac1d7f99ce89c7.gif[/img]

[b]Revamped Mega Pass:[/b]
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
 
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
 
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
[b]Note[/b]: Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/529f1833d7fadc841afaabf1fa02a9d7f969b27b.png[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
[b]How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?[/b]
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/246c95e56cfc60c1d7ae7138759fe04f54be1cf1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d1d507c0d185ab24516abe981258849cca763970.gif[/img]

[b]Note[/b]: Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
 to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.

notes.title: Weekly Ranking System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e305584a0e5ed2de003269aebd6d64c2f5d890e5.png[/img]

Do you think you have what it takes to be part of the Best Players in FS2 Court?

Prove your worth!

[b]Event Period:[/b]

06/15/2022 00:00 ~ 07/15/2022 23:59 (PDT)

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5bf1316c737e40220c42aa7b06308d97cff63274.png[/img]

1. Weekly Ranking Event runs 7 days a week for 3 Weeks.
2. Users who wish to participate need to complete at least 3 matches per day to be part of the ranking process
3. Weekly Ranking rewards will be sent to your Character's inventory at the end of each week
4. Weekly Ranking Event is a newly-released player ranking Event in which a different type of ELO rating
is being recorded into the account. (Event ELO resets every week)
5. The Weekly Ranking Event lasts for 3 Weeks and a Champion's League will be held in Week 4
6. All participants will start with a 500 default ELO rating and gradually increases by winning matches. (Matches played in the BZ channel will not be reflected)
7. The Top 10 users (Overall, not per position) for each week will be qualified for the Champion’s League
8. Users registered in the ranking can be selected as rivals. When a rival is chosen, the rival’s current ranking can be checked in the waiting room.
9. Participation in the Weekly Ranking Event cannot be canceled and you will have to participate every week

[b]*The ELO in the Weekly Ranking is an event score that is separate from the ELO in regular matches"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/5bf1316c737e40220c42aa7b06308d97cff63274.png[/img]

[b]Champion's League[/b]

1. After the third week of the Weekly Ranking Event, the Champion’s League will be held in Week 4.
2. Only the Top 10 users who played well in the past three weeks in the Weekly Ranking Event will be qualified to enter the Champion’s League.
3. When the Champion’s League starts, the Top 10 players from Week 1 to 3 will be transferred to the league automatically.
4. The Champion’s League will be held in the same way as the Weekly Ranking, and the winner will be granted a special exclusive accessory.

[b]Event Rewards[/b]

notes.title: Basketball League
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1bec0956e97b1e7536d898bf8b8068ebf22816eb.png[/img]

Hello, Ballers!

In commemoration of our 8th Anniversary update, here comes a revamped in-game
feature that will surely take the competitive scene in FS2 Court to another level!

You got game? Step up your game and show them what you got!

Thrilling rewards are waiting for you and your team!

[b]Event Period:[/b]

06/15 00:00 ~ 07/12 23:59 (PDT)

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]

Basketball League section is located at the Lobby section of Regular Channel or via waiting room (Lobby Court)

*Not available in BZ Channel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07d0f45eb61815b787caef78317936779d6fa73e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa84075a9f3983643eb2f6dddf8245fc8234ce32.png[/img]

Once accessed, the Basketball League interface will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e5448ddaf17cddfeffb7cc96d431fc357ed42628.png[/img]

[b]There are 3 Strategic Maps to choose from:[/b]

- Western Back Street
- Eastern Intersection
- Southern Redevelopment Area

[b]*Based on the user's average ELO rating, suggested Map may vary.[/b]

How to participate?

Simply for a team of 3 Users and wait for any available
opponent teams to play with, then select "Challenge"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e4703d1a56503e43c4bcbd7b2ca9ede89d501525.png[/img]

Event Information

Step 1. During the event period, participate in Basketball League every day.

Step 2. You can exchange the acquired badge for various items.

※ If you win once on the regular channel, you will be able to challenge the basketball league.

※ The average ELO of the team members identifies the area that can be entered, and the buttons on the non-entry areas are disabled.

(Each team member's ELO is calculated as the highest ELO score among the same position characters in the account.)

※ Even if your ELO is changed, you can maintain a series of wins in the same area.

[b]Match Rewards:[/b]

Users will receive 4 Badges per win
Users will receive 3 Badges per match loss

*Accumulated Badges can be used to exchange various League rewards

[b]Reward Guide:[/b]

For this month's Basketball League, we'll be giving the exact same rewards for ALL USERS
across 3 Servers regardless of which specific Strategic Map you've played for.

- FreeStyle2 Team

notes.title: 2022 Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b459488fb6314c3fe40fe505e90e981e39270895.png[/img]

Hello Ballers,

We have decided to present the overview of the FreeStyle2 team's objectives
and plan for this year 2022.

We hope that this presentation will give everyone a better picture of the
development process.

Feel free to check out the roadmap below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a4b48e541ef28ca2368aebc499a6097967acf35f.png[/img]

[b]Roadmap[/b]

[b]May[/b]
- ELO Soft Reset : To facilitate the matching process and adjust rankings, an ELO
soft reset will be performed.

- 8th Anniversary Event : Freestyle 2’s 8th Anniversary Event! Are you ready to
join the birthday party?

- Basketball League Renewal :The Basketball League will be improved in order
to bring players of similar skill levels together. Now you can play Basketball League
as it was meant to be!

[b]June[/b]
- New Ranking System : Grow and compete at the same time during the event
period! A new ranking event will be added. This may be the biggest update
yet in June! GM May will come back with event notifications on more updates
and services in the future!

- New Item : A chance to transform characters and change their looks!
Great items are on the way.

- New Currency : A new currency item will be added so that you can enjoy
promotion events through ‘play events’! We hope to plan more enjoyable events
and improve ease of use!

[b]July[/b]
- New Play Mode :Did you find the matches too simple?

A new play mode in which you can complete and grow easily will be added.

- New Type Character : The hidden ‘Sixth’ character will be revealed in Freestyle 2!

GM May is also curious who it will be! New character coming in July!

- New Package Event : Customize your items! Pick the items you want and
put them into a package to get a discount!

Wow. That’s something to look forward to!

[b]August[/b]
- Item Fusion Event : Expect new high-quality outfits from this ‘Item Fusion Event’!
We’ll let you have a quick glance at it later!

- Prediction Mode : Pick one from the Home & Away teams and root for them!
Experience Freestyle 2 from the cheering crowd’s point of view. 

[b]September[/b]
- New Character : A secret team will be newly revealed in Freestyle 2.
Wonder what team and characters they are? Stay tuned for September updates!

- Community Content First Update : The wait is almost over! The first large update
to improve the Crew system! A new content to lay the foundations for the Crew system
will be added.

- Balance Patch : Based on the user play data and survey results, we have planned
to carry out some basic tasks to prepare for balance adjustments in the future.

- Seasonal META Rotation Mode : Say goodbye to single-tactic METAs now.
Seasonal META Rotation Mode is here! A great chance to experience new METAs!

[b]October[/b]
- Community Content Second Update : Another large update to improve the
Crew system! Play improved crew contents with crew members and bring them
together! Yes! This is what the Freestyle 2 crew system is all about!

[b]November[/b]
- Tournament Mode : “Tournaments” are the icing on the cake in a sport game!
There will be only one winner. Join the tournaments that will be held regularly to
enjoy Freestyle 2 more!

- Card/SPC Book : Come! All the cards in the world are there! Collect all cards
and characters of Freestyle 2! The Book system will be added.

[b]December[/b]
- Club Owner System : A system where an individual can create and operate a
whole club by signing contracts with other users

- FS2 Career Mode : The Club Owner system will be added, where an individual
can manage a big club. Sign contracts with the best players and form the
best club in Freestyle 2!
 
Note: Depending on internal circumstances, Roadmap can be changed.

- Freestyle 2 Team

Hello, Ballers!

In commemoration of our 8th Anniversary update, here comes a revamped

You got game? Step up your game and show them what you got!

Thrilling rewards are waiting for you and your team!

[b]Event Period:[/b]

05/18 00:00 ~ 06/14 23:59 (PDT)

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]

Basketball League section is located at the Lobby section of Regular Channel or via waiting room (Lobby Court)

[b]*Not available in BZ Channel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07d0f45eb61815b787caef78317936779d6fa73e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa84075a9f3983643eb2f6dddf8245fc8234ce32.png[/img]

Once accessed, the Basketball League interface will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aad6c1763918feaa2af34070401a78f122e2b7db.jpg[/img]

[b]There are 3 Strategic Maps to choose from:[/b]

- Western Back Street
- Eastern Intersection
- Southern Redevelopment Area

[b]*Based on the user's average ELO rating, suggested Map may vary.[/b]

[b]How to participate?[/b]

Simply for a team of 3 Users and wait for any available
opponent teams to play with, then select "Challenge"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1110139d0e7a7abe2b3777cd5df13ee0f6bef602.jpg[/img]

[b]Event Information[/b]

Step 1. During the event period, participate basketball league every day.

Step 2. You can exchange the acquired badge for various items.

- If you win once on the regular channel, you will be able to challenge the basketball league.

- The average ELO of the team members identifies the area that can be entered, and the buttons on the
non-entry areas are disabled.

(Each team member's ELO is calculated as the highest ELO score among the same position characters
in the account.)

- Even ELO are changed you can maintain a series of wins in the same area.


[b]Match Rewards:[/b]

Users will receive 4 Badges per win
Users will receive 3 Badges per match loss

*Accumulated Badges can be used to exchange various League rewards

[b]Reward Guide:[/b]

Please refer to the image below for the items that are available for redemption
using a certain amount of Badge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26f71f0ec533932ac1748e49f17c98e798a1e15d.jpg[/img]

- Event rewards are paid to the locker room.

- You can get 4 badges if you win the basketball league and 3 badges if you lose.

(Each two-match win will earn three additional badges.)
- You can exchange badges for items in the locker room 

- The badge will be extinguished after the event, and you will not be able to recover the badge or exchange
items thereafter.


- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Character Changer is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/21514b82140957e537b263d9ab8728ba6f4f0d47.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers!

We would like to inform everyone that [b]Character Changer[/b] is now available!

You can completely change into the Character that you want.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/feca4837a3c747f8ac8ddad7d8f2e4260ada063e.png[/img]

Here are the things you should be aware of before using the Character Changer:

[b]* Once you switch to a certain Character, the Original Character's
Outfit, Cards, and Skills will reset.[/b]

- You may still equip the previous Character's Outfit as long as
it's Gender specific clothing.

[b]* Outfits that cannot be used after switching to a different Character[/b]

- Original Character's Exclusive outfit
- Original Character's Gender outfit

[b]* The new Character of your choice should and will be
converted to the position similar to the Original Character[/b]

- Choosing a different role/position is not available at the moment.
 
[b]* Character Change feature is available for ALL Characters regardless of its
rarity. However, for Characters that were created via Crazy 5 days,
Back to the Court, and Draft Event, users must complete their pending
missions before they can use the Character Changer item.[/b]
 

[b]* Character Changer restriction[/b]

- Switching to your Original Character is not allowed
- Characters currently training in Growth Mode are not eligible
 

[b]* Character Enhancements will be deleted after using Character Changer[/b]
- Character Parts
- Character Enhancement will revert to 0
- Character Enhancement Effect will be removed
- The additional attribute from the original Character
will not be inherited by the new one
- Exclusive Freestyle Skill of the original Character will be removed
- Shooting animation 
 
[b]* After using the Character Changer, it is not possible to switch back to the
original Character so please choose your desired Character wisely.[/b]

You may purchase the Character Changer Item via
Let's Get it Event.

For more details, you may visit the Event link below:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/3201507699814108744]Let's Get it Event Notice[/url]


[b]- FreeStyle2 Team[/b]

We would like to thank everyone for your awesome feedback regarding our recently released feature: Growth Mode!

Most of the feedback that we received from our users is the Match duration which for some, is a bit lengthy.

Well guess what? We heard you and this update will definitely make you use this feature more often!

notes.title: Megapass
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/fb8d0cd74a799b8e29486b956235ca4753bcd0a3.png[/img]

Mega Pass is back for its 21st season!
 
Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive
 
Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!
 
[b]Sale Period:[/b] 
2022/04/13 00:00 - 2022/05/17 23:59 (PDT)
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/eec1922ea615201dc9f4478fe44b9cd3d680043f.gif[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely to those who are able
to level it up completely.
 
Play games and finish up challenges to collect stars to level up your Mega Pass.
 
When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass will reward
the hard work of the player.

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for
590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bad68920701a3b42d59afb24dee9d035032e3f16.jpg[/img]

[b]Revamped Mega Pass:[/b]
 
Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!
 
- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)
 
- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards
 
- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests
 
[b]Note[/b]: Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2fbeff64fe6fdc208da1ed186e5b6934a4e5e174.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both regular and Premium Mega Pass. 
 
[b]How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?[/b] 

You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.
 
Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/03c114d6076265bf3e25946580719e5991f63db9.gif[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.

Noah a.k.a Persona!

He's a rising star in the past.
 
After a traumatic accident, he lost one of his leg.

But with perseverance and relentless attitude, he overcome his terrible experience.
 
Now, he's on Freestyle 2!

Don't be deceived by his cute face.

2. 3on3 Noah is here!: Selected attribute applies [+7] when the
  character is created
3. A.k.a Persona: Movespeed increases by 6 upon character creation
 
Noah also has 3 Parts that will give additional attributes to her:
 
[b]1. Shot Motion:[/b]
 
Noah's Jump Shot and Short Long Dunk Motions get slightly faster.
 
- Jump Shot Motion Speed Up
- Shot Dunk Motion Speed Up
- Long Dunk Motion Speed Up
 
[b]2. Basic Attribute:[/b] 

A portion of Noah's 'Training Points' are increased
 
- 3pt Shot Att, +4
- Middle Shot Att, +4
- Long Layup Att, +4
- Running Speed +4
- Tussle Att, +4
- Block +4
- Rebound +4
- Steal +4
- Stamina +4
 
[b]3. Extended Attribute:[/b]
 
A Portion of Noah's 'Extended Attributes' are increased
 
- 3pt:success% +2
- Mid,shot: success% +2
- Long Layup: range +2
- Steal: motion +2
- Stamina max +2
- Stamina: recovery +2
- Move: Speed +2
- Manual Block: Range +2
 
Don't miss the chance to add this rare SPC to your collection!
 
Wanna know how to recruit Noah in your team?

weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions.

Mega Pass is back for its 18th season!

Complete all the levels and acquire this season's exclusive

Cosmetic Items as well as other goodies!

[b]Sale Period:[/b]

2021/12/29 00:00 - 2021/02/01 23:59 (PST)

[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/49860dd23bbb8d6dd4891bfc15d2125644a229a4.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass rewards players handsomely
to those who are able to level it up completely.

Play games and finish up challenges to collect
stars to level up your Mega Pass.

When reaching certain levels, the Mega Pass
will reward the hard work of the player. 

Players can buy the Premium Mega Pass for
590 GKash which will give them access to
additional quests and more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ffafcc3c0a85dc094df828ecb3939446d1a9c57b.png[/img]

[b]Revamped Mega Pass:[/b]

Now, users can start earning more rewards upon
heading to the next step of Mega Pass rewards!

- Max Tier > Level 40 (Able to proceed to the next Step)

- Purchase Premium to be eligible in getting Premium Rewards

- Premium Quests: Moved to Daily and Weekly Quests

[b]Note:[/b] Users will not be able to gain more
stars on the last week of the Mega Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/40720f43f1616a35c3984e10af4e783d838847ff.jpg[/img]

The Mega Pass contains Tiers for levels. 
 
Every tier there will be a reward for both
regular and Premium Mega Pass. 

How do I Level Up my Mega Pass?
 
You can level up your Mega Pass tiers by collecting stars. 
 
Stars can be acquired by completing daily and
weekly quests, and by completing the Pass Grade Missions. 
 
Once you have completed the quest, you can click
on the quest and a  receive button will appear.

Stars will only be received when you do this,
and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure
to collect your stars as soon as you finish your quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/382e1c918e2ad7ad1d5b0439c96515876359d533.gif[/img]
  
[b]Note:[/b] Please be reminded that at the last week of the event -
levels will no longer be added in any way, this is the time allotted
to players in order to receive their rewards before the event ends.

notes.title: Steam Launcher Crash Fix
notes.content:
Greetings Ballers,

We are aware that there are numerous amount of users who are still having difficulty accessing the game mainly users from Steam platform.

After a deliberate investigation, we found out that the problem occurs when
a user have been running the game as an administrator.

We've come up with a solution and hopefully, it will resolve the issue for those who have been affected. 

For your reference, kindly follow the troubleshooting steps provided below.

1. Type the User Account Control at Windows Search function

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/18f7215341968d8006f3d30697fc0151e9e06cc6.png[/img]

2. Select "Change User Account Control Settings"
3. Check if your bar setting is at the 2nd option from the top where it says “Notify me only when apps try to make changes to my computer (Default)”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f349175b4f7a9fbfc6731b62cfbe06e5051fbab9.png[/img]

4. Restart your Computer and launch Freestyle 2

Manual
 
Check If your Steam.exe is running as Administrator.
Note: It should NOT be accessed as “Run As Administrator”.
 
1. Go to Steam Directory (usually located at “C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam”)
 
2. Find steam.exe
 
3. Right click and select Properties
 
4. Go to Compatibility
 
5. Make sure that “Run As Administrator” is OFF
 
6. Click Apply and OK

We hope this information helps and our sincere apologies for the inconvenience this has caused

- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Crew Takeover Event Season 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6366e0c9e5ebe2bf990a22baf5cfb093a64dff34.png[/img]

This month, gather your Crew members and climb your way to victory!

Crew Rank Takeover is here!

Event Period:

10/22 ~ 10/24 23:59 (PDT)

Event Mechanics:

- Crew Leaders will be given 7 days prior to the Event implementation to
gather Crew members as much as they can
- The 1st Day will commence after our next week's Server Maintenance
- Each day, during server reset (00:00), we will post an update for the Crew
standings via in-game notice and Website notice

Crew Points Calculation:

If 1 Member of the Crew plays a single match = 1 Point
If 1 Member of the Crew plays two matches = 2 Points
If 3 Members of the same Crew plays a single match = 3 Points

It's more beneficial if you play with your comrades to gather huge points per day.

REMINDERS:

1. Once Crew Member 'X' left Crew #1, the total accumulated of matches 'X'
played on that specific date will be removed from Crew #1's Match records.

2. If Crew Member 'X' leaves Crew #1 and joins Crew #2 on the same day
before the server reset (00:00), the number of matches 'X' played on that day
will be transferred to Crew #2 Match records.

3. If Crew Member 'X' leaves Crew #1 and joins Crew #2 on the next day
(after server reset), the numberof matches 'X' played on that day will be
removed but Crew #2 will not also receive the number of matches
'X' played from the previous day when he left Crew #1.

4. In any case that two or more Crews ended up having the same points,
we will choose the winner based on its' overall winning percentage rate.

- Freestyle 2 Team

notes.title: Crew Takeover Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9d74ae5b6c5199afacd63d6f22e642a75256a34f.png[/img]

This month, gather your Crew members and climb your way to victory!

Crew Rank Takeover is here!

[b]Event Period[/b]:

09/01 ~ 09/21 23:59 (PDT)

[b]Event Mechanics[/b]:

- Crew Leaders will be given 7 days prior to the Event implementation to
gather Crew members as much as they can
- The 1st Day will commence after our next week's Server Maintenance
- Each day, during server reset (00:00), we will post an update for the Crew
standings via in-game notice and Website notice

[b]Crew Points Calculation[/b]:

If 1 Member of the Crew plays a single match = 1 Point
If 1 Member of the Crew plays two matches = 2 Points
If 3 Members of the same Crew plays a single match = 3 Points

It's more beneficial if you play with your comrades to gather huge points per day.

REMINDERS:

1. Once Crew Member 'X' left Crew #1, the total accumulated of matches 'X' played on that specific date will be removed from Crew #1's Match records.

2. If Crew Member 'X' leaves Crew #1 and joins Crew #2 on the same day before the server reset (00:00), the number of matches 'X' played on that day will be transferred to Crew #2 Match records.

3. If Crew Member 'X' leaves Crew #1 and joins Crew #2 on the next day(after server reset), the number of matches 'X' played on that day will be removed but Crew #2 will not also receive the number of matches 'X' played from the previous day when he left Crew #1.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/57d24e143f5e56bd66657f6bc3da222f81d3397c.png[/img]

Being a Noble has its perks! Grace and her mega-corporation has developed what
she calls the Enchanted Wallet how this wallet works no really knows except
her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the
world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6e5288b138111793d6b8849eb2ff72f9fc135a86.jpg[/img]

[b]Event Mechanics:[/b]
 
[b]Note: [/b]
 
** Unable to purchase with Event Gkash
** You may only use Regular Gkash for purchasing the Wallet.
** Event Gkash expires after 14 Days from the time of purchase. 

1.) You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets” to participate in
this event and you can only buy one of the wallets for a limited time only
08/25 ~ 09/07 23:59 (Server Time)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/07a637adf5917a77738da0ef15a01e9f3451089f.png[/img]

2.) On your First Day, you will receive Event Gkash!
Log in every day to get Event Gkash each day!

(Log in for 14days and complete the reward list!)
 
[b]Enchanted Wallet (99 Gkash) Reward list [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/e8647e08f071d432e9ba75ba5620ca480799306d.png[/img]

Once you purchase this item, you get the 60 GKash back immediately!
 
You can get up to 320 Event Cash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9bf4c38a46616093d9faecc8a7e5ff4b4b63d733.png[/img]

[b]Enchanted Wallet (980 Gkash) Reward list [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/50c707005eef1c407d49366fccb6f11ce7a38dd6.png[/img]

Once you purchase this item, you get the 500 GKash back immediately!
 
You can get up to 3100 Event Cash!

[b]Note:[/b] The time starts to tick on the day and time when you open the wallet.
To prevent what happened from the previous Grace Wallet Event
here's the reward redemption date for your reference.
 
1. 8/25 00:00 (Activated) ~ 23:59
2. 8/26 00:00 ~ 23:59
3. 8/27 00:00 ~ 23:59
4. 8/28 00:00 ~ 23:59
5. 8/29 00:00 ~ 23:59
6. 8/30 00:00 ~ 23:59
7. 8/31 00:00 ~ 23:59
8. 9/1 00:00 ~ 23:59
9. 9/2 00:00 ~ 23:59
10. 9/3 00:00 ~ 23:59
11. 9/4 00:00 ~ 23:59
12. 9/5 00:00 ~ 23:59
13. 9/6 00:00 ~ 23:59
14. 9/7 00:00 ~ 23:59
 
What is Event Cash and how do I use it?
 
When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.
 
1. Event Cash is the currency you earn from the “Enchanted Wallet” from logging in.
2. If you have more Event Cash than the price of the item Event Cash will be consumed first.
3. If you have fewer Event Cash than the price of the item but have enough Gkash, your regular Gkash will be consumed.
4. If you both don’t have enough Event Cash or regular Gkash you will not be able to purchase the item.
5. Mileage will not be awarded for using Event Cash

notes.title: 1st Balance Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b49ddb08f6436f687cc02582a8d51a566db58bc2.png[/img]

Hello, This is Freestyle 2 Developer.
 
A week has passed since our July Balance Patch.
We have gathered the Play Data for each Position 
and reviewed the parts that we can improve.
 
We have prepared a 1st HotFix for the Balance Patch
on our 7/28 Weekly Maintenance.
 
Please check the details below to avoid any difficulties in playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/26860cd17c4b9e1c01010866d649063047123946.png[/img]

[b]Today’s Hotfix will be mainly based on the improvements for the SG Position.[/b]
 
We will make the improvements to create a more Inside Drive-in and
outside play rather than a previous playstyle.
 
In addition, to make our patch more stabilized, we will continue to improve
our balance through HotFix.

Therefore, please give us various feedbacks for our balance patch.

[b]Please note that the masteries for SG/SF Positions will be reset after the HotFix patch.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/3ab7506fc4d735df29abbd306cc648e66f0fd294.png[/img]

[b]1. BackRoll Turn Master Logic improvements [/b]
 
A. In case of Back Roll Turn Master Timing Fake, if the opponent is half marked, Max 5% Increase 
B. In the case of Back Roll Turn Master Ankle Break, if a shot is released Defense resistance hugely decreased
  - In a case when the defender gets an Ankle break in front of the offender, the phenomenon that
the resistance is still applied has been fixed.
 
[b]2. Swing&Swing Mastery Improvements[/b]
A. Mastery Level 1, Long Layup: range↑ +8 Added in default
 - Mastery Level 3, Long Layup: range↑ +8 Removed
 
B. Mastery Level 5, in Floater Success Rate ↑ Skill,[b] Long Layup: range↑ +4 Added [/b]
 
C. [b]Mastery Level 5, Spin and Drive Skill Added[/b]
D. Mid shot Strengthened
 - Midshot has been decreased and Mid shot related Stats have been adjusted in the Drift Mastery Skill 
E. Mastery Level 7, Drift Pass & Run Skill, [b]Moving Speed increase after Drift Pass 20 Added. [/b]

[b]3. Short Intercept Mastery Skill Stat Improved[/b]

When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.

notes.title: Grace's Enchanted Wallet!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8298320794044c97e14fc50cafa4ecc1b5add23f.png[/img]

Being a Noble has it perks! Grace and her mega-corporation has developed what she calls the“Enchanted Wallet” how this wallet works no really knows except her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/25eff5610c0e543c36008d5dcd82facefc52cffa.png[/img]

Event Mechanics:
 
Note: 
 
** Unable to purchase with Event Gkash
** You may only use [b]Regular Gkash[/b] for purchasing the Wallet.
** Event Gkash expires after [b]14 Days from the time of purchase[/b]. 

1.) You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets”
to participate in this event and you can only buy one of the wallets
for a limited time only 6/29 ~ 7/13 23:59 (Server Time)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec43f7d227f9bf45f114cbd2f90b92906bdfc497.jpg[/img]

2.) On your First Day, you will receive Event Gkash!
Log-in everyday to get Event Gkash each day!

(Log-in for 14days and complete the reward list!)
 
Enchanted Wallet (99 Gkash) Reward list 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b439cc3d266936cc9585beea1173976879e1fed.jpg[/img]

Once you purchase this item, you get the 60 GKash back immediately!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0038e1d61caf996dbf3bb6739b15140e77c0eaba.jpg[/img]

Enchanted Wallet (980 Gkash) Reward list 

Once you purchase this item, you get the 500 GKash back immediately!
 
You can get up to 3100 Event Cash!

[b]Note: [/b]The time starts to tick on the day and time when you open the wallet.
To prevent what happened from the previous Grace Wallet Event
here's the reward redemption date for your reference.
 
1. 06/30 00:00 (Activated) ~ 23:59
2. 07/01 00:00 ~ 23:59
3. 07/02 00:00 ~ 23:59
4. 07/03 00:00 ~ 23:59
5. 07/04 00:00 ~ 23:59
6. 07/05 00:00 ~ 23:59
7. 07/06 00:00 ~ 23:59
8. 07/07 00:00 ~ 23:59
9. 07/08 00:00 ~ 23:59
10. 07/09 00:00 ~ 23:59
11. 07/10 00:00 ~ 23:59
12. 07/11 00:00 ~ 23:59
13. 07/12 00:00 ~ 23:59
14. 07/13 00:00 ~ 23:59
 
[b]What is Event Cash and how do I use it?
[/b] 
When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.
 
1. Event Cash is the currency you earn from the “Enchanted Wallet” from logging-in.
2. If you have more Event Cash than the price of the item Event Cash will be consumed first.
3. If you have fewer Event Cash than the price of the item but have enough Gkash, your regular Gkash  will be consumed.
4. If you both don’t have enough Event Cash or regular Gkash you will not be able to purchase the item.
5. Mileage [b]will not be awarded[/b] for using Event Cash
6. Event Cash [b]will expire after 30 Days depends on the event[/b].
7. To check how much event Gkash you have left and when it expires simply 
mouse over the Gkash icon as seen below.

Stars will only be received when you do this, and the Quests will reset daily and weekly so be sure

notes.title: Grace's Enchanted Wallet!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f2b2529c5fec8e6e7dbad11eded1fcf9fa057fb2.png[/img]

Being a Noble has its perks! Grace and her mega-corporation has developed what she calls the “Enchanted Wallet” how this wallet works no really knows except her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b6d1706f8db27acc30f9fa8b2b1d26dbf290a803.jpg[/img]

Event Mechanics:
 
Note: 
 
** Unable to purchase with Event Gkash
 
** You may only use[b] Regular Gkash[/b] for purchasing the Wallet.
 
** Event Gkash expires after [b]14 Days from the time of purchase. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ae3f0a8581d1180ea674267d6dffc2ccb14a8a90.jpg[/img]

1.) You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets” to participate in this event and you can only buy one of the wallets for a limited time only 4/14 ~ 4/26 23:59 (Server Time)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ec43f7d227f9bf45f114cbd2f90b92906bdfc497.jpg[/img]

2.) On your First Day, you will receive Event Gkash!

Log in every day to get Event Gkash each day!
 
(Log in for 14days and complete the reward list!)
 
Enchanted Wallet (99 Gkash) Reward list 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8b439cc3d266936cc9585beea1173976879e1fed.jpg[/img] 

Once you purchase this item, you get the 60 GKash back immediately!
 
You can get up to 320 Event Cash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f4952119f3a9e2ec5c3cfad47e183cf191053732.jpg[/img]

Enchanted Wallet (980 Gkash) Reward list 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0038e1d61caf996dbf3bb6739b15140e77c0eaba.jpg[/img]

Once you purchase this item, you get the 500 GKash back immediately!
 
You can get up to 3100 Event Cash!

Note: The time starts to tick on the day and time when you open the wallet.
To prevent what happened from the previous Grace Wallet Event
here's the reward redemption date for your reference.

1. 04/14 00:00 (Activated) ~ 23:59
2. 04/15 00:00 ~ 23:59
3. 04/16 00:00 ~ 23:59
4. 04/17 00:00 ~ 23:59
5. 04/18 00:00 ~ 23:59
6. 04/19 00:00 ~ 23:59
7. 04/20 00:00 ~ 23:59
8. 04/21 00:00 ~ 23:59
9. 04/22 00:00 ~ 23:59
10. 04/23 00:00 ~ 23:59
11. 04/24 00:00 ~ 23:59
12. 04/25 00:00 ~ 23:59
13. 04/26 00:00 ~ 23:59
14. 04/27 00:00 ~ 23:59
 
What is Event Cash and how do I use it?
 
When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.
 
1. Event Cash is the currency you earn from the “Enchanted Wallet” from logging in.
2. If you have more Event Cash than the price of the item Event Cash will be consumed first.
3. If you have fewer Event Cash than the price of the item but have enough Gkash, your regular Gkash
    will be consumed.
4. If you both don’t have enough Event Cash or regular Gkash you will not be able to purchase the item.
5. Mileage will not be awarded for using Event Cash
6. Event Cash will expire after 30 Days depends on the event.
7. To check how many events Gkash you have left and when it expires simply 
mouse over the Gkash icon as seen below.

notes.title: Grace's Enchanted Wallet
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b727017ff9e3c8c733bd9cd62cf7e5b5df1174a8.png[/img]

Being a Noble has its perks! Grace and her mega-corporation has developed what she calls the “Enchanted Wallet” how this wallet works no really knows except her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

Event Mechanics:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cb1a10d2d70f0b67bfa555525dd44fb3e2cacf4a.jpg[/img]

1.) You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets” to participate in this event
and you can only buy one of the wallets for a limited time only 2/3~ 2/15 23:59. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d0e9b234f73396014f1af1f0b37e404fc6e349f8.jpg[/img]

2.) On your First Day, you will receive Event Gkash! Log-in every day to get Free Points each day and Event Gkash on the 7th and 14th day. 
 
(Log-in for 14days and complete the reward list!)
 
Enchanted Wallet (10,000 Points) Reward list:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b4d72ff65d23099435d6e047baa7c97f86ecf446.jpg[/img]

Once you purchase this item, you get the 120 GKash back immediately!

You can get up to 17,000 Points and 480 Event Cash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/93a258a207846749d2e886cc1eef7ee5a6c928a6.jpg[/img]

Enchanted Wallet (800 Gkash) Reward list:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/cb1a10d2d70f0b67bfa555525dd44fb3e2cacf4a.jpg[/img]

Once you purchase this item, you get the 800 GKash back immediately!
You can get up to 34,000 Points and 2,300 Event Cash!

[b]Note: [/b]The time starts to tick on the day and time when you open the wallet.

[b]To prevent what happened from the previous Grace Wallet Event
here's the reward redemption date for your reference.

1. 02/03 02:00 (Activated) ~ 23:59
2. 02/04 00:00 ~ 23:59
3. 02/05 00:00 ~ 23:59
4. 02/06 00:00 ~ 23:59
5. 02/7 00:00 ~ 23:59
6. 02/8 00:00 ~ 23:59
7. 02/9 00:00 ~ 23:59
8. 02/10 00:00 ~ 23:59
9. 02/11 00:00 ~ 23:59
10. 02/12 00:00 ~ 23:59
11. 02/13 00:00 ~ 23:59
12. 02/14 00:00 ~ 23:59
13. 02/15 00:00 ~ 23:59
14. 02/16 00:00 ~ 23:59[/b]

What is Event Cash and how do I use it?
 
When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.
 
1. Event Cash is the currency you earn from the “Enchanted Wallet” from logging-in.
2. If you have more Event Cash than the price of the item Event Cash will be consumed first.
3. If you have fewer Event Cash than the price of the item but have enough Gkash, your regular Gkash
    will be consumed.
4. If you both don’t have enough Event Cash or regular Gkash you will not be able to purchase the item.
5. Mileage [b]will not be awarded[/b] for using Event Cash
6. Event Cash [b]will expire after 60 days[/b].
7. To check how many events Gkash you have left and when it expires simply 
mouse over the Gkash icon as seen below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7a9523061e7fe7c1a4ac685e41a9654418b76d5d.jpg[/img]

[i]- FreeStyle 2 Team
[/i]

notes.title: UI Update Adjustments
notes.content:
Greetings Ballers,

The team has been gathering and reading all the feedbacks of the community regarding 
the recent UI Update that was implemented to the game.

With that being said, we have prepared the following UI adjustments. Kindly check the details below:

UI adjustments applied:

[b]A. Chat Font size [/b]

- 1) Chat Font size bigger from the current version.

[b]① Button size[/b]

-  Adjusted the button size bigger that the original version.

[b]② “X” Button[/b]

 - Chat Room turns off if you click the X
- Chat Room only turns off by clicking the button.

[b]③Notification Balloon[/b]

 - While Chat Room is OFF, notification is given in certain chats
 - Chat Type for Notification: Crew, Whisper
 - Notification shows 1~99, and above 99 only shows 99
 - Balloon gets removed when the user opens up the Chat room

Our team is continuously working for the improvement of the game UI and we are more than happy
to read all the feedback and suggestions from you. If you have any suggestions you may send it through our Support Team via CS Ticket.

Joycity Games Support: https://freestyle2.joycitygames.com/support/myquestion

We would like to extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone who shared their insights. 
Let us work together to have the best Freestyle2 experience!

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: 2021 Functional Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ca3459e9f9a0c40329fe93c5e6cb87a89290d825.png[/img]

We have updated the UI and we also have improved some functions in-game!

A. Improved Ranking System

1. Improvement of 'My Records' display

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f86f0e324dd53c7820600d5275d91defba7b6bdd.png[/img]

- Character records will now be displayed even if the character ranking is not included in Top 200.

2. Modify Ranking Motion

- You can now rotate the characters when checking the rank page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/159a9df6cee9aa25093e58e97e2cd390f9c2e9e0.gif[/img]

3. Reposition of Detailed Record Check Box

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/d82d624e55d7793f5b92e90ffaa94683a726e6f4.png[/img]

4. Added new records

- OP, DP, eFG%, TOV, AST

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a77ae3bd406a064f6c48542cf7bc196452ce081a.png[/img]

5. Added Crew info button in the crew ranking

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1218d2a143f4b684a7d94e77e6e5ebfc6f799596.png[/img]

- Click the Crew button to see the details of the crew member contributing to the Crew ranking.

6. Descending / Ascending settings

B. Improve channels

1.  Improved channel selection pop-up window
2. Improvement of channel change icon in the lobby
 
- Channel change phrases are added to the left side of the channel change icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1218d2a143f4b684a7d94e77e6e5ebfc6f799596.png[/img]

- Added indicator alignment function among users in the Top 200 ranking
-  Apply to the rating ranking and detailed history view tabs in 3x3 mode, position items in the crew ranking
 
C. User Interface Improvement
 
1. Add Locker Room Favorites Menu
- Favorites can be set through icons represented on the item thumbnail.
 
2. Added event suggestion from the shop recommendation menu
 
3. Adding gift box filters, sorting, and receiving selections
 
4. Improved icon functionality
- express function icons by item type in item thumbnail area
 
5. Icon drawers
- Where you can check golden bell, sponsor, VIP,Grace Secret Wallet, etc. Place Time Limit Event Icon
 
6. Added character selection screen position filter
 
7. Improved viewing of package components
- Pop-up window representation when component view is selected
 
Check this link to know more about the UI update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/2df327d4e470eb407a2f6e3a3d2154fa7e510788.png[/img]

[Link]: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/339610/view/3046090385081239030
 
Our team will do our best to offer everyone a better Freestyle2 experience!
 
-Team FreeStyle 2

notes.title: Voluntary Accumulation and First Purchase Event
notes.content:
Greetings Basketballers,

We would like to introduce to everyone our new events for newly created accounts!

[h3][b]1. First Purchase Event[/b]
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9fd7a345e04288a35c5b00e2c342f5640a011e5e.png[/img]

Purchase GKash Item and Get a Special Gift!

Event Details:

2020/12/16 00:00 ~

Event Mechanics:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/aa739d3856b6c41cad3f61e8e5f122a6101cb681.jpg[/img]

1. Rewards can be obtained only on the first purchase during the event period.

2. All Reward Items will be sent to the Gift Box.

3. Only one time per account are allowed for this event.

4. The event only reflects when using real GKash.

[b]It will show as "Complete" upon successful purchase:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/50fdc6ecf6425383cc126c25d5ec0f8013f9b65a.jpg[/img]

[b]It will show as "Owned" upon receiving the items:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ff785fb97f4095cdf191167bb3504da5e563bd20.jpg[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] This event is limited only for New Users (Newly Created Accounts)

[h3][b]2. Voluntary Accumulation [/b]
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/bd00c9c68a83c03c1c8df131cc4738882659fd1b.png[/img]

Invest in just a small sum and receive big returns for your future!

Here comes the new event named Voluntary Accumulation that comes with a lot of progression and benefits.

Event Period:
2020/12/16 00:00 ~~

Event Mechanics:

1. You may find the Voluntary Accumulation on the upper right side of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/b7097e16941b278acd760ecb473d9c927a495af6.png[/img]

2. Purchase the Normal Insurance for 495 Gkash. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7088acb6fac963a218d9045a44487679371e7855.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/7c4a1f48049c2a064683dc9b241a33d133603e6d.jpg[/img]

3. Once you purchased the Normal Insurance, complete the Regular Matches
and you will receive up to 2475 Event Gkash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9f9340aa7142fc8a776205d58a9d09be22d9acb7.jpg[/img]

- There are more rewards waiting for you If you purchase Insurance Plus. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/09883901920b8eb8777e0cdb80ffb5e1b58dc9d5.jpg[/img]

- Once you purchase the Insurance Plus, complete the Regular Matches
and you will receive additional rewards up to 7745 Event Gkash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/910cfb1810b642ddcf69c33052b44872727f6346.jpg[/img]

What are you waiting for? Get your Insurance now and receive BIG benefits from it.

- FreeStyle 2 Team

notes.title: 7/29 Balance and Bug Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/8002ad8d1fcfcbd985d92b55bae88d1e58bb950a.png[/img]

Hello This is Freestyle 2 Developer.
 
Please check the following balance and bug fix that will be applied to the game after the
 7/29 maintenance.

[h3][b]Balance Fix[/b][/h3]

1. Range increased when PG’s Face Up Dash is used after using Free Action Bug has
 been fixed.

2. Improved PG's collision motion not to be applied during “Full Speed” preparation time.
 
3. When the Last Resistance was successful by the defender, Shot Resistance applied to
 Put Back Dunk or a Tip In Shot for bounced ball bug has been fixed.

4. Condition for activating Last Resistance when a team defender is standing under 
the rim has been removed (Unable to activate even if your teammate is under the rim)

5. Last Resistance’s Under the rim Condition before 7/22 Patch has been applied 
- We have removed the condition since there was a bigger influence to Swing Strategy 
than the positive aspects of defending ISOs. We will keep on monitoring the 
Swing Strategy and improve it. 

[h3][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h3]

1. Start Up Dash Enhancing Pack Bug Fix
A. Missions not being updated when the possessing number of Enhancing Chip is 
0 has been fixed (Did not have issues when you had 1 or more enhancing chips)

B. The number of Enhancing Chips that weren’t applied will be applied during 
the maintenance.

notes.title: [Freestyle 2 Developer’s Note] July 2020 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/6d3b9ac5a076d85b17378b3720cc9f20f9587a14.png[/img]

Hello, this is Freestyle 2’s developer.

In this balance patch, we have prepared a patch to improve the defensive efficiency of the 3pt play against the iso tactics (including PF ISO), and in certain situations.

There was also an improvement in Pillar tactics last April, and we're trying to adjust this patch to make it more efficient.

[h2][b]A. New Mastery Skills and Updates[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]

[list]

[b]2. Power forward[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Energy Rim Protector Lv5
[*] Increased long dunk manual block Range 30
[*] Decreased Mid. shot success rate 3
[/list]

[b]3. Control Tower[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Quick Lob Catcher Lv7
[*] Increased long dunk manual block range 30
[*] Block attribute 4
[/list]

[b]- Others[/b]
1. For manual long dunks only
2. Not applicable to freestyle dunks.

[h3][b]2. Dunk Shot Resist Master[/b][/h3]
- Skill description: The higher the tussle ability, the greater the resistance to dunk shots.
  
[i][b]- Mastery Attributes[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Added to Heavy Rob Catcher Lv10

[b]3. Control Tower[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Option Man Lv10
[*] Stamina +3
[/list]

[b]- Others[/b]
1. Excludes when defender is on stand (applicable only when defender is in block status)
2. Resistance applies to all dunk types

[h3][b]3. Strengthened Last Resistance[/b][/h3]
- Skill description: Even attackers with high tussle can be given resistance with a certain probability depending on the altitude of ball possession. (However, the resistance probability depends on the attacker's ball possession time.)
[i][b] 
- Mastery Attributes[/b][/i]

[b]1. Center[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Heavy Rob Catcher Lv7
[*] Last-resistance activation rate increased 5
[*] Shadow block Horizontal Range -3
[/list]

[b]2. Power forward[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Energy Lob catcher Lv10
[*] Last-resistance activation rate increased 5
[*] Mid.shot : success%↓  3
[/list]

[b]3. Control Tower[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Option Man Lv5
[*] Last-resistance activation rate increased 5
[*] Block Attribute +2
[/list]

[b]- Others[/b]
1. Activates in probability according to the ball possession time regardless of dunk/layup to the attacker who has tussle exceeding 190 (defenders can resist if the attacker owned the ball for more than 2 seconds) 

[h3][b]4. Shot fake Steal Success Rate Increased[/b][/h3]
- Skill description: If equipped, Steal range increases for Shot Fake and steal success rate increases for 3pt Shot Fake and Jab Step. (However, in case of Jabstep, steal success rate depends on the ball possession time.)

[i][b]- Mastery Attributes[/b][/i]

[b]1. Point Guard[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Quickstep Chaser Lv5
[*] Manual block:range -6
[/list]

[b]2. Dual Guard[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Defensive Style Lv5
[*] 3pt Attribute -3
[/list]

- Others

[h3][b]5. Hun Hun Defense[/b][/h3]
- Skill description: After a certain time, Hun-hun Defense activates, where the character spreads out his or her arms to interrupt the opponent’s shots. (However, if you fail Drive Defense, you reveal a large opening)

[i][b]- Mastery Attributes[/b][/i]

[b]1. Point Guard[/b]
[list]
[*] Added to Atheletic Outlier Lv5
[*] Steal Motion Speed -2
[/list]

2. When Hun-hun defense is activated, the attacker's timing-fake shot defense resistance is greatly reduced.
3. When Hun-hun defense is activated, a shot resistance with a level slightly higher than the normal stand resistance is applied.
4. When shot deny status (with the R key held), 100% angle brake is applied to drive-in dribbles. 

[h3][b]6. Tip in shot, Put Back dunk success rate increased[/b][/h3]
- Skill description: When equipped, increases the success rate of tip in shot and put back dunk.

 [list]

move:collision angle↑ +24  Added (move collision angle attribute Function Applied)

notes.title: 04/08 Balance Patch Hot Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/1510635d609bfa463c9c065d07ed0478757cde07.png[/img]

Hello This is Freestyle 2 Developer.

After the balance patch, we have been checking the areas that were difficult to adapt to, and we're going to put a hotfix by organizing the areas that need to be complemented.

[h3][b]PF [/b][/h3]

1. Last Resistance set as F Key 

2. Beyond Screen Dunk
(1) Screen Mid Shot Resistance Decrease added
(2) Dunk Block Resistance Rate 15 -> 20

**We will be consistently adjusting the parts that could give adequate balance for Pillar Strategy. 

[h3][b]SG[/b][/h3]
1. Back Roll Turn Master Ankle Break Relieved 

(1) When defender is standing, Ankle break Check Range shortened 
-> Activates Ankle Break when Defender’s Standing status is within a certain range.

(2) Ankle Break Activation Rate Lowered corresponding to the distance with the defender

**When Ankle breaks with Back Roll Turn Master Mastery’s Back Roll turn Speed and Timing Fake, majority of users have faced difficulties in defending, more than expected rate. 

Therefore, we have adjusted the Ankle Break to relieve the defending difficulties, we will consistently review the Swing SG Plays in the top tiers and adjust it to create a better efficiency. 

[h3][b]
SF [/b][/h3]
1. Technical Shot Master
(1) When used with Drift Shot, Speed Increased 3 -> 5

2. Drift Shot Speed Upgrade
(1) Drift Shot Motion Speed 7 -> 5

3. Drift Shot Release Point Upgrade
(2) Drift Shot Release Point 10 -> 7

**We have progressed an adjustment to the Drift Shot Upgrade Mastery like the SG’s Back Roll Turn Mastery since there were higher effectiveness to the offense than intended. 

[h3][b]DG[/b][/h3]

1. Athletic Style Mastery Adjustment 
(1) Lv7 Baseball Pass
- Block +4 -> Block -4 (Changed)
- Pass +10 (Added)

2. Drive in Jumper
(1) Shot Release Point Increase

**High Block Mastery of DG as a Ball Handler Roll style is still having a greater effectiveness than intended. Therefore, to run a Ball Handler Roll we have added Pass Att to increase the pass play style, however, decreased the block effectiveness when selecting Baseball Pass. In addition, to give more diverse selection in offense, we have increased the release point for Drive In Jumper. 

[h3][b]PG[/b][/h3]
1. Perfect Pass
 (1) When Perfect Pass succeeds, Block Resistance ↑ Increased 

**We have increased the effectiveness of Perfect Pass for PG. 
The development team will continue to analyze the user’s play and improve it according to the direction as much as possible. Thank you very much

notes.title: Balance Patch Direction
notes.content:
Greetings Ballers,

This Balance Patch Note, is the Direction that our developers are thinking of for our next Balance Patch. We would like to share to everyone the Balance Patch notes before implementing it to our game because we want to hear the community feedback regarding this.

The names for new skills are tentative, which may have some changes when it is applied to the game.

Please take your time to read and go through the Balance Patch Note.
We will be starting our survey soon, and the survey will be based on the information below. 

[h1]Changes in All Positions[/h1]

[b]1. Jabstep[/b]
A. “Shot Delay after Jab Step” 1 Frame Increased

[b]2. Turnaround Fade Away[/b]
A. 10% of Decrease in default motion speed

[b]3. Hook shot Speed (Mastery Skill)[/b]
A. Hook shot Speed 46 -> 43
[b]
4. Last Resistance (New Skill), [i](Tentative Name)[/i][/b]

[i]A. Skill description[/i]
- When an offense player drives in and makes an inside play with a shot, Defence player with Last Resistance tries to resist the shot behind the offense player with a certain probability
- Activates when there is no player other than the offense player under the goal post.
- However, Resistance cannot be applied to an offense player with a high tussle.
- Activation type: Lay-up (including scoop shots), dunk, double clutch, triple clutch, double clutch dunk

[i]B. Position[/i]
i. Given as Basic Skill
- Last Resistance Lv1 : PG, DG
- Last Resistance Lv2 : C, PF, CT
- Shot resistance varies in Skill Level.

[i]C. Skill Details[/i]
i. Arrow Key facing the offense player + F behind the offender's back

ii. Only activates when there is no player other than the offense player under the goal post.
      ① If failed, activates basic block failure motion

iii. Unable to resist to an offense plater with higher tussle
      ① If resistance fails, shows “Last Resistance Unavailable’ ASA

iv. If resistance succeeds, shows 'Last Resistance Succeeded ‘ASA

v. Shot type available for Last Resistance;
Lay-up, dunk, double clutch, triple clutch, double clutch dunk.

[b]5. Screen Kill Pass (New Active Skill)[/b]

[i]A. Skill Description[/i]
Kill pass is possible within the screen range.

[i]B. Position[/i]
i. SF, SG, SW, PF

[i]C. Skill Details[/i]
i. Kill-pass available within the range of your team member’s screen.

notes.content:
[url=bit.ly/FS2GLTWxPH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/ee0c9fc18f994636ee1548b08806e6785131f878.png[/img][/url]

We know you are excited to show off your skills to the rest of the World and to prove your supremacy! Here are the details for the Global League Application for ballers in Taiwan and Philippines

*Please kindly read the application rules carefully.

Application Link: [url=bit.ly/FS2GLTWxPH]bit.ly/FS2GLTWxPH[/url]

Application Period: 2/12 - 2/18 23:59 (PST)

[h1]Brackets:[/h1]
Brackets will be uploaded by February 24th

Brackets may be uploaded before or after the scheduled time and date.

[h1]League:[/h1]
TOP 8 : WIN 1 MATCH
TOP 4 : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES
FINALS : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES

[i]** All Games will be Played in 1 Day, if your team fails to show up, your team members will not get the chance to apply for the next FS2 Global League.[/i]

[h1]Tournament Schedule:[/h1]

[h3]February 27th[/h3]

Server Time: 4:00 AM (PST)
China Standard Time: 8:00 PM (CST)
Philippine Standard Time: 8:00 PM (PHT)

[h1]Requirements:[/h1]

1. Team leader should apply for the team and submit the application with the team members’ information, once the application is sent all team members should not apply in another team.

2. If the team needs changes to the application, the team leader should use the “Team Adjustment” time between 2/19 00:00 to 2/23 00:00 (PST)  and send the final 
adjustment to luxorthegm@gmail.com.

The GM will reply to the team leader back when the GM has confirmed the Team Adjustment Mail sent by the Team Leader. GMs will try to check the email as many times as possible during the “Team Adjustment” Period, and help the team to adjust their teams. However, GM does not take responsibility for the adjustments email sent before or after the Team Adjustment Period.

3. Each character that is registered in one of the FS2 Global League Teams is not allowed to apply for other countries during the same FS2 Global League.

4. Please do not change your Character name once you have applied for this Global League. Changing your character name will lead you to lose your chance to play in the league, moreover, if your character name has been changed during the Global League, your name may be missed out in the Rewardee List. GMs and FS2 Team does not have the responsibility of you losing the chance to win the Rewards if you have changed your Character Name.

[i]***If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, and will not be able to participate in the next FS2GL as penalty. Please be sure to show up on time.[/i]

[h1]How are the Participating Teams selected?[/h1]

[b]First Come First Serve.[/b]

Teams with 3 Main Players and 1 Sub Player (4 Members in Total)

(It is not necessary that each team members belong to the same crew, Join with your friends!)

If the team has made some changes, please use the Team Adjustment Period to change the lineups!

Teams that reapply during the application period will have their prior applications deleted. The new application will reset your registered date and time to the time you have resent.
Therefore please make sure you do not make a mistake in registering your application with correct character information.

[h1]Event Rules[/h1]

1. All participants must be in the Tournament Channel lobby  at the exact Event time. 
(Time for each match will be announced later) 

2. Once you are invited to your team waiting room, please invite your teammates to the room.

3. If one of your team member does not show up on time, you may call your substitute player that you signed in when you applied for the FS2GL

4. If there are no sub players who can cover for your team and if there are not enough members to start the match, your team will lose automatically.

***However, if the match is a Top 8 Match, the Team No.9 will get the chance to participate the Global League.

5. No 3rd party program is allowed in the league. (If we detect such programs, the team will not be able to participate in the tournament anymore and the violators  will be suspended)

6. Only a total of 5 mins of preparation time will be given for each team to prepare for the tournament match. 

7. Only the Team Leader can write an application for this league.

8. If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, Please be sure to show up on time.

9. In the event that a team member is absent to the league, we will forbid the missing member's account from joining the next tournament as penalty. 

10. If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume from where the match has been left off. However if the baller does not return in 10 minutes and if there is no other registered Sub players in the team, the team will be disqualified.

11. We will only allow two (2) tries for a player that is having technical difficulties in joining the game.  If the player is unable to join on the second try, we will advise the team to call on their subs or they will be automatically disqualified from the FS2GL.

12. Ballers who are under investigation for hack are not allowed to join the tournament. We will advise the team leader to change the team member if in any case the user is found in the application.

13. Players may change their Skill Set/Equipped Outfits before and after the match. Players should not quit the game intentionally to take advantage to change their Character Set-up. We will not allow a player or a team to change their Equipped Skills if a player has been disconnected.

14. If we found out that any of their members used a different Character that is not registered to their team roster, the said team should be disqualified from the Tournament.

15. In order to run the League, if any of the team members in your team shows a certain action or an act that is suspicious for using an illegal third party program (hack, abuse in any internet network), your team will be disqualified immediately. And we do not have the responsibility for the result you have made.

** Event details may change depending on the situation.

[i][b]**Winning Team will be written at the back.
** The design of the back may change due to the length of the Team Name.[/b][/i]

[b][h1]1st Place[/h1][/b]
- 50,000 Event GKash
- FS2GL Winner Outfit * 1
- FS2GL 1st Place Title * 1
- Premium Sub Attribute Changer * 20
- Premium Prism * 10

[b][h1]2nd Place[/h1][/b]
- 20,000 Event GKash
- FS2GL 2nd Place Title * 1
- Premium Sub Attribute Changer * 10
- Premium Prism Card * 5

[b][h1]3rd Place[/h1][/b]
- 10,000 Event GKash
- FS2GL 3rd Place Title * 1
- Premium Sub Attribute Changer * 5

notes.title: FS2 Global League : Russia and Europe Application Form
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/0b5c949307a9d88900b97dd0d233bfb316ba9341.png[/img]

We know you are excited to show off your skills to the rest of the World and 
to prove your supremacy! Here are the details for the Global League Application
for ballers in Russia and Europe!

*Please kindly read the application rules carefully.

Application Link: http://bit.ly/30KKME7

Application Period: 1/22 - 1/28 23:59 (PST)

[h1]Brackets:[/h1]
Brackets will be uploaded by February 3rd

Brackets may be uploaded before or after the scheduled time and date.

[h1]League:[/h1]
TOP 8 : WIN 1 MATCH
TOP 4 : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES
FINALS : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES

[i]** All Games will be Played in 1 Day, if your team fails to show up, your team members will not get the chance to apply for the next FS2 Global League.[/i]

[h1]Tournament Schedule:[/h1]

Central European Time (CET) : 20:00 6th of February
Pacific Standard Time (PST) : 11:00 6th of February

[h1]Requirements:[/h1]

1. Team leader should apply for the team and submit the application with the team members’ information, once the application is sent all team members should not apply in another team.

2. If the team needs changes to the application, the team leader should use the “Team Adjustment” time between 1/29 00:00 to 2/2 (PST)  and send the final 
adjustment to luxorthegm@gmail.com.

The GM will reply the team leader back when the GM has confirmed the Team Adjustment Mail sent by the Team Leader. GMs will try to check the email as many times as possible during the “Team Adjustment” Period, and help the team to adjust their teams. However, GM does not take responsibility for the adjustments email sent before or after the Team Adjustment Period.

3. Each character that is registered in one of the FS2 Global League Teams is not allowed to apply for other countries during the same FS2 Global League.

4. Please do not change your Character name once you have applied for this Global League. Changing your character name will lead you to lose your chance to play in the league, moreover, if your character name has been changed during the Global League, your name may be missed out in the Rewardee List. GMs and FS2 Team does not have the responsibility of you losing the chance to win the Rewards if you have changed your Character Name.

[i]***If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, and will not be able to participate in the next FS2GL as penalty. Please be sure to show up on time.[/i]

[h1]How are the Participating Teams selected?[/h1]

[b]First Come First Serve.[/b]

Teams with 3 Main Players and 1 Sub Player (4 Members in Total)

(It is not necessary that each team members belong to the same crew, Join with your friends!)

If the team has made some changes, please use the Team Adjustment Period to change the lineups!

Teams that reapply during the application period will have their prior applications deleted. The new application will reset your registered date and time to the time you have resent.
Therefore please make sure you do not make a mistake in registering your application with correct character information.

[h1]Event Rules[/h1]

1. All participants must be in the Tournament Channel lobby  at the exact Event time. 
(Time for each match will be announced later) 

2. Once you are invited to your team waiting room, please invite your teammates to the room.

3. If one of your team member does not show up on time, you may call your substitute player that you signed in when you applied for the FS2GL

4. If there are no sub players who can cover for your team and if there are not enough members to start the match, your team will lose automatically.

***However, if the match is a Top 8 Match, the Team No.9 will get the chance to participate the Global League.

5. No 3rd party program is allowed in the league. (If we detect such programs, the team will not be able to participate in the tournament anymore and the violators  will be suspended)

6. Only a total of 5 mins of preparation time will be given for each team to prepare for the tournament match. 

7. Only the Team Leader can write an application for this league.

8. If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, Please be sure to show up on time.

9. In the event that a team member is absent to the league, we will forbid the missing member's account from joining the next tournament as penalty. 

10. If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume from where the match has been left off. However if the baller does not return in 10 minutes and if there is no other registered Sub players in the team, the team will be disqualified.

11. We will only allow two (2) tries for a player that is having technical difficulties in joining the game.  If the player is unable to join on the second try, we will advise the team to call on their subs or they will be automatically disqualified from the FS2GL.

12. Ballers who are under investigation for hack are not allowed to join the tournament. We will advise the team leader to change the team member if in any case the user is found in the application.

13. Players may change their Skill Set/Equipped Outfits before and after the match. Players should not quit the game intentionally to take advantage to change their Character Set-up. We will not allow a player or a team to change their Equipped Skills if a player has been disconnected.

14. If we found out that any of their members used a different Character that is not registered to their team roster, the said team should be disqualified from the Tournament.

15. In order to run the League, if any of the team members in your team shows a certain action or an act that is suspicious for using an illegal third party program (hack, abuse in any internet network), your team will be disqualified immediately. And we do not have the responsibility for the result you have made.

** Event details may change depending on the situation.

** The design of the back may change due to the length of the Team Name.[/b][/i]
