notes.title: [Freestyle 2 Developer’s Note] December Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/810b8c4f9e35997b998455b9fa3b7d9d01d4caaf.png[/img]

Hello
This is Freestyle 2 Developer.

We only have a few days of the year 2019. How was your 2019?
We had various changes and updates to our Freestyle 2. We would like to end our 2019 with the following contents below.
[h1]
1. Balance Hot Fix[/h1]
First, we have progressed a balance hot fix. Improved the problems that needed to be filled out made in our last Balance Patch. We will continuously reflect the things in order to bring out more fun game plays.

[b]A.	Center[/b]
1) Shadow Block Catch Success Rate Decreased
2) Shadow Block Dunk Success Rate slightly decreases

[b]B.	Shooting Guard[/b]
1) Side hop step Mastery Changes
a) Side Hop Step Motion Speed Increased [i](Motion Speed -24 -> -12)[/i]

[b]C.	Small Forward[/b]
1) Technical Shot Master Feature Added
a) When drift shot is used, Shot Speed slightly increases
(not applied in pivot)

[h1]2. Card Stress Relief #3[/h1]
A #3 Update has been made that we have been progressing starting from our October Patch.
In our 3rd update, the previous pkgs will be continuously given. Additionally, we have released a Card Sub Att item that can lock one of your sub attributes during the time when sub attribute changer is used. The Item Is exclusive for Allstar World Cards, therefore please have a look and enjoy.

[h1]3. Mentoring Day Event Released[/h1]
We have prepared a mentoring day event to make our New and Starting users to adapt to our FS2 Game easily. Please check out the event details in our game or in our event post.

[h1]4. Crew Updates[/h1]
A few features have been improved in our Crew Features. Various features and responsibilities have been added in Crew Management, please enjoy the crew system. We do know that this update also may be not enough; we will continuously improve our crew system.

[h1]5. Feedbacks Applied[/h1]
Recently and also in an everyday basis, we have been gathering up various feedback from lots of routes including Facebook, Website tickets, steam email support, etc.
We were able to update daily quest rewards, item exchange from stacked up card upgrade spray, increased the number of user blocks, Delete Feature of items in the locker room, Replay Improvements. Please give us more various feedbacks that has given you difficulties. We will continue to listen to our users’ feedback and prepare an update for those.

Merry Christmas and we wish you have a great New Year in 2020.

Thank you

We know you are excited to show off your skills to the rest of the World and to prove your supremacy! Here are the details for the Global League Application!

TOP 8 : WIN 1 MATCH
TOP 4 : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES
FINALS : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES

[i]** All Games will be Played in 1 Day, if your team fails to show up, your team members will not get the chance to apply for the next FS2 Global League.[/i]

[h1]Tournament Schedule:[/h1]
December 26th 
Server Time : 9:00PM (PST)

[h1]Requirements:[/h1]

1. Team leader should apply for the team and submit the application with the team members’ information, once the application is sent all team members should not apply in another team.

2. If the team needs changes to the application, the team leader should use the “Team Adjustment” time between 12/18 00:00 to 12/22 20:00 (PST) and send the final 
adjustment to luxorthegm@gmail.com.

The GM will reply the team leader back when the GM has confirmed the Team Adjustment Mail sent by the Team Leader. GMs will try to check the email as many times as possible during the “Team Adjustment” Period, and help the team to adjust their teams. However, GM does not take the responsibility for the adjustments email sent before or after the Team Adjustment Period.

3. Each character that is registered in one of the FS2 Global League Teams is not allowed to apply for other countries during the same FS2 Global League.

4. Please do not change your Character name once you have applied for this Global League. Changing your character name will lead you to lose your chance to play in the league, moreover, if your character name has been changed during the Global League, your name may be missed out in the Rewardee List. GMs and FS2 Team does not have the responsibility of you losing the chance to win the Rewards if you have changed your Character Name.

[i]***If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, and will not be able to participate in the next FS2GL as penalty. Please be sure to show up on time.[/i]

[h1]How are the Participating Teams selected?[/h1]

[b]First Come First Serve.[/b]

Teams with 3 Main Players and 1 Sub Player (4 Members in Total)

(It is not necessary that each team members belong to the same crew, Join with your friends!)

If the team has made some changes, please use the Team Adjustment Period to change the lineups!

Teams that reapply during the application period will have their prior applications deleted. The new application will reset your registered date and time to the time you have resent.

[h1]Event Rules[/h1]

2. Once you are invited to your team waiting room, please invite your teammates to the room.

3. If one of your team member does not show up on time, you may call your substitute player that you signed in when you applied for the FS2GL

4. If there are no sub players who can cover for your team and if there are not enough members to start the match, your team will lose automatically.

***However, if the match is a Top 8 Match, the Team No.9 will get the chance to participate the Global League.

5. No 3rd party program is allowed in the league. (If we detect such programs, the team will not be able to participate in the tournament anymore and the violators  will be suspended)

6. Only a total of 5 mins of preparation time will be given for each team to prepare for the tournament match. 

7. Only the Team Leader can write an application for this league.

8. If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, Please be sure to show up on time.

9. In the event that a team member is absent to the league, we will forbid the missing member's account from joining the next tournament as penalty. 

10. If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume from where the match has been left off. However if the baller does not return in 10 minutes and if there is no other registered Sub players in the team, the team will be disqualified.

11. We will only allow two (2) tries for a player that is having technical difficulties in joining the game.  If the player is unable to join on the second try, we will advise the team to call on their subs or they will be automatically disqualified from the FS2GL.

12. Ballers who are under investigation for hack are not allowed to join the tournament. We will advise the team leader to change the team member if in any case the user is found in the application.

13. Players may change their Skill Set/Equipped Outfits before and after the match. Players should not quit the game intentionally to take an advantage to change their Character Set-up. We will not allow a player or a team to change their Equipped Skills if a player has been disconnected.

14. If we found out that any of their members used a different Character that is not registered to their team roster, the said team should be disqualified from the Tournament.

notes.title: 2019.12.4th Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/f2dbbc9b8c28e8761acd5d5a0934ce865240ca26.png[/img]

Hello!

This is the Freestyle 2 Developer.

How are you guys doing? The Winter Season has arrived! And our last month of 2019 is here now.

We’ve came up with another Developer’s Note after our previous 10/30 Developer’s note.

Previously, we have indicated a few things about our developing phases and our directions. In this November Patch, the developer’s note will be regarding what we have thought of the changes made by our users from 10/30 patch.

[h1][b]1. Card Stress Relief #2[/b][/h1]
From our 1st Card Stress Relief (Joycity’s giveaway pkg, char. Creation pkg, and the card upgrade condition removal) on the 10/30, we have decided to give an extension to the events in order to give more users benefits from the card stress relief. A lot of our users loved the 1st Act and we would want to extend the period.

In addition, we have changed our Card Balls’ Card Reward Grades, setting up the Legend Pro cards as the lowest Card grades that you can get in the reward. We’ve also removed the “Enhanced Prism Card” Condition in the main slot at the Card Creation page. This was made to provide easier chances for our users to upgrade their cards to Allstar Pro Cards.

The chances in collecting Card Materials for Card Creation became much easier than before, and the removal of enhanced prism card requirement would relieve card stresses that our users had.

We aren’t stopping here; the Card Stress Relief #3 is indeed scheduled.

[h1][b]2. Ranking[/b][/h1]
The biggest fun in PVP game would be Ranking, however, our Ranking page wasn’t able to show enough to create fun activities, therefore we have prepared a separate Ranking Contents Page to the UI Menu instead of a small button which was placed next to the character.

Ranking page is divided into 3 pages, the MMR, the Record, and the Crew.

- MMR Ranking: A Rank that shows 100% of the users’ ELO scores.
Previously there was an Added Value Points which made confusion to the Ranking page, therefore we have removed the added value points to show pure rank, based on their proficiency of the game.

- Record Ranking: A Rank that shows the records in the Season.

- Crew Ranking: A Rank that shows crews with rankings based on the crew members’ MMR Ranking.

 Each Ranking Season starts from the 1st day and ends on the last day of the month. The character registers in the Ranking based on 3 Matches played per a day. (the character gets excluded from the Ranking when the character has not played or met the 3 matches / day requirement.

-EX 1) Users should play the following to have their characters registered,
1 Day 3 Matches, 10 Days 30 Matches, 30 Days 90 Matches 

-EX 2) Even if the character does not play after playing 9 matches in the 1st day, the character will still be registered until the 3rd day of the season.

-EX 3) If the character did not play 12 matches or above on the 4th day of the season, the character will be removed from the ranking.

-EX 4) If you have played 90 Matches in 1 Day (just an example) in the 1st week of the month, the ranking will stay even if you did not play until the 30th Day.
The Days will differ in which Month Season you are playing at, for December season, since we have 31 days, the user needs to play 93 matches to be ranked until the last day.

Please read the Help Page in the Ranking for further information.

[b][h1]1. Balance Patch[/h1][/b]

This balance patch is the basis of Freestyle 2.

The primary goal is to develop an easy-to-follow swing tactical play.

In the future, we will continue to make it easier and more efficient to play.

Based on the balance patch we’ve made, we will improve in a variety of ways to gradually improve the particular positions with low winning rate and population.
To balance the various tactics, we will try not to make nerf patches as much as we can. And solve the problems by buffing alternative and other tactics and adding a number of interactive tactical events.

After the patch, we will gather opinions from the users through various ways and continue to reflect it in the game.

Please support us and give us your opinion.

Thank you.


[h1][b]Detailed Balance Patch[/b][/h1]

[i][b][Mutual changes][/b][/i]

[b]1. All Masteries Level 10 Applied[/b]
- When your character level gets up to 24, all masteries will open up to level 10.
- Masteries is one of the biggest impacts to the current Balance, changes were made to have our users experience all masteries.

[b]2. Attacking Time 24 Secs -> 22 Secs[/b]
- Reducing the time contains various meanings. A much speedier attacking style, changes to the strategy and method, restraining particular play style, etc will be made by reducing the time.
- However, there will be a huge risk if we reduce with a big amount of time, therefore we will be considering the time adjustments by gathering and reviewing the related data and the style changes made after the patch.

[b]3. Paint Zone Deny Intercept Rate Adjustments [/b]
- By reducing the attacking time, one of the things we were worried about was the Unintentional Nerf to the Swing Strategy. 
 We thought the play must not be stressful and too nervous, but must be speedy and smooth.
- We have first reduced the Deny Intercept Rate in the Paint Zone, to make 2nd attack and return play much easier.

[b]4. Score Buff adjustment[/b]
- We have improved the score buffs because we believe buff-related systems for light user care often adversely affected the current play method when the score is higher than a certain point difference.

[b]5. Improved Post-up quick change skill (Timing Reliefs)[/b]

[i][b]
[Skill Changes][/b]
[/i]

[b]1. PF[/b]

- Control Improvements, easier attacks are improved for Light users.

[i]A. My way Dunk Focus 1 (Passive) Skill Added[/i]
 1) Able to Dunk in a pivot, only Straight front dunks are available (but with lower success rate)

 2) Straight Front dunk activates when F Key is pressed even without an arrow key								
											
[i]B. Dunk Upgrade, Dunk Focus given as basic skills[/i]
											
[b]2. C[/b]

- We have reduced the applied tussle stats which made Screen Upgrade_2's tussle too aggressive and improved to show the true identity of a "Center"
- To enhance the pass play, we've given kill pass to C and expect the center to be in the central role.

[i]A. Kill Pass Skill Added[/i]
1) Kill Pass: speed +12							
										
[i]B. SP Dunk Success% II, Dunk Focus given as Basic Skills	[/i]		

[i]C. Shadow Block Rate slightly uplifted		[/i]	
[i]											
D. Shadow Block&Catch I Skill Added	[/i]			
1) When Shadow Blocks, Shadow Block&Catch Skill activates at a certain rate.
2) When Shadow Block&Catch Skill activates the character grabs the ball.	

[i]E. Mastery Screen2 Upgrade Range reduced[/i]
1) If the physical check increases, the increasing range reduces													

[b]3. SF[/b]

- Based on the analysis of the overall balance data, we have determined that we need to improve the performance of our current SF.
- We've improved the ability to effective attack in swing strategy.

[i]A. Quick Change 2 Skill Added[/i]
1) Quick change is possible in all directions when not moving.
2) Quick change can be activated in 90 degrees to the moving direction while moving
3) Unable to equip Quick Change 2 if Away Screen Move Skill is equipped.

[i]B. SF Technical Shot Master 1 Skill Added[/i]
1) Drift shot can be used in a pivot
2) Backward to step, back dribble, Spin and Drive. Drift shot after Two Step and Fade away skill available after Technical Shot Master skill activates.
3) Unable to equip when Away Screen Move Skill is equipped
4) Reduced success rate and defense resistance when fade away skill made after the Technical Shot Master Skill.


[b]4. SG[/b]
		
-  Based on the analysis of the overall balance data, we have determined that we need to improve the performance of the SG in Swing Strategy.
-  Improved to efficiently attack while using swing strategy


[i]A. Quick Change 2 Skill Added[/i]
1) Quick change is possible in all directions when not moving.
2) Quick change can be activated in 90 degrees to the moving direction while moving
3) Unable to equip Quick Change 2 if Away Screen Move Skill is equipped.												

[i]B. Long Range Skill Given as Basic Skill	[/i]
														
[i]C. Tripping Prevention Skill Added 	[/i]
1) You may fall when colliding with an opponent character with high tussle stats,											

[i]D. Side Hop Step Mastery Skill Added 	[/i]															

[i]E. Crazy Step Improvements[/i]
1) At certain area if Crazy step is used while Drive Dribble, changed to have Drive Dribble to activate first. 

[b]5. PG [/b]

- PG's position has been reduced in strategic parts.
- We will gradually improve the PG's Balance to melt into various strategies. 

[i]A. No Mark Shot Skill Given	[/i]									
B. Diving Catch Skill Stat Added										
1) Diving Catch: Fail↓ +12 Added									

[b]6. DG[/b]

- Improved the smaller risk in selecting Athletic Style Mastery than other masteries.

[i]A. Added extra points in reducing Still Attributes	[/i]												
	1) Level 1: Steal -10												
	2) Level 7: Steal -5 -> Steal -7												
	3) Level 10: Steal -6 -> Steal -7												


[b]7. SW [/b]

- Added Risk in Swing Man's Powerful Drive in when used in Strategies other than swing

[i]A. Tripping Prevention Fail Condition Added [/i]
1) Tripping Prevention Failure Rate Added when colliding with a player with high tussle. 

We believe this single patch cannot show the full thoughts of the path we're heading to. However, we would like to show improvements little by little.

There is no answer to the balance,
we will show the changes by opening our ears, considering and reviewing one by one to fulfill our users and provide a fun game play.

[b][h1][Bug Fix][/h1][/b]

SF Dash Rebound inactivated in certain condition is fixed
PF Dash Chip out inactivated in certain condition is fixed
Character’s Speed getting slow after receiving the pass from a situation when pass and still is used simultaneously is fixed.

notes.title: FS2 Global League : Vietnam & Indonesia Application Form
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/9199a59674508ba917833b0e09a2eb0e9f1104a8.png[/img]

We know you are excited to show off your skills to the rest of the World and to prove your supremacy! Here are the details for the Global League Application!

*Please kindly read the application rules carefully.

Application Link: https://bit.ly/37f9K18

Application Period: 11/20 - 11/26 23:59 (PST)

[h1]Brackets:[/h1]
Brackets will be uploaded by Dec 2nd
Brackets may be uploaded before or after the scheduled time and date.

[h1]League:[/h1]
TOP 8 : WIN 1 MATCH
TOP 4 : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES
FINALS : WIN 2 MATCHES in 3 GAMES

[i]** All Games will be Played in 1 Day, if your team fails to show up, your team members will not get the chance to apply for the next FS2 Global League.[/i]

[h1]Tournament Schedule:[/h1]
December 5th

Hanoi Vietnam, Western Indonesian Time: 8:00P.M.

Server Time : 5:00AM (PST)

[h1]Requirements:[/h1]

1. Team leader should apply for the team and submit the application with the team members’ information, once the application is sent all team members should not apply in another team.

2. If the team needs changes to the application, the team leader should use the “Team Adjustment” time between 11/30 00:00 to 12/01 20:00 (PST) and send the final adjustment to steam_support@gamekiss.com

The GM will reply the team leader back when the GM has confirmed the Team Adjustment Mail sent by the Team Leader. GMs will try to check the email as many times as possible during the “Team Adjustment” Period, and help the team to adjust their teams. However, GM does not take the responsibility for the adjustments email sent before or after the Team Adjustment Period.

3. Each character that is registered in one of the FS2 Global League Teams is not allowed to apply for other countries during the same FS2 Global League.

4. Please do not change your Character name once you have applied for this Global League. Changing your character name will lead you to lose your chance to play in the league, moreover, if your character name has been changed during the Global League, your name may be missed out in the Rewardee List. GMs and FS2 Team does not have the responsibility of you losing the chance to win the Rewards if you have changed your Character Name.

[i]***If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, and will not be able to participate in the next FS2GL as penalty. Please be sure to show up on time.[/i]

[h1]How are the Participating Teams selected?[/h1]

[b]First Come First Serve.[/b]

Teams with 3 Main Players and 1 Sub Player (4 Members in Total)

(It is not necessary that each team members belong to the same crew, Join with your friends!)

[h1]Event Rules[/h1]

1. All participants must be in the Tournament Channel lobby  at the exact Event time. 
(Time for each match will be announced later) 

2. Once you are invited to your team waiting room, please invite your teammates to the room.

3. If one of your team member does not show up on time, you may call your substitute player that you signed in when you applied for the FS2GL

4. If there are no sub players who can cover for your team and if there are not enough members to start the match, your team will lose automatically.

***However, if the match is a Top 8 Match, the Team No.9 will get the chance to participate the Global League.

5. No 3rd party program is allowed in the league. (If we detect such programs, the team will not be able to participate in the tournament anymore and the violators  will be suspended)

6. Only a total of 5 mins of preparation time will be given for each team to prepare for the tournament match. 

7. Only the Team Leader can write an application for this league.

8. If your Teammates do not show up on the League Day and before the match time. All of your team members will lose by default as a result, Please be sure to show up on time.

9. In the event that a team member is absent to the league, we will forbid the missing member's account from joining the next tournament as penalty. 

10. If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume from where the match has been left off. However if the baller does not return in 10 minutes and if there is no other registered Sub players in the team, the team will be disqualified.

11. We will only allow two (2) tries for a player that is having technical difficulties in joining the game.  If the player is unable to join on the second try, we will advise the team to call on their subs or they will be automatically disqualified from the FS2GL.

12. Ballers who are under investigation for hack are not allowed to join the tournament. We will advise the team leader to change the team member if in any case the user is found in the application.

13. Players may change their Skill Set/Equipped Outfits before and after the match. Players should not quit the game intentionally to take an advantage to change their Character Set-up. We will not allow a player or a team to change their Equipped Skills if a player has been disconnected.

14. If we found out that any of their members used a different Character that is not registered to their team roster, the said team should be disqualified from the Tournament.

** Event details may change depending on the situation.

[i][b]**Winning Team will be written at the back.
** The design of the back may change due to the length of the Team Name.[/b][/i]

[i][b]
Complete Tournament Rewards will be posted during the November 27th Maintenance.[/b][/i]

notes.title: [Freestyle 2 Developer’s Note] October Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/064167171806a41a7c1662a6138a42d868a51f13.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

This is the Developer of Freestyle 2.

We always thank our users for loving and giving full interests to our Freestyle 2.
All of the members in FS2 Team including our GMs had been putting full effort to bring changes to the game. There were some difficulties such as High Barriers for New users, Card Stress, and Balance issues, which made our game harder to play. Therefore, we would like to make some changes and lessen / remove some of the obstacles.

[h1]1. High Entry Barrier Relieved[/h1]
We added a Play Guide contents that could bring the New, Returning, and Light Users to easily adapt to the game. You can check the Video Motions and Guide Descriptions for Rebound, Block, Shot, Screen etc by clicking on the button shown at the Lobby / Piece&DIY / M.Ball / Locker / Char / and the Waiting Room. (Play guide can be set ON/OFF at the Play Guide Screen)
We will be constantly expanding the Guide System to support users to adapt to the game easily.

[h1]2. Card Stress Relief[/h1]
Card Difference of not being able to reduce the gap had been influencing the Play Balance. This has created a higher entry barrier and made some of the users to stop playing the game. Therefore we will continue to reduce the play balance gap by reducing the stress from creating new card decks.
This patch will be our 1st Card Stress Relief update, giving out [Joycity’s Giveaway Package] and [Character Creation Package] and reduced the Card upgrade conditions. In addition, we have included the Max number of cards that can be disassembled at once from 100 to 500.
The Card Stress Relief 2nd update is scheduled in 2019 and will continue to reduce the stress that our users have.

[h1]3. Balance Issue[/h1]
The change to card difference will bring a different result to the balance, we will constantly check the changed balance results and prepare a Balance Update in November/December 2019 by utilizing various Data Types. Balance Update with more details will be introduced in our next developer’s note. 

FS2 Team is putting effort to bring a new change to our Freestyle 2 where users could play the game based on their controls. We will listen to both good and bad opinions, and ofcourse compliments are always welcome.

We will do our best to make a better Freestyle 2, and make our users to enjoy the game.
Thank you.

notes.title: FS2 Game Play - Network Accelerator Test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8007791/a57146ef025921e66b843e2311392f1ca09fee4c.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

We would like to announce an interesting notice for our FS2 Ballers. We will be implementing the state of the art network technology to our game on 9/17 scheduled maintenance starting at 23:00 (PDT).

The test is to check how good or bad our implementation was to the game. However, we need our users’ full interest and participation in order to create the most optimized and useful data result.

In order to participate in the best environment, FS2 Team would like to recommend our users,
- not to use VPN nor any accelerators (Speed Boost Programs) during the test period.
(the programs above will lead to worse network connection and record high ping results)

While we are on our test period, we would also want to open a small web event for our users and proceed a survey regarding our Test:

1) Test Participation Web Event
Play 5 Matches – and get 10 Card Sub Attribute Changers.

2) Test Performance Survey
(The Google Form will be announced in a separate notice later)
a) List out any differences you have experienced compared to the previous version of our network in-game

The Rewards will be sent during 9/25 Patch Maintenance Day or on the next upcoming maintenance.

Thank you for your time. Your clean participation will bring a better FS2 Game Environment!

Be free to create your own Freestyle!

-Team Freestyle 2

[b]- Application: [/b]Dash move speed ↑' has been added to the Dash Block Mastery of PF and the Dash Rebound mastery of SF.

We will keep monitoring for the balance in order to create a better environment.

Thank you.

notes.title: 2019.06.26th Balance Patch
notes.content:
Hello Ballers.

This is Freestyle 2 Developer from Joycity.

In our Balance Patch we have focused on some of the attributes of all positions. Moreover, we have also made some adjustments that were resulted in the Freestyle 2 1Q Survey. Focused on the CT position which ranked 1st as the position that needed a buff and the PF position which ranked 1st as the position that needed a nerf.

In our Skill Patch, a new CT skill has been released and the PF’s upgraded middle shot steps have been adjusted, for further details please refer to the context below.

In our Mastery Patch, the overall DG and PG Masteries have been renewed.
In particular, to PG’s 3-point success rate, attribute has been added that our ballers have consistently been requesting, and we believe the ‘Long range ↑’ skill in the ‘Scheme Breaker’ Mastery will bring a more aggressive PG play style than before.

Please check the details in the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/9a7e8b2467d7289fc93d32b15f79c89c235c9c5b.png[/img]

[h1]A. New CT skill Added[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/93aaa9ddfd4b0c37229e21f8da0f06816723435d.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Application: [/b][/i]A new passive skill ‘Box Out Master' is added to the CT position.

[i][b]Intention: [/b][/i]A Passive skill ‘Box Out Master’ added which provides significantly faster box-out movement than box out upgrade. CT was the top position in the 1Q survey that required the most Buff, and many said the CT position was not unique compared to other Big Man positions. The previous CT position’s scoring ability was lower than the Scorer's, rebound and block weren’t stronger than the Big Man position. After receiving continuous Feedbacks from the users, we decided to add specialized features in each position, C (rebound), PF (block), and CT (box out). “Box Out” will be CT’s concept, and CT’s position will be modified along with his “Box Out” Concept.

[h1]B. CT_Hand-to-Hand Skill Adjustment[/h1]

[b][i]Application 1 : [/i][/b]Pass-and-run can be triggered after using hand-to-hand skills

[i][b]Application 2 : [/b][/i]The Character’s moving speed increases temporarily after receiving the Hand-to-hand pass

[i][b]Intention: [/b][/i]The goal is to increase CT's use of hand-to-hand pass and affect the game plays. The Previous Mastery Skill (hand-to-hand & faster!)’s has been added to apply to the basic skill.

[h1]C. Passive Step Adjustment[/h1]

[i][b]Application: [/b][/i]PF's middle Shot Upgrade 2 skill has been lowered to middle Shot Upgrade 1.

[b][i]Intention: [/i][/b]This had the most opinions in our 1Q Survey, and as a fact, the PF position had a high middle shot success rate and manual dunk gave PF a high advantage in both offense and defense. Reduced the PF Position’s success rate and the reduced number can be achieved through PF’s offensive Mastery.

[h1]D. Default skill Changes[/h1]

[i][b]Application:[/b][/i] C, PF Position’s Dunk Success % II, Dunk Focus_2 skill has been excluded from the default skill.

[i][b]Intention: [/b][/i]High dunk success rate and increased skill slots allowed to meet both offense and defense. Two passive skills were excluded from the default skill to select options of defense or attack skills.

[h1]E. Spin move Lay-up skill Adjustment[/h1]

[b][i]Application 1 : [/i][/b]Stamina reduction value Increased when using Spin Move Lay-up.
[b][i]
Intention: [/i][/b]We believe the Spin Move Lay-up skill had been used excessively without any risk under the rim, therefore we have added the stamina reduction value in order to prevent users from using spin move lay-up multiple times.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/6e32d17936b2e4a154214f9f63da603e15893612.png[/img]

[h1]A. Mastery Skill’s Applied Value Changes[/h1]

[b]a. L Cut (SG) : L cut Dash Stamina Removed, 'L cut speed' skill’s moving speed Increased[/b]
[b][i]Intention: [/i][/b]After when the stamina reduces when using a dash, it was impossible to use the L Cut skill efficiently because of additional dashes were reduced when using L-cut. Stamina Reduction has been removed when using L Cut in order to use to let users use L Cut several times during their offense turn. Moreover, increased moving speed when ‘L cut Speed ↑' skill was equipped.

[b]b. Post-up jumper (SF) : Post up jumper Distance Limit Deleted[/b]
[i][b]Intention: [/b][/i]We determined that the previous Post up Jumper skill was not practical enough because the offense player was only able to use the Post up Jumper skill in narrow post areas or in front of the defense player(opponent) that had high block attributes.
Therefore, we removed the Distance Restrictions to increase the diversity and efficiency of SF's attack routes.

[b]c. Hand-to-hand & faster! (CT) : 'Hand-to-hand & faster!' speed Increased, Dash Duration Decreased[/b]
[b][i]Intention[/i][/b]: The character who receives a hand-to-hand pass will have faster moving speed but will have decreased duration.

[b]d. Dash Move Speed (All) : ‘Dash move speed ↑’ Value Decreased[/b]
[i][b]Intention:[/b][/i] Due to Fast Dash Moving Speed, efficiency of supporting defense was excessively too high, therefore we have reduced the speed by about 60%.

[h1]B. Mastery Skill Adjustment[/h1]

[b]a. Center (C)[/b]
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
Please check the details in the game.
[b]
b. Power Forward (PF)[/b] 
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The Middle Shot Success% has been added to the power dunker Mastery, while the middle shot success % Reduction has been added to the rest of the masteries. Moreover, Box Out Swarm Move Upgrade skill has been added to the Energy Lob Catcher Mastery.
Please check the details in the game.

[b]c. Control Tower (CT)[/b]
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
Please check the details in the game.

[b]d. Small Forward (SF)[/b]
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The placement of the Standard Forward Mastery has been changed so that 'Shot Fake Drive Speed↑’ and ‘Shoot Fake Drive Range↑’ skills can be learned step by step.
Reduced Rebound Increased value and increased the reduction of the shot success% in the Option Lob Catcher Mastery.
Please check the details in the game.

[b]e. Swing Man (SW)[/b]
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The placement of the Mastery has been changed so that 'Shot Fake Drive Speed↑’ and ‘Shoot Fake Drive Range↑’ skills can be learned step by step.
Please check the details in the game.

[b]f. Shooting Guard (SG)[/b]
Each Skill Attributes’ Increase and Decrease have been partially modified.
The placement of the Catch & Shooter Mastery has been changed so that 'Shot Fake Drive Speed↑’ and ‘Shoot Fake Drive Range↑’ skills can be learned step by step.
Added ‘Jab step Drive Speed↑’ Skill in Swing & Swing Mastery.

[b]g. Dual guard (DG)[/b]
Overall Mastery skills have been renewed.
Number of “Offensive Style” Mastery Skills Increased (13 → 20)
Number of “Defensive Style” Mastery Skills Increased (11 → 19)
Number of “Athletic Style” Mastery Skills Increased (11 → 17)
Please check the details in the game.

[b]h. Point guard (PG)[/b]
Overall Mastery skills have been renewed.
Number of “Athletic Outlier” Mastery Skills Increased (9 → 16)
Number of “Quick Step Chaser” Mastery Skills Increased (8 → 18)
Number of “Scheme Breaker” Mastery Skills Increased (12 → 18)
Please check the details in the game.

notes.title: Street Block System Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/4dd43d6b94d58e4de5dd0fe68f0802cf8fc4b917.png[/img]

Street Blocks, the long-awaited replacement for the Toy System, is now here! Check out our guide on how to use the Street Block System!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/73373d9c07d8eb18dad7a8bda99caae0ff6c0a50.png[/img]
[h1]
What is Street Block?[/h1]
- Street Block is a 3 month basis system that it will initialize all the points, blocks, 
plates when the season ends.

[h1]What is Block?[/h1]
- Shapes with various stat bonus that can be rotated and dropped inside
the block plate.

- Each block represents stats that will be added on the character attributes.

You can acquire Street Blocks by purchasing them using Block Points. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/610ecd6bbc29725468d7433c050ef0a0b48cd583.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/188bda3e25b7a395688c23041ef42df158346b35.png[/img]
- Total number of current Block Points.

[h1]What is Block Point?[/h1]
-Block Points are acquirable through regular matches (game plays), event rewards, 
and also when in the court lobby waiting for matches.

-Ballers can purchase the block box, expand zones, level up or change the
 blocks from using the block points.

[b][i]1 Day Acquisition Limit: 0/1200[/i][/b]

[i]** The 1 day acquisition limit is only for block points acquired with regular 
match and block points acquired when waiting for matches.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0ae9ee21c6606161ee5b7da437fe2e3427f1f402.png[/img]
The Block Boxes contains Blocks which have various stat bonuses in them.

Use the Block Points you amass to purchase Jumbled Block Boxes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/ba5ff1cf9ed6ec2746cc62d26e75336a445ab5dd.png[/img]

 Each block is unique and no other block will contain the same stat bonus.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/391566999051b658d689c5d391e3eb52391bdcc0.gif[/img]

This is the list of blocks which the Jumbled Block Box contains.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/8720894e675da2cdcfd36c61c7cb039e188edb0c.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0d174e3de700fc9a2a60bb56761b1237a02776d0.png[/img]
- Part of the Street Block Screen that shows the lists of added attributes from the blocks.

The attributes will apply to the game by rounding the decimal point.
Note: Less than 0.4 attribute values will not be shown in the character additional attribute screen.
(0.5 attribute and above = +1 in the character additional attribute screen)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0933917d23fac0ab04f3e1291e11411d944e1a48.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/6fa1111a75682c4e79e6764d9cecda006717f274.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/dd447075fbff509258c69b5f3e15387897cd0dd3.png[/img]
-  Area where you the street blocks will be placed.

You have to get creative in order to maximize the given Zone that you have! If you feel you are running out of Zones, you can increase the area of your zone with Block Points.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/13f94a2811a6f7fc4c5e9e8fd29204b7e34d2f13.gif[/img]

- All street blocks that are acquired from the Jumbled Block Boxes will be visible in this area.

If you have multiple similar blocks, you can combine them in order to increase the stat bonuses that they provide!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/f80f482a399c83b4121b81187aadfc9d3327de6d.gif[/img]

Equip the Blocks to the given Zone in order to benefit from the stat bonuses they provide!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/57b0d6dbb1044fe5adba3144fc9371efeae75c52.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/b2ac2055e4169ee348d1b965f6d2fc52a4dbf4fd.png[/img]

- Part of the Street Block screen where the Season # & Season Period is shown.

The blocks that you acquire will last for a total of 3 months before they are initialized. But don’t worry! 5% of the total block points that you have earned will be credited the following season! 

Every new season will introduce new exciting forms of zones for you to creatively add your blocks to!

notes.title: Freestyle2 New System Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/0466b231b177be1a859a5df35de79cddcd9090ba.png[/img]

Hello Ballers,
 
The following are the System Updates after the May 29th Patch!

[h1]Block Function Added![/h1]

Players can now use the Block Function in the in-game chat to block any communication from toxic players. The block function affects the blocked player’s Megaphone chat, Regular chat, in-game chat, and in the waiting court chat. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/8bac5339677e9506d0431c53ba98a8c35bda7adb.png[/img]

Please be informed that this function only blocks the communication of the blocked character, it will not block the whole account of the blocked character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/a0fdd821d4d2a4717ba5d558e568fdaf8a9e18e9.jpg[/img]

You can view the your blocked users under [b]Messenger>Settings>Blocked User. [/b]
You can unblock previously blocked players in here.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/ab3ff7fb61c35ae2d4e1239806c05995b6a01c79.jpg[/img]

[h1]
Report Function Added![/h1]

The in-game chat report is now added! You can now report players for their unsavory chats in the chat box!  You can block all chats including: Megaphones chats, regular chats, and in-game chats. Reports will be counted towards a person’s account. If you report another character of the same account, the number of report count of that account will not increase. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/efc796a1f815ea6d9c9b9689d8aee14fa66753ca.png[/img]

Only the line you have selected to report will be recorded in the database. If any users will falsely report anyone, we will be implementing a penalty depending on how much they have misused the report feature. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/a461a34e44d9eb5ef061a36c8f536933e1c12161.jpg[/img]

Megaphone chats can only be reported in the Main Menu, you cannot report while you are in-game or in the court lobby.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/b70a5235ef9c771e36c837e0f0e335b39a17643d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Intentional Leaving of the Game Penalty System[/h1]

We have added a feature to penalize players who leave the game intentionally.  This is to prevent players who keep force closing the game when they feel like it.

When a person intentionally leaves a game, they will acquire Termination Points. A person will experience varying penalties depending on the amount of Termination Points they have acquired. A person will automatically acquire 10 Termination Points when they leave a game.

[table]
[tr]
[th]Points[/th]
[th]Penalty[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]20 or above[/th]
[th]Cannot enter the room within 10 minutes of leaving the game [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]60 or above[/th]
[th]Cannot enter the room within 30 minutes of leaving the game  [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]70 or above[/th]
[th]Cannot enter the room within 45 minutes of leaving the game  [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]80 or above[/th]
[th]Cannot enter the room within 1 day of leaving the game  [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]120 or above[/th]
[th]Cannot enter the room within 3 days of leaving the game  [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]150 or above[/th]
[th]Cannot enter the room within 7 days of leaving the game  [/th]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i][u]How to remove the Termination Points[/u][/i]
[b]> Play Matches and complete them[/b]
-If you successfully complete one match without any problems, then 5 Termination Points will be removed from your account.

[h1]Piece and DIY System Updates[/h1]

Better UI added in order for users to know what materials will be used up when creating packs or when opening devices.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/8049f9b52ef0419e54c5ded56a6410a20ce4db56.png[/img]

[b]Create 100 Secret Packs button added
[/b]
 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/ee6d21075446f2c581622fe350ae8f238656e71d.png[/img]
[b]
100 Device Clear Button added[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/4a2d220ad16b88a0d2fad282b0d4826a0df4a05f.png[/img]

You can now sort by piece grade! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/aedaebd6387a2482374f110073fda61799a25aff.gif[/img]

Lock button is added to avoid accidental important pieces from being dismantled!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/637b6952b914d06e1768e6109a772c157b6dc6eb.gif[/img]

Easily locate craftable items with the Available button!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/8817a97d3e0f4c0eb890c992c2655d35ab97dcca.gif[/img]

[h1]
Character Creation Page[/h1]
A new informative window will help players understand the identity of each position and will help them with their decision in creating new characters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/e899a39b1ce64231052d4fccdda4eaa886f0cbf9.png[/img]

[h1]Character Attribute Recommendation[/h1]
Lost on what to upgrade? We got you! We now added recommended stats for players who are at lost on which attribute to increase.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/3268c9265137bd95159ebbccc85e7ed0c6c2a9f7.png[/img]

[i]The normal thumbs up means that we recommend adding points into this attribute.
The burning thumbs up means that we highly recommend adding points into this attribute.[/i]

[h1]Card Equip Level Changes[/h1]

We are bringing down the level requirement for equipping cards.

notes.title: Balance Patch 2019.04.24
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/5c9ebadc66a6ce071d75f83980d4e061fd5d8248.png[/img]

Hello Ballers, this is the Freestyle 2 Developing Team.

We would want to thank all of our ballers for loving our Freestyle 2.
We have read the Survey Feedbacks and applied a small portion of the feedbacks in our new Balance Update. We will continue to listen our ballers’ feedback and balance each position’s strengths.

[h1]★ Skill Patch[/h1]

[h1] A. Skill Remove [/h1]

[b] Application : [/b] PF’s Skill Remove – Steel Will
[b] Intention : [/b]  Even though the defenders had a good defense against the strong dunks of PF, offense team PFs were still able to make points. However, when it comes to scoring PFs, we believe that Still Will is an important skill for them, therefore we have decided to put the skill in the Offense Mastery.

[h1] B. Passive Skill Change [/h1]

[b] Application : [/b] Passive Attribute 48 → 36

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8007791/a1292f12969460689e2a477aa077f52aa8f1ab55.png[/img]
 
[b] Intention : [/b] Reduced Passive values in order to reduce down the High success rate of Dunks.
 
[h1]C. Skill Adjustments [/h1]

[b] Application :[/b]  Added Stamina Consumption at Hook Shot Pass and Jump Pass.

[b] Intention : [/b] Due to the use of too many Jump Passes and Hook Shot Passes, it is showing that the offense players are having more advantage under the Rim. Therefore we have lowered the high frequency use of Jump passes by adding Stamina Consumption to the skills.

[b] Application :[/b]  Reduced 1/4 of increasing speed of the mastery skill “Dash move speed ↑”

[b] Intention : [/b] We have adjusted the corresponding mastery skill’s speed because we believe the Defense Range had been too broad due to fast speed in mastery skills and high equipping rate of Dash Move Speed.

[h1] Mastery Update [/h1]

[b] The Masteries of C, PF, and CT positions have changed globally.[/b] 

[b] Application : [/b] C, PF, CT position’s mastery placement and skill change

[b] Intention : [/b] The selection of Masteries has widen than before, each mastery has been clearly divided by the unique type to provide users broader selection and give a chance to choose that suit one’s self and to consider own fitment.


[h1]Center (C)[/h1]
We've mitigated a significant reduction in the initial attributes. We believe that the burden of selecting and equipping masteries will be greatly reduced. Also, we believe that compared to other masteries, the hook shot pass’s attribute has been reduced too much, therefore we have decreased the reduction. Please check the details through In-Game.


[h1]Power forward (PF)
[/h1]
We have clearly divided the Power Forward’s Offense and Defense Masteries over the previous Masteries. In the offense mastery of PF, we have increased the reduction in the block attributes more than the rebound reduction. Also, Power Forward playing offensive tactics with defense mastery did not suit our intention, therefore we have reduced the offensive attributes in the defense mastery. Please check the details through In-Game.


[h1]Control Tower (CT)
[/h1]
We have mitigated the reduction values of CT’s initial attributes. We have set and divided the Control Tower’s Mastery to show its uniqueness, Quick Lob Catcher to become an Original (Rebound, Block) Big man, Floor Spacer to become a Scorer (Dunk, 3 Points) Big Man, and Option Man to become a Utility (Movement Speed, Pass) Big Man. Also, Dunk-at-Will skill has been added to the Mastery Tree. Please check the details through In-Game.

notes.title: 2017.07.05th.Patch.Notes
notes.content:
The balancing patch is taking effect this July.  

There are many summer prizes and events so please see the new updates below. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1498041682039.png[/img]

[h1]1. Big series player (C/ PF/ CT) [/h1]
i.	Modified swim bug in PF position 
ii.	Modified Free style condition in PF position 
iii.	Get the new indomitable will skill in PF position 
iv.	Get post push skill in C, PF, CT position 
v.	Get middle shot focused skill in CT position 
   [h1]       
2.	Scorer and guard series player (SF/ SG/ DG/ PG) [/h1]
i.	SG 3 points shot resistance improvement  
ii.	Scorer position skill rebalancing: 
Breakthrough fake/ back roll turn &back dribble/ shot fake breakthrough/ quick change handling improvement 
Away screen move skill's speed buff time decreased
Get the enhanced diving catch skill in PG position 
Get the enhanced breakthrough skill in DG position 
Get the enhanced breakthrough skill in SF position 
                Get long range skill 
Get middle shot focused skill in SW position 
            Get the enhanced pass skill in SW position 
iii.	Provide new skills 
Drift pass (SF, SW, DG)
Brilliant breakthrough 2 (SG, SW, SF/CHN, GSP)
                Back roll turn 2 (SG) 
                Breakthrough fake 2 (SG, SF, SW, DG, PG)
     [h1]          
3.	Related to all positions [/h1]
i.	Screen swim move basic skills 
ii.	All positions can purchase screen body check skills 
iii.	Screen: decreased stamina on continuous use of screen, when the away screen move skill is activated, screen cancellation time is extended  
iv.	After the success of the away screen move, increase the screen swim probability when you get on the screen. 
v.	The defender movement speed is temporarily increased when an indirect hit with a defender in areas under than the basket  

	Additional details 
- Drift pass 	

* This is a skill to pass to the nearest team member after diving into input direction in a traveling and pivoting state. 		
* When a good drift pass is successfully activated, it ignores the defender. (Good drift pass is applied when the distance is far enough from the marker or the defender tries to block the pass) 
- Tactical changes
Freestyle 2 requires more careful and close team play on offense which will
improve away screen move tactics.
Together with side effects with tactical improvements 
The away screen move, which is one of the Freestyle tactical moves, will be   
changed from an unconditional move to a conditional skill.

- Rolling back to the December Patches Away Screen Move Tactical Patches
(away screen move will occur when a screener and a receiver are in conflict, 
when away screen move is used, the screener will get away from the screen)
- Screen Swim Move skill is given to all positions as a default skill
(Skill to avoid screen)
- Screen body check is given to the previous position as purchasing skill
- Extend screen cancellation time (extend only when away screen move is    
 triggered)
- When an away screen move is triggered and the defender is caught on the   
 screen, the screen swim move probability is accumulated
- Away screen move skill's speed buff time decreased
        Because of the risk of using consecutive screens on non-risk screens in the 
        pick play tactics, the screen has been changed to be used more carefully.
- When using screens continuously, stamina will drop
- When the defender and indirect offender collide, the defender's movement 
  speed is increased

notes.content:
The balancing patch is taking effect this July.  

There are many summer prizes and events so please see the new updates below. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1498041682039.png[/img]

[h1]1. Big series player (C/ PF/ CT) [/h1]
i.	Modified swim bug in PF position 
ii.	Modified Free style condition in PF position 
iii.	Get the new indomitable will skill in PF position 
iv.	Get post push skill in C, PF, CT position 
v.	Get middle shot focused skill in CT position 
   [h1]       
2.	Scorer and guard series player (SF/ SG/ DG/ PG) [/h1]
i.	SG 3 points shot resistance improvement  
ii.	Scorer position skill rebalancing: 
Breakthrough fake/ back roll turn &back dribble/ shot fake breakthrough/ quick change handling improvement 
Away screen move skill's speed buff time decreased
Get the enhanced diving catch skill in PG position 
Get the enhanced breakthrough skill in DG position 
Get the enhanced breakthrough skill in SF position 
                Get long range skill 
Get middle shot focused skill in SW position 
            Get the enhanced pass skill in SW position 
iii.	Provide new skills 
Drift pass (SF, SW, DG)
Brilliant breakthrough 2 (SG, SW, SF/CHN, GSP)
                Back roll turn 2 (SG) 
                Breakthrough fake 2 (SG, SF, SW, DG, PG)
     [h1]          
3.	Related to all positions [/h1]
i.	Screen swim move basic skills 
ii.	All positions can purchase screen body check skills 
iii.	Screen: decreased stamina on continuous use of screen, when the away screen move skill is activated, screen cancellation time is extended  
iv.	After the success of the away screen move, increase the screen swim probability when you get on the screen. 
v.	The defender movement speed is temporarily increased when an indirect hit with a defender in areas under than the basket  

	Additional details 
- Drift pass 	

* This is a skill to pass to the nearest team member after diving into input direction in a traveling and pivoting state. 		
* When a good drift pass is successfully activated, it ignores the defender. (Good drift pass is applied when the distance is far enough from the marker or the defender tries to block the pass) 
- Tactical changes
Freestyle 2 requires more careful and close team play on offense which will
improve away screen move tactics.
Together with side effects with tactical improvements 
The away screen move, which is one of the Freestyle tactical moves, will be   
changed from an unconditional move to a conditional skill.

- Rolling back to the December Patches Away Screen Move Tactical Patches
(away screen move will occur when a screener and a receiver are in conflict, 
when away screen move is used, the screener will get away from the screen)
- Screen Swim Move skill is given to all positions as a default skill
(Skill to avoid screen)
- Screen body check is given to the previous position as purchasing skill
- Extend screen cancellation time (extend only when away screen move is    
 triggered)
- When an away screen move is triggered and the defender is caught on the   
 screen, the screen swim move probability is accumulated
- Away screen move skill's speed buff time decreased
        Because of the risk of using consecutive screens on non-risk screens in the 
        pick play tactics, the screen has been changed to be used more carefully.
- When using screens continuously, stamina will drop
- When the defender and indirect offender collide, the defender's movement 
  speed is increased

notes.content:
[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495637797370.png[/img]
Greetings ballers. 
As you all have been expecting, this month is our 3rd Year Anniversary! 
To celebrate, we are having many events and giveaways to thank our ballers that have been playing FS2! Also the Wild Rookies have finally come out! Check out these mischievous SPC characters today! See below for the latest news and updates this month!

[h1]Happy 3rd Year Anniversary![/h1]

To celebrate our 3rd Year of gaming, we have prepared three giveaway events! 

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630360600.png [/img]
Login during the Event period to receive the 3rd Year Anniversary Outfit and Title! We are also giving out tickets for the new SPCs!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7521

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7518

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495630943661.png[/img]
The mischievous Wild Rookies have come to the FS2 courts! These new SPC characters are some what different to our usual SPCs. You will be able to transform to Villains and gain unlimited Freestyle! The Wild Rookies also have a +50 Training Point! 
You will find the Wild Rookies in the SPC Vending Machine. The Package contains a whoping [SPC Exclusive Cards, Skill Slot x3, Wish Cards x2]

[h1]AFK Boot system added[/h1]

An AFK Boot system has been added to the game. If there is no key input for a long period of time during a match, you will get a pop up message informing you that the game will close soon. You will be given 10 seconds to move and if there is no key input, the game will close.  
[i]** The match will be considered as a loss for users that are on the same team. The user that got kicked out due to AFK will not get any rewards for that match **[/i]

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631153895.png [/img]


[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631280465.png[/img]
For a limited time only, the Special Skill Box is on sale in the capsules! Step up your game with these special skills!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7524

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631344212.png [/img]
Equip your all new Wild Rookies with these Effect Freestyles! You will be shooting Fire balls and lightnings for every single shot!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/7523

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1495631395887.png[/img]
Check out the all new Dreamworld Unicorn outfit in the itemballs!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/7517

notes.title: 2017 Summer Season Crew Tournament Application
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1494867369906.png[/img]

Winners train, losers complain.

Be prepared and dominate the 2017 Summer Season Crew Tournament!

Application Period: 05/29 - 06/04 23:59 (PDT)

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSemAWlH5v4IRSWhC7NRaOyxSBkUse-7GOOuxwn5aeae9GSutg/viewform][b][u][Application Link][/u][/b][/url]

** Only Crew Masters may apply for this Tournament

[h1]Brackets[/h1]	 
Brackets will be uploaded by June 5th.

[h1]NA Server Schedule[/h1]

Top 32 Block A: June 10 (Sat) 4PM to 7PM (PDT) 
Top 32 Block B: June 11 (Sun) 4PM to 7PM (PDT) 
Top 16: June 17 (Sat) 4PM to 7PM (PDT) 
Top 8: June 18 (Sun) 4PM to 7PM (PDT) 
Top 4 and Bronze Match: June 24 (Sat) 4PM to 7PM (PDT) 
Finals: June 25 (Sun) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)

[h1]EU Server Schedule[/h1]
	
Top 32 Block A: June 10 (Sat) 8AM to 11 AM (PDT)
Top 32 Block B: June 11 (Sun) 8AM to 11 AM (PDT) 
Top 16: June 17 (Sat) 8AM to 11 AM (PDT) 
Top 8: June 18 (Sun) 8AM to 11 AM (PDT) 
Top 4 and Bronze Match: June 24 (Sat) 8AM to 11 AM (PDT) 
Finals: June 25 (Sun) 8AM to 11 AM (PDT)

[h1]ASIA Server Schedule[/h1]
	
Top 32 Block A: June 10 (Sat) 1AM to 4 AM (PDT) 
Top 32 Block B: June 11 (Sun) 1AM to 4 AM (PDT) 
Top 16: June 17 (Sat) 1AM to 4 AM (PDT) 
Top 8: June 18 (Sun) 1AM to 4 AM (PDT)
Top 4 and Bronze Match: June 24 (Sat) 1AM to 4 AM (PDT) 
Finals: June 25 (Sun) 1AM to 4 AM (PDT)

[h1]Requirements[/h1]

1. Top 200 on Challengers League Ranking by May 28th 

2. Your crew can only apply on one server. 
Do not apply on multiple servers for this tournament. 

3. Please do not change your Character name once 
you have applied for this tournament. 

4. Don't apply more than one time with characters in 
the same account for multiple crew teams.
- You are allowed to apply 2 characters in the same 
account for 1 team, but you will get the reward only 
once. 

5. In-Game Name (IGN) with special characters are 
not allowed to participate.

[h1]Teams Applicable per Crew[/h1]
1.Crews with less than 50 Crew members: 1 team
(3 Main Players + 2 Subs in total)

2.Crews with over 50 Crew members: 2 teams 
(6 Main Players + 4 Subs in total)

**In the case that more than 32 teams apply for this event 
(for each server: NA/EU/Asia), we will select the top 32 teams based
on their Crew Ranking. The 2nd team from the same crew may 
not be selected depending on the situation. 
This is to give other crews a chance to participate in the tournament.

** Event details may change depending on the situation.

[h1]Streaming:[/h1]
The Top 4 Matches will be streamed in the following link: http://www.twitch.tv/gamekiss

[h1]Event Rules:[/h1]
1. All participants must be in the Tournament Channel lobby
at the exact Event time.
(Time for each match will be announced later)

2. Once you are invited to your crew waiting room,
please invite your teammates to the room.

3. If one of your team member does not show up in time,
you may call a subsititue player that you signed in when you applied
for the tournament

4. If there are no sub players who can cover for your team 
and there are not enough members to start the match, your team
will automatically lose.

5. No 3rd party program is allowed for this tournament.
(If we detect such programs, the crew will not be able to participate
in this tournament anymore and the violators will be suspended)

6. Only a total of 5 mins preparation time will be given for each team
to prepare for the tournament match.

7. Only the Crew Master can write an application for this tournament.

8. If your Team does not show up on the [Top 32 stage] and have
thus lost by default, your crew won't be able to participate in the
next tournament. Please be sure to show up on time.

9. In the event that a team member is absent to the
tournament, we will forbid the missing member's account from 
joining the next tournament as penalty.

10.If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume 
from where left off. However if the baller does not return in 
10 minutes and there are no registered Sub players in the team,
the team will be disqualified.

11. We will only allow two (2) tries for a player that is having
technical difficulties in joining the game. If the player is unable
to join on the second try, we will advise the team to call on their 
subs or they will be automatically disqualified from the tournament.
** Event details may change depending on the situation.


[h1]Rewards:
1st Place:[/h1]

[b]Winning Team Members:[/b]
7000 Gkash + 40,000 Points +
Star Training Zip-up (Rare) + Star Training Pants (Rare)
+FS2 Champion Belt + Winner’s Golden Wings (15D) (Animation) 
+New SPC Coupon

[b]Winning Crew Members:[/b]
3 Card Balls+  3 Item Balls  + SAKUN Black Patriot Mask

[h1]2nd Place:[/h1]

[b]Team members:[/b] 
5000 Gkash + 10,000pt 

[b]All Crew members: [/b]
1 Card Ball + 1 Item Ball + SAKUN O FLAG Cap

[h1]3rd Place[/h1]
Team members: 
2000 Gkash

Top 16 teams (Under3rd Place)
Team members: 
5 Point Balls + 20 FreeStyle Tickets

-Team FreeStyle2

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1487075332486.jpg[/img]

[h1] Position Balance Adjusted [/h1] 
[b]1.Small Forward[/b]
[i]A. High Middle Shot success rate adjusted[/i]
-After the last balance patch, the success rate of Middle Shots while
in the presence of defenders was abnormally high, especially the
Drift Shot
 
-The success rate of Drift Shot has been reduced to a certain degree.
 
[b]2.Control Tower[/b]
[i]A. Hand to Hand Pass effectiveness increased[/i]
-Hand to Hand Pass was added to create different strategies and 
connections during Post Up
-Due to the short range of the Hand to Hand Pass receiving motion 
the skill was less effective.
-The range of Hand to Hand Pass receiving motion has been increased

[b]3.Swing Man[/b]
[i]A. Tripping Prevention I control difficulty decreased[/i]
-Due to difficulty in control keys of this skill, 
it was hard to utilize the Tripping Prevention I skill
 
-Controls have been made easier by also allowing the 
control keys to be pushed before the collision happens 
to use the Tripping Prevention I Skill.  You no longer have to press
Direction key + A exactly when you collide in order to use this skill
 
[i]B. Scoop Shot effectiveness increased[/i]
-Experienced users were able to predict Scoop Shots and defend
it with ease
-Scoop Shots can now be connected with Jump Pass to 
create new offense strategies
 
[i]C. Back Block[/i]
Back Block activation error fixed
-When having Back Block equipped, even blocks from the front 
activated the Back Block skill
-Adjusted so that Back Block is no longer activated if 
your character is in front of the opponent

notes.title: 2017 Winter Season Crew Tournament Postponed
notes.content:
Greetings Baller,
 
We would like to apologize for the inconvenience that happened during the 1st match in Asia server. We are very regretful to inform you that the Winter Season Tournament schedules will be postponed due to technical issues in the Tournament Channel.
 
We were able to hold one match in the Event Channel but however the match could not be broadcasted live. After further review, we have decided to postpone the 2017 Winter Season Crew Tournament till next week rather than holding matches in bad conditions. Rest assured as we are working on this issue in the Tournament channel and will be fixed by next weekend.
 
We seek for your patience and understanding.
 
We will be giving [Card Ball x5] as compensation to all participants of the tournament due to this inconvenience. We will be sending it during the next server maintenance.

notes.title: 2017 Winter Season Crew Tournament Application
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1484925015518.jpg[/img]

Rise to the top and be the Champions of 2017 Winter Season Crew Tournament

[h1]Registration Period:[/h1]
February 3rd ~ February 12th   

[h1]Application Link: [/h1]
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdIPXKsIx0DxkQc9NRvwaczOFiGfMkPDJf8_Ge5Htp_9Kv2MQ/viewform

** Only Crew Masters may apply for this Tournament
 
[h1]Brackets: [/h1] Brackets will be uploaded by February 13th.

[h1]Tournament Schedule[/h1]
[h1]NA Server: [/h1]
Top 32 Block A: Feb 25 (Sat) 4PM to 7PM (PST)
Top 32 Block B: Feb 26 (Sun) 4PM to 7PM (PST) 
Top 16: March 4 (Sat) 4PM to 7PM (PST) 
Top 8: March 5 (Sun) 4PM to 7PM (PST) 
Top 4 and Bronze Match: March 11 (Sat) 4PM to 7PM (PST)
Finals: March 12 (Sun) 4PM to 7PM (PST)

[h1]EU Server: [/h1]
Top 31 Block A: Feb 25 (Sat) 8AM to 11 AM (PST) 
Top 31 Block B: Feb 26 (Sun) 8AM to 11 AM (PST) 
Top 16: March 4 (Sat) 8AM to 11 AM (PST) 
Top 8: March 5 (Sun) 8AM to 11 AM (PST) 
Top 4 and Bronze Match: March 11 (Sat) 8AM to 11 AM (PST) 
Finals: March 12 (Sun) 8AM to 11 AM (PST)

[h1]ASIA Server: [/h1]
Top 32 Block A: Feb 25 (Sat) 1AM to 4 AM (PST) 
Top 32 Block B: Feb 26 (Sun) 1AM to 4 AM (PST) 
Top 16: March 4 (Sat) 1AM to 4 AM (PST) 
Top 8: March 5 (Sun) 1AM to 4 AM (PST) 
Top 4 and Bronze Match: March 11 (Sat) 1AM to 4 AM (PST) 
Finals: March 12 (Sun) 1AM to 4 AM (PST)

[h1]Requirements: [/h1]
1. Top 150 on Challengers League Ranking by Feb 5th

2. Your crew can only apply on one server.
Do not apply on multiple servers for this tournament.

3. Please do not change your Character name once
you have applied for this tournament.

4. Don't apply more than one time with characters in
the same account for multiple crew teams.

- You are allowed to apply 2 characters in the same account 
for 1 team, but you will get the reward only once.

***If your Teammates do not show up on the [Top 32 stage]
 and thus lose by default, your crew won't be able to participate
 in the next tournament as penalty. Please be sure to show up on time.


[h1]Teams Applicable per Crew[/h1]
1.Crews with less than 50 Crew members: 1 team
 (3 Main Players + 2 Subs in total)

2.Crews with over 50 Crew members: 2 teams 
(6 Main Players + 4 Subs in total)

**In the case that more than 32 teams apply for this event 
(for each server: NA/EU/Asia), we will select the top 32 teams based
 on their Crew Ranking. The 2nd team from the same crew may 
not be selected depending on the situation. 
This is to give other crews a chance to participate in the tournament.

** Event details may change depending on the situation.

[h1]Streaming: [/h1] 
The Top 4 Matches will be streamed in the following link: http://www.twitch.tv/gamekiss

[h1]Event Rules: [/h1]
1. All participants must be in the Tournament Channel lobby
at the exact Event time.
(Time for each match will be announced later)

2. Once you are invited to your crew waiting room,
please invite your teammates to the room.

3. If one of your team member does not show up in time,
you may call a substitute player that you signed in when you applied
for the tournament

4. If there are no sub players who can cover for your team 
and there are not enough members to start the match, your team
 will automatically lose.

5. No 3rd party program is allowed for this tournament.
(If we detect such programs, the crew will not be able to participate
 in this tournament anymore and the violators will be suspended)

6. Only a total of 5 mins preparation time will be given for each team
 to prepare for the tournament  match.

7. Only the Crew Master can write an application for this tournament.

8. If your Team does not show up on the [Top 32 stage] and have
 thus lost by default, your crew won't be able to participate in the
 next tournament. Please be sure to show up on time.

9. In the event that a team member is absent to the
 tournament, we will forbid the missing member's account from 
joining the next tournament as penalty.

10.If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume 
from where left off. However if the baller does not return in 
10 minutes and there are no registered Sub players in the team,
 the team will be disqualified.

11. We will only allow two (2) tries for a player that is having
 technical difficulties in joining the game. If the player is unable
 to join on the second try, we will advise the team to call on their 
subs or they will be automatically disqualified from the tournament.
** Event details may change depending on the situation.

[h1]1st Place:[/h1]

7000 Gkash + 40,000 Points

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1484939733985.JPG[/img]
Star Training Zip-up (Rare) + Star Training Pants (Rare)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1477309556985.PNG[/img]
Winner’s Devil Wings (15D) (Animation) + FS2 Champion Belt

[b]Winning Crew Members:[/b]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1484939769881.JPG[/img]
3 Card Balls + 3 Item Balls + Military Training Bag

[h1]2nd Place:[/h1]

[b]Team members:[/b] 
5000 Gkash + 10,000pt 

[b]All Crew members:[/b] 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1484939814974.JPG[/img]
Cross Buckle Bag 
+ 1 Card ball + 1 Item ball

[h1]3rd Place[/h1]	
[b]Team members:[/b] 
2000 Gkash

[h1]Top 16 teams (Under3rd Place)[/h1]	
[b]Team members:[/b] 
5 Point Balls + 20 FreeStyle Tickets

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]
