notes.title: 2016.12.07th 'Rebound' Update Patch.Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479907199926.png[/img]

Hello, Ballers!

Project Manager of Freestyle2, Lucy is here to talk about 
our [b]2017 future plans [/b] and [b]December update![/b] <3
It is bit long, so please read carefully! (*wink*)

[h1]1. Central NA server![/h1]

Yes, finally! We are planning to move our NA server at the first quarter of 2017. 
During this year, we have done various tests with many servers to find a new 
server that can provide better services to our ballers. After extensive testing, 
we are happy to announce that we have finally found a best server for NA region 
users and are currently under way in preparing for the server move. 
We will provide further details on schedules and specifics later in the future.  

[h1]2. More Tournaments![/h1]

In 2017 you will be able to see even more famous Crews and FS2 Star Players
compete in big matches! First of all we are planning to have one of our biggest and 
renowned yearly tournament which is the 5 week long “Super Crew Tournament”.
Since this is the biggest tournament we have, we will be giving out exclusive prizes 
such as the Zip-Up Hoodie and many more for winners. 

And most importantly there will be [b]“Real Money” rewards[/b] for this tournament! 
We will also be preparing new kinds of exciting tournaments 
such as an All Stars match where the great compete to be the greatest!

[h1]3. Future Balance patch[/h1]

How was the December Rebound balance patch? 
Please fill out our survey so we can make a better gaming experience for you. 
We will also be giving out 10 Card Balls to 10 people who participate in this Survey as a small compensation!
][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1k1HPn_9fe5j9RQDQH8fzb9Cc294fTAkIuNdEsjSnHRw/edit][b][u][Schedule and Bracket Link][/u][/b][/url]

Okay, now let's talk about December update!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896616404.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895847576.jpg[/img]

> Ballers in the Rookie Channel will no longer be able to learn Skills with 
   Lv. 24 Requirement or higher even if their Character Level is above Lv. 24.

> Skills that used to have an unlock level of 24~50 have been adjusted to all have a Lv. Requirement of Lv. 24.
   You will be able to learn all skills when you enter the Pro Channel!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895880733.jpg[/img]

The trouble every Baller goes through is in deciding which stats to choose to upgrade for your playstyle! 
Now check which stat effects which part of your gameplay right inside the game!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897855219.gif[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895916658.jpg[/img]

The time taken to open items continuously has been reduced .

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479895953346.jpg[/img]

Tutorial for New player has been updated.

[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o6Zt8lU2xG6e5VIFq.gif[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896007491.jpg [/img]

The crowds surrounding the court is turned off when you set your Graphic settings to “Low Quality”

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897959855.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896039425.jpg[/img]

[h1][u]Playstyle Balance Adjustments[/u][/h1]

[h1]1. "Dash" playstyle[/h1]
> Defending Dash playstyle has been made easier.

- Away Screen Move
  Teammate will no longer get a speed boost when an opponent collides with Screening player.
- Away Screen Move will not be activated during Screen Collision.

Before:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479899287742.gif[/img]
After:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479899287742.gif[/img]

[h1]2. "Isolation" Playstyle[/h1]

 > Defense resist of Dunks and Layups have been decreased to provide higher 
feedback to successful defensive plays.

1.  Success rates have been increased during No Mark chances.
2.  Defense resist stats have been added to defensive moves.
       >  Defense resist against Standing Defense added.
3.    Success rate of Dunks and Layups are decreased when opponents 
       use defensive moves. 
4.    Defense Resist attributes effectiveness increased

[h1]3. "Pick&Move" controls improved[/h1]
Improves team play between positions and adds new offensive playstyles for Big man.

- Press [A] + [Direction Key] after using Screen to use Pick&Move .
(Pick&Move can be used if keys are pressed during Screen collision)

[h1]4. Rebound/Chip Out skill balance[/h1]

- Chip Out’s Card Sub attributes effectiveness has been decreased .
- Rebound’s main attributes effectiveness has been increased.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479908461877.jpg[/img]

[h1]Small Forward [/h1]

New Skill: Spin and Drive
This skill allows for new drive fake timing and various driving patterns

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897060833.gif[/img]

1. Press [V] Key while Driving to use skill

2. This skill can be used in either direction of the Drive

3. Collisions during Spin and Drive are the same with Dribble collisions

4. Combination actions possible
     >  Press [Direction Key] + [D] Key to connect with a quick Jump Shot
     >  [Direction Key] towards Post + [D] Key to Layup

[b]Middle Shot adjustment[/b]

1. Middle Shot Success rate according to distance has been adjusted
      > The normal range of Middle Shot has been reduced
      > Middle Shot attributes effectiveness has been increased

2. Middle Shot Focus Skill: Defense Resist attribute effectiveness slightly increased

[h1]Control Tower[/h1]

[b]Attribute adjustment[/b]

1. Middle Shot +26 / 3pt Shot +12
2. Short Dunk -13 / Long Dunk -13 / Short Layup -13

[b]Skill adjustment[/b]
> [ Middle Shot Focus III ] decreased to II

[b]New Skill: Post Up Keeping[/b]
The Post Up Keeping skill allows you to connect with other moves such as Drives 
and shots to provide various offensive strategies

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897223736.gif[/img]

1.Hold [W] Key when receiving ball

2.Combination actions possible
    a. Post Up Dribble ([Direction Key toward post])
    b. Turnaround Fadeaway ([Direction Key away from post] + [D] Key)
    c. Post Up Cut in Drive 
        > While Post Up Keeping hold [Left or Right Direction Key]. 
        > Drive Fake with short key presses
    d. Connect Post up Keeping with Post Up Drive Fake or Backward Two Step

[b]Hand to Hand Pass[/b]
Skill has been adjusted so that Hand to Hand Pass can be used while 
Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901868535.gif[/img]

a.Pass to a close teammate during Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling 
b.Press [S] Key while Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling
c.Adjusted so Hand to Hand pass can be used while Post Up Dribbling

[b]Post Up Drive Fake II changed to Post Up Drive Fake III[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896952556.png[/img]

[u]1.Controls[/u]

A.Post Up Drive: During Post Up Wind Up [Left or Right Direction Key facing post]
B. Post Up Drive Fake Shot: While Post Up Drive Fake press 
[Direction Key opposite from drive] + [D] Key
C. Post Up Drive Fake Pivot Shot: While Post Up Drive Fake Pivoting press 
[Direction Key opposite from Pivot direction] + [D] Key

[u]2.Post Up Drive Fake Pivot Shot mechanic[/u]

A.Press only [D] Key to Jump Shot
B.To Post Shot or Layup press [Direction Key towards post] + [D] Key
(Jump Shot if not in Layup range)
C.To Post Reverse Layup press [Direction Key away from Drive] + [D] Key
(Drive Fake motion if not in Layup range)
D. If [D] Key is not used this leads to Drive Fake motion

[h1]Swing Man[/h1]

[b]Backward Dribble[/b]
Enhance Drive patterns

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901844504.gif[/img]

1.Press [A] + [Direction Key away from post] at beginning of drive
2.Dribbling is possible after using Backward Dribble
3.The Backward Dribble skill can be combined with [A] Dribble skills

[b]Tripping Prevention skill improvement[/b]
Actions have been added when colliding during drives to enhance SW position

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901803970.gif[/img]

1.While Drive Collision press [Direction Key] + [A] Key
A.Press [Left or Right Direction Key facing post]: Side Hop Step combination
B.Press [Direction Key away from post]: Back Step combination

[b]Added skills from other positions[/b]
Add more ways to make shots for SW

> Added skills: Jump Pass / Floater
>Scoop Shot skill improved: The position of Scoop Shots have been adjusted

We are always looking to improve our gameplay for our ballers. 
We hope this balance patch makes our game much more fun and competitive! 
See you on the courts!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479907118349.jpg[/img]
One ‘Training Reset’ and ‘Character Specialty Changer’ will be given to all
the ballers that log-in within the event period from 12/07 ~ 12/25 23:59 once 
per account.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479915256516.png[/img]
Card Moving System is now added to the game!

Card Transfer is limited! So better choose the cards that you wish to transfer wisely!

Check out this link more more details: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/gameguide/gmguide/5312

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904177260.png[/img]
Try your luck in the card balls to obtain your desired legendary cards!

We have doubled the chance to get legendary cards for limited period only!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5311

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904149110.png[/img]
The unique training suits designed by Total and Sancay are now 

available in the Capsule Shop for limited time offer only!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5310

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904072598.png[/img]
Quest for the net as we open Crew League Season 6!

Enjoy crew league point x 2 during this season!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5309

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479904017962.png[/img]
Let’s make the Crew League System more interesting by completing the 

Crew League Challenge Missions! 

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5309

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903961762.png[/img]

Control the rebound and Collect Random Box Reward!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5308

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903811680.png[/img]
Decorate the Christmas tree and earn Tree-mendous rewards!

Link:http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5307

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903778579.png[/img]

Log in everyday and heap awesome items for free!

Check this link for the reward List:
http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5306

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903709258.png[/img]

Calling all users who haven’t log in to the game for 90 days?
 
This event is solely for the returnees!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/5305

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479903593329.png[/img]
Check out the new items this December in the in-game shop.

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/5304

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479897223736.gif[/img]

1.Hold [W] Key when receiving ball

2.Combination actions possible
    a. Post Up Dribble ([Direction Key toward post])
    b. Turnaround Fadeaway ([Direction Key away from post] + [D] Key)
    c. Post Up Cut in Drive 
        > While Post Up Keeping hold [Left or Right Direction Key]. 
        > Drive Fake with short key presses
    d. Connect Post up Keeping with Post Up Drive Fake or Backward Two Step

[b]Hand to Hand Pass[/b]
Skill has been adjusted so that Hand to Hand Pass can be used while 
Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901868535.gif[/img]

a.Pass to a close teammate during Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling 
b.Press [S] Key while Post Up Keeping or Post Up Dribbling
c.Adjusted so Hand to Hand pass can be used while Post Up Dribbling

[b]Post Up Drive Fake II changed to Post Up Drive Fake III[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479896952556.png[/img]

[u]1.Controls[/u]

A.Post Up Drive: During Post Up Wind Up [Left or Right Direction Key facing post]
B. Post Up Drive Fake Shot: While Post Up Drive Fake press 
[Direction Key opposite from drive] + [D] Key
C. Post Up Drive Fake Pivot Shot: While Post Up Drive Fake Pivoting press 
[Direction Key opposite from Pivot direction] + [D] Key

[u]2.Post Up Drive Fake Pivot Shot mechanic[/u]

A.Press only [D] Key to Jump Shot
B.To Post Shot or Layup press [Direction Key towards post] + [D] Key
(Jump Shot if not in Layup range)
C.To Post Reverse Layup press [Direction Key away from Drive] + [D] Key
(Drive Fake motion if not in Layup range)
D. If [D] Key is not used this leads to Drive Fake motion

[h1]Swing Man[/h1]

[b]Backward Dribble[/b]
Enhance Drive patterns

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901844504.gif[/img]

1.Press [A] + [Direction Key away from post] at beginning of drive
2.Dribbling is possible after using Backward Dribble
3.The Backward Dribble skill can be combined with [A] Dribble skills

[b]Tripping Prevention skill improvement[/b]
Actions have been added when colliding during drives to enhance SW position

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479901803970.gif[/img]

1.While Drive Collision press [Direction Key] + [A] Key
A.Press [Left or Right Direction Key facing post]: Side Hop Step combination
B.Press [Direction Key away from post]: Back Step combination

[b]Added skills from other positions[/b]
Add more ways to make shots for SW

> Added skills: Jump Pass / Floater
>Scoop Shot skill improved: The position of Scoop Shots have been adjusted

We are always looking to improve our gameplay for our ballers. 
We hope this balance patch makes our game much more fun and competitive! 
See you on the courts!

Ho Ho Ho Merry Christmas!

Are you in the spirit for Christmas? 

To celebrate Christmas, our Player MODs will be giving out gifts to a few special Ballers that 
have been nice this year. The Player MOD Santa’s will be giving out [b][u]1 Legend SP Edition Card Deck [/u][/b]of your choice for this Christmas!  If you want a chance to receive a gift from Santa, 
you will need to write a letter to him first! Write a letter to Santa and tell him what you like about Freestyle2 and one sentence that can summarize FS2! Don’t forget to mention which
SP Legend Card Deck you wish to get. 

We will choose 9 special Ballers from the letters to play a match against the MOD Santa’s. 
We will also be choosing 3 more Ballers during the event date so make sure to come on over! 

We will have a trivia quiz in the live channel. 
Get it correct to get a chance to play! If you win, your wish will come true! Check below for more details!

notes.title: About the upcoming update!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1479452135518.png[/img]

Hello, Ballers!

Project Manager of Freestyle2, Lucy is here to talk about upcoming update on December 7th!

We are preparing a lot of exciting new contents for the upcoming December update. I know you guys were super curious about the upcoming *mystery* update, so Lucy has come to give you some hints on what’s coming up in the future! First off, we have chosen Rebound as our theme for this new update because we believe that this update is going to be a game changing moment for FS2 and we will be bouncing back in action like rebounding in basketball.

(Yes, I know that the theme seems like we’re going to add a super new Rebound skill or redesign all Centers and PFs but it was more intended to send a message/meaning) 

But get excited because we’re planning to have a lot of cool events and awesome rewards in this upcoming Rebound patch. So stay tuned! We are also going to have a “Big Announcement” regarding one suggestion that you guys have been talking about in the forums and in game a lot. Since we are planning Q&A sessions such as ‘Ask Lucy a question’ soon, don’t forget to write down any questions you want to ask her!
It’s getting pretty chilly outside so stay warm and safe! 

We’ll see you on the Courts!

Greetings Ballers,

As you must be aware, we are currently holding our Seasonal Final Tournaments and we are looking for a baller that wishes to commentate for the four final matches of the tournament. 
To make things interesting and fun, the MODs and GMs will be giving out gifts to ballers that are watching the live stream. 

A small gift of 1500 Gkash will be given per each day the baller commentates.If you can commentate both matches you will receive a total of 3000Gkash.

notes.title: 2016 Fall Season Crew Tournament
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1476962201040.jpg[/img]

Everyone knows that Fall is the season for Basketball. Sign up to compete in the Fall Season Crew Tournament. 

[h1]Registration Period:[/h1]
November 2nd ~ November 13th  

[h1]Application Link: [/h1]
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1g9YFH7OYKJIS2mRKFgqZ5IZOdc4p2ySf2EuqP2qOee4/edit

** Only Crew Masters may apply for this Tournament
 
[h1]Brackets: [/h1] The Brackets will be announced on November 14th 

[h1]Tournament Schedule[/h1]
[h1]NA Server: [/h1]
[b]Top 32 Block A:[/b] November 19th (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)
[b]Top 32 Block B:[/b] November 20th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)
[b]Top 16:[/b] November 26th (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)
[b]Top 8:[/b] November 27th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)
[b]Top 4/Bronze Match:[/b] December 3rd (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)
[b]Finals:[/b] December 4th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (PDT)

[h1]EU Server: [/h1]
[b]Top 32 Block A:[/b] November 19th (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Top 32 Block B:[/b] November 20th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Top 16 Block:[/b] November 26th (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Top 8:[/b] November 27th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Top 4/Bronze Match:[/b] December 3rd (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Finals:[/b] December 4th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (CET)

[h1]ASIA Server: [/h1]
[b]Top 32 Block A:[/b] November 19th (SAT) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 32 Block B:[/b] November 20th (SUN) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 16 Block:[/b] November 26th (SAT) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 8:[/b] November 27th (SUN) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 4/Bronze Match:[/b] December 3rd (SAT) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Finals:[/b] December 4th (SUN) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)

[h1]Requirements: [/h1]
1.Crew must be in Top 150 in Challengers League Ranking by November 2nd 

2.Crews can only apply to one server tournament. You will not be allowed to participate in multiple servers

3.Do not change your Character name once you apply to the Tournament

4.You cannot apply to multiple crew teams with one account. You may apply multiple characters in the same account to 1 team but you will receive the reward only once.

** Crews that get disqualified due to not showing up on the tournament will not be allowed to participate in the next future tournament as a penalty. Please make sure to show up to the tournament on time.

[h1]Teams Applicable per Crew[/h1]
1.Crews with less than 50 Crew members: 1 team
 (3 Main Players + 2 Subs in total)

2.Crews with over 50 Crew members: 2 teams 
(6 Main Players + 4 Subs in total)

3.Crews with over 100 Crew members: 3 teams 
(9 Main Players + 6 Subs in total)

** If more than 16 teams apply for the Tournament for each server, we will select the top 16 teams based on their crew EXP. Multiple teams from the same crew may not be selected to participate in the tournament in order to give other crews a chance to participate. (These details may change due to different circumstances)

[h1]Streaming: [/h1] 
The Top 4 Matches will be streamed in the following link: http://www.twitch.tv/gamekiss

[h1]Event Rules: [/h1]
1.All participants must be inside the Tournament Channel lobby exactly on the event time (The time for each match will be announced later on)

2.Once you are invited to your crew waiting room, please invite your teammates into the room.

3.If one of your team member does not show up on time, you may call upon your Sub player that you have signed in while applying for the event

4.If there are no Sub players that can cover for absent members, your team will be disqualified and will automatically lose.

5.No 3rd party programs are allowed in this event. (If we detect any programs the crew will be banned from any future tournaments and the violator will be suspended)

6.If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume from where left off. However if the baller does not return in 10 minutes and there are no registered Sub players in the team, the team will be disqualified.

7. We can only allow a player that is having technical difficulties to proceed to the game after two (2) tries. If the player unable to proceed on the second try, we will advise to call on their subs or they will be automatically disqualified to the tournament.

** Event details may change due to situations

Everyone knows that Fall is the season for Basketball. Sign up to compete in the Fall Season Crew Tournament.

November 2nd ~ November 13th

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1g9YFH7OYKJIS2mRKFgqZ5IZOdc4p2ySf2EuqP2qOee4/edit

[b]Top 16 Block:[/b] November 26th (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Top 8:[/b] November 27th (SUN) 4PM to 7PM (CET)
[b]Top 4/Bronze Match:[/b] December 3rd (SAT) 4PM to 7PM (CET)

[b]Top 32 Block A:[/b] November 19th (SAT) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 32 Block B:[/b] November 20th (SUN) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 16 Block:[/b] November 26th (SAT) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 8:[/b] November 27th (SUN) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Top 4/Bronze Match:[/b] December 3rd (SAT) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
[b]Finals:[/b] December 4th (SUN) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)

[h1]Requirements: [/h1]
1.Crew must be in Top 150 in Challengers League Ranking by November 2nd 

2.Crews can only apply to one server tournament. You will not be allowed to participate in multiple servers

3.Do not change your Character name once you apply to the Tournament

4.You cannot apply to multiple crew teams with one account. You may apply multiple characters in the same account to 1 team but you will receive the reward only once.

** Crews that get disqualified due to not showing up on the tournament will not be allowed to participate in the next future tournament as a penalty. Please make sure to show up to the tournament on time.

[h1]Teams Applicable per Crew[/h1]
1.Crews with less than 50 Crew members: 1 team
 (3 Main Players + 2 Subs in total)

2.Crews with over 50 Crew members: 2 teams 
(6 Main Players + 4 Subs in total)

3.Crews with over 100 Crew members: 3 teams 
(9 Main Players + 6 Subs in total)

** If more than 16 teams apply for the Tournament for each server, we will select the top 16 teams based on their crew EXP. Multiple teams from the same crew may not be selected to participate in the tournament in order to give other crews a chance to participate. (These details may change due to different circumstances)

[h1]Streaming: [/h1] 
The Top 4 Matches will be streamed in the following link: http://www.twitch.tv/gamekiss

[h1]Event Rules: [/h1]
1.All participants must be inside the Tournament Channel lobby exactly on the event time (The time for each match will be announced later on)

2.Once you are invited to your crew waiting room, please invite your teammates into the room.

3.If one of your team member does not show up on time, you may call upon your Sub player that you have signed in while applying for the event

4.If there are no Sub players that can cover for absent members, your team will be disqualified and will automatically lose.

5.No 3rd party programs are allowed in this event. (If we detect any programs the crew will be banned from any future tournaments and the violator will be suspended)

6.If a baller disconnects during a match, the match will resume from where left off. However if the baller does not return in 10 minutes and there are no registered Sub players in the team, the team will be disqualified.

7. We can only allow a player that is having technical difficulties to proceed to the game after two (2) tries. If the player unable to proceed on the second try, we will advise to call on their subs or they will be automatically disqualified to the tournament.

** Event details may change due to situations

notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1476270207830.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1476270766093.png[/img]
Happy Halloween! Are you ready to get spooked? 
A curse has fallen upon the FS2 courts. All ballers that take step afoot the 
courts on Halloween night will be transformed into eerie Green Skeletons!
You can only play as Green Skeletons in the waiting rooms and you will turn
back to normal size in team matches.
 
If you want to still play as Skeletons you may do so in the VS Com Mode.
If you aren’t really into Skeletons you can always change your outfit. 
The size of your character will still stay small so don’t forget to take a selfie! 
This effect lasts from October 26 ~ 31.

notes.title: Challenge the Player Mods
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1474386612861.jpg[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

The Player Mods are back for another round. The Player Mods had the upper hand in the first event since the contenders were teamed up randomly. Let’s make things a bit more interesting this time around by putting the challengers on same grounds with the Player Mods. Let’s see what these Mods are made of!

Team up with your friends to Challenge the Player Mods and win some cool kicks! Team up with 4 friends and Challenge the Mods. There will also be rewards given out for those that are watching in the On-Air match so stay tuned. 

[h1]Applications are up from Oct 4th ~Oct 7th (00:00) PDT. [/h1]

There’s not much time so hurry up!

[h1]Application Link: [/h1] https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdaAcEzYFRmjYo3BI1DRT_-35WvUxrXPENYXjby_BV3selmdA/viewform 

[h1]Event Schedule:[/h1]
[b]Date: October 9th[/b]
Asia Server: October 9th 2AM to 3AM (PDT)
EU Server: October 9th 8AM to 9 AM (PDT)
NA Server: October 9th 5PM to 6PM (PDT)

[h1]Event Mechanics:[/h1]
1.The Player Mods will be grouped into teams.

2. Ballers who wish to challenge the Mod Team will fill up the Google doc form as a team with the following information:
-Team Name
-Team Leader
-Main Team Members (3)
-1 Substitute Member
**Note: Teams will be chosen in random from the list of applications.

3.3~9 Teams will be chosen to challenge the Player Mods.
(3 Teams per Mod Team).
-If in cases when the applied team does not show up, GMs will choose random ballers and make a team of 3 to face the Mod team. 

4.The match will be broadcasted as an On-Air match

5.Winning team members will be given the Rare Rubber Stomps shoes.

6.On-Air rewards will be given out during the On-Air Match to the users that get the questions correct.

[h1]Rewards:[/h1]
[b]Winning Team: Rubber Stomps[/b]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1474385623355.PNG[/img]
[b]Losing Team: 2 Card Balls[/b]
[b]On-Air Question Rewards: 1 Card Ball per right question (total 10)[/b]

We’ll see you at the match then. Get your game face on!

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472643698199.png[/img]
Do you ever wonder why the Change attribute tab is still available in the 
card window?

It is because you still have a chance to change the sub attributes of  your cards and we will be giving FREE Card Sub attribute changers by just logging into the game!
 
[b]Event Period: [/b]
09/14 – 09/27 23:59
 
[b]Event Mechanics: [/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472643040363.PNG[/img]

Don’t miss a single day!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472643104846.png[/img]

Get Flick FreeStyle Skill box by completing the Bingo board!
Collect bingo titles and enjoy the buff!
 
[b]Event Period: [/b]
2016.09.14 – 2016.09.27 23:59
 
[b]Event Details:[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642003376.png[/img]

[b]Shuffle:[/b] Do you have many numbers that are not in a row?
Do you want to make another row without bingo ticket? 
With Shuffle function, you can shuffle the numbers on the board!
 
[b]Reset:[/b] You can reset the bingo board and re-start the bingo!
You can get free items if you complete bingo missions. 
 
[h1]Bingo Mission Reward:[/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642292695.png[/img]
Reward: 2 Card Balls
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642318682.png[/img]

Reward: 1 Prism Card
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642372944.png[/img]
Reward: Get Flick Style Skill box
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1468410178294.gif[/img]

Play a match to receive 1 Bingo Coin or login to receive 3 Bingo Coins a day!
 
Collect a Bingo Coin and Complete the Bingo Missions!
 
Note: You can only obtain [b]99 Bingo coins per day.[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472643078373.png[/img]

Heard about [b]“Buff Title”?[/b]

It is not your ordinary achievement title because this title can only
be used for a certain period of time!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642215356.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642406834.png[/img]

Buff Effect: All Attribute +3 for 30 Days

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642436889.png[/img]

Condition: Get Mismatched numbers 100 times
Buff Effect: All Attribute +1 for 30 Days

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1472642253029.png[/img]

Condition: Get number 7 on bingo 7 times
Buff Effect: 100% Point buff for 7 Days
 
Complete the Bingo and collect these “Buff Titles”!
 
[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: New FS2 Player Mods!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1471517016734.jpg[/img]

Hello Ballers,

I’m glad to inform you that we have finally made our decisions on who will lead our FS2 community as Player Mods! It was really difficult choosing only 10 from so many great applications. But before making the announcement there are few things I’d like to go over concerning the Player Mods.

[b]About Player Mods[/b]

[h1]Role[/h1]
As mentioned before being a Player Mod is 100% voluntary. There are many ways to help out the FS2 community and there are no restrictions on what you can do as long as you are helping out! This could be:
-Helping users in need
-Creating guides for users
-Taking care of forums and communities 
-Report bugs or issues
-User event forums (coming soon)
These are only few of the many things you can do to help ballers out there. And don’t forget Player Mods are volunteers. There are no rewards or gifts given for being a Player Mod.

[h1]Assessment Period[/h1]
It’s up to you on how you want to help the community. However there are a few rules in being a Player Mod. 

First off, Player Mods will go through an Assessment Period of 4 weeks where the GM team and the Player Mod Leaders will assess the new Mods to see if they fit our team. As long as the Mods are helping out in the community and are not inactive for a long time, they will successfully become full Player Mods.

Secondly, if the Player Mod is inactive for an extended period of time (2 weeks) we will have to replace them with a new candidate. When you become a full Player Mod, you will be given the Player Mod cape and other more abilities that will aid you in helping the community more. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1471517268288.png[/img]

[h1]About Player Mod Leaders[/h1]
You might be curious on who these Player Mod Leaders are. They’re your old Supporters that have been working with us till now! Player Mod Leaders will be given a special in-game title to distinguish them from other Player Mods. These Leaders are here to help the new Mods in becoming full Player Mods. 

[h1]They’re main role is:[/h1]
-Guide and show the new Mods on how to be a great Player Mod. 
-Sharing any issues that arise in the Player Mods with the GM team 
-Help GMs in assessing new Player Mods
Currently we are only planning of having 3 Leaders per server. But whenever there’s a case where a Leader has to leave us, the Leaders and GMs will vote on who the next Leader will be from the original Player Mods. 
 
These are our current Player Mod Leaders:

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1471517353956.png[/img]

** Since all the supporters in the EU server have left, the GM team will choose new Leaders for EU after the Player Mods go through the Assessment Period.

Now that we’ve gone through the specifics, without further ado, let me introduce you to the new Player Mods!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1471517498589.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1471517527597.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1471517564016.png[/img]

Note: Three more ballers were added as Player Mods.

Joedefender for Asia
Alloces for EU
BurakkuJoka for NA


[h1][Update] New FS2 Player Mods:[/h1] http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/notice/4189

Congratulations to the new Player Mods.
Please send in your forum usernames (nickname) to 
[steam_support@gamekiss.com] via email so we can invite you to the 
Player Mods Forum page.

-Team FreeStyle2

notes.title: Become a FS2 Mod!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405655628.png[/img]

Hello Ballers!

We are looking to recruit new FS2 Player Mods! 
We have decided to change the name of our Supporters to Player Moderators (Player Mods in short) as this term is easier to understand the role they play and gets rid of unnecessary confusion: they’re here to moderate the game and help other ballers.

So! Any ballers out there that are willing to work with us to make FS2 better, this is your chance!

[u]Being a Player Mod is a voluntary role and they gain no advantage over other users either than some abilities to help aid users and exclusive clothes/titles to make identifying Player Mods easier. We are looking for ballers that are willing to volunteer to help.[/u]

However there are some rules and qualifications to become one of our Player Mods. You know the old saying, “With Great Power comes Great Responsibility” (Uncle Ben). 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405089414.jpg[/img]
Submit an application to the following link during the registration period to apply.

[h1]Registration Period:[/h1] August 19th ~ August 29th

[h1]Results:[/h1] August 31st

[h1]Application Form:[/h1] 
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1moPOHnCj0P2_gljJwmsO5KvIqX2yjHalSeDwk2cWXls/edit

** The new Player Mods will be announced through the Gamekiss Official Website.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405225804.jpg[/img]
1.Player Mods will have access to a special forum section where only Player Mods and FS2 Team can enter.

2.Candidate must be active and knowledgeable of the FS2 community and also loves playing FS2.

3.Candidate must be active in sharing FS2 news and updates in the community sites.

4.Someone who is well known and friendly to the community members and are always willing to help or assist new players.

5.Crew leaders will be given further consideration. 

6.Player Mods shall have no hidden or personal agendas/plans to join the FS2 Player Mods for their own good. (Abusing, title, etc.)

7.After becoming a Player Mod, you will go through a 4 week assessment term where the Player Mod Leaders determine if you fit the team. Player Mods must not abuse Mod authorities, act disrespectfully to users, and must be supportive. 

8.Be like Spiderman and do the right thing.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405313461.jpg[/img]
[b]1.Help out Ballers.[/b]
-The most important responsibility we are looking for in a Player Mod is their willingness to help new ballers or ballers that are having difficulty.
-Answer player inquires related to game play (tips, guides, how to play)
-Post guides and tips on the message board for new players.

[b]2.Moderate the message board.[/b]
-Ensure that the guidelines for the forum is always followed by other community members and report to the GM team if issues arise in the forum.
-Player Mods must be friendly and cooperative.
-Player Mods have the ability to manage both Gamekiss and Steam forums as a moderator.

[b]3.Report bugs or issues to the GM team.[/b]
-Player Mods can report bugs or errors that occur inside the game on the Player Mod forums and it will be monitored.
-Abusive players notified by the Player Mods will be monitored by the GMs.

4.Player Mods have access to manage the upcoming Event Forum where Player Mods and users can freely create their own tourneys and tryouts. Inform the GMs with the details and the Player Mods can run the tourney they wish to play.
-The GM team may assist the Player Mods, but Player Mods are responsible for running these events (ex. Player Mod Quiz event, Beat the Player Mods event, etc.)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405458751.jpg[/img]
1.The GM team will choose ballers that qualify to become a Player Mod.

2.We are recruiting the following number of Player Mods for each server
[b]-Asia Server:[/b] 7 Player Mods
[b]-NA Server:[/b] 7 Player Mods
[b]-Europe Server:[/b] 10 Player Mods
 
Apply now to get a chance to become a FS2 Player Mod! We’ll be waiting!

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

6.Player Mods shall have no hidden or personal agendas/plans to join the FS2 Player Mods for their own good. (Abusing, title, etc.)

7.After becoming a Player Mod, you will go through a 4 week assessment term where the Player Mod Leaders determine if you fit the team. Player Mods must not abuse Mod authorities, act disrespectfully to users, and must be supportive. 

8.Be like Spiderman and do the right thing.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405313461.jpg[/img]
[b]1.Help out Ballers.[/b]
-The most important responsibility we are looking for in a Player Mod is their willingness to help new ballers or ballers that are having difficulty.
-Answer player inquires related to game play (tips, guides, how to play)
-Post guides and tips on the message board for new players.

[b]2.Moderate the message board.[/b]
-Ensure that the guidelines for the forum is always followed by other community members and report to the GM team if issues arise in the forum.
-Player Mods must be friendly and cooperative.
-Player Mods have the ability to manage both Gamekiss and Steam forums as a moderator.

[b]3.Report bugs or issues to the GM team.[/b]
-Player Mods can report bugs or errors that occur inside the game on the Player Mod forums and it will be monitored.
-Abusive players notified by the Player Mods will be monitored by the GMs.

4.Player Mods have access to manage the upcoming Event Forum where Player Mods and users can freely create their own tourneys and tryouts. Inform the GMs with the details and the Player Mods can run the tourney they wish to play.
-The GM team may assist the Player Mods, but Player Mods are responsible for running these events (ex. Player Mod Quiz event, Beat the Player Mods event, etc.)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1470405458751.jpg[/img]
1.The GM team will choose ballers that qualify to become a Player Mod.

2.We are recruiting the following number of Player Mods for each server
[b]-Asia Server:[/b] 7 Player Mods
[b]-NA Server:[/b] 7 Player Mods
[b]-Europe Server:[/b] 10 Player Mods
 
Apply now to get a chance to become a FS2 Player Mod! We’ll be waiting!

[b][u]during the 22nd – 28th and also whole event period.[/u][/b]

It was limited time offer SPC.[/b] http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/3049

[h1] For Twitch users[/h1]
1.Take a screenshot that shows off your stream screen and # of max concurrent viewers
Make your own thread and write all the info below here:

http://forums.gamekiss.com/forum/freestyle2/fan-art
[b]Steam Event Category:[/b]
 http://steamcommunity.com/app/339610/discussions/10/

1.Character name:
2.Stream screenshot: 
3.Your Twitch channel URL:
4.# of subscriber:
5.Twitch stream highlight URL:

[b]Steam Event Category:[/b]

1.Character name:
2.Youtube Video URL:

3.Content Quality
4.The video must be uploaded after Aug 8th
5.If you submit multiple times with same video, we will count only one that is latest submit

** The final week reward will be given only once per account.
** We might ask you to send us certain page of YouTube and Twitch channel to verify if you are the owner of channel. If player were not able send us screenshot, reward won’t be given. 


[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: Be the Summer Season Crew Tournament Official Commentators
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469192513553.jpg[/img]

Be the official FS2 commentator for 2016 Summer Season Crew Tournament
and receive tremendous rewards!
 
Upload your sample commentation video on YouTube.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1458048472007.jpg[/img]

Audition Period: August 5 – August 10th 23:59 (Server Time)

Here’s how!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1458048510471.jpg[/img]

[h1]A. Apply with replay File and Upload it on YouTube[/h1]
 
1.Make a full commentation with this match: 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B0mz-LyFr1w3Z0tsczktUXN2VzA/view

2. Use the replay file provided. Do not use unnecessary video effects
(Such as zoom-in, color  change, non-FS2 music etc.)
 
3. If you can show yourself commentating on the corner of the video, 
you will get extra points.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447158329106.png[/img]

4.No cursing or hate speech is allowed. Be fair and avoid taking sides.
 
5.If you have an extra person who wants to commentate along with you, 
make a commentation video together. (maximum of 2 ballers including yourself) 

Once you are done, upload your video on YouTube with this title:
[b][u]“Freestyle2 Commentary by [your character name]”[/u][/b]

[h1]B. Apply with Twitch Highlight [/h1] 
 If you have twitch channel and already have a good highlight video that 
you are discussing while you are playing a FS2, that would be just fine! 
 
Just use that highlight link when you submit the application.
 
Post your entry on the Fan Art section of our message board.
[b]Gamekiss:[/b] http://forums.gamekiss.com/forum/freestyle2/fan-art
[b]Steam:[/b] http://steamcommunity.com/app/339610/discussions/10/

Please make sure to include the following information:
[h1]Thread title: Commentary Audition by [YOUR in-game main character name][/h1]
Character Name:
Audition YouTube link:
Freestyle2 experience: ____year(s)
Additional comments:

Commentator should be available for the final stage streaming:

Top 4/Bronze Match and Final Matches:
 
[b]Asia Server: [/b]
Top 4/Bronze Match: August 13th (Sat) 4PM to 7 PM (PDT)

[b]EU Server:[/b]
Top 4/Bronze Match: August 13th (Sat) 7AM to 10 AM (PDT) 
Final: August 14th (Sun) 7AM to 10 AM (PDT)
 
[b]NA Server: [/b]
Top 4/Bronze Match: August 13th (Sat) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)
Final: August 14th (Sun) 1AM to 4AM (PDT)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1458048722874.jpg[/img]

[b]Audition Winning Reward: [/b]
1000 Gkash
 
[b]Participation reward for commentating:[/b]
3000 Gkash + Black shadow set

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432565093789.gif[/img]

The Winner/s will be announced on [b]August 11th. [/b]

Twitch channel broadcasting key, so if you applied to this event and won, 
please be sure to send an e-mail with your skype id!

Show us what you’ve got and be our official Commentator this season!

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: August 3 Patch Notes: Lobby lag issue updated, Shot Clock Violation issue updated, Hack monitoring system updated, Wulin character voice update, Event button location adjusted , Card sub attribute changer and New events
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026057238.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026675566.jpg[/img]

Performing a certain action inside the channel lobby increased lag significantly. It has been updated so that while inside the channel lobby the framerate does not decrease below a certain point regardless of any action performed. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026708377.jpg[/img]

- Players should be able to play normal game after a short period of time 
if the game and shot clock timer gets stuck.
 
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026729101.jpg[/img]

-Hack monitoring system now collects a larger range of abnormal skills and 
movements. It now collects a more detailed and thorough data log that allows 
for closer inspection.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026751546.jpg[/img]

The original voices for the Wulin characters have been remastered. 
Certain character voices having low volume have also been resolved.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026771702.jpg[/img]

Locations of certain buttons that used to overlap have been adjusted.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026790984.jpg[/img]

Card Sub Attribute Changer is available again in the Card System.
However, [b][u]Card Sub Attribute Changer item can only be obtained from the event.[/u][/b]
[b][u]You cannot purchase the said item directly in the Change Attributes tab of the Card system.[/u][/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469027584578.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469020286965.png [/img]
Get a maximum of 50 Card Balls for only 550 Gkash. (X5 more balls than original amount!) Just login for 20 out of 30 days to receive all 50 Card Balls! Don’t miss out!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/3131

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469019931525.png[/img]

Certain items in the point ball rewards will be deleted and sold in the shop. 
New rare rank clothes have been added to the point ball rewards.

[h1]Updated Items [/h1]
-Hawaiian Surfer Top (Attri.7D) 
-Tropical Printed Boardshorts (Attri.7D)
-Soft Dread Extension
-Sakun Smile Cat Doll 2.0
-Sakun Smile Cat Doll 1.0

Point Ball Item Update: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/3134

[h1]Deleted Items[/h1]
-Gingerbread man
-Flexible Snickers
-Rare Tops
-Rare Bottoms
-Oxford Flat Shoes
-Sporty High-Top
-Beach Sandals
-Box of Vietnamese Hair
-Rare Hair Box
-Best Sailor Hat
-Rare Sporty (7d)

[h1]Deleted and moved to in-game shop[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469027731418.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469020180283.png[/img]

Did you just purchase the SP Magic Ball Package? 
Then you’ll probably need a lot of Sub Attribute Changers and Prism Card++ won’t you?
 
Here, I’ll give you 3 Sub Attribute Changers for free. Oh, yeah don’t forget to get your free Gold Core too!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469026821333.jpg[/img]

The items sold in the Epic Deal shop will be replaced. 
The Epic Deal shop will now be a permanent feature of FS2 and no longer an event.

[h1]Billy’s Epic Deal Shop: For New Players Only[/h1]

[b]How to get this ticket? [/b]
-If you are a New Player and just reached level. 6 for the first time, 
Billy will send you a ticket so you can open his secret shop.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469027817617.PNG[/img]

[h1]Clara’s Epic Deal Shop: For every Baller![/h1]

[b]How to get this ticket?[/b]
-You can get this ticket by playing a match only in the
PRO CHANNEL as a Match reward
it has a low chance to appear so play a lot of matches in Pro Channel! 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469031108923.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469020231989.png[/img]
Be cryptic adventure of FS2 court with this new outfit only available in the 
Capsule Shop for limited time only!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/3130

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469020055748.png[/img]
Login 7 days to receive a Sub Attribute Changer! Login every day! 
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/3129

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469020117997.png[/img]
Play a match, Collect the letters, Control the rebound and win tons of prizes in 
Liu’s Summer Match!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/3133

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1469019990530.png[/img]
Check out this new outfits available this August!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/3128

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

this tournament.

for multiple crew teams.

but you will get the reward only once.

2) Given by disassembling rare rank items at a low chance.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1461767385484.png[/img]

(Random activation)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1461767661756.jpg[/img]

1)While completing the 5 Placement Matches, you will be able to get a Card Deck
for new player. (You may only get this once per account.)
 
2)Card equipment tutorial will be added and the information of Card set effect
will be explained.
 
3)If a baller did not finish the tutorial a tutorial pop-up will show up.
 
4) “Losing Streak” Buff 
-If a new player loses matches in a row, a Buff will be activated.
This will temporarily increase all attributes (only in major channel)

notes.title: New Crew System Bug Fixes & FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]1. There is no Crew Rankings! I want the old Rankings back.[/h1]
- Unfortunately, the previous ranking has been replaced to the Crew League
Ranking. The Crew EXP system has been removed and there will be no
Crew Rankings based on the Crew EXP. This is mostly likely the new update
for the Crew system.

[h1]2. My contribution points are gone![/h1]
- Same as Crew ranking, we have removed the old contribution points and
started a new one based on your attendance and Crew League participation.
 
 
[h1]3. No staffs/admins/leader/vice-leader/managers can invite/accept someone 
or someone's application if they wanted to join a specific crew.[/h1]
- This bug has been fixed today.
 
 
[h1]4. Whenever we, as a crew team tries to contribute/play together - then
the match finishes, it doesn't give us any Crew Points.[/h1]
- We have revised the previous GM guide to make this issue clear.

Please be informed that unlike on our previous Crew EXP system, Crew Coins
can [b][u]ONLY[/u][/b] be acquired by completing the following:
 
1. Crew Attendance Mission
2. Playing a Crew League Match
 
We will have a Crew League more often so every crew can have a chance to get the Crew Coins.

For more details regarding this matter, please check this link:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/339610/announcements/detail/851553645898549975

[i]Be free to create your own style, FreeStyle![/i]

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: Crew System Update
notes.content:
Check out our new and improved Crew System that will give you and 
your crew members more reasons to play!

[b]There will be no more Crew Exp. system it will now be replaced with[/b] [h1]“Crew Coin”.[/h1]

Crew Coins will be the main key of this brand new system,
 so let me explain about Crew Coin first!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459441686008.jpg[/img]
- The “Crew Coin” is a new in-game currency that is earned by the Crew and used only in Crew System. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459441724406.jpg[/img]
- With the Crew Coins, players can level up their crew, purchase Crew Buffs. 
- Also, players will be able to customize their own Crew Uniform and 
Crew Emblem with Crew Coin later. (This feature will be available after 3rd Crew System Update.)

[h1]I.	CREW MAIN SCREEN [/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459446708643.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459442913281.jpg[/img]

You can view these Crew Members in this section of the main screen: 
[b]Crew Master, Vice-Crew Master, Star Player and Manager(s).[/b] (Up to 5 players)

Here is a list of new roles and explanation.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532242111.jpg[/img]
[h1]1)Crew Master (1 Baller)[/h1]
Crew Master can assign crew members to a various roles and have a highest authority.
Crew Master can assign other Ballers as their Vice-Crew Master and Manager.
 
Crew Master Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can change the Crew’s emblem
2.Can appoint and dismiss the Vice-Crew Master or Manager
3.Can Invite and kick crew members
4.Can post and delete recruitment notice
5.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
[h1]2)Vice-Crew Master (1 player)[/h1]
Vice-Crew Master has the same authority as Crew Master.

Vice Crew Master Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can appoint and dismiss the crew Manager
2.Can Invite and kick crew members except the Crew Master
3.Can post and delete recruitment notice
4.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
[h1]3)Manager (No limit)[/h1]
Manager has authority to invite and accept a player to his crew.
 
Manager Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can Invite crew members 
2.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
[h1]4)Crew Member[/h1]
Crew Members have no authority.

[h1]**New Feature: Crew Master Change[/h1]
Crew Masters can be replaced if the Crew Master does not login for a 
month or leaves the Crew. 
 
It will be automatically given to other Baller based on this priority list.

notes.title: Crew System Update
notes.content:
Check out our new and improved Crew System that will give you and 
your crew members more reasons to play!

[b]There will be no more Crew Exp. system it will now be replaced with[/b] [h1]“Crew Coin”.[/h1]

Crew Coins will be the main key of this brand new system,
 so let me explain about Crew Coin first!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459441686008.jpg[/img]
- The “Crew Coin” is a new in-game currency that is earned by the Crew and used only in Crew System. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459441724406.jpg[/img]
- With the Crew Coins, players can level up their crew, purchase Crew Buffs. 
- Also, players will be able to customize their own Crew Uniform and 
Crew Emblem with Crew Coin later. (This feature will be available after 3rd Crew System Update.)

[h1]I.	CREW MAIN SCREEN [/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459446708643.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459442913281.jpg[/img]

You can view these Crew Members in this section of the main screen: 
[b]Crew Master, Vice-Crew Master, Star Player and Manager(s).[/b] (Up to 5 players)

Here is a list of new roles and explanation.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1459532242111.jpg[/img]
[h1]1)Crew Master (1 Baller)[/h1]
Crew Master can assign crew members to a various roles and have a highest authority.
Crew Master can assign other Ballers as their Vice-Crew Master and Manager.
 
Crew Master Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can change the Crew’s emblem
2.Can appoint and dismiss the Vice-Crew Master or Manager
3.Can Invite and kick crew members
4.Can post and delete recruitment notice
5.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
[h1]2)Vice-Crew Master (1 player)[/h1]
Vice-Crew Master has the same authority as Crew Master.

Vice Crew Master Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can appoint and dismiss the crew Manager
2.Can Invite and kick crew members except the Crew Master
3.Can post and delete recruitment notice
4.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
[h1]3)Manager (No limit)[/h1]
Manager has authority to invite and accept a player to his crew.
 
Manager Access Level and restrictions:
1.Can Invite crew members 
2.Can approve and deny Crew Recruitment application 
 
[h1]4)Crew Member[/h1]
Crew Members have no authority.

[h1]**New Feature: Crew Master Change[/h1]
Crew Masters can be replaced if the Crew Master does not login for a 
month or leaves the Crew. 
 
It will be automatically given to other Baller based on this priority list.

notes.title: March 16th Game Update: Team SLAM release, Channel Merge, Crew League Tier info, Grace's Enchanted Wallet, Extreme Level up event, Unlock the box, new outfits
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456937571459.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. Channel Merge[/h1]
Rookie & Major Channel will be merged.
But don’t worry! The ELO system has been improved upon this 
channel merge, so you will not be facing teams that are too strong.
 
-New & existing baller ELO rating system update
Default ELO points will be changed according to the Baller’s status 
and highest character level
 
a. New baller’s ELO default point / minimum point : 300 ELO points
  - Even if you keep losing, ELO point won’t go down below 300 ELO points.
 
b. Default points for the ballers who do not have a character
over Lv.20 in their account : 700 ELO points
 
c. Default points for ballers who have characters 
over Lv.20 in their account : 1000 ELO points
 
ELO system now counts the points based on the highest character level in
your account.

[h1]2. Crew League Tier info has been added[/h1]
-Now you can check your Crew Tier any time.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456937065809.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454307925916.jpg[/img]

[h1]3. Back/Waist items have been separated.[/h1] 

Now you can wear both Back Accs. and Waist Accs. together
starting from this patch.
 
For example, you can now wear the Champion belt and 
Crew league Cape together!
 
But you will no longer be able to add attributes to waist item anymore. 
 
If you already added Back Accs. attribute Coupon-Avoid Block from 
DIY system on to your Waist Accs. before this patch, your attribute 
will be removed and an Attribute Coupon will be placed in your Gift box.
 
Applicable items are as follows:
-	FS2 Champion Belt 
-	Duck Tube 

[h1]4. Team Slam Release![/h1]
-Team Slam premium package limited sale!
There are new Special Characters and a premium package!
 
Don’t miss out on this special chance for a Skill slot, Points, or
Premium random card box!
 
-Team Slam 30% special sale!
30% sale on the Team Slam coupon for 2 weeks only!
Now is the best chance for buying a premium package if you have 
been hesitating!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456929348815.jpg[/img]

Are you tired of your second character? Or did you create a new character today?
There is a BIG Level Up Event for everyone!
When can you get the Reward? 
You’ll get it during the weekly maintenance after the event! 
You can get various benefits such as 1000 Gkash, Skill slot, etc! 
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2933

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456929394061.png[/img]
Only for 2 weeks! This is the only chance to the real Kung fu Master outfit!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2934

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456929497388.png[/img]
Are you in need of cash? Buy a Point Wallet and get free cash or get the
Cash Wallet where you can get up to 3 times the return plus 50,000 points! 
Think hard and fast because you only have 1 week.
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2936

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456929258411.png[/img]
Play a game, Stay log in, collect SP Box keys earns free items from the SP Random box!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2932

notes.title: 2016 Super Crew League
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455893403663.png[/img]

It’s time for the REAL super match with all the top Crews!
 
Did you expect the ordinary Top 32 tournament? No, this time will be different.
 
Check out the new rule and tons of exclusive rewards  for this Crew League.
 
Let’s now start the biggest FS2 Crew League and see who will be the best
among the rest this year! This will be the first and the last Crew League of 2016.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455887814412.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455904937560.jpg[/img]

March 4th - March 13th 23:59 (10 days)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905018001.jpg[/img]

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1bbBRpV38gyqwsf6xN-t6lUJsx1alZoaz_RrnW1cja2s/viewform

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905119724.jpg[/img]

Pre-Group stage brackets will be uploaded by March 14th.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905173971.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905654562.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455908171690.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905684899.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455908206253.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905711064.jpg[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455908247393.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905790033.jpg[/img]

1. 1000 Crew EXP on March 13th 23:59 (PDT)
2. Your crew can only apply on one server.
Do not apply on multiple servers for this tournament.
3. Please do not change your Character name once you applied for this tournament. 
4. Don't apply more than one time with characters in same account for multiple crew teams.

[i]-You are allowed to apply 2 characters in the same account for 1 team, 
but you will get the reward only once.[/i]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455905885609.jpg[/img]

[b]Crew with over 5 Crew members: [/b] 1 team (3 Main player + 2 sub) 

[b]Crew with over 30 Crew members:[/b]2 teams (6 Main player + 4 sub in total)

**If more than 32 teams are applying for this event (for each server: NA/EU/Asia), 
we will select top 32 teams based on their crew EXP and 2nd or 3rd team of crew will not 
be selected depends on the situation to give other crews a chance to participate.

** Event detail can be changed depends on the situation.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455906001678.jpg[/img]

Match will be streamed from Group Stage :
http://www.twitch.tv/gamekiss

Commentation will be added from Final Stage

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455906093755.jpg[/img]

Event Rule  

1. All participants must be in Tournament Channel lobby following exactly the
event time. (Time for each team match will be announced later)
 
2. Once you invited to your crew waiting room, invite your teammates to the room.

3. If your one of team member doesn't show up in time, you may call a sub player
that you signed in when you apply for the event
 
4. If there are no sub players who can cover and not enough members to start the
match, your team will automatically lose. 

5. No 3rd party program is allowed for this event. (If we detect it, that crew
won't be able to participate in this tournament anymore and the violator
suspended)

6. Matches will resume if a baller disconnects however if the baller does not return
after 10minutes and there are no registered sub players the team will be
disqualified.

8. Only the Crew Master can write an application for this event.

** Event detail can be changed depending on the situation.

A Golden Seed will be given to the certain crews.

Entry to the group stage will be given to [b]‘Team A’[/b] of the crews who were given a Golden Seed.

[b]Qualification: The crews who ranked first or second place in a major tournament last 2015.[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456291149427.PNG[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456291379675.PNG[/img]
** Edited: Smooth Aces Crew has been replaced to Logic Crew. (03/06/2016)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1456291267634.PNG[/img]

** Once the crew master submits for this Crew League, 
Team A from the application will be automatically advanced to Group Stage. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455906252280.jpg[/img]

This stage will determine the teams for the final stage, 
the number of teams per server may vary.
 
The total numbers of participating teams that will go to the
Group Stage are as follow:

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455890823068.PNG[/img]

** Details may changed depends on the situation.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455890960321.png[/img]

[b]How teams will go to the group stages are as follow:[/b]

1)A tournament comprised of 32 teams will be conducted;
the tournament will end when the top 8 teams have been decided. 
(Best out of 1)
 
2)The top 8 teams will be given priority and will be able to proceed to the
group stage.
 
3)The remaining seeds will be selected from the top 16 teams 
[b]in order of highest Crew EXP on March 28th 00:00[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455906498365.jpg[/img]

Group stage will be done in a ‘Round Robin’ way.
1.	All teams will have one match against each team in the same group.
 
2.	Only 8 matches are available per group.
-	Group A match: April 2nd
-	Group B match: April 3rd
-	Group C match: April 9th
-	Group D match: April 10th
 
3. The Top 2 scoring teams per group will proceed to the final stage.
The crews who got Golden seed will be assigned equally to each group.
 
The current assigned group list is:

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455890926231.png[/img]


[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455890912736.png[/img]


[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455890899478.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455906576896.jpg[/img]

The final stage willgo along with Best out of 3 matches.
The crew league winner of the Final match will go to the team who won 3 times 
first from the ‘Best out of 5’.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455891209648.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455892418738.png[/img]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455891341988.png[/img]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455891451020.png[/img]

3 Card balls + 3 Item balls + Doodle Snapback
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455892036402.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455906951402.jpg[/img]

[h1]Team members: [/h1]
5000 Gkash + 10,000pt 

[h1]All Crew members:[/h1] 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455892218591.png[/img]
Sakun Duck Cap (O)+ 1 Card ball + 1 Item ball

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1455907052794.jpg[/img]

[h1]Team members:[/h1]
5 Point Balls + 20 FreeStyle Tickets

Ready to sign up today?
 
Be prepared for the biggest Crew League of this year!

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

The FS2 supporters and GMs will be hanging out in the tournament channel!
 
Use your wits to guess the room’s password by solving the clues the GMs give out.
 
Once 3 players get in the room it’s all about how good you play basketball!
 
[h1]Event Date: [/h1]

Asia server: 4AM to 7AM (PST) 
EU Server: 5PM to 7 PM (CET)
NA Server: 5PM to 7 PM (PST)

1. GM will create a room with a 4 digit password in Event Mode channel.
2. Players will try to enter the room by guessing the password. 
3. The GM will give clues using the megaphone.
4. The first player who will enter the room will be added by the GM 
and he will be advised to proceed in the tournament channel and wait for the GM invitation
 for the match

notes.title: February 17th Game Update: Crew League System, Improved Card Slot UI, Community Server Merge, FS2 Lite Version, New event and Item Shop Update
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508527781.png[/img]
[u]System update and changes[/u]

[h1][1] 1st Crew System Update: Crew League[/h1]
Crew league system has been added.

Crew related Updates will be serialized in 2016, keep an eye out on the FS2 website.
Check this Crew League Guide here:
http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/gameguide/gmguide/2891 

[h1][2] Channel merge[/h1]
There will be changes in some of the channels after this updates.

[b]1.Pro and star channel will be merged for due to the following reasons below:[/b]
-Many ballers in Star channel will play Crew league this month and the number of players in Star channel won’t be enough.
-Most of Ballers who made new positions have reached the appropriate levels.

[b]2. Rookie channel change[/b]
> No more level restrictions in Rookie channel
- Except Asia server, ballers can enter the Rookie channel if the character is below level 12 regardless of the highest level in the ballers’ account. 
-To High level Ballers:
After removing a level restriction, some of high level ballers might
indiscriminately do Smurfing / Evicting new players which create a big barrier for the new players. 
      
Ballers, when you are playing in rookie channel, please help new ballers learn how to play well and get along with them.

Channel merge are as follows:

[b]Asia Server[/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508941569.png[/img]
** Rookie channel level restriction as before.

[b]EU/NA server[/b]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508952866.png[/img]
** Ballers will be able to enter the Rookie channel if the character is below level 12 even though they have characters over level 12 in their account.

[h1][3] Improved UI of the Card slot[/h1]
UI of Card slot is improved for easier Equip/Remove/Upgrade.
Character card filter has been added to that Rare/Legends can be sorted.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509148294.png[/img]

[h1][4] Community Server has been merged.[/h1]
Along with the Crew League Update, the community server has been
merged for smoother synchronization of Crew related data. So now you can see your friend’s log-in status when your friends log-in to other servers.
 
Ex) When Lucy plays at Asia server, there will be a notification when Dime logs-in the EU server. 
 
But because the physical servers are different, you will not be able to use these functions with your friend who is in another server:
1. Following  
2. Room Invite
3. Wisper

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509295314.png[/img]
The new function that will indicate where your friend logged-in will be added soon with further updates.

[h1][5] New Feature: FS2 Lite version (Beta)[/h1]
[b]> This feature is only available on Gamekiss Client at this moment.[/b]
- When you install FS2 for the first time, you can download the minimum
game data and start playing using the Lite version.[u] This new feature will let you play before the download is finished.[/u] 

While playing, the Launcher will download the rest of the game.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509474383.png[/img]

-Full client download progress will be shown on top.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509552313.png[/img]

-Once you download the minimum data of Lite version, you can log-in
        and play at Lite version.

-After finishing download of Full Game files, you can play at Full version by restarting of FS2 client.

Lite version has some limitations which are as follows:
-Limited outfit options (You may not be able to change clothing)
-Every card has the same image. 
(There will be only 3 types of Card images: Defense/Offense/Talent)
-Sound limitation (Only 1 BGM can be used)
-Court limitation (There will be only 1 type of court (map))

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509689361.png[/img]

-Every toy will appear as below:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509743306.png[/img]

[h1][6] Awesomium version update[/h1]
-You can now view the Notice in Windows 10.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509819366.png[/img]

[h1][7] Removed Toy package[/h1]
Limited sale Toy package has been removed.
Shark Toy Random Box
Octopus Toy Random Box
Diodon Toy Random Box

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454509900556.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454503602727.png[/img]
Check out the new outfits available in SAKUN and Mileage shop!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/2894

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508166943.png[/img]
Be as powerful as dragon in FS2 court with these Haaxsin Dragon masks only available in Capsule for limited time only!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2897

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508126655.png[/img]
Never got the item you want in the Events? Now you can get the item you want among 18 other items in Coin shop! You can collect the Coins by justlogging-in for 120mins or playing matches. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to get various New Permanent FX items! 
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2896

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454503658163.png[/img]
No teammates? Don’t be upset anymore. You can do Dirty Dance alone now. 
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/notice/2895

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454508201434.png[/img]
Club League Opening! This BIG chance will never happen again! 
You will get 1500 Mileage when you achieve 10 wins in a row at Crew Match!Do you know how much you need to consume Gkash for 1500 Mileage? It’s 30,000Gkash! 
And there are Special rewards such as 50 Epic Coins and Character Specialty Changer too. Don’t miss it!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2898


[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: Crew League System Update
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454423063659.jpg[/img]

Let’s make your FreeStyle2 experience even more exciting with this new system!
Let’s achieve a new goal which is different from Crew Tournament.
Let me introduce the new system which all the Crew members can participate, 
the Crew League System!
 
[h1]** Notes **[/h1]
 
1. Only the Crew Members [u]who already joined the crew before the Crew League starts[/u] can receive the Crew League reward. 
So you [b]MUST[/b] join a crew before the league starts.
 
** Crew master cannot evict the  members during the Crew League event period.
 
2. Only the Crew Member with character level 12 or up can join the crew league

[h1][u][1] Crew League open time[/u][/h1]
- During the Crew League Event, 
Crew League System only opens during the time below:

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454306034446.PNG[/img]
        
-‘Crew Match’ button will be activated only for the Crew Master / Member with character level 12 or up.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421409643.PNG[/img]

[h1][u] [2] What is Crew League?[/u] [/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454307962387.png[/img]
 
[h1]1) Crew Tier[/h1]
Crew Tier will change based on Crew points after the Crew match. You can view the conditions by clicking the button.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421599796.PNG[/img]
[i]** Tier will be refreshed & changed every hour.[/i]

[h1]2) League[/h1]
There are 2 types of Crew Leagues:

  [b]a. Challengers League[/b]
  Every Crew can join Challengers League for the first 3 weeks.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421687929.PNG[/img] 

  [b]b. Masters League[/b]
  After the 3 weeks of Challengers League, Master’s League will open for 1 week and it is exclusively for [b][u]the Top 30% crews in the Challenger’s League ranking.[/u][/b]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421819626.PNG[/img]

  [b]-Crew League Rule[/b]
  Crew League has Individual ranking and Crew ranking.  A Crew member 
  with the highest Individual Crew point will be chosen as the Star   Player. 
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454421906693.PNG[/img]

[h1]3) Crew League Timer[/h1]
It will inform the opening and closing time of the Crew League.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422100344.PNG[/img]

[h1]4) Rival Crew[/h1]
From the 2nd week of the League, a rival crew with comparable points and total number of wins will be chosen. Rival crew will be re-selected every week. 

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422196303.PNG[/img]

[h1]5) Crew League On-air[/h1]
You can watch other Crew’s matches.
 
[h1]6) Crew League Room List[/h1]
You can enter the room made by a Crew member.You can also make a room if there is no room available.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422280122.PNG[/img]

[h1]7) Crew League Court[/h1]
-3 members from your crew can make a team and join the Crew League Match.
-You can also check the Crew League Ranking and Crew League event time in the court. 
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422378614.PNG[/img]

[h1][u][3] Crew League info[/u][/h1]
You can view the Changes of Crew ranking, Match info., Acquired Crew Points, and Top 5 players in this page.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422498934.PNG[/img]

[h1][u][4] Ranking info[/u][/h1]

[b]a. Crew ranking[/b]
You can view the Crew ranking of the Crew League.
You can also select to view the ranking of Challenger’s League and Master’s League.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422610316.PNG[/img]

[b]b. Crew member ranking[/b]
You can view the Crew member ranking and Star player. And you can also see the Character image by clicking the Character name.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422701702.PNG[/img]

[b]c. Individual ranking[/b]
You can view the ranking based on individual league points.You can see the Character image and Crew name by clicking the Character name.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422830640.PNG[/img]

[h1][u][5]Crew League Reward![/u][/h1]
** Players should have at least 15 individual League Points & joined the crew [u]before the Crew League starts[/u]
 
If you have multiple characters in the same crew, you will receive the reward only once.

[b] a. Challengers League Reward [/b]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454422946794.PNG[/img]

[b] b. Masters League Reward[/b]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1454423004904.PNG[/img]
