notes.title: January 13th Update: New Positions (CT/DG), Star Channel Update, Match reward system update, New player care system, 'Post up keeping’ and more events!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451488918541.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

Please check out the notes below for the details of the game update today!
 
[h1]1.'Post up keeping’ state has been added[/h1]
Now you can use new motion : Post up keeping by press [W] without pressing any direction key right after receiving the ball. 
All positions can use ‘Post up keeping’ now, and Control Tower can use 
the exclusive skill [Hand To Hand] right after [Post up keeping] motion.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451486328817.gif[/img]

[h1]2. New Position: Control Tower / Dual Guard[/h1]

[b]A. What is Control Tower and Dual Guard? [/b]

[b]Control Tower[/b] is often called the 'Passing Center'. 
This position has both a Centers Rebound ability and PG's Passing ability.
 
[b]Dual Guard [/b]specializes in driving skills and has both the SF’s and PG's abilities.
 
[b]B. How to create CT/DG?[/b]
1 .In order to these positions, player must have a certain position character with lv12 or above in his account.
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451496783596.PNG[/img]

2. It must be created with Lv.12 character. (Basic or Special Character)

[b]Special Characters[/b]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451496830003.jpg[/img]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451496802532.png[/img]

[i]** You can't create CT/DG/SW with buzzer beater character because 
there is no Lv.12 buzzer beater coupon.

**lv12 basic character. (Costs 48,000 Points to create lv.12 basic character.)[/i]

[b]C. New special skills for CT[/b]

video link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-s2zo-4_gCs

[b]1. Deny Intercept (lv.8)[/b]
Automatically catch the ball when you defend a pass
 
[b]2. Pass And Run (lv.16)[/b]
Make a short dash after making a pass
 
[b]3. Power Tab Pass (lv.28)[/b]
Tap the ball towards your teammate denying the opponents
 
4 .Hand To Hand Pass (lv.36)
Pass to a teammate while in a post up keeping position
(hold [W] key in Triple Threat state)
 
[b]D. New special skills for DG[/b]

Video Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Da_KiNuRNnM

[b]1. Rolling Diving Catch (lv.6)[/b]
-Catch a loose ball by somersaulting for it
** This skill’s catch distance is longer than PG’s Diving catch.

[b]2. Pass And Run (lv.16)[/b]
Make a short dash after making a pass
 
[b]3. No Mark Shot (lv.28)[/b]
Increases your chance to make a shot when you are not defended
 
[b]4. Jump Shoot & Pass (lv.36)[/b]
Pass during a fake jump shot 
 
[h1]3. Star Channel Update[/h1]
Channel was divided by 2 channels due to the increasing users of the Lv.25~39 
by new position. But after monitoring, it can be combined again. 
Channels division is as follows: 
[Pro: Lv. 25~39/ Star: Lv. 40~50] 

[h1]4. Match reward system update[/h1]
Instead of getting the reward by opening the box, items will be given to the 
locker directly after match.

[h1]5. Card sub-attribute changer system has been closed[/h1]
This function is not available anymore. 
 
[h1]6. New player care system[/h1]
Tutorial system for new player has been updated. 
It will teach you how to equip skills, purchase skills and use attribute point in detail. 
This system is only for the users whose highest level of characters is below Lv.6.

[h1]7. Megaphone Update[/h1]
The speed of in-game Megaphone motion has been adjusted.
If the content of your message is short, the text on your megaphone will not move.

[h1]8. Black Lightning SP Uniform pkg[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487338734.png[/img]
Did you know you can make any of the new positions (DG/SW/CT) 
with Black Lightning SPCs?
 
This is the great chance! Because you can buy the most awesome 
exclusive SPC uniform package! Check out the awesome package
here:http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2861

[h1]9. Sakun Outfit Capsule[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487414632.png[/img]
You can get the unique Sakun outfit through the capsule! 
Sakun attribute is +7 but adding attribute on Sakun outfit is cheaper than Rare items! 
Check out this: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2860

[h1]10. Make your own Items! Event[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487560901.png[/img]
You want to get an Animation item in DIY system but it is too hard?
Get new Animation items during the event period! 
There are 2 special items you can get ONLY in this event. 
Some of materials can be acquired ONLY in DIY Material Random Box.
You can get DIY Material Random Box by playing 4 times in team match or just purchase it with 30 Gkash!
Check this out for more information: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2859

[h1]11. Shop item update[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487740101.png[/img]
Mileage shop and item shop was updated.
Check out the new outfits for January at: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/item/2858

[h1]12. Log-in 7 Days Straight![/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451487872555.png[/img]
Login everyday and get what you want! If you miss a day for log-in, 
it will go back to Day 1 because it’s Cumulative Log-in Event!  
Please keep in mind!
** If you claim a reward, it will reset to Day 1. 
So you need to wait and log-in until you can get an item you want!
Check this link for the rewards for this event: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2857

[h1]13.FS Time[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1451488002799.png [/img]
This Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Enjoy 100%+ Exp & Point Buff!
Check this out for more details: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/2856

notes.title: Unlock the Room and Beat the Supporters
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1443546806523.jpg[/img]

The FS2 supporters and GMs will be hanging out in the tournament channel!
 
Use your wits to guess the room’s password by solving the clues the GMs give out.
 
Once 3 players get in the room it’s all about how good you play basketball!
 
[h1]Event Date: [/h1]
Date: January 10th.
Asia server: 4AM to 7AM (PST) (Asia 1 Server)
EU Server: 5PM to 7 PM (CET)
NA Server: 5PM to 7 PM (PST) 

[h1]Event Mechanics:[/h1]
1. GM will create a room with a 4 digit password in Event Mode channel.
2. Players will try to enter the room by guessing the password. 
3. The GM will give clues using the megaphone.
4. The first player who will enter the room will be added by the GM 
and he will be advised to proceed in the tournament channel and wait for the GM invitation
 for the match
[i]** The Player can invite his team members, or team up with random players.[/i]

[h1]Rewards:[/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1450800576539.jpg[/img]

The FS2 Supporter's team is not responsible for lost or stolen pride!
 
Be prepared!
 
Defend and Dominate!

[i]Be free to create your own style, Freestyle![/i]

[b]-Team Freestyle2[/b]

notes.content:
Hello, Ballers!
 
This is the project Manager of Freestyle2, Lucy! 
 
Please check out the notes below for the details of the December 16 game update!

[h1]1. Basic character creation limit increase[/h1]
In creating SW position normal character, the limit of creation will increase from 5 to 8.
 
Now, Players who has less than 8 Basic Characters can create a SW Basic Character.
 
Note: You can make as many SPC SW characters as you want there will be No limit.

[h1]2. VIP Membership Feature update[/h1]
VIP players won’t be able to kick out other players from the court.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1449149633138.png[/img]

Event Period: December 18 – 22 23:59

You better watch out and you better be Nice because
Santa Lucy is here to fill your Christmas with joy and cheer!

Tell her what you want for Christmas and the reason why you want it!
 
Santa Lucy will pick 5 good ballers and send the present by December 25th!

Here's How!

notes.title: December 2 Game Update: New SPC Update, Reporting System, Card Bug Fix, New Card Update, Xigncode has been added and events!
notes.content:
Hello, Ballers!

This is the project Manager of Freestyle2, Lucy! (You can still call me GM lucy if you want ♥)
 
I have prepared things you ballers really wanted, such as ‘new position’, ‘Grace’s Wallet’, ‘New character’, ‘Roll the dice’, ‘reporting system’ and so on! (yes, FREE Gkash too!)
 
So many reasons why we have to play Freestyle2 this month! 

Please check out the notes below for more details!

[h1]1. New Position: Swingman[/h1]

[b]A. What is Swingman? [/b] 
>It specialized in driving skills and has both the SF’s and SG’s abilities.

[b]B. How to create SW?[/b]
1.In order to make Swingman Position, player must have a
SG or SF character with lv12 or above in his account.
 
[b]2.It Must be created with lv12 character. (Basic or Special Character)[/b]

1) SPC
Players should purchase [u]lv.12 SPC Coupon[/u]
         
SW position SPC can be created:
- Naughty Kitties: Ginger/ Nicki
- Black Lightning: James Kim
- The West: Ox Queen
- Noble: Robert
** You can't create SW with buzzer beater character because there is no lv12 buzzer beater coupon.

3) lv12 basic character. (Costs 48,000 Points to create lv.12 basic character.)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447851393161.png[/img]

[b]C. New special skills only for SW[/b]

[b]1.Tripping Prevention (lv.16)[/b]
No tripping while drive collision
 
[b]2.Post Up Drive Combo (lv.24)[/b]
Able to connect to various dribble while post up drive
 
[b]3.Side Hop Step (lv.30)[/b]
While in Drive Dribble, jump toward the side quickly to keep distance from defender
 
[b]4.Scoop Shot (lv.34)[/b]
Layup shot with an underhand scooping motion

[b]D. SW Suggested Card[/b]
-	SP edition #3~#5 (Legend, Pro)
-	Summer Rafting (Legend, Pro)
-	The Witch (Legend, Pro)
-	I’m Here (Legend, Pro)
-	Toy Edition #1 ~#5 (Legend, Rookie)
And so on!

[h1]2. Card Related[/h1]

[b]A. Card skill bug fix[/b]
The card skill has been updated. We have fixed some issues related to card skill 
and now you should be able to use it. You can use certain skill once you complete
the card deck!

It doesn’t matter which position you are! 
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447851743509.png[/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447877449770.JPG[/img]

[b]B.  Card ball update[/b]
1. Fly to the Sky (Offense/Defense/Talent)
2. Summer Rafting (Offense/Defense/Talent) << Specialized Card for Swingman Position
6 cards have been added to card ball.

[b]C. Card Fusion[/b]

Players were not able to get these cards from Card Fusion because of minor bug.
These cards have been newly added to Fusion card result list, so players should
be able to get these cards from Card Fusion after this update.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447877472182.JPG[/img]

[h1]3. Reporting Players [/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447852549623.png[/img]

Now you can report players directly after the match.
You do not have to send additional report beside this.
 
1.You can report ill-mannered or hack users you played a match with. 
(Only recent 5 matches)
 
2.You can report same character only once per a day.
 
3.Please write a report with detailed description. 
 
Ex) please check [3:24] from this match’s replay file. He is sliding too much!
 
Once you report, server will automatically send us the replay file of 
suspicious player’s match. 

FS2 GM team will review and check/update how many times each player
has been reported.

[h1]4. Xigncode has been added.[/h1]
 
We changed our Anti-cheat engine from Hackshield to Xigncode.
 
This anti cheat engine is commonly used in many online games and is updated
constantly whenever especially when they find new illegal programs. 

The FS2 team is taking rapid action against the hackers and we are trying our best so
that honest Ballers are not affected by these hackers. 

We will keep updating our Anti-cheat engine from time to time. 
 
If you have any issues related to Xigncode, please don’t hesitate to contact us at 
steam_support@gamekiss.com.

[h1]5. OX Queen Update[/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447849624892.png[/img]

Ballers be ready! The "Ox Queen" is here to show off her Swingman Skills! 
She will be joining the “West” SPC!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/808

[h1]6. Grace’s Enchanted Point Wallet[/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447848685671.png[/img]

Need points and GKash?
No worries! You can get FREE Event Cash and free points from this Enchanted Wallet!

Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/807

[h1]7. Reindeer Christmas Package[/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447845593447.png[/img]
Get this Reindeer X-mas Pkg for limited time only and Be Santa’s favorite Reindeer this season!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/806

[h1]8. Roll the Dice![/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447846207851.png[/img]

Be a mighty baller that is powerful as a horse with this Gold Horse head from the 
Roll the Dice event!
Link: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/event/805

[h1]9. FS Time![/h1]
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1447844718830.png[/img]

Ready to enjoy?
 
Let’s have fun together and I’ll see you guys soon in the Game Lobby!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1446057554769.jpg[/img]

1. Asia1/Asia2 server: 150 Crew EXP on Dec 6th 23:59 (PST)
2. Your crew can only apply on one server.
Do not apply on multiple servers for this tournament. 

[i]** Don't apply more than one time with characters in same account[/i]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1446057619793.jpg[/img]

Top 8 Matches will be streamed at http://www.twitch.tv/gamekiss

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1446057731812.jpg[/img]
Crew with over 10 Crew members: 
1 team (3 Main player + 2 sub) 

Crew with over 20 Crew members: 
2 teams (6 Main player + 4 sub in total)

Crew with over 40 Crew members: 
3 teams (9 Main player + 6 sub in total)

**If more than 32 teams are applying for this event (for each server: NA/EU/Asia1/Asia2), 
we will select top 32 teams based on their crew EXP and 2nd or 3rd team 
of crew will not be selected depending on the situation to give 
other crews a chance to participate

** Event detail can be changed depends on the situation.

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1446057818460.jpg [/img]
1. All participants must be in Tournament Channel lobby following exactly the
event time. (Time for each team match will be announced later)
 
2. Once you invited to your crew waiting room, invite your teammates to the room.

3. If your one of team member doesn't show up in time,you may call a sub player
that you signed in when you apply for the event
 
4. If there are no sub players who can cover and not enough members to start the
match, your team will automatically lose

5. No 3rd party program is allowed for this event. (If we detect it, that crew
won't beable toparticipate in this tournament anymore and the violator
suspended)

6. Top 8: 1 match / Top 4, Final: Best out of 3

7. Matches will resume if a baller disconnects however if the baller does not return
after 10minutes and there are no registered sub players the team will be
disqualified.

8. Only the Crew Master can write an application for this event.

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440593272834.png[/img]
 
Ranked mode has been added to the game.

[h1]Pre-Season Period: September 9 to September 22, 23:59[/h1]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590192955.png[/img]

These are the things you need to know with the Ranked Mode!
 
1.You have to be level 24 or higher in order to play the Ranked mode.

2.Ranked Mode opens only at 6:00 – 9:00 / 19:00 – 22:00 (Server Time)
 
3.You can get the first rank after you finish the 10 placement matches.

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590344788.png [/img]

4. You can compete against others with the ELO score you earned from the ranked Match

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590394463.png [/img]

5.Ranked mode is divided into 7 different divisions.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590431700.png[/img]

6.Your rank depends on the ELO score that you earned in the ranking match.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590464976.png[/img]

7.Cool rewards are waiting for you!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590464976.png[/img]

**Note: You can only use the King’s cape for 30 days.

[h1]Ranked Mode will be closed after the Pre-season.[/h1]

This is a two weeks event so elevate your game and let the madness begin!

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440590518988.png [/img]

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1440592840420.png[/img]

[h1]Event Period: 9/9~10/6 23:59:59[/h1]
 
Calling all Newbies and Returnees!
 
This event is exclusively only for the New Ballers and Comeback players! 
 
[b]Qualifications:[/b]

[b]Returnees:[/b] Ballers who didn't log-in for more than 30 days
[b]Newbies: [/b] ballers who created their accounts starting September 9

notes.title: August 5 Game Update: Black Lightning, SPC vs Competition event, Grace's Enchanted Wallet, Hot Summer package and Random Box, 15% more Mileage and August Shop Item Update
notes.content:
[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437567948678.png [/img]

From the breath-taking Buzzer Beater team to the aristocrats’ Noble team, another extraordinary team 
will be added on Freestyle2 Basketball to make every match unforgettable!

Check out the video and meet the ultimate rival of the Noble ones, the indigent Black lightning team.

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=diX66PULmcU


It’s time to take sides and battle it out on the streets “Team Noble or Team Black Lighting” which team will you side with?
 
Come and join the “Special character competition” event and take your favorite team’s side and win this battle to prove who the best is!

[h1] Event Period: [/h1]
 
8/5~8/25 23:59:59

[h1]How to Participate:[/h1]
 
1.)	Select a team “Noble” or “Black Lighting” 
(The team you select will not affect game play)

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437566901305.png [/img]

2.)Start playing matches for your team! Win or lose you will earn points for the team you joined.
 
Note:
- Get 3 points for winning a match and 2 points for losing.
- Points can only be earned from 3v3 team matches
- If you have an SPC that belongs to the team you selected you will earn a bonus of 100pts!
 
3.)Earn points to unlock special items! So keep playing until you unlock them all by reaching the 
point requirement.

 [img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437566919230.png [/img]

4.)At the end of the event both teams will be rewarded win or lose, the winning team will receive a better reward.


[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437564278450.jpg [/img]

Being a Noble has it perks! Grace and her mega corporation has developed what she calls the
“Enchanted Wallet” how this wallet works no really knows except her and her team of scientists.
 
But what it does is quite impressive as it can help ballers from all over the world achieve almost a “Noble” status.

[h1] Event Mechanics:[/h1]

1.)	You must first Purchase one of “Grace’s Enchanted Wallets” to participate in this event 
and you can only buy one of the wallets for a limited time only 8/5 ~ 8/18. 

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437570074592.jpg [/img] 

2.) Log-in everyday to get Event Cash! You can get Free Event Cash each day for up to 30 days.
 
(Log-in for 30days and complete the reward list!)

[h1] Enchanted Wallet (100 Gkash) Reward list [/h1] 

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437563516105.jpg [/img]

[h1]  Super Enchanted Wallet (500Gkash) Reward list [/h1]

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437563532068.jpg[/img]

[h1]What is Event Cash and how do I use it?[/h1]
 
When buying a premium item you can only use regular Gkash or Event Cash.

1. Event Cash is the currency you earn from the “Enchanted Wallet” from logging-in.

2. If you have more Event Cash than the price of the item Event Cash will be consumed first.
 
3. If you have fewer Event Cash than the price of the item but have enough Gkash, your regular Gkash
    will be consumed.
 
4. If you both don’t have enough Event Cash or regular Gkash you will not be able to purchase the item.
   
5. Mileage [u] will not be awarded[/u] for using Event Cash

6. Event Cash will [u]expire after 60 days.[/u]



[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437561522086.png [/img]

Get this Hot Summer outfit that will brighten up your carefree summer days from the 
Hot Summer package and Random box! Check this link for more details: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/newsdetail.jce?newsId=670



[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437560409949.png [/img]

Event Period:
 8/5~8/11 23:59:59

Event Details:

Get 15% More Bonus Mileage for every cash-item purchased during the event period!
You will get 20% Mileage in total (5% Basic Mileage + 15% Bonus Mileage) for your every purchase!

The more cash items you purchased, the more bonus mileage you get!
So get ready and purchase items!

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1437559735738.png [/img]

Check out this link for the trendy outfits this August!: http://freestyle2.gamekiss.com/news/newsdetail.jce?newsId=667

notes.title: Crew Tryout day!
notes.content:
[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1435125876870.png [/img]


Greetings Ballers!

It's time for some tryouts! the FS2 2015 summer season crew tournament is just around the corner.

Get your crew member or tournament teammates to match up against the other teams before the main event.


[b] Event date:[/b]  July 17th (Sat)

[b] Application:[/b]  July 7th - July 12th 18:00 PDT

[b]Application link:[/b] https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1UNG9JxcjEzqG41IlHcR59yaBnSYHHK2D2SE0-0-mcsI/viewform

[i]* Only the crew master/leader can apply this event[/i]

[h1][b]Event details[/b][/h1]

[b]For Crew Masters[/b]

1. This event is a player hosted event. Each crew master are responsible for organizing the event.
2. Crew masters will receive [SAKUN Designer Head] for organizing the tryout event.
3. Your crew should have at least 500 Crew EXP for participating this event
4. To start the try out event, make a room with your crew name in Free Match mode
5. Crew masters must post a screenshot of their free match room on http://steamcommunity.com/app/339610/discussions/3/

[b]For Other players[/b]

1. Tryout Crew lists will be up on July 13th
2. If you are interested in certain crew, contact the crew master or just join the tryout room on the tryout time


So let's have fun ballin before the tournament! Where all the matches get real serious!


[i]Be free to create your own style, Freestyle![/i] 
 
[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

notes.title: Summer Season Crew Tournament
notes.content:
[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1434696569587.png[/img]

Greeting Ballers,

The will to win is not nearly so important as the will to prepare to win!
 
so be Prepared!
 
Secure your crew application for the Summer Season Crew Tournamen this July!
 
Here is the tournament details!

[h1] I. Application Period[/h1]

- July 3rd - July 19th 18:00 (PDT)

[h1] II. Application [/h1]

Only crew leader can apply for this event

NA server:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/18nB-Kg8Is6PYDTpgrD9GBaAZxSJ2hpxMiOLmSiY0nS4/


EU server: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/16IgDVpI8N2_v7BYGI9USNqRRVqNQHvaA617dgMLOw8o/closedform

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ZmSnYw4tRnp-A5MkfhZYFFY1FBGHFxz-FhGKkuUSDhs/viewform?c=0&w=1

Asia 2 Beta:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1gdJLbr2ADXUU0rbORbqANRqmmhPj_XtQXM-pzvhwnuI/viewform?c=0&w=1


[h1] III. Tournament Schedule [/h1]

NA Server
Top 32 Match Block A: July 25th (Sat) 6PM to 8PM (PDT)
Top 32 Match Block B: July 26th (Sun) 6PM to 8PM (PDT)
Top 8 Match: August 1st (Sat) 6PM to 8PM (PDT)
Top 4 & Final Match: August 2nd (Sun) 6PM to 8PM (PDT)

EU Server
Top 32 Match Block A: July 25th(Sat) 6PM to 8PM (CET)
Top 32 Match Block B: July 26th(Sat) 6PM to 8PM (CET)
Top 8 Match: August 1th(Sat) 6PM to 8PM (CET)
Top 4 & Final Match: August 2nd (Sun) 6PM to 8PM (CET)

Asia Beta 1 Server
Top 32 Match Block A: July 25th (Sat) 4AM to 6AM (PDT)
Top 32 Match Block B: July 26th (Sun) 4AM to 6AM (PDT)
Top 8 Match: August 1st (Sat) 4AM to 6AM (PDT)
Top 4 & Final Match: August 2nd (Sun)4AM to 6AM (PDT)

Asia Beta 2 Server
Top 32 Match Block A: July 25th (Sat) 2AM to 4AM (PDT)
Top 32 Match Block B: July 26th (Sun) 2AM to 4AM (PDT)
Top 8 Match: August 1st (Sat) 2AM to 4AM (PDT)
Top 4 & Final Match: August 2nd (Sun)2AM to 4AM (PDT)

** Brackets and Team list will be announced on July 20th
** Event detail can be changed depends on the situation.



[h1] IV. Event Rule  [/h1]

1. All participants must be in Tournament Channel lobby following exactly the event time.
   (Time for each team match will be announced later)

2. Once you invited to your crew waiting room, invite your teammates to the room. 

3. If your one of team member doesn't show up in time,
    you may call a sub player that you signed in when you apply for the event

4. If there are no sub players who can cover and not 
   enough members to start the match, your team will
   automatically lose

5. No 3rd party program is allowed for this event.
   (If we detect it, that crew won't be able to participate
   in this tournament anymore and the violator suspended)

6. Top 32, Top 16: 1 match / Top 8, Top 4, Final: Best out of 3  

7. Only the Crew Master can write an application for this event.

** Event detail can be changed depending on the situation.


[h1] Rewards [/h1]

**If more than 32 teams are applying for this event
 (for each server; NA: 32 Teams / EU: 32 Teams /
 Asia 1: 32 Teams  / Asia 2: 32 Teams)


[h1] 1st Place [/h1]

Winning team members: 
 
7000 Gkash + 20,000pt + Star Training Zip-up (Rare, White) +
FS2 Champion Belt 

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1434699289451.png [/img]

All Crew members: 
3 Card balls + 3 Item balls + V Mask

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1434699343115.png [/img]

[h1]2nd Place[/h1]	
 
Team members: 5000 Gkash + 10,000 pts
 
All Crew members: 1 Card ball + 1 Item ball
 
[h1]3rd Place[/h1]	
 
Team members: 2000 Gkash
 
[h1]Top 16 teams[/h1]
(Under 3rd Place)	
Team members: 5 Point Balls + 20 FreeStyle Tickets


So what are you waiting for?

Apply now!

[i]Be free to create your own style, Freestyle![/i]

[b]-Team FreeStyle2[/b]

It’s time to play street ball on the new Freestyle2 courts!

Rumors of a secret treasure can be uncovered in these mysterious courts.
 														
[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1434542318915.jpg [/img]


Play a match to randomly get a piece of the treasure map from each court!
 
**During the event period, only these four courts will be available to play in.

** The treasure map pieces are randomly given.

** You can only obtain the pieces by playing with other ballers in team match mode.

 
 Once you have completed the map, use them to acquire the treasure box.

You can obtain the following items from the Treasure box!
 
- Premium Card Random Box
 
-VIP Sponsor (3days)
 
-Card Attribute Badge (Offense)
 
-Card Attribute Badge (Defense)
 
-Card Attribute Badge (Talent)
 
-Freestyle Ticket*3
 
-Card Upgrade Spray *25
 
-1000 EXP Coupon

 
You can start all over again once you acquired the random box.

notes.title: Broadcast FS2 and get 10,000 Gkash!
notes.content:
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432561702726.png [/img]

[b]Date: June 7th – June 28th[/b]

Let’s share Freestyle2 with the other gamers on Youtube, Twitch and have lots of fun!
 
Each week, we will choose up to 3 winners from each division and send them free cardballs!
 
At the end of the event, we will choose 6 final winners and give them
[10,000 Gkash and a rare outfit set] each!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1434437013554.jpg[/img]

Here is reward list!
 
1st week Reward (June 8th - 14th)		

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432561889738.png[/img]
 
2nd week Reward (June 15th – 21st)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432561903712.png[/img]

Final week (June 22nd - 28th)

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432562036646.png[/img]


** Final week rankings will be based on how well a baller participated during
the 22nd – 28th and also whole event period.
 
Do you want to know how the Black Shadow Outfit set looks? Check it out!

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1432565093789.gif[/img]


**The [Black Shadow outfit set!] is a Rare Fx item! This item will be available on Itemball later. (around September)

[b][h1]How to participate?[/h1][/b]
 
[b][h1]For Twitch users[/h1][/b]

Make your own thread and write all the info below here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/339610/discussions/10/

1.	Character name:

2. # of max concurrent viewers of today's stream:
3.	Take a screenshot that shows off your stream screen and # of max concurrent viewers: 
4.	Your Twitch channel URL:
5.	# of channel follower:
6.	Twitch steam highlight URL: 
 
[b][h1]For Youtube users[/h1][/b]
2.	Make your own thread and write all the info below here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/339610/discussions/10/
 
1.	Character name:
2.	Youtube Video URL:
3.	Youtube Channel URL:
4.	# Of subscriber:
5.	# Of viewer at the end of this week. 

[**** Don't forget the video must be new video that is uploaded after June 8th***** ]
 
** If you want to update your info, just keep make a comment on your thread



[b][h1]How to get a good score?[/h1][/b]

We will pick the Top3 and Top 10 based on the following rules:
 
[b][h1]Twitch TV[/h1][/b]
 
1.	# Of Max concurrent viewer (Screenshot needed)
2.	# Of Channel followers
3.	Contents Quality 
(Make a highlight out of your stream via Twitch so we can check on your stream later)
4.	It has to be the one you streamed during the event period.

[b]What is Steam Trading Cards?[/b]

Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and tradable Steam community items.

[b]Do free to play games drop trading cards?[/b]

Free to play games drop game cards based on your in-game purchasing. For every $9 USD spent (approximate), you will earn one card drop. This card will drop at some point as you play.

[b]What is a badge?[/b]

A badge is an icon on your profile (and tied to your account) that represents the trading card sets you've collected or your participation in an event.

notes.title: Game Updates: Controller support, Legendary uniform pkg, New skills...
notes.content:
FS2 Joypad Control Update!

We have updated the Gamepad support for FreeStyle 2!

You can now assign the buttons of your game pad with any of the game keys to suite your own controller style.

 - Plug in the controller anytime you want to use it

 - Click on the new “Config Joypad” button

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430913546472.png[/img]

- On the new window that will appear you can select which key matches the button on your gamepadjust select the key and press the corresponding button on your gamepad to map it instantly.

 [img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430913563618.png[/img]

- Once you are done mapping the keys on to your gamepad press “OK” to finish the process.

 Now you are ready to play FreeStyle 2 Street Basketball with your gamepad!

 Pull off those stylish moves with ease and comfort 

**Works best for Xbox or Dualshock 4 controllers*



Legendary LA Uniform Package

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430910477640.jpg[/img]

Get the champion team's uniform available for Limited Time Only! Wear this Legendary Uniform Package and show off your Freestyle Skills!

[b]Date: 5/20 – 6/02 24:00 PDT[/b]
[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430909491694.gif[/img]

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430911006594.png[/img]

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430910069776.gif[/img]

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430911111338.png[/img]


[b]3/6/9 Event [/b]
You can still get up to [b]$25 worth of Items for Free![/b] Check this out!

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430309972637.png [/img]


Period: May 13th - May 26th

Complete each missions and get free awesome items!
 
1. Log in to Freestyle 2 for the 1st time during the event period and get Free “The West” Special character. ($14.50)
 
2. Play 3 Matches and get 10,000 points coupon. 
 
3. Play FS2 for an hour and get a free Black Shadow Mask ($5)
 
4. 9 days consecutive log-ins and get free skill slot! ($ 4.50)



[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430914615600.jpg[/img]

Collect the Letters and Get a New Skills & Exclusive Items!

Collect the letters and complete 2 sentences!

By completing [1st B-day PLAY FS2!], you can get a chance to acquire new skills!

1. Play a match to get event letters! You can get up to 2 letters as a match reward!

2.You can get [PLAYFS2!] letters from Item Ball
You can get letters [PLAYFS2!] by using Item Ball
You will be given one [Letter Random Box] per 1 Item Ball use
ex.  if you use 10 Item Balls, you will automatically get 10 bonus
[Letter Random Box]

3.You can also get [PLAYFS2!] letters by playing matches.
(lower chance)

Since we are giving 1 bonus letters for using 1 Item Ball for sure, it might be the fastest way
to complete the sentence!  However that doesn’t mean you can’t get [PLAYFS2!] letters by playing a match :D

4.Get a Random Box for completing first row
[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430912193734.png[/img]
 [img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430912622869.gif[/img]

5.   Get SP Random Box by complete all sentence.
  [img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1430912218003.png[/img]

6. Ballers can get a skill box from the SP random box. The skill box contains:

    Euro Step
            - Penetrate the defenders with zigzag steps.
              Position: SF/SG
              Level Requirement: 23

    Diving Catch & Pass
-Pass the ball immediately after diving catch.
 Position: PG
         Level Requirement: 23

    Outlet Pass
-Right after Rebound/Block&Catch, protecting the ball from the steal and pass to others.

              Position: PF/C
              Level Requirement: 23


Note: Only 1 skill is obtained per skill box the skill will be determined by the position of the character that opens the box.

Want to know more about new skills? Check this video!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F9TKbty5Msk

All About Thai Language Update

Today, we are grateful to announce that we will be adding the Thai language after the scheduled maintenance. In line with this update, we need Thai Players' support for the betterment of our Thai translation. 

If you have suggestions for the better Thai translation, kindly leave your suggestion to the "Language report" section of our Steam Community with the format here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/339610/discussions/8/

There is an easier way to patch the game just browse the FS2 local files and click on launchersteam.exe

How to do this? Follow these steps:

1. Right Click Freestyle2: Street Basketball and Click Properties

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785509035.png [/img]

2. Click Local Files Tab and choose Browse Local Files

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785710349.png [/img]

3. Double Click LauncherSteam.exe

[img] http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785750708.png [/img]

This will cause the game to patch and download the latest update directly and ignore older files on steam.

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429785797284.png[/img]

The latest version of FS2 is now

[img]http://img.gamekiss.com/fs2/1429786081407.png[/img]

By following the steps above, you do not have to download the 16GB patch files.

- Team FreeStyle 2

notes.title: Beta Asia Server and Joypad control option
notes.content:
Greetings Ballers,

We would like to take this opportunity to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone, especially for your support to our STEAM launch. 

We know that most of you ballers are asking what would be our future updates. 

[b] Are we planning to add more servers? [/b]

Today, we wish to inform everyone that we are planning to have a 
[h1][ Beta Asia Server ][/h1] 

 We know that we mentioned on other notice that we have no plans in adding Asian server. 
However, we found out there is a matching issue in the NA server because there are many users from Asian countries. 

To make the gaming experience better, we decided to add Beta server to test Asian server and [u][b]there might be some changes during the service. [/b][/u]
(This is the reason why we call this server as "Beta" Asia server.)
***Taiwan/China/Korea will be IP blocked because there are Asian publishers who are currently servicing FS2.

Beta Asia server will open really soon, so stay tuned!

Everyone can still use their GK account/Steam account on both NA / Beta Asia server since account data will be shared in any server.
 
We think that this would offer everyone a better Freestyle2 basketball experience!

Furthermore, like what we have said, every suggestion are greatly appreciated, thus, we are also considering to add another NA Server.
We are trying our best to give everyone the BEST Basketball experience.

Plus, we are planning to add joypad control option and dev team is already working on it now. 
(half way done already!)

Once again, Thank you for your continued support!
Elevate your game with Freestyle 2.


 -Team FreeStyle2

notes.title: Contacting support and posting issues on the forums
notes.content:
Greetings Ballers,

Do you have a bug to report?
Problems with your account, billings issues or wish to report suspicious activity? Please remember that the GM team is always willing to help you solve your issues via the ticketing support service.

Send us ticket via e-mail here: steam_support@gamekiss.com


Why do you have to file a ticket instead of post the problem on the forums?


1.) Most of time, we require private information that should not be shared with the public (UserID, Card info, etc.) in order to fix the problem.
(Your forum account and game account is different so you will be asked to file a ticket on the forums anyway.)


2.) Reporting Hack program users: We would like to thank you for reporting us hackers, but posting it on the forum causes a flame war.
If you do post on the forums we will close the thread and ask you to send us ticket with the replay file of the match (if you played against the suspicious player)
Your report will be forwarded to Dev team and we will check his game logs and collect all the data of his other activities.


3.) Most of forum users are eager to help you with your problem!
However a random poster can be providing you with misleading or dangerous information, such as sharing files or unofficial patches and modifications.


4.) The forums are a public discussion board where players communicate with one another and not a support center.
The forums are a public message board for players to communicate with each other and we would like the forums to be about player discussions 


So please remember to file a ticket if you require assistance from instead of posting issues on the forums.

You can send us ticket via e-mail here: steam_support@gamekiss.com

- Team FreeStyle 2
